I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politiebureau verdwijnt uit het straatbeeld: bijna 200 bureaus gesloten'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that nearly 200 police stations are closing, questioning police accessibility for citizens and whether the closures are a cost-cutting measure of 76 million euros. The Minister responds that police are modernising, that closures are part of a shift toward presence in neighbourhoods via alternative points of contact, and that service quality is not compromised.
The move to be more present in the neighbourhoods and less at police stations does not come at the expense of service quality.
De beweging om meer aanwezig te zijn in de wijken en minder op bureaus gaat niet ten koste van de kwaliteit van dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Moerdijk vraagt hulp bij problemen met Albanese inklimmers’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Moerdijk needs help with Albanian stowaways climbing into lorries and ships, and whether the ministry would take a national lead, talk with the port authorities and promote awareness campaigns. The minister says controls at maritime border posts have been intensified, that several bodies are working on the problem, that outreach to drivers is underway, and that tailored solutions per location and secure truck parking are being pursued, without committing to new specific steps.
Various bodies are working on measures for the stowaway issue.
In diverse gremia wordt er gewerkt aan maatregelen voor het «inklimmersvraagstuk».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Tientallen criminelen krijgen uitkering ondanks openstaande celstraf'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice why convicted criminals with outstanding prison sentences still receive benefits, how much this costs, and what will be done to stop and recover payments. The minister answers that benefits are terminated under a 2011 scheme, 837 benefits were withdrawn in 2016-2017, courts have in some cases ruled withdrawal unlawful, and a CJIB-UWV pilot with letters to offenders will continue.

To withdraw or refuse benefits of convicted persons with an outstanding prison sentence, benefit agencies match CJIB files of fugitives from the investigation register against files of benefit recipients.

Om de uitkeringen van veroordeelden met een openstaande vrijheidsstraf in te trekken of te weigeren, matchen uitkeringsinstanties CJIB-bestanden van voortvluchtigen uit het opsporingsregister met de bestanden van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie werkt in asbestpand, rapport werd ‘stilgehouden’'

MP Helder (PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether reports that police staff work in an asbestos-containing building, and that a report was withheld, are true, and whether the health risk and the timing of roof replacement are acceptable. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged that the asbestos report was known only within police facility management, that communication with staff and the works council was lacking, and that the asbestos roofs will be removed in the short term, possibly in 2018.
Unfortunately, communication about the measurements and the need to replace the roofs did not immediately take place with the employees; this was careless.
Helaas heeft over de metingen en de noodzaak om de daken te vervangen niet meteen communicatie met de medewerkers plaatsgevonden, dit was onzorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Te weinig nieuwe wapenstokken voor politie.’

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether a shortage of new extendable batons for police, and an apparently botched procurement, left trained officers carrying old batons, and whether the new batons would be delivered by end of August 2018. The minister answered that deliveries are phased per the manufacturer agreement, that local shortages may occur where training runs faster than planned, and that officers may swap for the new baton if their unit is short.
The delivery of the extendable batons proceeds in phases and in line with the planning and agreement with the manufacturer.
De levering van de uitschuifbare wapenstokken verloopt gefaseerd en conform planning en afspraak met de fabrikant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Extreem links vaak vrijuit'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice why the public prosecution service does not prosecute far-left extremists reported as often going unpunished, and whether the minister would instruct prosecutors to pursue them. The minister answered that far-left extremism is not treated differently from other extremism, that lawful activism is permitted and police and prosecutors act where the law is broken, and that he does not interfere in prosecutorial decisions, referring to earlier answers.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I do not interfere in the independent judgment and responsibilities of the public prosecutor.
Ik treed als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet in de onafhankelijke oordeelsvorming en verantwoordelijkheden van de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politiecellen Tilburg tijdelijk dicht: dit is schrijnend'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about police cells in Tilburg being temporarily closed, forcing an arrestee to spend a night in a police station, and whether this can be avoided. The minister explained a miscommunication caused the one-hour stay, said Tilburg cells close for renovation from 29 July to 18 August with transfers to Breda or other complexes, and said police housing policy is being revised.
These arrangements have been brought again to the attention of the officers.
Deze afspraken zijn opnieuw onder de aandacht gebracht van de agenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie: witwassen via boot is kinderspel'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why there is still no mandatory registration of boats despite police warnings since 2015, and whether the government is responsible for boat-related fraud and money laundering and will legislate. The minister replied that only fast motorboats require registration, that rules were recently tightened on ownership details, and that an evaluation next year will assess whether the improvements suffice.
An evaluation next year must make clear whether the improvements are sufficient from the police's point of view.
Een evaluatie volgend jaar moet duidelijk maken of de verbeteringen uit oogpunt van de politie voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘OM ziet opvallende stijging aantal corruptiezaken binnen politie en douane en het Jaarbericht OM 2017’

MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service's 2017 annual report noted a rise in corruption and leak cases without giving reasons, and whether research would be done. The minister answered that Rijksrecherche cases rose from 31 in 2011 to 45 in 2017, pointed to a 2017 WODC report finding no significant increase in integrity violations, and declined further study while noting the report was already sent to Parliament.
I see no reason to conduct further research in addition to the report mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Ik zie geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen in aanvulling op het in het antwoord op vraag 2 genoemde rapport
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Anticorruptieteam nodig'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether he agrees with an expert that a dedicated anti-corruption and anti-drug-smuggling team conducting proactive investigations is needed in the Rotterdam port. The minister replied that current investigative tools are sufficient, that a special team would add no value according to the prosecution service and police, and pointed to broader measures against undermining crime.
According to the OM and the police, the current investigative tools are sufficient to tackle official and non-official corruption, and setting up a special team currently adds no value.

Volgens het OM en de politie zijn de huidige opsporingsmiddelen daarbij voldoende om ambtelijke en niet-ambtelijke corruptie aan te pakken en heeft het inrichten van een speciaal team op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Agenten bezorgd over privacy: uniformen nog steeds thuis bezorgd'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether centralised pickup of police uniforms by unit or station, rather than home delivery, would be safer, following reports of officers' privacy concerns. The minister answered that since July 2017 officers choose between home or police-station delivery by tracked, screened courier, and that most parcels (88,068) went to homes versus 7,471 to stations.
Since 1 July 2017, the receiving police officer can choose between delivery of a parcel to the home address or to a police station.
Sinds die datum kan de ontvangende politieambtenaar kiezen tussen het afleveren van een postpakket op het huisadres of op een politiebureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Extra budget is al op’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the extra NFI budget was already exhausted, forcing police and prosecutors to choose which forensic samples to submit, and about alternatives such as outsourcing autopsies to universities, cutting NFI management, and costs of a professor, a letter-dating technique and the NFI Academy. The Minister acknowledged rising demand and capacity limits, said choices remain necessary, rejected outsourcing autopsies to universities on infrastructure and expertise grounds, and promised a new vision on forensic research to the House in autumn 2018.
I will inform your House about that in autumn 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar in het najaar van 2018 over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Agent kan fluiten naar feest'

An MP asked whether the Justice Minister would help a police officer reach his 50-year service jubilee, five working days away, and whether a gesture of thanks would be sent. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, praised the long service, described the police farewell guidelines and the rule that staff over pension age leave unless service interests require otherwise.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend is kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Jong en Helder over het bericht 'Bizar probleem defensie: Schietende jassen'

MPs asked about a report that winter jackets issued to military and police personnel could accidentally fire weapons via loose cords, and about the injury, measures taken, the Inspectorate SZW investigation, and whether the jackets remain in use. The government said the injured soldier has recovered, the Marechaussee banned firing in these jackets, about 4000 soldiers still have them with elastic removal required, the police do not use them, and it announced a plan for a safer defence organisation while withholding the inspectorate's timing and dates.
Making working conditions safer is therefore a top priority for the coming years.
Het veiliger maken van de werkomstandigheden is dan ook topprioriteit voor de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten "Aanrander nog hier" en "Doodsbang voor het monster uit Hoorn."

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why a convicted rapist, Mohammed M., was still in the Netherlands after his unconditional sentence ended, and why the victim was not actively informed and was left in fear. The State Secretary answered that he was placed in immigration detention, could not be deported due to a subsequent asylum application rejected through the courts, and was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018, while denying that the prosecution had promised the victim deportation.
The prosecutor's office informed the victim about the convicted person's release on 22 February 2018 once he had served the unconditional part of his sentence.
De zaaksofficier van justitie heeft het slachtoffer geïnformeerd over de invrijheidsstelling van de veroordeelde op 22 februari 2018

Antwoord op vragen van Helder en Beertema over het bericht op de website van de politie inzake 'Politie-iftar 2018' en het bericht op de Instagram-account van de jeugd-agent Apeldoorn inhoudende dat de politie Apeldoorn

PVV MPs Helder and Beertema asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police website item and an Apeldoorn youth-officer Instagram post promoting a police iftar, questioning police neutrality and the role of such events in tackling Moroccan-Dutch youth gangs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local police units may organise community events such as iftars to stay connected with society, that police must keep lifestyle neutrality, and that no special target-group policy exists in youth crime prevention.
The police is for and of everyone and must, including when it organises meetings with population groups, maintain its neutrality.
De politie is van en voor iedereen en moet, ook als zij ontmoetingen met bevolkingsgroepen organiseert, haar neutraliteit bewaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over het bericht 'Heibel om afschieten honden op Bonaire'

MPs Helder and Graus asked whether the chief prosecutor on Bonaire acted unlawfully by telling police that loose dogs could be shot, and why Caribbean Netherlands lacks the animal welfare rules of Europe Netherlands. The Minister replied that the e-mail was a clumsy internal instruction about reporting, not an order to lie, and that European and Dutch animal welfare rules do not apply in Caribbean Netherlands, which relies on local regulation and the Penal Code BES.
The chief prosecutor in that e-mail certainly did not intend to create the suggestion that reporting should be done contrary to the truth.
De hoofdofficier heeft in het betreffende e-mailbericht dan ook geenszins de intentie gehad de suggestie te wekken dat er in strijd met de waarheid geverbaliseerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Politiechef wil meer agenten in buitenland’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether extra funding in the coalition agreement for deploying police officers abroad comes at the expense of the national police budget, and whether this burdens overstretched local police. The Minister confirms the structural 267 million euro investment, says it is not at the expense of other police budgets to be detailed in June 2018, and argues that deployment abroad benefits Dutch local safety.
In my letter of 20 December 2017 I already committed to informing the House in around June 2018 in more detail about these aspects.
In mijn brief van 20 december 2017 2 heb ik reeds toegezegd uw Kamer rond juni 2018 nader over deze aspecten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Winkeldiefstal daalt helemaal niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the CBS crime figures understate shoplifting, given industry claims that reporting is hard and that retailers have stopped filing reports. The minister acknowledged a gap between registered and actual crime, pointed to an ongoing WODC study due in May 2018 and to easier reporting channels, but said he could not verify the industry's sampling method and saw no need for a new measurement instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politie: wij hebben allochtonen nodig'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a report that police need allochtonen, questioning positive discrimination, the overrepresentation of people with migration backgrounds in integrity violations, dual nationality, Islam, and prayer time for officers. Minister Grapperhaus answered that diversity is operationally necessary, selection standards are unchanged and integrity risks are addressed through measures, while rejecting the idea that dual nationality is undesirable and stating there is no policy on prayer during duty hours.
Above all, the selection criteria and quality of the police are not compromised.
Voorop staat dat aan de selectiecriteria en kwaliteit van de politie niet getornd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Brandweer smijt met miljoenen'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the Amsterdam-Amstelland fire service paid out 3.9 million euro unlawfully, whether the amount is recoverable, how the former commander failed to intervene, and how to prevent such practices. The minister answered that the veiligheidsregio is the employer and accountable to its municipal councils, that the misconduct is unacceptable, and that the schemes have been stopped, while not addressing the recoverability question in substance.
The Amsterdam-Amstelland safety region is, under the Safety Regions Act, the employer of the fire service personnel.
De veiligheidsregio Amsterdam-Amstelland is volgens de Wet veiligheidsregio's werkgever van het brandweerpersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘het OM neemt minder in beslag van crimineel’

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service is seizing less criminal assets, given a report of declining seizures and the 115.6 million euro target for 2018. The minister replied that the cited figures refer only to the Den Haag district, that national confiscation proceeds have not declined and exceeded targets, and saw no reason for an interim report.
The amounts mentioned in the article are correct, but only concern the value of goods seized by the Den Haag district prosecutor's office in the period 2014 to 2017.
De in het artikel genoemde bedragen kloppen, maar zien enkel op de waarde van de in beslag genomen goederen door het arrondissementsparket Den Haag in de periode 2014 tot 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie kiest voor nieuwe definitie van etnisch profileren'

The MP asks about a police report stating that ethnicity plays a role in selecting suspicious situations, and about the police's new definition of ethnic profiling, questioning whether it is workable given the words 'mede' and 'zonder goede en geldige reden'. The Minister replies that the report does not claim deliberate structural ethnic profiling, that proactive checks must rest on objectifiable grounds, and that the police-developed handling framework, which the Minister presumes workable, sets the principles and definition.
Making distinctions without objective justification in (proactive) police action is unacceptable.
Onderscheid maken zonder objectieve rechtvaardiging bij (proactief) politieoptreden is ontoelaatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Burgemeesters willen rol als crimefighter’

Helder (PVV) asked whether the minister knows of the ten regional mayors' proposal to give mayors an explicit role in combating undermining crime via the Municipalities Act and whether he agrees, and what he will do. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed he has read the proposal, said the government treats undermining crime as a priority, and said the signals and bottlenecks, including the proposal, will be taken into account in an upcoming action agenda rather than committing to specific changes now.
This action agenda will, among other things, provide information on the undermining legislation.
In deze actieagenda zal onder meer informatie worden verstrekt over de ondermijningswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Bezoek aan Ertugrul Gazi CamiiMoskee'

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police neutrality was compromised by a Haaksbergen police visit to a mosque and whether this conflicts with anti-discrimination policy. The Minister confirmed the facts, reaffirmed the importance of police neutrality and a diverse police force, and said local activities are left to police units themselves, with no national ban on posing with Zwarte Piet.
Both the police and I remain steadfast in the neutrality of police officers in public contact.
Zowel de politie als ik hechten onverminderd aan de neutraliteit van de politieambtenaar in publiekscontact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Moordzaken gedwongen in de ijskast'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police had to halt investigations into four serious crimes due to lack of capacity, and what would be done. The minister confirmed that four of nineteen tactical investigations in the Limburg unit were temporarily suspended to free capacity for other serious cases, denied budget cuts to operational capacity, and said investigations are not fully stopped and new tips will still be followed up.

In this specific situation, the police and the Public Prosecution Service, given the number of serious offences in the Limburg unit, chose to temporarily halt the tactical investigation in four of the nineteen cases so that this capacity could be freed up for other serious cases.

In deze specifieke situatie hebben politie en OM, gelet op het aantal ernstige delicten in de eenheid Limburg, gekozen om het tactisch onderzoek in vier van de negentien zaken tijdelijk stil te leggen zodat deze capaciteit kon worden vrijgemaakt voor andere zware zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat een niet bestaand land lid is geworden van Interpol

PVV MPs asked why the Palestinian Authority could join Interpol, whether the Netherlands supports this, and when aid would be cut given attacks on Israel. The government said the bid had sufficient support in Interpol's General Assembly, the Dutch delegations abstained because the Kingdom does not recognise a State of Palestine, and it sees no reason to revise relations with the Palestinian Authority.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to revise the relationship with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen aanleiding om de relatie met de Palestijnse Autoriteit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat Erdogan Interpol misbruikt om jacht te maken op politieke tegenstanders

MPs De Roon, Helder and Markuszower asked whether Turkey misuses Interpol systems to pursue political opponents, what safeguards exist, and whether Dutch nationals have been affected. The government answered that it shares concern, describes Interpol's safeguards (Constitution article 3, Secretary General review, the CCF complaints commission) and Dutch pre-checks of Red Notices, and says it knows of no cases involving Dutch nationals.
The cabinet is concerned about reports, such as this one, that Turkey uses INTERPOL for arrest requests that violate article 3 of the INTERPOL Constitution.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over berichten, zoals onderhavig rapport, dat INTERPOL door Turkije wordt gebruikt voor arrestatie-verzoeken die een schending vormen van artikel 3 van de INTERPOL Constitutie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut vervoert lijken voor sectie naar België”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Netherlands Forensic Institute sends bodies to Belgium for autopsies, why two offered Dutch pathologists were not used, and whether autopsies should be done domestically. The minister replied that a Belgian university hospital was chosen for its expertise and capacity, that talks with one pathologist took place, and that the shortage is temporary after a pathologist's death, with trainees fully deployable from mid-2018.
After careful consideration, it was decided to cooperate with the University Hospital in Antwerp.
Na een gedegen afweging is gekozen voor samenwerking met het Universitair Ziekenhuis in Antwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht “Terreurvader Bunschoten vrij met enkelband”

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an ankle monitor and location ban are sufficient to protect the children of a suspect in a child abuse case, after he was released from preventive custody. The State Secretary answered that the independent judge decided on the release under strict conditions, that sentencing is for the courts, and that the government does not decide on pre-trial detention.
The independent judge, and not the government, decides in the Netherlands whether suspects must await their trial in custody.
De onafhankelijke rechter, en dus niet de regering, beslist in Nederland of verdachten hun berechting in de cel moeten afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politiedienst slaat alarm: duizenden buitenlandse terreurtips genegeerd'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the police international legal assistance centre (LIRC) has thousands of backlogged terrorism-related requests and signals and whether this structural understaffing endangers security. The minister confirmed the backlog figures, said terrorism requests get top priority, and stated 32 vacancies have been filled with the remaining 8 expected by early 2018, with a letter to follow.
Requests related to terrorism receive the highest priority and are handled immediately.
Verzoeken in het kader van terrorisme krijgen de hoogste prioriteit en worden direct opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Vaak te laat bij brand'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Safety and Justice whether fire services often arrive late at emergencies, whether they can fail to deploy due to staff shortages, and whether the government will engage with volunteer firefighter unions. The minister says an Inspectorate study on the quality of fire response, including arrival times and staffing, is expected by year end; responsibility for staffing and arrival-time registration lies with regional safety boards, and a meeting with unions will be held with results reported to parliament.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice is currently conducting research into the quality of repressive fire brigade care.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie doet op dit moment onderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de repressieve brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht “Twee conducteurs mishandeld door treinreizigers”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports of conductors and police being assaulted on trains, asking why measures have not stopped it, whether travel bans and harsher penalties will be imposed, whether NS security staff will get batons and pepper spray, whether a perpetrator profile and a real-time database of travel bans will be created. The government answered that eight and 23 measures are being implemented or evaluated, that travel-ban evaluation will be shared in autumn, that NS security staff have no need for pepper spray, that a perpetrator profile report was already delivered, and that a database will be considered in the travel-ban evaluation.
These measures are currently being evaluated. You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Deze maatregelen worden momenteel geëvalueerd. Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Milieuactivisten maken voor tienduizenden euro’s schade’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked whether police knew in advance of a Code Rood activist break-in at an Amsterdam port business park, why police did not intervene sooner, how few arrests were made, and whether damages can be recovered. Minister Blok answered that the mayor is responsible for police operations, referred specific questions to the local authority, reported 13 arrests, and noted victims can claim damages through criminal or civil routes.
The mayor is responsible for directing the police with regard to public order in his or her municipality.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van de politie ten aanzien van de openbare orde in zijn of haar gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Helder en Wilders over een aanranding door een Somalische asielzoeker in Hoorn

PVV MPs asked why a Somali asylum seeker was arrested only months after a sexual assault in Hoorn despite the victim's early tip, why he kept a residence permit while already a suspect, and whether his permit will be revoked. The state secretary explained the DNA-based arrest timeline, said the permit will be reviewed for withdrawal now that the conviction is final, and rejected calls to close borders.
Now that the judgment in this case has become final, the IND will examine whether the residence permit of the person concerned can be withdrawn.
Nu in deze zaak het vonnis onherroepelijk is geworden, zal de IND onderzoeken of de verblijfsvergunning van de betrokkene kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het aantal gevallen van ladingdiefstal explosief stijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether cargo theft is rising sharply, whether foreign gangs are responsible, whether thefts occur while trucks are moving, and how police handle reports and cross-border cooperation. The minister answered that Q1 2017 cases were 46 percent above Q1 2016 but 15 percent below Q4 2016, that the police see some foreign perpetrators but mostly Dutch ones, and described a new reporting desk and European cooperation.
In the second quarter of 2017, no further reports have been received in which there is a suspicion that the cargo was already stolen while driving.
In het tweede kwartaal 2017 zijn geen aangiften meer binnengekomen waarbij het vermoeden bestaat dat de lading al rijdend is gestolen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over boeren in Limburg die drones gaan gebruiken in de strijd tegen criminelen die in hun maisvelden stiekem hennepplantages onderbrengen

PVV MPs Helder and Graus asked whether police helicopter flights to detect cannabis cultivation in Limburg maize fields were stopped for lack of funds, and how farmers would be protected. The Minister replied that flights were halted because detections had been very few, that helicopters can still be used on concrete indications, and that farmers share responsibility for protecting their property.
Because the number of cannabis plantations detected in this way was very small, it was decided to stop these control flights.
Omdat het aantal wietplantages dat op deze wijze werd opgespoord zeer gering was, is besloten te stoppen met deze controlevluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de basisteams van de politie ernstig tekortschieten

The MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a report shows serious shortcomings in police basic teams, including a shortage of detectives that leaves petty crime unaddressed, and how this will be fixed. The Minister replies that the report does not conclude there is a severe detective shortage or harm to crime fighting, notes citizens rate the police 6.9, and refers to a separate fuller response.
In the conclusions of the report I therefore see no basis for the above claim.
In de conclusies van het rapport zie ik dan ook geen grondslag voor bovenstaande stellingname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 agenten nog niet gescreend’

An MP asked the minister about reports that over 600 police officers, including 65 in the highest-category trust positions, had not yet been screened, and about the rising number of officers suspected of crimes. The minister confirmed some officers still await screening, said the number is lower than reported, stated A-screenings are expected to finish around summer 2017, and gave 2016 figures showing 279 police employees suspected in 791 criminal investigations.
The number of employees concerned is lower than stated in the article.
Het aantal medewerker waar het om gaat is lager dan in het artikel wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Politie slaat door met positieve discriminatie'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police vacancy text in Amsterdam that excluded native Dutch applicants and was later amended, and whether diversity policy should be abolished. The minister confirmed the vacancy text was discriminatory, said it was revised after the police judged it violated the duty of care, and defended diversity steering as operationally necessary while not addressing abolition of the policy.
Regarding the vacancy text in question, the police judged that it did not meet the duty of care requirement, after which the vacancy text was amended.
Wat de betreffende vacaturetekst betreft, heeft de politie geoordeeld dat hiermee niet werd voldaan aan de zorgvuldigheidseis, waarna de vacaturetekst is aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Amsterdamse politie wil hoofddoekje toestaan bij uniform'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the Amsterdam police was considering allowing headscarves as part of the uniform and how this fits with police neutrality rules and diversity policy. The minister said the police adheres to the lifestyle-neutrality code, that no concrete plan exists, that diversity policy does not override rules, and that he sees no reason to deviate from the code.
There was no concrete proposal or plan regarding this subject.
Er was geen concreet voorstel of plan met betrekking tot dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Voortvluchtige criminelen ontlopen gevangenisstraf’

The MP asks whether convicted criminals who evade their prison sentences can be tracked down, whether execution limitation periods and a mandatory appearance at sentencing should be introduced, and whether the self-reporting procedure should be stricter and more police capacity provided. The Secretary of State says that all convicted persons must serve their sentence, explains the tracing and signalling approach and the differentiated limitation periods, rejects a statutory duty to appear and stricter sentencing for non-reporting, and promises a progress letter in summer 2017 and a new chain-management table with the police.
Yes, I share the view that no convicted criminal should evade their sentence.
Ja, ik deel het standpunt dat geen enkele veroordeelde crimineel zijn straf dient te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ’Wat is er staatsgeheim aan de dood van de 8-jarige Sharleyne?'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that a public prosecution office classified documents in the Sharleyne death investigation as state secret, and why the father was refused access under the Wob. The minister answered that the refused OM-journaal was an internal quality tool, that the state-secret reference was an error from placing it in a classified ICT environment, and that the father's access rights were not violated.
The OM Noord-Nederland additionally referred to the circumstance that the document would have been classified as a state secret.
Het OM Noord-Nederland heeft daarbij ten overvloede verwezen naar de omstandigheid dat het betreffende document zou zijn gerubriceerd als staatsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Helder over twijfels bij het overlijden van een jongen in een instelling

MPs Agema and Helder asked about the death of a boy in an institution, the discontinued NODO procedure for investigating child deaths, its funding and responsibility, and 20 reported suspicious deaths submitted by relatives. The government answered that NODO was ended in 2014 after evaluation, replaced by the NODOK scheme focused on parents' grief, that in this case a non-natural death was established, and that further investigation would follow regular criminal procedures, without giving case details for privacy reasons.
Regarding further investigation in this specific situation, we cannot make any statements, in view of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over nader onderzoek in deze specifieke situatie kunnen wij, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een cocaïnebaron die zijn enkelband sloopt en vlucht

An MP asks why a convicted cocaine trafficker who fled after removing his ankle monitor was allowed to await trial under electronic monitoring, and whether the monitor should be abolished. The minister acknowledges the frustration, says the suspect is being actively sought, states that the court independently decided to suspend detention, and rejects abolishing the monitor as disproportionate.
Whether or not to suspend pre-trial detention is, however, a decision of the independent judge.
Het wel of niet schorsen van de voorlopige hechtenis is echter een beslissing van de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten 'Cijfers onder de pet' en 'Stempel nationale veiligheid excuus'

PVV MPs asked why police refused to share data on crimes by asylum seekers after a Telegraaf FOIA request, and whether this undermines police and mayors' information. The minister says the police initially interpreted the request narrowly, is re-assessing it with priority, and that information is shared with local authorities though no separate registration of asylum seekers' crimes exists.
In response to the Telegraaf's FOIA request, the police replied that they do not record the residence status of persons when arresting or stopping them.
Op het WOB-verzoek van de Telegraaf heeft de politie geantwoord dat zij bij aanhoudingen en staandehoudingen de verblijfstatus van betrokkenen niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht magere score voor politie in de buurt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a news report that residents of South Limburg are the least satisfied with local police, and about drug-related nuisance, the number of neighbourhood officers, and measures to raise satisfaction. The minister confirmed the low regional score, said the cause is not clear from the data, pointed to a target of 97% neighbourhood officer staffing by end 2017, and answered the measures question only in general terms.
However, the results do not show what makes one region score higher than another.
Uit de uitkomsten is echter niet op te maken wat maakt dat de ene regio hoger scoort dan de andere.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Jeugdbendes veroorzaken megaschade”

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a press report on youth gangs causing large damage, whether the promise to remove youth gangs from the streets was kept, whether parents should be held liable, and whether dual-nationality offenders can lose Dutch nationality. The minister answers that the integrated approach has reduced problematic youth groups by 18%, explains parental civil liability by age, and states that the Rijkswet does not allow revoking nationality for ordinary crimes.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over een interventie door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in een onderzoek naar een smeergeldaffaire waarin het Saoedisch koningshuis betrokken zou zijn

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether the Foreign Ministry intervened to halt a bribery investigation involving Saudi royals, including cancelling the hearing of a Saudi witness, and whether a criminal investigation may be blocked for diplomatic reasons. The ministers answered that the decision not to send a mutual legal assistance request followed the normal procedure, weighing security risks to the witness rather than diplomatic relations, and declined to launch a separate inquiry.
Contrary to what the questions suggest, relations with the country to be approached are not decisive in weighing whether a legal assistance request is submitted.
Anders dan in de vragen wordt gesuggereerd, zijn verhoudingen met het aan te zoeken land niet van doorslaggevend belang bij de afweging of een rechtshulpverzoek wordt ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opheldering geëist over dood 14-jarige Luciano”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the death of a 14-year-old was explained to the parents, whether an autopsy was performed, and whether autopsies should be mandatory for minors. The minister declined to discuss the facts citing family privacy, said the prosecutor is handling the parents' access request and the inspections will brief the mother, and stated autopsy is ordered when suspicion of crime or third-party involvement exists regardless of age.
Regarding the facts, I cannot make any statements in the context of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over de feiten kan ik, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat er gesjoemeld wordt bij de reclassering

An MP asked whether the state secretary would release the results of investigations into alleged misconduct at Reclassering Den Haag and whether the probation service's financial audit was external. The state secretary replied that two independent investigations (KPMG and the DJI integrity bureau) found no sign of informal trade, but the reports belong to Reclassering Nederland and will not be released by the ministry.
RN is the commissioning party and owner of the reports; therefore I do not possess the investigation reports and it is not for me to make them public.
RN is opdrachtgever en eigenaar van de rapporten; zodoende ben ik niet in het bezit van de onderzoeksrapporten en is het niet aan mij deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Vuurwapen en munitie in cel gedetineerde” en het bericht “Drie overvallen tijdens verlof met enkelband

An MP asked why a convicted murderer was moved to a half-open facility with weekend leave, how a gun and ammunition got into his cell, and whether an ankle monitor is adequate given reported robberies during leave. The Secretary of State defended the placement rules and the monitoring, said the incident is regretted, and declined to confirm the suspicion but promised to send answers after an ongoing internal investigation.
Given the ongoing investigation and the privacy of the person concerned, I will not comment on this.
Gelet op het lopende onderzoek en de levenssfeer van de betrokkene doe ik hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Cel voor gijzelen importbruid'

PVV MPs asked whether a sharia court dissolved a marriage in the Netherlands and whether Dutch law can be supplemented by Islamic law, and whether such organisations should be dissolved. The minister replied that no parallel legal structure is possible, that no sharia courts are known to exist in the Netherlands, and that the Public Prosecution Service will consider a dissolution request under Article 2:20 Civil Code if warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that, if there is cause, it will consider filing a request with the court.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat, zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Justitie biedt vader meisje van Nulde excuses aan”

An MP asked why the father of a murdered girl from Nulde was informed too late about the unescorted leave of her killer, a TBS patient, and whether the Information Point for Detention Progress should face sanctions or compensation for late notifications. The Minister says the IDV informed victims within its 7-working-day target in 99.5% of cases, defends not introducing sanctions or automatic compensation, but commits to talks with DJI and the OM on better aligning leave decisions and victim notification.
For that short notice period, the Public Prosecution Service has offered apologies.
Voor die korte termijn heeft het OM excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Madlener over het bericht dat de snelwegpolitie wordt afgeschaft terwijl er juist behoefte is aan meer controle op verkeershufters

MPs Helder and Madlener asked whether the motorway police unit is being abolished, reducing control of dangerous drivers, and why the government is ignoring calls for more such enforcement and conflicting statements from prosecutors. The minister replied that motorway enforcement will be kept at least at current levels by the Dienst Infrastructuur, with result agreements to follow, and that the prosecution service, not the minister, directs enforcement priorities.
The House will be informed of the outcomes.
De Kamer zal over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over reclasseringswerkers die de regels overtreden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of reclassering staff selling offender-made furniture off the books and letting an offender work on a private project, and about management's handling of earlier whistleblower complaints. The State Secretary confirmed that external investigations found cash sales against agreements, said staff were re-instructed, saw no grounds to doubt the director's conduct, and pointed to existing integrity codes and whistleblower channels.
I have no reason to doubt the conduct of the director of RN in this matter.
Ik heb geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan het handelen van de directeur van RN in dezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de gemeenschap die deels opdraait voor schade door krakers

An MP asks why Utrecht municipality and police settled with squatters for EUR 37,500 instead of the nearly EUR 60,000 damage awarded, and whether taxpayers should bear part of the cost. The minister explains the settlement was a deliberate procedural choice given costs, delays and the squatters' inability to pay, while stating that full recovery of damages remains the aim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Asielkraak kost goud”

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why a group of undocumented migrants squatting buildings in Amsterdam has not been deported or stopped, and whether squatting bans and bed-bath-and-bread provision will be enforced or ended. The State Secretary replied that deportation depends on cooperation from countries of origin, that evictions of such squats have been carried out and upheld in court, that the financial compensation to municipalities for bed-bath-and-bread will be stopped, but refused an asylum stop while announcing targeted measures.
I informed your House on 21 November that I am ending the financial compensation for the bed, bath and bread provisions offered by municipalities.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 21 november geïnformeerd dat ik de financiële vergoeding voor de door gemeenten geboden bed, bad en broodvoorzieningen stopzet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Beveiligingsteam Oranjes bende”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of a toxic atmosphere and alleged corruption in the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, including a whistleblower on leave for 17 months. The minister answered that an external culture investigation and an internal integrity inquiry were under way, that the head of the service is stepping down, and that the whistleblower was on leave for five months and the investigation is careful rather than fast.
Following the report, the current head of the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, in consultation with the police chief, has decided to make his position available.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport heeft het huidige hoofd van de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen in goed overleg met de politiechef besloten dat hij zijn functie beschikbaar stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het door het openbaar ministerie negeren van de wens van ouders van misbruikte kinderen

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police and prosecutors do not systematically notify parents or guardians when images of their abused children reappear in new sex-crime cases, and whether a US-style notification system will be adopted. The minister replies that notification is case-by-case and victim-centred, that a systematic US-style model is not desirable, and describes existing Dutch and Interpol image databases.
Structurally notifying victims, as in the American model, is not something I consider desirable.
Het structureel notificeren van slachtoffers, zoals in het Amerikaanse model, acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Rechters slap met misbruik’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper report claiming judges impose lenient sentences for child sexual abuse, with few prison terms and rare professional bans, and whether minimum sentences or sentencing guidelines should be introduced. The minister answered that a meeting with the Public Prosecution Service, the judiciary and the National Rapporteur will discuss how the rapporteur's recommendations can contribute, and that the Chamber will be informed of the outcome.
I will inform the Chamber of my response to the report and of the outcome of this meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer berichten over mijn reactie op het rapport en over de uitkomsten van deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Helder, Fritsma en De Graaf over de Marokkaanse straatterreur in Maassluis

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about street disturbances by Moroccan-origin youths in Maassluis, including arrests, the mayor's conduct, camera use, police response times and denaturalisation. The minister answered that local authorities chose an emergency order that restored order, eight complaints were filed, five suspects arrested under OM direction, and that camera deployment was routine, while declining to discuss the ongoing investigation and noting the 15-minute police response target.
While the investigation is ongoing, I, as usual, make no further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik, zoals gebruikelijk, hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Helder over het bericht dat de effecten van bezuinigingen op het NFI onder de pet worden gehouden

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether budget cuts at the Netherlands Forensic Institute are delaying murder and rape cases, whether the NFI director and the ministry tried to hide the effects and to keep the works council from speaking to parliament, and whether the Chamber has been misinformed. The minister replies that longer turnaround times are acknowledged with remedial measures, that the Chamber has received all relevant information, that the works council was in fact allowed to speak, and that there is no reason for sanctions.
The Chamber has not been withheld information.
De Kamer is geen informatie onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over gevangenissen die toch dicht gaan

An MP asked whether prisons would be emptied and closed this cabinet term despite the parliamentary motion against closures, and whether housing asylum seekers in prisons circumvents that motion. The State Secretary replied that no prisons are being closed now, that the motion stands, and that temporary use of prison buildings for asylum seekers is possible only with municipal consent, while the prison's formal purpose is retained.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Politie toont weer beelden schokkend uitgaansgeweld”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a police publication of images of violent nightlife assaults, whether violence is rising, what measures will be taken, and whether publishing footage and privacy concerns should reduce sentences. The minister answered that recorded violence has been falling since 2010, that violence is tackled with all criminal law means and preventive measures, that publishing recognisable footage can be effective but needs care, and that sentencing is for the judge.
Determining the sentence, and whether to take into account the publication of footage of the criminal offence, is a matter for the judge.
Het bepalen van de strafmaat en het eventueel rekening houden met het publiceren van beelden van het strafbare feit, is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de politie die het onderspit delft tegen zware criminaliteit

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecution capacity in the south of the Netherlands should be increased in response to organised crime, and whether official crime statistics give a realistic picture. The Minister points to existing measures and a EUR 3 million budget for the south, says a WODC study on online crime is underway, and says statistics are a realistic picture while noting that some crime is not registered.
Dismantling the criminal industry is not an easy task. It requires our full attention.
Het afbreken van de criminele industrie is geen makkelijke opgave. Het vereist onze volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Martin Bosma en Helder over het weglaten van cruciale informatie in het programma Opsporing Verzocht

PVV MPs asked why the Opsporing Verzocht broadcast omitted that a robbery victim couple was attacked with antisemitic motives and that the victim named Moroccan perpetrators, and whether NPO coverage is driven by political correctness. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that the broadcast is an official investigative tool controlled by the prosecution service (OM) rather than the NPO, and that only verified information directly relevant to identifying suspects was included.
The criminal investigation covers all aspects of the offence. As this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on its content.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek richt zich op alle aspecten van het strafbare feit. Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat sluiting van nog meer gevangenissen dreigt

An MP asks the Secretary of State whether prison closures are threatened because recorded crime is falling, and whether this reflects cuts to prosecution and police rather than real crime levels. The Secretary acknowledges prognoses point to falling cell demand, orders a preparation plan, denies that cuts are impairing investigation, and promises a WODC study and an Inspectorate report.
I have therefore asked the WODC to start a study on this matter.
Ik heb daarom het WODC gevraagd dienaangaande een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over celdeuren die van binnenuit afgesloten kunnen worden door gedetineerden

An MP asks the State Secretary whether cell doors that prisoners can lock from inside should be replaced after reports of dangerous situations for prison staff and a fatal incident. The State Secretary answers that an inventory found the doors need no replacement, only some bolts or locking plates adjusted, and that staff instructions were reinforced.
Based on this inventory, it appears that the cell doors do not need to be adjusted.
Op basis van deze inventarisatie blijkt dat de celdeuren niet aangepast hoeven te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Bende in de bajes’

An MP asked whether violent incidents in prisons are rising, whether guards get enough risk information from police, how incidents are reported, and whether the state will reduce violence. The Secretary of State replied that 258 physical assaults on staff occurred in 2015, down from 5.5 to 3 per 100 places since 2010, and that no extra measures beyond existing ones are planned.
Given this declining trend, I see no reason to take extra measures beyond all the known preventive and repressive measures already being taken.
Ik zie gelet op deze dalende tendens geen aanleiding om extra maatregelen te treffen bovenop alle bekende preventieve en repressieve maatregelen die al worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Cipiers aangevallen’ en ‘Wapens en drugs in gevangenis Alphen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of guards being attacked and weapons and drugs found in Alphen prison, including how a bread knife reached a cell and claims experts warned of dangers. The State Secretary confirms the reports, explains the item was a blunt cell-inventory knife, and states that safety has top priority and that warning signals are taken seriously, without accepting that problems were ignored.
There is no question of signals about risky situations having been ignored.
Er is geen sprake van dat signalen over risicovolle situaties zouden zijn genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Veiligheid uit het oog verloren’

An MP from the PVV asks whether police capacity problems force surveillance staff into roles they are not trained for, whether recruits were misled about promotion timelines, and whether critics within the police face reprisals. The Minister replies that surveillance staff are not trained for firearm incidents, denies promises of a three-year promotion path, states the police have a handling framework for attacks and that staff have adequate room to voice concerns.
The chief of police has informed me that there is currently sufficient attention and room within the police for staff to express their views and concerns about the policy pursued.
De korpschef heeft mij laten weten dat er op dit moment binnen de politie voldoende aandacht en ruimte is voor medewerkers om hun mening en zorgen over het gevoerde beleid te uiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat boeven de baas zijn in de bajes

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether influential prisoners rule certain wings instead of staff, whether corrupt prison guards enable weapons, phones and drugs, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary says staff do not recognise the criticism, asked the Inspectorate to bring forward its integrity and contraband investigation, and points to existing screening and integrity measures without adding new ones for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Weer een veiligheidslek politiesysteem C2000’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the police C2000 radio system can be detected by devices (Target Blue Eye) that reveal nearby police vehicles, and what would be done. The minister answered that the detection capability has been known since 2013, that the police account for it in their working methods, and that he will examine whether legal measures could help, while noting a ban would have limited effect and enforceability questions.
Nevertheless, I will examine whether possible legal measures could support an effective and unhindered performance of the tasks of the police and other emergency services.
Niettemin zal ik onderzoeken of eventuele juridische maatregelen ondersteunend kunnen zijn aan een doelmatige en ongehinderde uitvoering van de taken van de politie en andere hulpverleningsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat rechtsbijstand aan slachtoffers van misdrijven in gevaar komt

An MP asked whether victims' lawyers are underpaid by the Legal Aid Board, leading to reduced willingness to take victim cases, and whether the government will ensure fair fees. The minister denied underpayment, cited quality rules and low numbers of refused extra-hours requests, and said the Commission-Wolfsen recommendation on fee recalibration will be addressed in a spring 2016 reply.
In its recently published final report, the Commission-Wolfsen recommends recalibrating the flat-rate point allocation, including the threshold for extra hours.
In haar onlangs verschenen eindrapportage doet de Commissie-Wolfsen de aanbeveling de forfaitaire puntentoekenning te herijken, ook ten aanzien van de grens voor extra uren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over het bericht dat Belgisch Limburg bezorgd is om de waakzaamheid van Nederland

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why vigilance in Belgian Limburg is reportedly higher than on the Dutch side, whether the Netherlands should raise vigilance and close its borders, and how information exchange with mayors will be improved. Minister Van der Steur answered that Belgium raised its threat level, that the Netherlands has been at 'Substantieel' since 2013 with additional measures, that border closure is not justified now while mobile checks and ANPR were intensified, and that information exchange is being strengthened internationally and locally.
After the attacks in Paris, it was decided among other things to intensify measures at locations where travel movements to and from Belgium and France take place.
Na de aanslagen in Parijs is onder meer besloten tot intensivering van de maatregelen op locaties waar reisbewegingen van en naar België en Frankrijk plaatsvinden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks controle op ingetrokken rijbewijs’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice why drivers under a driving ban face almost no checks, whether enforcement should be stepped up, what local safety triangles are doing, and what consequences follow for a driver who caused a fatal crash and drove again during a ban. The minister answered that police check licences where possible but such checks are labour-intensive, that driving while banned is a crime, that a letter on stricter enforcement will follow in January, that local teams handle traffic enforcement, and that a criminal investigation is pending so the court must decide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de sluiting van de Penitentiaire Inrichting (PI) Tilburg

An MP asks why the Tilburg prison (PI Tilburg) must close after Belgium decided not to extend its lease, and whether a one-year extension was possible, and whether the building could house asylum seekers or foreign detainees. The State Secretary answers that the rental was always temporary, Belgium declined any extension and no negotiations took place, that DJI will close the prison and terminate the lease after 1 January 2017, that reuse for asylum reception requires local government consent, and that he will thank staff in person.
Of course I am willing to discuss the possibilities for continuing the provision of the facility if there is a need on the Belgian side.
Natuurlijk ben ik bereid het gesprek te voeren over de mogelijkheden tot voortzetting van de terbeschikkingstelling als daar van Belgische zijde behoefte aan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat verdachten veel vaker zonder straf de rechtszaal uit lopen

MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice whether the rise in acquittals (from about 4% to 10.3% of criminal cases) was caused by police or prosecution failures linked to cuts, and whether the cuts would be reversed. The minister attributed the rise to stricter judicial review of evidence, fewer joined cases, and quality problems in summary-penalty cases, said the budget for the Public Prosecution Service was not yet shown to be inadequate, and promised a letter on the justice budget before the budget debate.

In my letter to the House of 15 September 2015 I stated, in response to the report on the feasibility of the Public Prosecution Service budget, that I do not think it is already justified to conclude that the 2016 budget framework is inadequate.

Bij mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 15 september 2015 3 , heb ik in reactie op het rapport «actualisatie validatie-onderzoek haalbaarheid budgettair kader Openbaar Ministerie» aangegeven dat ik niet van mening ben dat reeds nu al de conclusie gerechtvaardigd is dat het budgettair kader van 2016 ontoereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het bericht dat de snelheidscamera’s op de A2 goed zijn voor 48 miljoen euro aan boeteopbrengsten

MPs Madlener and Helder asked whether speed cameras on the A2 generating 48 million euro in fines treat motorists as a cash cow, how many minor violations are involved, whether the controls are necessary for road safety, and whether the speed limit will be raised to 130 km/h. The minister replied that the controls aim at compliance with limits, gave the breakdown of fines by excess speed, cited a Rijkswaterstaat analysis showing reduced speeds, and said a decision on raising limits awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House about this still this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over dat de Haagse politie quota invoert om meer allochtone agenten in dienst te krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether The Hague police would introduce ethnic quotas for recruiting officers, and why the mayor would discriminate against native officers and ignore recruitment requirements. The minister answered that there is no quota, only diversity targets set by the police chief, that quality remains paramount, and that the police will improve explanations of ID checks following an Ombudsman recommendation.
There is neither for the Den Haag unit nor for the force as a whole any quota for the number of officers with an immigrant background.
Er is noch voor de eenheid Den Haag noch voor het korps als geheel sprake van een quotum voor het aantal agenten met een allochtone achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: ‘Alarm om bezuinigingen NFI’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that budget cuts at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) are alarming investigative services, whether unnatural deaths are being under-autopsied, and whether the cuts will be reversed. The Minister denied that investigative services issued the alarm, said no evidence shows homicides are being missed, announced an exploratory study of decision points in the death investigation process, and said the cuts cannot be reversed given the NFI's capacity limits.
I have therefore instructed the NFI to conduct an exploratory study into the decision points in that process.
Ik heb het NFI daarom opdracht gegeven een verkennend onderzoek te doen naar de beslismomenten in dat proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het negeren van een negatief advies door de inlichtingendienst door de politie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police disregarded a negative AIVD advice when a police officer suspected of being a mole was cleared, and what measures will ensure such advice has consequences. The answer refers to a separate letter on the suspected officer rather than answering the questions in this document.
Further answer: the written questions from MP Helder (PVV) number 2015Z19390 have been answered by means of the letter 'Information about the suspected police officer'.
Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) vraagnummer 2015Z19390 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Informatie over de verdachte politieambtenaar»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de aanhouding van een PIJ-er voor een roofoverval met dodelijke afloop

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why a youth-PIJ detainee, given leave against the rules and then linked to a fatal robbery, was released, and whether the PIJ measure and its high recidivism should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to discuss the pending case, defended the leave system and PIJ measure with recidivism figures, rejected reviewing the measure, and said an investigation into the case would be carried out.
Given the seriousness of this situation, I am having an investigation into this case carried out.
Gezien de ernst van deze situatie laat ik een onderzoek naar deze casus uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Fritsma en Wilders over wijkagenten die bezoeken brengen aan leden en sympathisanten van de protestgroep Asielzoekerscentra (AZC)-alert

PVV MPs asked whether police home visits to members and sympathisers of the anti-AZC protest group AZC-alert, in uniform and by police car, are intimidating and whether they will stop. The minister replied that proactive contact with groups planning demonstrations is routine police work under local authority, aimed at reducing tension, and that there is no reason to change the practice.
This takes place under the responsibility of the local authority.
Dit gebeurt onder verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de tientallen miljoenen die het Rijk laat liggen door een versnipperde aanpak

MP Helder asks whether the state leaves tens of millions unclaimed through a fragmented approach to seizing criminal assets, and whether the government will pool budgets and invest in regional asset-seizure teams. The minister disputes the underlying estimates as unreliable, calls the current target ambitious but realistic, and points to a structural 3 million euro increase in the 2016 budget while referring to earlier answers.
There are no reliable estimates of how much criminal money actually circulates in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare schattingen over hoeveel «misdaadgeld» er precies omgaat in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de psychotherapeute die een relatie heeft met een gedetineerde

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a freelance psychotherapist who produces pro Justitia reports for the NIFP and had a relationship with, and married, a detainee, questioning her impartiality and whether staff unrest and conflict of interest were addressed. The State Secretary answered that the NIFP sees no integrity problem, that the relationship was self-reported ten years ago, and that agreed safeguards (no assignments in the region or prison where her ex-husband is) are sufficient, with no further measures planned.
It has been agreed that she will no longer produce pro Justitia reports in the parts of the country where her ex-husband resides and will not conduct examinations in the prison where he is detained.
Zo is afgesproken dat zij geen pro Justitia rapportages meer verricht in die delen van het land waar haar ex-man verblijft en geen onderzoeken verricht in de PI waar hij zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “TBS'er op verlof steekt vrouw in gezicht”

An MP from the PVV asked how a TBS patient on authorised leave could escape his escort and obtain a weapon to stab a woman, and whether the state should use physical restraints during leave and circulate his description to police. The State Secretary answered that the clinic is investigating and that leave is granted only after expert assessment, that restraints and police circulation are rejected or left to police and prosecutors, and that the suspect has been arrested and brought before an investigating judge.
I have asked the TBS clinic where the TBS patient resides to conduct an investigation into the events and report back to me.
Ik heb de tbs-kliniek waar tbs-gestelde verblijft gevraagd een onderzoek in te stellen naar de gebeurtenissen en mij hierover te berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat usb-sticks gestolen zijn bij een inbraak bij een officier van justitie

An MP asked whether unencrypted USB sticks holding case information of the public prosecution service (OM) were stolen in a burglary and how such leaks will be prevented. The minister confirmed the incident, said the data was placed on unsecured sticks by mistake, and gave no figure on how many unsecured sticks are in use, while stating that rules were reiterated to staff.
By mistake, the information was placed on unsecured USB sticks.
Per abuis is de informatie op onbeveiligde usb-sticks gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een schietgrage crimineel die uit een inrichting is ontsnapt

An MP asked why a dangerous criminal escaped from a forensic psychiatric unit in Den Dolder, why he was there rather than in prison, and what security measures apply when such detainees are placed in care. The State Secretary explained the placement criteria, said the escape was reported to police, and noted he was arrested in Spain and returned to the Netherlands.
I am of the opinion that this process is careful and I see no reason to change it.
Ik ben van mening dat dit proces zorgvuldig is en zie geen aanleiding om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de bezuinigingen op het NFI problemen opleveren voor het opsporen van criminelen (tevens verzoek Van Nispen)

The MP asks whether cuts of 9 million euros at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) will harm criminal investigations, given concerns from the Public Prosecution Service, and whether the cuts will be reversed. The minister answers that the cuts are part of the efficiency target, that police and prosecutors manage forensic demand through existing agreements, that reorganisation costs are incidental, and that core NFI production stays intact, without reversing the cut.
The core production of the NFI remains fully intact.
De kernproductie van het NFI blijft onverkort overeind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Enkelband huisarrest kan worden gekraakt’

An MP from the PVV asked whether ankle monitors used for house arrest can be hacked and whether they are used in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that GWG International monitors are not used in the Netherlands, that Dutch systems are continuously monitored and periodically hack-tested, and that there is no reason to stop using them.
From this it has not so far appeared that the system in the Netherlands has been hacked.
Daaruit is tot op heden niet gebleken dat het systeem in Nederland is gekraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over de uitzending van EenVandaag over zwanendrifters

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police did not intervene against threats and abuse toward a veterinarian and residents involved with swan-drivers, and what would be done to protect them and stop the animal abuse, and whether a dedicated animal police should be reinstated. The minister replied that the police recorded the complaints, proces-verbaals were sent to the public prosecutor, the matter is handled under High Impact Crime, and the animal police function is kept as a task accent with about 180 task-accent holders deemed sufficient.
When people want to file a report of threat or mistreatment, the police record it.
Wanneer mensen aangifte willen doen van bedreiging of mishandeling, dan wordt dit door de politie opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de peperdure vliegtrips van de politietop

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about business-class flights by the national police leadership, the amounts spent, and whether such spending will be restricted and reviewed. The minister confirmed the amounts relate to business-class flights for the top 61 officers, said the Besluit allows business class only outside Europe, and that a change to the regulation restricting this is being finalised, while pointing to existing conduct rules and periodic review of trips.
At this moment the finishing touches are being put on the relevant regulation.
Op dit moment wordt de laatste hand gelegd aan de betreffende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: ‘Onrust in tbs-kliniek’

An MP asked whether cuts at a private forensic psychiatric clinic (halving security staff, thinner night shifts, many violent incidents) make escapes more likely and what the government will do. The State Secretary replied that the cuts are internal decisions of the private clinic, that security levels were maintained, that no escapes were reported since January 2015, and that no action is needed because the situation is not unsafe.
The clinic's director explained on request that the cut concerns a restructuring of security staff, but certainly not a halving of the workforce.

De bestuurder van de kliniek heeft desgevraagd uiteengezet dat de genoemde bezuiniging een herstructurering van het beveiligingspersoneel betreft, doch beslist geen halvering van het personeelsbestand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte gepakt in Limburg’

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of a terror suspect arrested in Limburg, whether terror suspects should be kept out of the Netherlands, whether this should be treated as a security warning, and whether the Netherlands should leave Schengen and reintroduce border controls. The government confirmed the arrest, said suspects can be arrested, prosecuted or extradited, noted the threat requires vigilance, and rejected leaving Schengen while defending its policy of preventing departures of foreign terrorist fighters.

The Cabinet is of the view that persons about whom there is a well-founded suspicion that they will travel to Syria and Iraq with the intention of joining a terrorist organisation must be prevented from departing.

Het Kabinet is van mening dat personen ten aanzien waarvan het gegronde vermoeden bestaat dat zij naar Syrië en Irak zullen uitreizen met de intentie om zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie, het uitreizen moet worden verhinderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een viervoudig moordenaar die, ondanks een levenslange gevangenisstraf, van de Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing en de Jeugdbescherming (RSJ) met verlof mag

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a life-sentenced prisoner who may obtain leave despite the sentence, following an RSJ appeal ruling requiring structural incidental leave for life-sentenced prisoners. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling will be implemented and said he will consult stakeholders and report after the summer on possibly changing how life imprisonment is executed, including resocialisation and leave.
Ik zal uitvoering geven aan deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke killer die nachtverlof kreeg

An MP asks why a convicted killer under TBS was allowed unsupervised overnight leave despite the rules, whether the state knew in February, and whether TBS should be abolished. The State Secretary confirms that the clinic granted unauthorised overnight stays, announces a patient-admission stop, an Inspectorate investigation and a sample check of other clinics, and rejects abolishing TBS on recidivism grounds.
The Inspectorate for Security and Justice has started an investigation to be able to answer that question.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie is een onderzoek begonnen teneinde die vraag te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Winkels in nood door roofklanten’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that shop theft has stayed high, that retailers face large losses, that theft is not a police priority, and whether foreign suspects dominate.
