The minister answered that theft is unacceptable, cited CBS figures showing a slight decline, described OM prioritisation, a revised prosecution guideline and encouragement to file reports, and stated that Eastern European suspects are about 13 percent of registered suspects.
Shop theft certainly has priority for the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Winkeldiefstal heeft zeker prioriteit voor het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Holleeder regeert vanuit cel’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary how the detained criminal Holleeder could still reach the outside world from the high-security EBI prison, whether witnesses against him are at risk, and whether his special treatment (natrium-poor bread bought outside) is true. The State Secretary answered that all contact is blocked except with his lawyer, that EBI supervision measures are strictly enforced with staff trained for this group, and that the bread claim is incorrect.
From the moment the person has been in the EBI, he has had no contact whatsoever with persons outside the institution, other than with his lawyer, not by post, telephone or visits.

Vanaf het moment dat betrokkene in de EBI verblijft, heeft hij op geen enkele wijze – anderszins dan met zijn advocaat – contact met personen buiten de inrichting gehad, niet via post, telefoon of bezoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over de uitspraak van een lid uit een coalitiefractie dat de korpschef van de Nationale Politie er goed aan doet sollicitanten te checken op PVV-achtige opvattingen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a coalition MP's remark that the police chief should screen job applicants for PVV-like views was acceptable and whether he would distance himself from it. The government answered that selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under the Constitution and the ECHR, that political affiliation plays no role in selection, and that it would not judge individual MPs' opinions.
Selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under Article 1 of the Constitution, Article 14 of the European Convention on Human Rights and other treaties.

Het selecteren van sollicitanten op politieke opvattingen is niet toegestaan op grond van artikel 1 van de Grondwet, artikel 14 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en andere verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over minder criminaliteit door militairen op straat

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would deploy soldiers in the Netherlands to tackle crime at hotspots, after a Belgian report of reduced crime where soldiers patrol. The minister replied that the National Police is adequately equipped, but civilian authorities can request military assistance in specific situations.
The National Police is generally adequately equipped to tackle and combat crime, including at places referred to as hotspots.
De Nationale Politie is in het algemeen voldoende toegerust om criminaliteit aan te pakken en te bestrijden, ook op plaatsen waar aan wordt gerefereerd met de term «hot spots».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het opvragen van beelden de politie tonnen kost

An MP asked whether the police and prosecution must pay banks for camera footage under an NVB arrangement, costing millions, and whether banks should provide it free. The minister replied that a statutory compensation basis (art. 592 Sv) and forfaitaire agreements exist, that the aim is not to deter requests, and that he sees no reason to change the rules.
I see no reason to amend this statutory arrangement.
Ik zie geen reden om deze wettelijke regeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de politie in 215 gemeenten vaak te laat komt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police arrive late in 215 municipalities, whether the 90% within-15-minutes norm for 2015 will be met, and what measures will ensure it. The minister confirmed the figures, attributed lateness mainly to rural geography and unforeseen peaks, said the 90% target is a self-imposed police goal with no statutory basis, and listed existing measures without guaranteeing the target per municipality.
This target was set by the police itself and is not a legally established norm.
Deze streefnorm heeft de politie zichzelf opgelegd en is geen wettelijk vastgestelde norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitlatingen van Guy Verhofstadt over een Europese CIA

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Guy Verhofstadt's call for a European CIA and whether the government would rule out transferring sovereignty on intelligence. The minister confirmed the remarks were made in Verhofstadt's capacity as an MEP, stated the government will not transfer sovereignty since internal security remains a national matter, and said those holding such views are free to express them.
The cabinet considers it important that this remains so and therefore has no intention whatsoever of transferring sovereignty to a 'Euro-CIA'.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat dit zo blijft en is dus geenszins voornemens om soevereiniteit aan een «Euro-CIA» over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over bange agenten die terreurverdachten met een meldplicht weren uit politiebureaus uit angst voor aanslagen

An MP from the PVV asked whether police fear for their safety and bar terror suspects under a reporting obligation from police stations, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister replied that the arrangement concerned a single person at one station, that there is no general policy of categorising such persons, and that he saw no reason to revise his predecessor's position on administrative detention.
As far as could be verified, such an arrangement to report via the intercom was made at only one police station, for one person with a reporting obligation.
Voor zover kon worden nagegaan is een dergelijke afspraak, om zich via de intercom te melden, slechts op één politiebureau gemaakt ten aanzien van één persoon met een meldplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke crimineel die vervroegd is vrijgelaten en ook nog een zak geld heeft gekregen

An MP asks why a violent offender, a Turkish national in the country illegally, was released early through sentence interruption with a bag of public money and an identity card, and whether the government will change the rules. The Secretary of State explains that sentence interruption is a return instrument, that the offender left with a large sentence remainder and an entry ban, that IOM support is in kind up to EUR 1,500, and that no change to conditional release is planned.
I want to emphasise that IOM is independent in carrying out its tasks.
Ik wil benadrukken dat IOM in haar taakuitvoering onafhankelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de ontsnapping van een gevangene

An MP asked the state secretary about a detainee who escaped while being transferred to a clinic and whether handcuffing should be standard during transport. The secretary said the escape was unexpected, the detainee surrendered voluntarily, standard use of restraints conflicts with rules, and search costs remain with the responsible organisations.
I stand fully by my earlier judgement that DJI staff are well able to make an adequate assessment per detainee of whether it is appropriate to apply restraints.

Ik sta onverkort achter mijn oordeel van destijds dat medewerkers van DJI goed in staat zijn om per gedetineerde een adequate afweging te maken in hoeverre het aangewezen is om vrijheidsbeperkende middelen toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het NAVO-hoofdkwartier in Brunssum een mogelijk jihad-doelwit is

An MP asked whether the NAVO headquarters in Brunssum is a jihadist target, whether surveillance of NATO staff by mosque visitors was ignored, and whether the threat level should be raised. The minister declined to comment publicly on threat assessments for specific objects, said NATO reports no specific local threat, and said existing services act where needed.
For security reasons I do not make public statements about threats and risks concerning specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreiging en risico ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tegengehouden jihadisten extra dreiging’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether blocking jihadists from leaving the country is wise given warnings that they become a threat, and whether the government will stop its deradicalisation approach and revoke citizenship of those who fight abroad. The minister answered that the risks are known, that blocking departure is deliberate policy to prevent foreign fighters from being trained and radicalised, and pointed to two legislative routes to strip Dutch nationality from terrorism suspects.
Blocking radicalised persons remains and will remain deliberate policy.
Het tegenhouden van geradicaliseerde personen is en blijft weloverwogen beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: “Verdachte vrij om DNA-drukte rond zaak MH17”

Member Helder (PVV) asked whether a suspect in a robbery was released from pre-trial detention because the NFI's DNA analysis was delayed by the MH17 workload, and whether budget should be increased. Minister Opstelten answered that the media report was incorrect: the DNA report was ready on 6 October 2014 but not passed to the prosecutor or detective, and the court released the suspect on conditions for personal reasons, so no budget increase is warranted.
No, the media reporting is incorrect and has since been corrected by the AD.
Nee, de berichtgeving in de media is onjuist en ondertussen gerectificeerd door het AD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de transactie met militairen, verdacht van verduistering

PVV MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers why a settlement offer over alleged embezzlement by soldiers in Kunduz was made on embezzlement in a group rather than in a service relationship, and whether the suspects were Marechaussee members subject to dismissal. The Defence minister answered that the settlement was based on the suspicion of embezzlement committed in association, that the suspects were not Marechaussee members, and gave no further explanation of the omitted aggravating element.
Answer 2 See the answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Zie het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat partijen een sharia-schikking hebben bereikt bij de Rechtbank Den Haag

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a Hague court settlement, in which parties agreed to submit their dispute to an imam and swear on the Koran, was acceptable and whether the government would stop such sharia settlements. The Minister answered that the settlement was reached under Dutch law, not sharia, that courts may record settlements unless contrary to law or public morals, and that he does not judge the independent court's assessment.
I do not intervene in this assessment by the independent judge.
Ik treed niet in deze beoordeling door de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht van jihadverdachten op terroristenafdelingen

An MP from the PVV asks whether jihadist suspects on terrorism wings can have contact with each other and whether security should match the EBI, the highest-security unit. The state secretary denies the reported mistreatment, defends individual regimes with risk-based contact limits, and says the terrorism wings are sufficiently secured, so the EBI level is not needed.
I therefore do not consider it necessary for the terrorism wings to have the same security level as the Extra Secure Facility.
Ik acht het daarom niet nodig dat op de terroristenafdelingen hetzelfde beveiligingsniveau geldt als die van de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een agentenmepper een lagere straf heeft gekregen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a lower sentence for an officer-assaulting man because of his debts was acceptable and whether sentencing law should be changed to exclude such circumstances. The minister answered that judges independently weigh all circumstances, that sentencing is tailored case by case, and that he would not change the law or comment on specific sentences.
The judge is independent in this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Man in Amsterdam opgepakt voor voorbereiden aanslag op agenten’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported arrest in Amsterdam for planning an attack on police officers, including why border controls were not reintroduced, how the suspect entered the Netherlands, whether borders should be closed to immigration from Islamic countries, and whether police should stop wearing uniforms in public. The Minister answered that border controls would be a last resort and not proportionate, declined to discuss individual cases, rejected closing borders, and said there are no concrete indications of an attack and no reason to deploy the military at stations.
No statements are made about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar jihadi-training in Ardennen’

Written questions from PVV MPs asked whether jihadi training facilities exist in or are used from the Netherlands, how many of the 41 passport-confiscated jihadists were trained in the EU, and whether jihadists can be denaturalised and expelled. The minister replied that no evidence of training camps in the Netherlands exists, that 48 passports are flagged, and that a bill to strip nationality from dual nationals convicted of terrorism is being prepared.
I have no indications that jihadist training camps are located in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat zich in Nederland jihadistische trainingskampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat België niet langer cellen van de Penitentiaire Inrichting Tilburg wil huren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Belgium will stop renting cells in the Tilburg prison, whether staff were informed, and whether the prison should stay open given its low cost. The State Secretary answered that the treaty runs to end-2016 with a yearly notice date, that talks with Belgium are ongoing, and that the closure decision under the Masterplan DJI will not be reconsidered as there is no growth in demand.
The treaty between the Netherlands and Belgium on the use of the PI Tilburg is valid until 31 December 2016
Het verdrag tussen Nederland en België over het gebruik van de PI Tilburg heeft een geldigheid tot 31 december 2016
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de politie veel meer personeel inhuurt

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is true that police spend far more on hiring external staff, and whether this should be halted given terrorism threats and the cost compared with hiring frontline officers. The minister confirms external hiring costs of about 186 million against a budgeted 155 million, defends the spending as needed for the police reorganisation and continuity, and declines to halt it, while saying the force will keep scrutinising costs.
The police's most recent forecast assumes realised external hiring for 2014 of about 186 million.
De meest recente prognose van de politie gaat uit van een realisatie externe inhuur over 2014 van circa 186 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de helft van de jonge verdachten allochtoon is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the WODC's claims that relatively more second-generation Moroccan and Turkish youths have higher crime rates, and that allochtone youths are presumably less involved in cybercrime, are scientifically grounded, and whether a research bureau should refrain from unsubstantiated statements. The Minister confirmed the statements, cited a 2012 CBS-based publication for the first claim, treated the cybercrime remark as a hypothesis warranting further research, and defended the WODC's role in formulating testable assumptions.
Part of scientific research is also formulating assumptions in order to test them empirically afterwards.
Onderdeel van wetenschappelijk onderzoek is ook het formuleren van veronderstellingen om die daarna empirisch te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Nederland kan IS alleen verbieden op initiatief van het OM”

MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether IS can be banned in the Netherlands only on the initiative of the public prosecutor, and why Germany could ban it while the Netherlands could not. The minister answered that IS is already banned in the Netherlands via the EU sanctions list combined with the Civil Code and the Criminal Code, that no civil dissolution procedure is available because IS cannot acquire legal personality here, and that he will act if new measures prove necessary.
If necessary I will act immediately and ensure targeted strengthening of the legal instruments.
Indien noodzakelijk zal ik direct optreden en zorgen voor gerichte versterking van het wettelijk instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over jihadverdachten die op verzoek van het OM zijn vrijgelaten

An MP asked why the Public Prosecution Service, after seeking pre-trial detention of two jihad suspects, later accepted their release under strict conditions and whether ankle monitors and reclassering oversight are adequate. The Minister declined to comment on the court's individual decision, denied a long waiting list for electronic monitoring, and defended the conditions as monitored, while acknowledging contact between suspects cannot be fully excluded.
I do not intervene in the judgment of the independent judge in an individual criminal case.
Ik treed niet in het oordeel van de onafhankelijke rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Een grote groep, voornamelijk Turkse jongeren, die een jongen afgetuigd hebben’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of a group, mostly Turkish youths aged 13 to 17, who assaulted a boy, and called for harsher youth crime measures, an ISD for juveniles from age 12, and group liability. The Minister referred to earlier answers on the group's composition, defended the existing juvenile criminal law and combined approach, refused the ISD extension, and said participants proven to have joined the assault can be held liable under the existing group-violence provision.
No, I am not willing to do that. Juvenile criminal law offers sufficient possibilities to address youth crime.
Nee, ik ben daartoe niet bereid. Het jeugdstrafrecht biedt voldoende mogelijkheden om jeugdcriminaliteit aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat er weer een tbs’er ontsnapt is tijdens verlof

An MP asks why a tbs detainee escaped during supervised leave, whether the risk assessment and tbs system are structurally flawed, why searches were not broadcast earlier, and whether escort staff should be armed. The State Secretary answers that the escape followed standard procedure, that the risk assessment was sound, that the detainee was arrested on 30 September, and that arming escorts is not warranted.
I do not share this view. In this case there were no signals that the tbs detainee would want to abscond.
Deze mening deel ik niet. In dit geval waren er geen signalen dat de betreffende tbs-gestelde zich zou willen onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Superblunder: Franse jihadisten op vrije voeten'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that French jihadists were free in Turkey, whether Dutch-passport jihadists were held or extradited, whether they could be kept out, and whether border and passport controls should be tightened or borders closed. The minister said no Dutch-passport jihadists are currently known to be held in Turkey and none extradited, refused to end automated passport checks at Schiphol or to close borders, citing EU free movement and proportionality rules.
Such a decision is, as far as I am concerned, not on the agenda.
Een dergelijk besluit is wat mij betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een kliniek een gevaarlijke veroordeelde liet lopen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a clinic released a dangerous, previously acquitted-on-grounds-of-insanity offender, and whether clinics may decide such releases on their own. The state secretary answered that the clinic granted conditional discharge under the bopz framework, that the psychiatric decision lies with the medical director, and that a pending forensic care bill would require ministerial consent for early termination.
Deprivation of liberty in connection with a disorder is only possible when the disorder and the danger arising from it justify it.
Vrijheidsontneming in verband met een stoornis is alleen mogelijk wanneer de stoornis en het gevaar dat daaruit voortvloeit dat rechtvaardigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Ontslag fraudeaanklager wegens mogelijke fraude’

MP Helder (PVV) asks whether the dismissal of a fraud prosecutor suspected of fraud could have been prevented by better screening at appointment, and whether a politically connected appointment is normal. Minister Opstelten answers that the advocate-general was appointed through the normal selection procedure, refers to earlier answers to Oskam's questions, and says a prosecutor must have unblemished conduct and that fraud is a high priority, with a letter on the state of affairs promised before year end.
No. The advocate-general in question was therefore appointed after going through the normal selection procedure.
Nee. De betreffende advocaat-generaal is dan ook benoemd na het doorlopen van de normale selectieprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder over de terreuraanpak en het dreigingsniveau in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and Helder asked why the terrorism threat level was not raised from substantial to critical after a jihadist's call for attacks in the Netherlands, and how much more concrete a threat must be. Minister Opstelten answered that individual threats do not currently warrant a higher level, that the threat remains within the substantial band, and that services are doing everything to prevent attacks, and noted the Chamber was briefed on 29 September.
The threats expressed by individuals do not currently constitute grounds for raising the threat level.
De bedreigingen die door individuen zijn geuit vormen op dit moment geen reden het dreigingsniveau te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Conflict Almere over parketwacht”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that criminal and family hearings at the Almere court were suspended from 1 September 2014 due to insufficient police capacity for courtroom security. The minister confirmed the suspension, said hearings would resume in Almere on 17 November 2014 after agreements with the police, and said the police and the court had agreed on a service agreement for 2014–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Bajes bakermat van drugsbende’

An MP asked whether prisons allowed inmates to run an international drug network and whether DJI budget cuts endangered safety. The State Secretary denied any failure in supervision, stating cooperation with the prosecution and police led to conviction, and that staffing shortages were not the cause, while safety remained a precondition of the Masterplan DJI.
I dispute the claim that detainees could have started an international drug gang undetected during their detention.
Ik bestrijd de stelling dat gedetineerden onopgemerkt een internationale drugsbende hebben kunnen beginnen tijdens detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Samenleving elk jaar voor 30 miljard getild’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a press report claiming fraud costs society 30 billion euros a year is accurate, and whether fraud should be tackled harder and detection raised. The minister said the 30 billion figure cannot be confirmed given wide uncertainty in fraud estimates, reaffirmed the government's anti-fraud action plan and a progress report before year end, and argued cost-benefit logic cannot decide fraud policy.
The cabinet will send the House a progress report on the nationwide approach to fraud before the end of this year.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer voor het einde van dit jaar een voortgangsrapportage sturen over de rijksbrede aanpak van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf ‘Extra bezuinigingen bij Justitie door tegenvallers’

An MP asks whether the Justice Ministry faces additional cuts after shortfalls, whether EU criminal law implementation could be dropped to save money, and whether the reclassering waiting list and merging the three reclassering organisations should be addressed. The minister rejects further cuts being ruled out, says EU directives must still be implemented, defends community sentences as effective, and says alternatives for reclassering are being explored with information to follow before the budget debate.
I will inform the House on this in more detail before the budget debate.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer hier vóór de begrotingsbehandeling nader over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bosma over stappen van het Openbaar Ministerie tegen GeenStijl

MPs Helder and Bosma asked whether criminal investigations into GeenStijl photos reflect unequal treatment compared with the 'Dood aan de Joden' case, and whether free speech is safe under this cabinet. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service assesses each case on its merits, that both were examined, and that free speech was not breached criminally.
Each case is assessed by the Public Prosecution Service on its own merits.
Iedere zaak wordt door het Openbaar Ministerie op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de berichten ‘Nederlandse Marokkanen nu ook in Marokko berecht’ en ‘Luxe auto’s en appartementen: daar gaat het geld naartoe’

PVV MPs asked about reports that Dutch-Moroccan dual nationals are detained and prosecuted in Morocco, how many dual nationals are detained and still receive benefits, and whether citizenship, assets, and benefits should be withdrawn or repatriation encouraged. The minister confirmed about 150 dual nationals detained in each country, explained benefit termination via data exchange, rejected the claim of hundreds involved in killings, noted existing asset-seizure and Moroccan benefit-check powers, and declined denaturalisation and benefit restrictions based on work history.
If a person is in detention and receives a benefit from the Dutch state, this benefit is terminated.
Indien een persoon in detentie verblijft en een uitkering van de Nederlandse staat ontvangt, wordt deze uitkering beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten dat een TBS’er uit de Rooyse Wissel Oostrum is verdwenen

PVV MP Helder asked why the escape of a TBS patient from the Rooyse Wissel Oostrum clinic was not publicly announced with a description, whether this secrecy will change, how many TBS patients were unlawfully absent in 2014, and whether unsupervised leave should end. Minister Teeven replied that police and prosecutors decide case by case on using a description, that about 27 patients breached leave conditions in 2014 through August, and that leave is a carefully controlled part of treatment and no general description will be issued for every leave.
Police and prosecutors must be able to decide for themselves, based on their expertise and experience, case by case, whether to deploy certain investigative tools, including the timing.
Politie en OM moeten zelf, op basis van hun deskundigheid en ervaring, per casus kunnen beslissen over de wenselijkheid van de inzet van bepaalde opsporingsmiddelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “PvdAer: ISIS is complot”

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether a Ministry of Security and Justice employee whose Twitter posts they called racist and radical should be dismissed. Minister Opstelten distanced himself from the posts, said her secondment to the NCTV was ended immediately, and said she is suspended pending an investigation and a decision on employment measures.
To ensure a careful decision-making process, the outcome cannot be anticipated.
Omwille van een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces kan niet vooruit worden gelopen op de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de zesvoudig moordenaar Cevdet Yilmaz die met onbegeleid verlof mag

An MP asked the State Secretary why a court allowed the life-sentenced prisoner Cevdet Yilmaz unaccompanied leave, how levenslanggestraften are treated and what it costs, and why life prisoners are placed in TBS clinics. The State Secretary answered that the court ruling is known, that the case is unique and rests on earlier policy, that leave will consider victims' residences, and gave cost figures and the placement criteria, without committing to new action.
I realise that this development is heavy and burdensome for victims and survivors.
Ik besef dat deze ontwikkeling voor slachtoffers en nabestaanden zwaar en ingrijpend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Helder over de anti-Israëldemonstratie

PVV MPs asked whether police failed to act against Nazi and terror symbols and a Hitler salute at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and whether the mayor failed and suspects should be arrested, stripped of Dutch nationality and expelled. The minister refers to earlier answers, says criminal punishment is for the judge, and explains that Dutch nationality can only be revoked for terrorism convictions after 1 October 2010 and that residence can be ended only after a final conviction.
If someone has committed a criminal offence, it is for the judge to assess what punishment is appropriate, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien iemand een strafbaar feit heeft begaan, is het aan de rechter om te beoordelen welke straf passend is, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de antisemitische demonstratie door moslims in Den Haag

Three PVV MPs asked why police and the mayor did not act against alleged criminal speech (calls to violence, a Hitler salute) at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and why a journalist was removed rather than her harassers arrested. The minister answered that two people were arrested and will be prosecuted, no Hitler salute was found, the mayor lacks legal power to ban a demonstration for its content, and the journalist's treatment aimed to prevent escalation.
The mayor also has no power to act against a demonstration solely to prevent or end criminal offences.
De burgemeester heeft ook geen bevoegdheid tegen een demonstratie op te treden enkel ter voorkoming of beëindiging van strafbare feiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat de bewoners uit de Tarwewijk, Rotterdam-Zuid angstig zijn voor de vrijlaten van de 15-jarige Rotterdamse jongen die woensdag is aangehouden voor mis

MPs Beertema and Helder asked the education state secretary about a 15-year-old Rotterdam boy released after assaulting a bullied girl, the fear in the neighbourhood, the school's failure under its anti-bullying protocol, and the need to punish bullies quickly given social media. The state secretary said an inquiry by the Rotterdam youth consul is underway, outlined planned legislation making school safety and bullying prevention enforceable by the inspectorate, and stated bullying figures have not risen though cyberbullying has.
With the announced legislation, it will become possible for the inspectorate to effectively supervise the social safety of pupils at school.
Met de aangekondigde wetgeving wordt het voor de inspectie mogelijk om effectief toezicht te houden op de sociale veiligheid van de leerlingen op school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over straatcoaches

The MPs asked whether street coaches, subsidised by municipalities, conceal crimes from police, whether police agreements with them obstruct information flow, and what the government will do given a Movisie study finding them ineffective. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such arrangements, that no national agreements exist, and that he will discuss the Movisie findings with the VNG and report to the House.
It is the responsibility of the local authority to make agreements on the deployment of street coaches and cooperation with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal bestuur om afspraken te maken over de inzet van straatcoaches en de samenwerking met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over een tbs’er die 100 euro per dag vangt door getalm van de IND

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why the IND delayed declaring a Turkish tbs detainee undesirable, causing a daily penalty payment, and whether Turkey takes back such nationals. The state secretary replied that the objection was declared unfounded on 22 July 2014, removal preparations have started, the deadline overrun was due to case complexity, and the IND has issued work instructions to prevent recurrence.
Due to the complexity of this case, the IND regrettably exceeded the decision deadline for the objection, which led to a penalty payment as stated in the article.
Vanwege de complexiteit van deze zaak is tot mijn spijt de beslistermijn in bezwaar door de IND overschreden, wat heeft geleid tot een dwangsom zoals in het artikel staat vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf , Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Gevaarlijke jihadist vaak buiten beeld’

PVV MPs asked whether the government will reintroduce border controls, detain and expel returning jihadists and impose an immigration stop from Islamic countries after a report that foreign jihadists move freely in Europe unknown to the services. The Staatssecretaris answered that European intelligence cooperation is intensified, rejected the listed measures as incompatible with the constitution and treaties, and pointed to a national action programme on travel-data collection for later this autumn.
Concrete public statements cannot be made about the nature of cooperation between intelligence services.
Over de aard van de samenwerking tussen inlichtingendiensten, kunnen in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opnieuw Straf brandstichter Winschoten”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a convicted arsonist could serve a prison sentence in a TBS clinic where he is already treated, and about the cost and frequency of such arrangements. The State Secretary answered that prison sentences are normally served in penitentiary facilities, that courts may advise on placement, that such placements in forensic psychiatric centres occur in a small number of cases, and that each case is weighed individually.
Prison sentences are in principle carried out in penitentiary institutions.
Gevangenisstraffen worden in beginsel in penitentiaire inrichtingen ten uitvoer gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Man rent geboeid weg uit politieauto”

An MP asked how a handcuffed arrestee escaped from a police car, whether figures on escapes and attempts could be provided, and whether the broekstok (leg restraint) should always be used during transport. The Secretary of State said the escape method is unknown, gave figures for attempts and one escape (no figures for arrestees are registered), and defended the current case-by-case restraint policy while declining to recover costs from the arrestee.
Figures on the number of escapes and attempts by arrestees are not available, because they are not registered as such.
Cijfers over het aantal ontvluchtingen en het aantal pogingen hiertoe van arrestanten zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de houding van geprivilegieerden t.a.v. betaling van boetes

An MP asks whether diplomats who ignore serious traffic fines should be sanctioned more effectively, including via a blacklist and fuel-card measures like those used in the United States. The minister answers that roughly half of the fines in 2012-2013 went unpaid, that Netherlands lacks jurisdiction over absolute-immunity diplomats, and that announced measures aim to encourage payment, while the US-style approach is deemed unsuitable.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has examined in detail the options for holding privileged persons to account for unacceptable conduct, without undermining the treaty obligations the Netherlands has.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft uitvoerig gekeken naar mogelijkheden om geprivilegieerden aan te spreken op onacceptabel gedrag, zonder dat daarmee afbreuk wordt gedaan aan de verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen die Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over politie en Openbaar Ministerie die niets doen tegen ladingdiefstal door spookbedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police and the Public Prosecution Service were doing nothing about cargo theft by a fake company, including why the victim company was no longer contacted and why an investigation was apparently halted. The minister answered that the case was transferred to the national police infrastructure unit, that contacts with the victim continue, that the appointment-based complaint procedure is explained by limits on internet reporting, and that police and prosecution were unaware of the Haaglanden investigation mentioned in the press.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over vluchtelingen met een vals paspoort die vrijuit gaan

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why asylum seekers carrying forged passports escape prosecution, whether this conflicts with the Refugee Convention, and what measures would be taken. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution is only possible after a final rejection of the asylum claim, that the Supreme Court ruling is binding, and that no new measures or treaty withdrawal are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Helder over de ronselfilm ‘Fighting Journalists, Oh Oh Aleppo “De spookstad”

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they knew of a jihadist recruitment film targeting Dutch youth, whether it aimed at recruiting for jihad, how they view the fact that the people involved are third-generation Dutch-born, and whether they would prosecute the makers and strip citizenship from dual nationals. The minister confirmed knowledge of the film, said it intends to radicalise and recruit youth, stated that recruitment for jihad is a crime with prosecution decided case by case by the Public Prosecution Service, and noted citizenship can be revoked after a final terrorism conviction where dual nationality exists.
Recruiting for jihad is a crime. The Public Prosecution Service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een dader van een gewelddadige overval die vrij komt door een blunder van de politie (ingezonden 11 juni 2014).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a violent jeweller robbery where a convicted-on-appeal suspect was acquitted, allegedly due to police blunders and missing camera footage, and whether evidence can be tracked to prevent loss. The Minister answers that the court acquitted for insufficient evidence, not a police blunder, describes the existing track-and-trace system for forensic traces, and says no compensation or further action is warranted.
There is no question of a blunder.
Er is geen sprake van een blunder.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Helder over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)  het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft gepasseerd bij het fraudeonderzoek in het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis te Nieuwegei

MPs Klever and Helder asked whether the NZa bypassed the Public Prosecution Service (OM) by imposing only an administrative fine in the St. Antonius hospital fraud case, and whether the tripartite protocol was followed. The ministers answered that the NZa independently concluded there was no intent, so the case did not qualify as a criminal offence under the ne bis in idem rules, that the hospital repaid improper claims, and that fraud must be fought through an integrated approach.

The NZa independently concluded, on the basis of the available investigative material, that no intent had been shown in this case and that the conduct therefore did not also constitute a criminal offence.

De NZa heeft zelfstandig, op basis van het beschikbare onderzoeksmateriaal, de conclusie getrokken dat er in het onderhavige geval van opzet niet is gebleken en de gedraging derhalve niet tevens een strafbaar feit opleverde.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het rapport ‘Geef integriteit in rechtspraak meer systematisch aandacht’ van de Universiteit Leiden in opdracht van de Raad voor de rechtspraak en het bericht ‘financiële belang

An MP asked the Minister about a Leiden University report on integrity in the judiciary, including public registration of judges' financial interests and secondary positions, and combining judgeship with political roles. The Minister said an advisory working group is studying financial-interest disclosure and will report, that secondary positions must be registered and disciplinary measures are possible, and that the integrity system is already considered sound.
Once the advice is completed, the Council for the Judiciary will come with a position.
Zodra het advies is afgerond zal de Raad voor de rechtspraak met een standpunt komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Per dag 4 keer grof geweld tegen politie’

The MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report of four serious violent attacks on police per day, the accuracy of the figures, further measures, and why such crimes receive community service sentences. The Minister confirms the police registered 5,520 incidents and 4,332 reports of aggression and violence against police officers in 2013, a decline from 2012, says violence in all forms is unacceptable, refers to a letter on further measures to follow in autumn, and notes that sentencing in serious violence cases is a matter for the prosecution and judiciary.
I will answer you before the date of 18 June.
Ik zal u antwoorden voor de datum van 18 juni aanstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke Zwitserse jeugdcrimineel die in Nederland in een luxueus hotel is geplaatst

MP Helder asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why a dangerous Swiss young offender was housed in a luxury hotel in the Netherlands, how this squares with earlier answers, whether the Netherlands should decide on flight risk itself, and whether the hotel has training rooms for young offenders. The State Secretary answered that the stay was temporary housing within a resocialisation trajectory rather than treatment, agreed the Netherlands must judge risk itself, saw no need for action toward Switzerland, and denied that hotels have training rooms for offenders or that taxpayer money pays for this.
I trust that this will result in the Swiss authorities handling such a case differently in the future
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit tot gevolg heeft dat de Zwitserse autoriteiten een dergelijke zaak in de toekomst op een andere manier zullen behandelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over bendeleden die naar Marokko zijn gevlucht

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether gang members fled to Morocco to evade police, whether they are suspects, and why Morocco would refuse legal assistance requests. The minister answered that all suspects in the investigation have been arrested, no suspects are hiding in Morocco, no legal assistance requests were made, and the investigation is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
Because the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any statements on this point.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt kan ik op dit punt geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Lubbers wilde strafzaak voorkomen”

MP Helder asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecutor had been aware of former PM Lubbers' statements about nuclear weapons at Volkel and why no prosecution followed, and whether this amounts to class justice. The minister answered that the OM knew of the public statements, found no grounds for a criminal investigation after establishing whether they were factually accurate, and denied that Lubbers' former office played any role.
In connection with this, the OM stated in its press release that there were no grounds for conducting a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft in verband daarmee in het betreffende persbericht gemeld dat er geen aanknopingspunten waren voor het verrichten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het ten onrechte vrij laten van Somalische piraten

Two PVV MPs asked why Somali pirates were released early despite earlier assurances that this only happens on proven departure, and whether they will serve their full sentences and be deported afterwards. The State Secretary replied that the law wrongly allows early release for foreigners who file asylum claims, that he will propose amending the Criminal Code, that the court found lawful residence so release applies, and that deportation of pirates is being pursued through agreements with Somalia.
I will therefore submit a proposal as soon as possible to amend the Criminal Code on this point so that only foreigners with a stable form of lawful residence can be eligible for conditional release.

Ik zal daarom zo spoedig mogelijk een voorstel indienen om het Wetboek van Strafrecht op dit punt te wijzigen zodat alleen vreemdelingen met een bestendige vorm van rechtmatig verblijf voor voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling in aanmerking kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Werkstraf voor doodrijdster Jim (16)’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether a community service sentence for a 16-year-old who killed a cyclist is acceptable to the victim's family, and whether community service as a main penalty should be abolished. The State Secretary declined to comment on the court's ruling, said the prosecution's demand was carefully made, and stated the cabinet wants to keep community service but considers it unsuitable for serious sex and violent crimes.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on a judgment of the court.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over een oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Buurtvader Gestel: “Ik ga derde overvaller Deurne niet aangeven”

PVV MPs asked why no action was taken against a neighbourhood father who said he would not name the third robber of a Deurne jeweller, and whether he should be arrested and whether Moroccans distrusting the Dutch should give up benefits and leave. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation and rejected the claim of a failed integration and parallel society, and rejected the benefit-surrender idea by restating that everyone has equal rights and duties.
The investigation into the robbery in Deurne – and therefore also the investigation into all possible suspects – has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek naar de overval in Deurne – en daarmee ook het onderzoek naar alle mogelijke verdachten – is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over misdrijven plegende Afghaanse diplomaat en de uitzending van PowNews d.d. 17 april 2014

Parliamentarians Helder and De Roon asked why an Afghan diplomat who assaulted and damaged property was only reprimanded, not expelled, waived immunity or prosecuted, and what was done about his parking abuse and diplomatic plates. The government answered that the diplomat's conduct was unacceptable but did not warrant expulsion, that Nederland cannot waive or prosecute under absolute immunity, and that a New York-style plate revocation was studied and rejected for legal and practical reasons.
In this case the diplomat's conduct was indeed completely unacceptable, but it did not qualify for such a visible and politically charged sanction.
In dit geval was het gedrag van de betreffende diplomaat weliswaar volstrekt onacceptabel, maar kwalificeerde het niet voor het treffen van een dergelijke zichtbare en politiek beladen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke Zwitserse jeugdcrimineel die in Nederland in een luxueus hotel is geplaatst

An MP asked whether a Swiss juvenile offender was relocated to a luxury Dutch hotel for training and whether he should be sent back. The Secretary of State answered that it was temporary supervised housing within a resocialisation plan, that Switzerland did not notify the Dutch authorities, and that he had already left the Netherlands, with no public cost.
This concerned temporary housing within the framework of his resocialisation trajectory and therefore not a transfer.
Dit betrof tijdelijke huisvesting in het kader van zijn resocialisatietraject en dus geen overplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over het bericht dat de Interpol database van gestolen en/of vermiste paspoorten nauwelijks wordt gecheckt

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether Interpol's database of stolen and lost passports, which they said is rarely checked by governments, is adequately used at Dutch airports. The state secretary answered that the Koninklijke Marechaussee and national police have access to the database and consult it when needed, that the Schengen border check is secure, and that the Netherlands works with EU partners on passenger data.
I am currently examining the possibilities to better use this database to flag illegal immigration, serious crime and terrorism in passenger flows.
Ik onderzoek momenteel de mogelijkheden om deze databank beter te benutten bij het in passagiersstromen signaleren van illegale immigratie, zware criminaliteit en terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over allochtone homohaters uit Amersfoort

MPs asked the ministers about reports that a gay man in Amersfoort was driven out of his neighbourhood by harassment from young men, and whether mass immigration and Islamisation hinder gay emancipation and whether perpetrators should be expelled or punished more harshly. The ministers condemned discrimination, said perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected, rejected expulsion of Dutch nationals, and listed existing local and national support measures without new concrete commitments.
Perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected.
Daders moeten worden aangepakt en slachtoffers beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat jonge criminelen van 12 tot 23 jaar binnenkort als straf naar school gestuurd kunnen worden

PVV MPs asked whether the government accepts that compulsory education as a penalty for young offenders aged 12 to 23 undermines school safety and whether it is a real intervention. The minister said the bill, which is pending advice from the Council of State, gives a basis to bring such youths into education and that a full debate will follow after submission, without detailing the research basis.
On the justification of the bill and what is necessary for its proper implementation, we would be glad to hold the debate with you after it is submitted to your House.
Over de onderbouwing van het wetsvoorstel en hetgeen voor een goede uitvoering daarvan noodzakelijk is, voeren wij na indiening bij uw Kamer graag het debat met u.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een slachtoffer dat niet wist van het verlof van haar verkrachter

An MP asks why a rape victim was not informed about her offender's leave, and whether registration at the Informatiepunt Detentieverloop should extend to offenders who were not held in pre-trial detention in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answers that the OM followed its policy, which requires prior pre-trial detention for registration, acknowledges the consequences, and promises a revised policy by summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat uitbreken in de bajes kinderspel is

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether it is acceptable that prisoners can escape from their cells with a simple screwdriver, and whether he will take immediate measures. The State Secretary acknowledged the incident, said an investigation is ongoing, noted that the cell had double escape protection, and said the bolts securing the bars are being replaced, though he sees no need for further measures.
An investigation into how the incident was able to occur is currently under way.
Momenteel loopt een onderzoek naar de wijze waarop het incident zich heeft kunnen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het vrijlaten van Syrië-gangers

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he is aware of a court releasing Syria-travellers pending trial, whether they should be detained rather than released, and whether administrative detention and denaturalisation should be used against returnees. The minister answered that courts weigh flight and recidivism risk, that reclassering supervision intensity follows a risk instrument, that the AIVD assesses returnees, and that administrative detention is unnecessary since criminal and administrative tools already exist.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation of the persons concerned.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke situatie van betreffende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een zware crimineel die vrijkomt door een tikfout

An MP asked why a serious criminal was released early due to a clerical error by the Utrecht court (6 years entered as 6 months), why prison staff and a second check did not catch it, and what will prevent recurrence. The government acknowledged the administrative error, said the court tightened its work processes and the issue will be discussed nationally, and stated that an extra prison-level check would add no value and that the suspect is being actively sought.
The court has in the meantime tightened its own work processes in this area, after consulting with the Public Prosecution Service about it.
De rechtbank heeft ondertussen de eigen werkprocessen op dit gebied aangescherpt, na hierover met het OM contact te hebben gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over chemische drugslaboratoria d.d. 18 februari 2014

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on chemical drug labs, including whether criminals exploit substances not yet listed under the Opium Act and whether a generic ban on new drugs should be introduced. The minister acknowledged the problem, rejected a generic ban citing a 2012 RIVM assessment and existing legal tools, and stated that lab dismantling by police with LFO expertise minimises risks to residents.
The cabinet concluded that the benefits of introducing a generic system would be extremely limited and certainly would not outweigh the disadvantages.
Het kabinet concludeerde dat de voordelen van de invoering van een generiek stelsel uiterst beperkt zouden zijn en zeker niet opwegen tegen de nadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de moordenaar van Melanie Sijbers wapens maakte tijdens zijn vluchtpoging en het bericht “Foutenfestival rond Peter H. onderzocht”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether reports that the murderer of Melanie Sijbers made weapons during an escape attempt and that a 'festival of errors' surrounded his placement were accurate, and how such tools and placements would be prevented in future. The State Secretary denied the weapons claim, said tools are kept locked away, stated that the placement procedure was correctly followed, and announced a review and a change to the procedure for placing extreme-profile detainees.
An extensive security investigation is currently under way into the fact that Peter H. was nevertheless able to leave his cell.
Naar het feit dat Peter H. wel zijn cel heeft weten te verlaten vindt momenteel een uitgebreid veiligheidsonderzoek plaats.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Helder en Oskam over zijn uitspraak dat er goede gesprekken zijn met de advocaat van een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude en zijn toezegging de Kamer hierover te informeren

MPs Gesthuizen, Helder and Oskam asked why the minister said in parliament that talks with the lawyer of an identity-fraud victim were going well, and whether the Chamber had been properly informed. The minister replied that talks took place, the last on 16 April 2013, that the state asked for substantiation of the claimed damages, and that the lawyer was still considering a response; he said the earlier statement was accurate and that individual cases are not usually discussed substantively in the Chamber.
It is not customary to discuss an ongoing individual case in substance in the Chamber.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om in uw Kamer inhoudelijk in te gaan op een lopende individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer overval zelf de cel in’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a crime victim who detained a robbery suspect and was now being investigated as a suspect should be treated as a helpful citizen, and whether this conflicts with the 2010 guideline on self-defence. The minister replied that the victim was never treated as a suspect for the robbery, but is suspected of threatening the suspect's girlfriend afterwards, so the self-defence guideline does not apply, and no help or letter to parliament is planned.
At present I see no need to provide assistance to the citizen concerned.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak om hulp te verlenen aan de betreffende burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Reorganisatie Openbaar Ministerie (OM) ‘gevaarlijk’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the planned reorganisation of the Openbaar Ministerie (public prosecution service) endangers criminal prosecution, whether budget cuts rather than court mergers cause problems, and whether the Chamber will be kept informed. The minister replied that the report is known, referred to earlier answers to similar questions, and said the Chamber is informed twice a year via the Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen programme, with the next report before the summer recess.
I inform the Chamber twice a year about the state of affairs of the Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen programme.
Ik informeer uw Kamer twee keer per jaar over de stand van zaken van het programma Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over jonge criminelen die hulpverleners uitlachen

PVV MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about young criminals mocking youth-care and police workers, doubting the effectiveness of the youth gang approach, judges' acquittals, expanding ISD measures to 12-year-olds, and parental liability. The minister rejected the claim that the approach fails, pointed to judicial independence, said ISD is being tested for 16-23 year olds and youths 12+ already have sanctions, and noted parents can be prosecuted or held liable for damages up to age 14 or 15 in civil law.
On 12 November 2013 I informed the House of Representatives about this.
Op 12 november 2013 heb ik de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Scores politie onbetrouwbaar’

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police registration of solved crimes is unreliable and how Parliament can supervise crime-fighting performance and High Impact Crime statistics. The Minister answers that the inspectorate's findings concern mainly the former regional systems, that police statistics are not unreliable overall, and that measures to fix registration are underway.
I do not share the view that the police figures are unreliable.
Ik deel de opvatting dat de politiecijfers onbetrouwbaar zijn niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Puinhopen bij justitie Limburg”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of serious problems at the Limburg public prosecution service and whether the government will act, inform parliament and accept that problems stem from court mergers and digitisation. The minister rejects the 'puinhopen' characterisation, points to earlier letters and measures taken by the Limburg parquet, and attributes some issues to the reorganisation while promising regional fixes.
Where (temporary) coordination problems arise, the district prosecution office takes measures to address them.
Daar waar zich (tijdelijke) problemen in de afstemming voordoen treft het arrondissementsparket daarvoor maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over de berichten “Rijbewijs gewoon te koop in Litouwen” en “Litauiske forekort kjopes for 80 Euro”

Two PVV MPs asked the transport minister whether Lithuanian driving licences bought for 80 euros should no longer be accepted in the Netherlands and whether Lithuanian vehicles should be barred from Dutch roads. The minister answered that no fraud has been established, that EU rules require mutual recognition of licences and free movement precludes banning Lithuanian vehicles, and that roadside checks continue.
This could be the case if fraud had been demonstrated. However, this is not the case.
Dit zou het geval kunnen zijn als fraude zou zijn aangetoond. Dit is echter niet het geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de benoeming van de Venezolaanse Consul in Aruba

Two PVV MPs asked whether Venezuela appointed a consul in Aruba who is suspected of drug trafficking linked to a terrorist organisation, whether he is on US watch lists, whether an international arrest request applies, and whether this was raised during a Dutch delegation visit. The minister answered that no request for a new Venezuelan consul-general in Aruba has been received, that the person is publicly listed on the US Treasury SDN list since 2008, that the Justice Minister will not comment on non-public lists or arrest requests, and that the delegation visit did not raise the appointment.
The Minister of Security and Justice does not comment on non-public lists of the United States or on international arrest and detention requests.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie doet geen uitspraken over niet-openbare lijsten van de Verenigde Staten of internationale opsporings- en aanhoudingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Tieners roven impulsief en voor de kick’ en ‘Stoere straatrover in de cel vaak een grienend jochie’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether juvenile street robbers under 16 should be punished harder, whether 14- and 15-year-olds should be tried under adult criminal law, and whether the adolescent criminal law should be reversed. The minister said the existing integrated approach and juvenile law suffice, that adult law for 14- and 15-year-olds would conflict with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, and that the adolescent criminal law will be kept.
I see no reason, given the age of the street robbers as described in the newspaper article, to further strengthen the approach described in answer 2.
Ik zie in de leeftijd van de straatrovers -zoals bedoeld in het krantenartikel- geen aanleiding de in antwoord 2 beschreven aanpak verder te verstevigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Klever over het bericht van de Nationale ombudsman “fraude valt mee”

Two PVV MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the National Ombudsman's statement that fraud is less serious than assumed, and whether they agree that all fraud must be tackled and that such statements insult taxpayers. The Minister replied that all fraud is unacceptable, pointed to the Rijksbrede aanpak Fraude and the zorgfraude plan of action, and said he does not share the view that the Ombudsman's statement is an insult, as the Ombudsman's task is to oversee government.
No, I do not share that view. The National Ombudsman's task is to oversee the government and make statements about it.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. De Nationale Ombudsman heeft tot taak om toe te zien op de overheid en daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een man 1000 xtc-pillen naar detentiecentrum Zeist heeft meegenomen zonder dat het personeel dat in de gaten had

An MP asked the State Secretary whether staff at detention centre Zeist should have recognised 1,000 ecstasy pills smuggled in by a detainee, and whether the man should be tracked down and deported to serve his sentence abroad. The State Secretary confirmed staff did seize and recognise the pills but failed to report them promptly, led an internal investigation with staff reprimanded, and said the case concerns a remand prisoner whose conviction is not yet final, so enforcement is not yet possible.
It was wrongly neglected to report the discovered contraband immediately.
Ten onrechte is verzuimd dadelijk aangifte te doen van de aangetroffen contrabande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een verkrachter met tbs weer de straat op mag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a sex offender under TBS (detention under a hospital order) being released on conditional termination was acceptable, and whether the leave scheme should change. The minister answered that conditional termination is allowed only when the risk is sufficiently reduced, that reclassering supervision and conditions apply, and that the leave scheme needs no change for this case, though a separate revision is planned.
The court extended the TBS order by one year and conditionally ended the state-ordered detention.
De rechtbank heeft de terbeschikkingstelling met een termijn van een jaar verlengd, en de verpleging van overheidswege voorwaardelijk beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een invalide man die al voor de vijfde keer is overvallen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a disabled man robbed for the fifth time, asking whether the police will catch the perpetrators quickly and punish them harshly. The minister condemned the robberies, said police are investigating and taking prevention measures, and declined to give publicly the progress of the investigation.
It is not conducive to the chances of success of this investigation if I make public statements about its progress.
Het is voor de succeskansen van dit onderzoek niet dienstig als ik over de voortgang publiekelijk mededelingen doe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over journalist van PowNews / Angolese ambassade

MPs Helder and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an Angolan embassy employee who assaulted a PowNews journalist, and whether diplomats committing offences should be expelled. The minister said the matter went to police and the public prosecutor, outlined diplomatic tools such as protest, requests to lift immunity and persona non grata status, and promised a letter on tackling offences by privileged persons.
During the budget debate of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, a letter was promised to the House on tackling offences committed by privileged persons.

Tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is aan de Kamer een brief toegezegd over de aanpak van de problematiek rondom overtredingen en/of misdrijven door geprivilegieerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over cijfers van de ‘span of control’ bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen en de Dienst Vervoer & Ondersteuning in het bijzonder

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about average span of control (number of staff per manager) at the Rijksoverheid, DJI and DV&O, and whether DV&O's 54 managers for 1,100 fte was justified amid budget cuts. The State Secretary answered with per-unit figures (DV&O has 63 managers for 1,055 fte, after a reorganisation added managers) and defended the ratios as efficient given DV&O's nationally deployed tasks.
No, DV&O has a total of 63 managers on a staff of 1,055 fte.
Nee, de DV&O heeft in totaal 63 leidinggevenden op een personeelsbestand van 1.055 fte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over banen en opleidingen voor jihadisten

Two MPs asked whether returning jihadists are being helped with jobs, training and neighbourhood activities instead of being prosecuted, and what measures will stop this. The minister answered that each returnee gets a threat assessment, criminal prosecution is examined case by case, a local tailored approach may be used to reduce threat, and the prosecution service is examining criminal investigation options for returnees.
For every person returning from Syria a threat assessment is made and it is examined whether criminal prosecution is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt een dreigingsinschatting gemaakt en wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over trajectcontroles

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about average-speed (trajectory) checks, including boete counts on the Utrecht-Amsterdam route, revenue, and accident effects on the A2. The minister answered that the 2012 comparison cannot be made reliably, reported roughly 43.6 million euro in sanctions from May to August 2013, said revenue goes to the state treasury, and deferred the accident question until 2014 data is available.
The requested comparison cannot be made properly.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet goed te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over berichten dat de politie een verkrachtingszaak een jaar laat liggen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police left a rape case untouched for a year, and whether mistakes by police and prosecutors should be recorded. The minister confirmed the reports, agreed that measuring is knowing in principle, but said registering errors is impractical and that 'error' is hard to define, so no registration is planned.
Beyond the considerable administrative burden this would impose on police and the Public Prosecution Service, the main obstacle is that the concept of 'error' cannot be defined unambiguously.
Naast de aanzienlijke administratieve last die dit voor politie en Openbaar Ministerie met zich mee zou brengen staat daaraan vooral in de weg dat het begrip «fout» niet eenduidig te definiëren is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Gevangene ontsnapt in Groningen’ en ‘Tbs’er ontsnapt tijdens proefverlof’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of a prisoner escaping in Groningen and a tbs patient absconding during supervised leave, and whether the leave system should be tightened (two guards, police alerts) and the costs recovered. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, explained the leave was approved after a positive advisory opinion and had gone without incident, said his position on tightening rules is unchanged, and declined to recover search costs since police core tasks are not charged.
After the Advisory Committee on tbs leave review (AVt) gave a positive recommendation, supervised leave was granted from 13 April 2012.
Nadat het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing tbs (AVt) positief heeft geadviseerd is er per 13 april 2012 begeleid verlof verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Polenprijsje voor niet handsfree bellen: 50 euro’

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreign truck drivers are favoured in traffic fines, citing a Polish driver fined 50 euros instead of 220 for phone use, and whether the government will stop this and re-sanction affected drivers. The minister answered that foreign drivers are not favoured, that the reduced amount was an exceptional prosecutorial decision given perishable cargo, that data on foreign fines is limited, and that a settled sanction cannot be increased.
Foreign drivers are not favoured when imposing traffic fines.
Buitenlandse chauffeurs worden niet bevoordeeld bij het opleggen van verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een voorstel van de politiebond om niet te bezuinigen op de politie en het OM, maar om te investeren in de fraudeaanpak

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government would respond to a police union proposal to invest in fraud enforcement instead of cutting police and prosecution budgets, and whether it would collect fraud statistics like Britain. The minister answered that fraud is a top priority, a cross-departmental action plan will be presented by year-end without pre-empting its measures, and that reliable fraud-size estimates are very difficult, so statistics are not an end in themselves.
As I announced in my letter of 3 July, the cabinet will present an action plan before the end of this year.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 3 juli jl. heb aangekondigd, zal het kabinet voor het einde van dit jaar een actieplan presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Sluitingsdatum Willem II gevangenis in Tilburg staat nog steeds niet vast” en de Rijksbegroting 2014 Veiligheid en Justitie

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Tilburg prison (PI Tilburg), leased to Belgium, will stay open after 2016, and whether earlier statements on this were misleading given the budget text. The State Secretary reaffirmed his statements, said Belgium's cabinet has agreed to extend use in 2014 and formal steps are underway, but only the extension to 31 December 2016 is currently on the table.
I will inform your House and the staff of PI Tilburg when the decision-making is definitively concluded.
Ik zal uw Kamer en de medewerkers van de PI Tilburg berichten wanneer de besluitvorming definitief is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de Marokkaanse groepsmishandeling van een vrouw

MPs from the PVV asked about a reported group assault on a woman by Moroccan men, whether the perpetrators had been arrested, whether the government would acknowledge a 'Moroccan problem' and expel convicted offenders, and whether group liability should be extended. The minister replied that police found the woman admitted to fabricating the account, a false-report procedure was started, and that group participation in violence is already punishable under article 141 of the Criminal Code, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
Following this confession, the police drew up an official report against her for filing a false complaint.
Naar aanleiding van deze bekentenis heeft de politie proces-verbaal tegen haar opgemaakt wegens het doen van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Aankoop EU voor niets”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reported spending on a building for a planned European Public Prosecutor's Office was wasteful given the office's uncertain status, and whether Netherlands should host so many international organisations in times of crisis. The Minister said no Rijksgebouwendienst purchase for the EPPO exists and referred to earlier answers on a Den Haag building, while defending the government's policy of attracting international organisations to the Netherlands.
The Rijksgebouwendienst has not purchased any location for a European Public Prosecutor's Office.
De Rijksgebouwendienst heeft geen locatie aangekocht ten behoeve van een Europees Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Twee jonge criminelen lopen weg uit behandelcentrum ‘

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about two young offenders who escaped from a youth detention centre by getting into a car, and asked about Burgernet alerts, cost recovery and preventing future escapes. The state secretary confirmed the escape, said an internal investigation is pending, defended the discretion over Burgernet and the policy against recovering police costs, and promised to review measures after the investigation.
I am awaiting the investigation being carried out by the Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit of the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) into this incident.
Ik ben in afwachting van het onderzoek dat door het Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) wordt uitgevoerd naar dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Moordenaar niet teruggekeerd van verlof”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a convicted murderer who failed to return from prison leave in July 2013 and whether the public was informed, and asked about abolishing leave and charging prisoners for their resocialisation.
