The State Secretary answered that the prisoner was arrested in Austria in August 2013, that leave is part of resocialisation and recidivism reduction, that the government plans to abolish the current detention phasing and introduce electronic detention, and that the public is informed mainly through investigation appeals.
In view of this incident, the Public Prosecution Service has requested the court that the conditional early release of prisoner N. be further withheld.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft gezien dit voorval bij de rechtbank gevorderd dat de voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling van gedetineerde N. verder achterwege blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het weren van diplomaten die hun boetes niet betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch policy allows withdrawal of agrément from diplomats who repeatedly commit traffic offences and do not pay fines, and why the agrément procedure is not more publicly visible. The minister answered that agrément is never withdrawn, that persona non grata is a last-resort instrument with risk to bilateral relations, and that the ministry sends quarterly letters to embassies about unpaid fines.
Agrément is granted but not withdrawn.
Agrément wordt verleend maar niet ingetrokken.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Agent wil DNA niet afstaan voor databank» (ingezonden 6 augustus 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether all police officers, especially forensic investigators, should be included in the elimination DNA database for serious crimes, and why a promise made in December 2012 has not yet been fulfilled. The minister answers that voluntary registration is growing, that the new National Police will contribute through a uniform privacy regulation, and that he trusts it will ensure adequate registration, promising a letter in the autumn.
I therefore have every confidence that the National Police will ensure adequate registration in the elimination database.
Ik heb er dan ook alle vertrouwen in dat de Nationale Politie zal zorgen voor afdoende registratie in de eliminatiedatabank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tbs’er op verlof aangehouden voor belagen 13-jarig meisje’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether a tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient on leave, arrested for stalking a 13-year-old girl, should be disclosed, and whether the leave regime should be tightened, including armed escorts and police profiles. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, described the transmural leave approval process and the revocation rules, and declined to change the regime, citing the recidivism figures and that the risk cannot be fully excluded.
For the person concerned, FPC de Rooyse Wissel requested an authorization for transmural leave on 24 May 2013.
Voor betrokkene is door FPC de Rooyse Wissel op 24 mei 2013 een machtiging aangevraagd voor transmuraal verlof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Ontsnapte boefjes gepakt’ en ‘Drie ontsnapte jongeren uit Hartelborgt aangehouden’

An MP asked the State Secretary about press reports of three youths escaping from the Hartelborgt juvenile institution, whether the escape was easy, whether the investigation would be shared with parliament, and whether measures would prevent future escapes. The State Secretary said investigations by DJI and the inspectorates are underway, the inspectorate will publish its findings, the DJI security investigation stays confidential, and further measures depend on the outcomes.
The security investigation, carried out by the DJI Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit, is confidential in nature and will not be presented publicly.
Het veiligheidsonderzoek, uitgevoerd door Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI), is vertrouwelijk van aard en wordt niet publiekelijk gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Helder over het bericht: 'Seks, drugs en telefoons in jeugdgevangenis'

MP Helder (PVV) asked the state secretary about press reports of drugs, phones, sex and freedom of movement in a youth detention centre (Teylingereind), including whether the convicted killer of a referee had access to a key, and whether detention is punitive enough and whether searches should be standard. The state secretary denied the key claim, said an internal inquiry found no evidence of sexual contact with staff, admitted contraband can never be fully excluded, rejected longer maximum detention and standard full searches, and said existing rules and controls will be kept.
Following the PowNews broadcast, the management of Teylingereind immediately launched an internal investigation into the truth of this claim.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending van PowNews heeft de directie van Teylingereind direct een intern onderzoek ingesteld naar het waarheidsgehalte van deze bewering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Crimineel Martha op vrije voeten’ en ‘Topcrimineel vrijgelaten door Hof van Amsterdam’

An MP asked whether a high-profile criminal released pending appeal by the Amsterdam appeals court should have been freed, and what measures the government would take to prevent such releases and to implement immediate execution of sentences after first-instance conviction. The minister said it cannot comment on the court's release decisions, that the prosecution had argued for continued detention and has no appeal remedy, that appeal alone is not grounds for suspending detention, and that a bill on immediate execution will be put to consultation this month.
I cannot comment on the assessments by the district court and the appeals court in connection with the suspensions in the criminal cases mentioned in answer 1.
Ik kan niet treden in de beoordelingen door de rechtbank en het gerechtshof in verband met de schorsingen in de in antwoord 1 genoemde strafzaken.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het aantal ontvluchtpogingen van gedetineerden en het gebruik van vrijheidsbeperkende middelen bij het vervoer van gedetineerden (in

An MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice for the number of escape attempts by detainees during transport since May 2012 and the total number transported, and questioned the policy of not applying restraints by default after an ombudsman ruling. The secretary disclosed 14 attempts (2 successful) out of about 44,000 persons and 138,000 transport movements, denied that the policy invites escapes, and said the current rules are adequate.
Yes. In the period May 2012 through June 2013, there were 14 attempts to escape from transport.
Ja. In de periode mei 2012 tot en met juni 2013 hebben zich 14 pogingen tot onttrekking aan transport voorgedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat Samir A. begin september vrijkomt

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government will overturn the court decision releasing terrorist Samir A. on conditional release, and what measures will prevent such releases in future. The minister replied that the prosecution had sought to block the release and that the court rejected this, leaving no legal remedy, but strict conditions (reporting duty, location and contact bans, media ban, exit ban, passport seized, strictest reclassering supervision) now apply, and that life sentences are the appropriate tool for such cases.
The court however decided otherwise, and I have no legal remedies available against that.
De rechtbank heeft evenwel anders beslist en daartegen staan mij geen rechtsmiddelen open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het laffe Marokkaanse geweld tegen twee zusjes

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about a violent incident against two sisters by Moroccan youths, the over-representation of Moroccan Dutch in violent crime statistics, the government's seriousness on the issue, and whether offenders should be prosecuted, denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that the SCP explains only part of the gap, that the approach targets risk behaviour without ethnic distinction, that local authorities handle public order, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onophoudende Marokkaanse geweld (ingezonden 4 juli 2013).

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret reports that Moroccan Dutch are over-represented in violent and property crime, whether mass immigration has made society less safe, and whether a harsher repressive approach and immigration stop are warranted. The minister acknowledged the high crime rates, said SCP research shows background factors explain only part of the gap, and rejected group-based measures and denaturalisation for common crimes, favouring prevention and tough action without ethnic distinction.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common crimes is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked about child abuse at a Tilburg Koran school, why the complaint did not lead to prosecution, how many complaints against Islamic institutions led to cases, and whether schools promoting hatred should be closed. The minister said the prosecutor found too few leads for further investigation, data cannot be split by institution type, and closure is possible only where needed for public order or building-safety violations.
The Public Prosecution Service assessed the complaint and concluded it offered too few leads for further criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft de aangifte beoordeeld en is tot de conclusie gekomen dat deze te weinig aanknopingspunten biedt voor een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een 10-jarig meisje is aangerand door een illegaal in Nederland verblijvende Somalische bewoner v

PVV MPs asked the state secretary how a suspect with a record of sexual aggression, residing illegally in the Netherlands, could move freely and whether such persons should be detained, and asked for a guarantee he would not be released and how many criminal illegal residents exist. The state secretary replied that the suspect was arrested and detained pending trial, that his removal was blocked by lack of treatment options in his country of origin, that the court decides on the measure, and that the government is improving data on criminal illegal residents.
It is for the judge to decide which measure is appropriate, taking into account all circumstances of the case and the perpetrator's personal situation.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen welke maatregel passend is, alle omstandigheden van het geval en de persoon van de dader meewegend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Nederland paradijs voor buitenlandse inbreker”

An MP from the PVV asks whether the Netherlands is attractive to foreign burglars because of low sentences, low detection and clearance rates, and a small chance of imprisonment, and asks about minimum sentences, stacking of sentences, deportation and border closure. The state secretary acknowledges concern about burglary and low clearance rates, rejects minimum sentences and says the government will review sentence stacking and German measures, while promising to raise detection rates and the integrated approach.
My ambitions for tackling home burglary are therefore considerable.
Mijn ambities voor de aanpak van woninginbraken zijn dan ook fors.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Geld voor gedupeerde TBS-patiënten» (ingezonden 26 juni 2013).

An MP asks the state secretary whether TBS patients forced to transfer when a clinic closes could claim compensation, how much that might cost, and whether this should be ruled out. The state secretary replies that only courts can award damages, that a lawful transfer creates no unlawful situation, and that the transfers will be carefully managed to avoid treatment delays.
Only the judge rules on awarding compensation in the case a TBS patient claims it.
Alleen de rechter oordeelt over toekenning van een schadevergoeding in het geval een tbs-gestelde dat eist.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het nieuwsbericht over het debat Masterplan DJI op de intranetsite van Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI), Dienst vervoer en Onder

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether an internal DJI intranet news item on the Masterplan DJI debate was incomplete for omitting the PVV, and whether it amounted to censorship that should be corrected. The State Secretary answered that the item was not deliberately incomplete, that it only summarised some of the 17 motions (the PVV motion being referenced via another intranet item), and that no correction would be made.
I do not believe the news item is deliberately incomplete.
Ik ben niet van mening dat het nieuwsbericht bewust incompleet is.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichten «Heb ik recht op een uitkering als ik naar een gevangenis ga?» en «Utrecht weigerde ten onrechte bijstand tbs’er» (ingezonden 2

An MP asked the minister whether the limited list of benefits that stop during imprisonment also applies to tbs detainees, and whether convicted offenders should be barred from benefits and allowances while detained. The state secretary confirmed the rule applies to tbs patients with an exception for those discharged from prosecution, explained that detained persons have no right to assistance under the Wet werk en bijstand, and listed the limited set of situations in which benefits may continue.
The Wet socialezekerheidsrechten gedetineerden provides that a person deprived of liberty under law has no entitlement to a benefit.
In de Wet socialezekerheidsrechten gedetineerden is geregeld dat indien een persoon rechtens zijn vrijheid is ontnomen, deze geen recht heeft op een uitkering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Strafhof krijgt eigen cellen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Hague-based International Criminal Court's new holding cells, and the omission of them from the DJI Masterplan debates, were concealed, and whether the plans should be scrapped. The state secretary answered that the cells are only waiting rooms on court days, outside the Masterplan, so no prisons need closing, and declined to reconsider or relocate the court.
In view of the above, there was no reason to inform your House within the framework of the DJI Masterplan about these holding cells being built by the International Criminal Court.
Gelet op het bovenstaande was er geen aanleiding om uw Kamer in het kader van het Masterplan DJI te informeren over deze nieuw door het Internationaal Strafhof te bouwen bewaarcellen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «Jesse R. en Eric Jan Q. moeten uit de EBI» (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the RSJ ordered two serious criminals moved from the Vught EBI to a lighter regime and whether public safety can be guaranteed. The minister confirmed a new decision was required and that both were transferred to a high-security facility, saying the move was appropriate given current conduct and that additional measures can be imposed at any time.
The detainees have, as I already mentioned in answer to questions 2 and 3, been transferred to a high-security facility because this is appropriate given the detainees' current conduct.

De gedetineerden zijn, zoals ik al in het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 heb vermeld, overgeplaatst naar een hoog beveiligde inrichting omdat dit is passend is gezien het actuele gedrag van de gedetineerden.
Antwoord vragen Helder over de invloed van de EU op strafrechtelijke regelgeving

The PVV MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the ministry has studied the EU's influence on criminal law, whether the subsidiarity principle is being applied to EU legislation, whether implementing EU rules that change nothing in Dutch law is pointless, and whether he opposes a European Public Prosecutor beyond EU fraud. The minister answers that no such study was made since no need was seen, that subsidiarity checks are done via BNC-fiches and national parliaments have a role under the Lisbon Protocol, that unchanged rules need only notification, and that the Netherlands is critical of a European Public Prosecutor and will keep taking an active position.
No research as meant by the questioner has been carried out by my ministry.
Er is vanwege mijn ministerie geen onderzoek als door vragenstelster bedoeld gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Chaos bij OM leidt tot vertragingen in rechtbanken» (ingezonden 11 juni 2013).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether organisational chaos at the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is delaying court cases, letting offenders off with lower sentences and raising costs, and what will be done, including whether lengthy delays are registered, whether budget cuts are harmful, and whether a dangerous TBS patient could not be returned to custody because the OM failed to supply the file. The Minister denies chaos, says problems are limited, describes reform programmes (ZSM, the new judicial map, cooperation in the chain), declines to register the reasons for overrun cases, defends the cuts, and explains the TBS case, in which the court ruled on the merits after the full file was available.
There is no chaos at the OM and the number of cases in which problems actually arise is limited.
Er is geen sprake van chaos bij het OM en het aantal zaken waarin zich daadwerkelijk problemen voordoen is beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Vorm een Europees OM voor aanpak witwaspraktijken’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government will act on an advisory report recommending a European Public Prosecutor, and what it thinks of concerns about national sovereignty and coordination with national prosecutors. The minister replied that a Commission proposal is expected this summer, that the cabinet will form a view once it is published, and that the Netherlands has so far been critical of such an office, pointing to earlier letters and debates.
Once that draft regulation is published, the cabinet will form a view on it and share it with your House through the usual channel of a BNC fiche.
Zodra die ontwerpverordening gepubliceerd is, zal het kabinet zich daarover een mening vormen en deze delen met uw Kamer via het gebruikelijke kanaal van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord vragen Helder, Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht: ‘Discriminatie in cellen’

Three PVV MPs asked whether non-Muslim prisoners are being discriminated against by Muslim prisoners, whether Muslim prisoners gain undue influence, what measures will be taken, and how many prisoners hold dual nationality. The state secretary answered that no cases of structural discrimination or complaints to supervisory committees are known, that directors can sanction such conduct and file complaints, and that no further measures are needed.
I am not aware of any cases of (structural) discrimination of non-Islamic detainees by detainees with an Islamic background.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend van (structurele) discriminatie van niet-islamitische gedetineerden door gedetineerden met een islamitische achtergrond.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.

Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht dat toezichthouders van het Openbaar Vervoer in Amsterdam geen boete voor vernieling meer mogen geven van het Openbaar Ministerie wanneer er sprake is van

Two PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam public transport inspectors may no longer issue fines for vandalism when OV gates are forced open, and whether the government would reverse this and widen inspectors' powers. The state secretary answered that Amsterdam's VOV inspectors, who are employed by the municipality, cannot issue zwartrijden fines under article 70 of the Wet personenvervoer, so an OM policy line and an adjustment of working methods are being pursued, while refusing to withdraw the OM policy or change the regulations.
To achieve a more uniform method of settlement, the OM recently issued a policy line on fare evasion and electronic access gates.
Om tot een meer eenduidige afdoeningswijze te komen heeft het OM onlangs een beleidslijn uitgevaardigd over zwartrijden en elektronische toegangspoortjes.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Fritsma over het bericht ‘België: bijna 20 criminele illegalen per dag’

MPs Helder and Fritsma asked whether the government tracks how many illegal migrants are arrested for crimes, their nationality, and how many lead to conviction and expulsion, following a report on Belgium. The state secretary answered that this data is not yet available, that linking criminal justice and migration databases is underway with expected data in 2014, and that in 2012 about 690 convicted or suspected foreigners were removed or left from the Dutch return caseload.
The requested information is not yet available.
De gevraagde informatie is nog niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘OM te traag in verkrachtingszaak’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a rapist of a 14-year-old girl received a sentence reduction because the case stalled at police and the Public Prosecution Service, and what measures will prevent such delays. The minister answered that the prosecutor requested two years instead of the usual three because of the long delay, the court imposed 30 months (10 suspended), the verdict is under appeal, and that the delay in this case could not be explained and no measures against individuals are warranted, while stating that the justice chain's performance will be strengthened.
In this case it proved impossible to establish why additional investigation was not carried out already after the complaint was filed in 2003.
In de onderhavige casus bleek het niet mogelijk te achterhalen waarom niet reeds na het opnemen van de aangifte in 2003 aanvullend onderzoek is verricht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht “Bonnenregen op A4 wekt ergernis”

MPs De Graaf and Helder asked why many speeding fines were issued on the A4 after average-speed (trajectory) checks started, and whether signage ambiguity should be fixed and fines dropped. The minister replied that the 100 km/h limit has long applied, signage was unchanged, warning signs and press releases preceded the checks, and that fines will not be dropped.
The maximum speed on the section of the A4 where the trajectory check is located has been 100 km/h for many years.
De maximumsnelheid op het gedeelte van de A4 waar de trajectcontrole staat, is al vele jaren 100 km/h.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het mislukken van de linkse methode van 'pappen en nathouden'

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop funding social prevention projects such as street coaches, neighbourhood barbecues and combat sports in favour of harsher repression, after a study found such interventions did not reduce neighbourhood nuisance. The minister answered that the study will be shared with municipalities, that local authorities are primarily responsible for choosing combinations of preventive and repressive measures, and that the government will not change course toward minimum sentences or wider expulsion powers beyond existing policy.
It is therefore up to the local government and its partners to assess which (combinations of) measures are deployed.
Het is dan ook aan het lokaal bestuur en zijn partners om te beoordelen welke (combinaties van) maatregelen worden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Commission to test the efficiency of national courts’ en ‘ook in uw stad een EU rechter’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the EU Justice Scoreboard amounts to European control over national judges and a step toward a single European legal system. The minister replied that the scoreboard is a voluntary Commission data-collection tool for improving national court efficiency and does not assess or control individual judges.
The system offers member states an instrument with which they can, on a voluntary basis, improve national legal systems
Het systeem biedt lidstaten een instrument aan waarmee deze – op vrijwillige basis – de nationale rechtssystemen kunnen verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Erdogan maakt werk van Yunus”

MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked whether Turkey taking the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights infringes Dutch sovereignty, and whether Turkey's EU accession should be rejected. The minister answered that it has not been confirmed Turkey has referred the case, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy supporting Turkey's accession perspective.
It has not been confirmed that Turkey is referring the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights.
Het is niet bevestigd dat Turkije de zaak Yunus aan het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens voorlegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tbs’er in kliniek gepakt met kinderporno’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a tbs patient and an accomplice caught viewing child pornography on a smartphone smuggled into a forensic clinic, asking how contraband reached the ward, whether the public's trust is damaged, whether the patient had prior similar convictions, and what measures will prevent smuggling. The State Secretary confirmed the arrests, said a incident report was requested from the clinic, withheld individual offence details on privacy grounds, defended the tbs system with recidivism figures, and promised access control via the Forensische Zorg bill and a later letter on re-imposing tbs.
For privacy reasons, offence details of individual tbs patients are not made public.
Uit privacyoverwegingen worden (delict-)gegevens van individuele tbs-gestelden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Ouderen steeds banger op straat» (ingezonden 22 maart 2013).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Plus Magazine survey showing older people increasingly fearful on the street, questioning its representativeness, its claimed link to crime, and whether tougher sentences for elder abuse and other measures are planned. The minister answered that the survey is not representative, that the national Veiligheidsmonitor shows most older people feel safe, that no tripling of sentences for elder abuse is warranted since prosecutors have room within existing maxima, and referred to the budget debate for other measures.
I see no reason, and the figures given in the previous answers do not provide one either, to introduce a measure such as you propose.
Ik zie geen aanleiding, en de in de voorgaande antwoorden gegeven cijfers bieden die evenmin, om een maatregel zoals u voorstelt in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Misdaad levert een huurwoning op”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that criminals receive priority for rental housing while ordinary citizens wait years, and whether such priority can be ruled out. The minister replied that the Amsterdam 'Pak je kans' project offers temporary housing only to former offenders who work or study, on a strict protocol, in former municipal service dwellings not part of the regular stock, and that there is no priority for regular rental housing.
There is no question of priority for the named group in obtaining a regular rental home.
Er is voor de genoemde groep geen sprake van voorrang voor het krijgen van een regulier huurhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Belagers hulpverleners zwaarder gestraft

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why prosecutors' sentence demands for violence against care workers fall below the BOS guideline, and whether the minister is responsible for steering the Public Prosecution Service. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a Tilburg replication study and to a College of Procurators-General investigation into deviations from the guideline, and promised to report the outcome to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending van De Vijfde Dag op 27 februari 2013

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a broadcast showing a prosecutor allegedly lying was accurate, and whether the government would investigate, inform parliament and take action against the prosecutor. The minister referred all six questions to a separate letter to parliament sent the same day.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the letter (Parliamentary paper II 33 400-VI, no. 99) that I sent to your House today on this matter.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief (Kamerstuk II 33 400-VI, nr. 99 ) die ik uw Kamer heden heb toegezonden over deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Sterfgevallen niet als verdacht herkend, talloze moorden blijven onbekend’ en ‘Slordig met slachtoffers’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether unnatural deaths are going unrecognised and murders unsolved because autopsies are not ordered, and whether a national protocol and a changed criterion for autopsy are needed. The minister said the procedure for non-natural deaths is clear, that the Public Prosecution Service orders autopsies whenever a coroner suspects a crime, that the two cases are under investigation and could not be discussed, and that no change of criterion is planned.
In the interest of these investigations, I cannot address whether the reporting on these cases is accurate.
In het belang van deze onderzoeken kan ik niet ingaan op de vraag of de berichtgeving over deze zaken correct is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over Turkije‘s oorlogstaal en de Nederlandse Patriotmissie

Two PVV MPs asked whether Turkey's accusation that Israel commits state terrorism, and Turkish minister Davutoglu's remarks urging Syria toward war, warrant summoning the Turkish ambassador and withdrawing Dutch Patriot missiles from Turkey. The government replied that Turkey said its remarks were criticism of Assad rather than an incitement to attack Israel, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for steps toward rapprochement, and that it has no information linking a Netherlands-based figure to the Ankara bombing; it rejected withdrawing the Patriots.
The Netherlands will continue to urge Turkey and Israel to take steps that make rapprochement possible.
Nederland zal verder bij Turkije en Israël blijven aandringen op stappen die toenadering mogelijk maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over de berichten Werkstraf in plaats van tien weken cel, Oudjaarstuig lacht om straf en Hufters overal buitensluiten

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice why judges imposed lighter sentences than the prosecution demanded in New Year's Eve 'super-fast court' cases and whether harsher punishments and pink-overall community service should be used. The minister answered that most convictions matched or were close to prosecution demands, that the prosecution appealed some cases, that it raises demands by 75% (200% for assaults on public servants) for event-related crimes, and that the court decides the appropriate sentence.
It is for the judge, taking into account the concrete circumstances of the case, to impose an appropriate sentence.
Het is aan de rechter om, rekening houdend met de concrete omstandigheden van het geval, een passende straf op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over regels die een snelle publicatie van beelden mishandeling belemmeren

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice Minister whether rules and waiting lists delay the rapid publication of camera footage of serious assaults, and whether these rules should be changed and police and prosecutors allowed to share footage with other media. The minister answered that publication depends on the case and that such investigative tools must stay under prosecutors' and police control with agreed procedures, and that existing possibilities are sufficient without a new legal basis.
The use of camera footage is already possible to a sufficient degree. Inclusion in the Code of Criminal Procedure as a special investigative power is not necessary for this.
Het gebruik van camerabeelden is reeds in voldoende mate mogelijk. Opname in het Wetboek van Strafvordering als bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid is hiervoor niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Bijbanenregister rechters nog vol hiaten’, ‘Veel rechters verzwijgen bijbaan’ en ‘Verbazing over het niet melden bijbanen rechters’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that the register of judges' side jobs was incomplete and that many judges concealed their secondary positions, and whether judges' independence, conflict-of-interest rules and sanctions should be tightened. The minister said the register is being updated, that the recusal and challenge instruments work well, that a broader disciplinary sanctions bill goes to consultation by 1 April 2013, but that failing to disclose a side job does not automatically imply conflict of interest.
I agree that conflict of interest on the part of a judge is unacceptable and that it is appropriate to respond with a sanction.
Ik deel de mening dat belangenverstrengeling van een rechter ontoelaatbaar is en dat het gepast is daarop te reageren met een sanctie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Rechter kent wet niet goed

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that judges misapply the law on human trafficking, releasing traffickers, and whether this conflicts with the government's stated aim to fight trafficking harder. The minister acknowledges the high acquittal rate, points to specialisation of judges and expertise-building in courts since 1 January 2013 as the response, and says he shares the concern that traffickers should not be freed through judicial ignorance.
To prevent unnecessary acquittals in human trafficking cases, specialisation and building expertise within the courts is necessary.
Om onnodige vrijspraken in mensenhandelzaken te voorkomen is specialisatie en opbouw van expertise binnen de gerechten nodig.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de brief van Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie van 27 november 2012 waaruit blijkt dat bij gedetineerdentransport geen vrijheid beperkend

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Security and Justice why restraints are used during detainee transport only when expressly ordered, and why transport guards must decide individually, arguing this is dangerous. The state secretary replies that the Penitentiary Principles Acts allow restraints when motivated, that the Public Prosecution Service and the institution share the risk assessment, and that he sees no reason to make restraints the default.
When using restraints, the necessity requirement comes first.
Bij de aanwending van vrijheidsbeperkende middelen staat het noodzakelijkheidsvereiste voorop.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Hardenberg woest om taakstraf na geweld”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why a 25-year-old who seriously injured a young man (broken jaw, skull fracture) received a community service sentence, and whether community service should be excluded for such violent offences. The State Secretary declined to comment on the judge's ruling, noted that the Public Prosecution Service has appealed on the ground that the 2012 restriction on community service was wrongly applied, and defended the existing statutory balance between legislator and judge without committing to abolish community service.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on the judge's assessment.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over het oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de vermoedelijke eerwraak op een 16-jarig meisje

PVV MPs asked whether an apparent honour killing of a 16-year-old in IJsselstein was honour-motivated, how many honour killings occurred in ten years, whether immigration from Islamic countries is linked to them, and whether perpetrators with dual nationality should be deported. The state secretary declined to comment on the motive during the ongoing investigation, provided registration figures, rejected the links to religion and immigration, and explained the sliding-scale deportation rules without addressing individual cases.
The investigation into the death of the 16-year-old schoolgirl from IJsselstein is still in full swing.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de 16-jarige scholiere uit IJsselstein is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de onstuitbare opmars van de Marokkaanse crimineel

PVV MPs asked whether Moroccan youth are an unstoppable rise in crime and whether the government will confront a 'Moroccan problem' head-on. The minister rejects the claim in general terms, notes overrepresentation in specific crimes, says policy applies no ethnic distinction and points to existing prevention and enforcement measures.
The cabinet acknowledges that certain groups cause more nuisance and crime than others.
Het kabinet onderkent dat bepaalde groepen meer overlast en criminaliteit veroorzaken dan andere.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Terrorist Jason W. mag met bewaking op verlof’

An MP asks the state secretary whether the leave granted to terrorist detainee Jason W. (Hofstad group) should be reversed, given the risk to public safety and the apparent reversal of the earlier refusal. The state secretary answers that after a Council ruling he re-sought advice from police and prosecutors, who convinced him leave was now possible under supervision, and he sees no reason to change the decision.
The RSJ instructed me to take a new decision, taking into account the ruling of the appeals committee.
De RSJ heeft mij daarbij opgedragen een nieuwe beslissing te nemen, met inachtneming van de uitspraak van de beroepscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending betreffende de situatie in de justitiële jeugdinrichtingen en het bericht “Lak aan regels in Teylingereind”

PVV MP Helder asked the state secretary about a broadcast alleging drugs, weapons and phones are present and treatment is lacking at youth detention centre Teylingereind, and whether escapes during leave can be stopped. The state secretary disputed most of the broadcast's claims, said escapes are unacceptable and leave policy will be tightened with a report before summer 2013, but rejected mandatory use of restraints and additional measures on contraband.
I am therefore in consultation with the youth detention sector to tighten the leave policy.
Ik ben derhalve met de sector JJI in overleg om het beleid met betrekking tot verlof aan te scherpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het Onderzoeksrapport Taskforce TBS 2012 en zijn brief d.d. 30 januari 2013 ‘Onderzoek Taskforce TBS naar (mogelijke) gemaximeerde TBS’

Member Helder (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether citizens have a right to know how many dangerous TBS patients are now at large following the ECtHR Van der Velden ruling, and whether all cases affected by the ruling, including those before 26 November 2012, should be investigated and the figures published. The State Secretary answered that the Council for the Judiciary examined the affected cases, that the Supreme Court later narrowed the reading of the ruling, and that the Council's report with figures has been sent to Parliament and is public.
I have asked the Council for the Judiciary to investigate which cases of TBS detainees require attention in light of the ECtHR ruling.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr) verzocht te onderzoeken welke zaken van tbs-gestelden aandacht vragen in het licht van de uitspraak van het EHRM
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht «Bejaarde is leven niet meer zeker na massale afranseling»

PVV MPs asked the government whether criminal Moroccan youths terrorising neighbourhoods and committing racist violence should be harshly punished, sent to re-education camps, and deprived of Dutch nationality with family deportation. The minister answered that policy does not distinguish by ethnicity, outlined prevention and tough enforcement, rejected re-education camps as unproven, and said revoking nationality for common crimes is not possible.
In this approach no distinction is made by ethnicity.
In deze aanpak wordt geen onderscheid naar etniciteit gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over het racistische Marokkaanse geweld

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a claim that Moroccan-origin youths cause a structural problem of violence, asked for the causes of police contact among young Moroccan men, and asked whether dual-nationality offenders could be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that socio-economic and demographic factors explain over-representation in crime, that enforcement applies no ethnic distinction, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common offences is not possible.
Of course, it is the case that the groups that more often cause problems will accordingly come into contact with this approach more often.
Wel is het uiteraard zo dat de groepen die vaker problemen veroorzaken navenant meer met deze aanpak in aanraking zullen komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Psycho’s op vrije voeten”

An MP asked about reports that long-stay TBS patients, including psychopaths, are being moved to regular wards where they may gain leave and work toward reintegration, and questioned the role of libido-suppressing medication and recidivism trends. The state secretary answered that transfers occur only when new treatment prospects exist, that treatment is tailored and risk management is prioritised, and that the long-stay policy is under evaluation with results due later in the year.
In these cases, those concerned are transferred back to regular TBS wards so that the treatment ordered by the judge can be resumed.
In deze gevallen worden betrokkenen teruggeplaatst naar de reguliere tbs-afdelingen zodat de door de rechter opgelegde behandeling hervat kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de moskee als toevluchtsoord voor schietende criminelen

PVV MPs asked whether a group of men fleeing a shooting incident in Rotterdam hid in a mosque, whether police entered promptly, and whether the minister would close the mosque. The minister answered that the building was an annex (library, barber) rather than a prayer space, that police entered and found no one, and that closing a mosque is a municipal competence.
The possible closure of a mosque is a municipal competence.
Eventuele sluiting van een moskee is een gemeentelijke bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht Tbs'er ontsnapt tijdens begeleid verlof

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about a report that a tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patient escaped during supervised leave, asking whether escort security should be tightened, whether police should receive a description in advance, and whether escapes are unacceptable. The state secretary replied that supervised leave is a necessary, phased part of resocialisation, that unauthorised absences are under 1 per mille of leave movements, that police need no advance description since cooperation works in practice, and that the leave advisory body reviews every request.
The Advisory Committee on Leave Assessment for tbs (AVt) advises on all leave applications, on whether leave should be granted or not.
Het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing tbs (AVt) adviseert bij alle verlofaanvragen, over het al dan niet toekennen van het verlof.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘megabezuiniging van 100 miljoen euro op het gevangeniswezen’

An MP asks the minister why electronic detention at home is being introduced amid a 100 million euro prison budget cut, whether it contradicts the tough-on-crime stance, and whether it endangers staff and public safety. The minister replies that electronic detention is an acceptable alternative for short sentences if applied selectively, that a bill is being prepared, and that a masterplan on prison capacity is being drawn up.
As I indicated during the debate on the 2013 budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice, I am preparing a bill that will make the use of electronic detention possible.

Zoals ik tijdens de behandeling van de begroting 2013 van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie heb aangegeven, bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor dat de toepassing van elektronische detentie mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord vragen Wilders, Helder en Agema over het bericht Aanrander bejaarden vrij

PVV MPs Wilders, Helder and Agema asked the Justice minister about reports that a 15-year-old suspect of sexually assaulting elderly women was released, and how victims and nearby residents would be protected. The minister confirmed the reports, explained that the court lifted the pre-trial detention suspension, said further investigation and neighbourhood police contact are underway, and noted that vulnerability can be weighed in sentencing.
During this period neighbourhood police officers remain in contact with those involved.
Gedurende deze periode houden wijkagenten contact met de betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaveren en Helder over de dodelijke schietpartij bij een kickboksgala

Two PVV MPs asked about a fatal shooting at a kickboxing gala, the suspect's reported school-shooter background, the overrepresentation of Moroccan and Turkish youths in violent crime statistics, and whether a suspect with a serious criminal record should be deported. The minister said the overrepresentation is partly explained by demographic and socioeconomic factors, declined to comment on individual cases, and described the general rules on deportation after conviction and a planned tightening of the sliding scale.
I will not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Helder over een blog “Politie zet mogelijke getuigen op internet”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police publishing photos of possible witnesses to an assault online, and whether prior approval from the prosecution was obtained, and whether this endangers witnesses. The minister confirmed the photos were posted on the prosecutor's instruction after no other means were available, said the people were hard to recognise, acknowledged the risk was considered, and stated the photos have been removed.

Since no other investigative means were available and the conditions set in the Guideline on publication of investigative information were otherwise met, the public prosecutor ordered the publication of a number of photos of possible witnesses on the internet.

Aangezien er geen andere opsporingsmiddelen voorhanden waren en er ook overigens is voldaan aan de voorwaarden die werden gesteld in de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving, is in opdracht van de officier van justitie besloten tot het plaatsen van een aantal foto's op internet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bontes over het bericht “Misdaad loont weer, criminaliteit kan stijgen”

PVV MPs Helder and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether misdaad pays and whether the minister will raise sentences and the chance of arrest after a newspaper report that criminality could rise. Minister Opstelten said he agrees crime should not pay, disputed the report's claim of low arrest odds citing clearance rates, and pointed to regeerakkoord measures (more police, minimum sentences for recidivism, a tougher Voetbalwet) while deferring some points to later letters and referring elsewhere.

I will inform the House before the spring memorandum in more detail about how the coalition agreement measures to strengthen the police and improve the performance of the criminal justice chain will be implemented.

Ik zal uw Kamer voor de voorjaarsnota nader berichten over de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord die zijn gericht op versterking van de politie en verbetering van de prestaties van de strafrechtsketen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Fritsma over het overbrengen van piraten naar Nederland

PVV MPs asked whether the foreign minister is involved in deciding to transfer captured Somali pirates to the Netherlands for prosecution, why transfer to the region or flag state was not chosen, whether pirates could be tried under Dutch law in the region and serve sentences there, and whether they could obtain asylum or stay in the Netherlands. The minister answered that prosecution is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service coordinated with the foreign and defence ministers, that a clear Dutch interest (attempted murder of Dutch marines) justified prosecution here, that trial under Dutch law in the region is not possible and sentence execution in Somalia is currently not possible though capacity-building is supported, and that asylum is expected to be refused under Article 1F and sentences of 24 months or more.
Instituting criminal prosecution in the Dutch criminal justice system is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het instellen van strafrechtelijke vervolging is in het Nederlandse strafrechtelijke stelsel voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘cipier ernstig gewond na gevangenisgeweld’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that a female prison guard at PI Hoogeveen was seriously assaulted by an inmate, and how such an incident could happen, what measures would prevent recurrence, whether charges were filed, and whether fellow inmates who applauded would be sanctioned. The State Secretary confirmed the assault and injuries, described the response time, announced an internal calamity investigation by the DJI with outside members, reported that charges were filed, and declined action against applauding inmates.
I await the findings and recommendations of this investigation and will take appropriate measures where necessary.
Ik wacht de bevindingen en aanbevelingen van dit onderzoek af en onderneem zo nodig passende maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Justitie laat verdachte van zware mishandeling vrij’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how a suspect of serious assault was released by mistake and whether release checks should include DNA, and what measures will prevent recurrence. The State Secretary explained the release procedure with cross-checks and biometric verification, said DNA adds no value, noted the error was corrected within two days, and said measures will await an independent internal investigation.
I will await the outcome of the investigation before deciding whether to take measures.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek af alvorens een beslissing te nemen over het treffen van maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Bontes over het artikel ‘Drugrunners vechten met NS-personeel’

MPs De Graaf, Helder and Bontes asked whether a permanent public transport ban, a permanent police post at Rotterdam CS, tasers for NS staff, and broader group liability should follow a violent attack on NS staff by drug runners. The minister answered that a travel and stay ban bill is being prepared, that the police post will return after renovation, that tasers have no legal basis for NS staff, and that existing criminal law suffices.
A bill amending the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to allow a stay ban at stations, for example, is currently being prepared.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel tot wetswijziging van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 ten behoeve van een verblijfsverbod op bijvoorbeeld een station.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Marokkaanse gevangenen naar eigen land’

PVV MPs asked whether a large share of prisoners are Moroccan nationals, whether transferring them to Morocco to serve sentences would save costs, and whether an agreement with Morocco should be concluded. The state secretary answered that about 5% of intake is Moroccan nationals, that transfer is only possible under WOTS or WETS with consent and the receiving country's agreement, and that the ministry will explore a supplementary bilateral agreement with Morocco.
The Ministry of Security and Justice will look into whether there are possibilities to conclude a bilateral (supplementary) agreement between the Netherlands and Morocco.
Vanuit het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie zal worden geïnformeerd of er in hoeverre er mogelijkheden zijn om een bilaterale (aanvullende) overeenkomst te sluiten tussen Nederland en Marokko.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “OM Breda laat tonnen van wiettelers liggen”

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Breda public prosecution service lets large sums from cannabis growers slip and imposes community service instead, and whether community service should be abolished. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, states that community service is not always suitable, and notes that legislation excluding community service for serious sexual and violent offences and recidivists took effect in early 2012.
I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from members Recourt and Kuiken.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar het antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 van de leden Recourt en Kuiken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Ruim 200 gram hasj in cel drugsveroordeelde”

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether drugs could be smuggled into a prison cell holding a convicted drug offender, why urine checks did not catch them, and whether staff were involved. The state secretary confirmed the report, explained the standard drug-control regime and urine testing, said a staff member is suspected and was arrested and reported, and that the criminal investigation is closed while the court has not yet ruled.
The staff member concerned was arrested at the institution, and his access to DJI buildings was revoked.
Het desbetreffende personeelslid is in de inrichting aangehouden, waarbij hem de toegang tot de gebouwen van DJI is ontzegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het woonrecht van krakers zwaarder weegt dan het belang van ontruimen

An MP from the PVV asks the Justice Minister about a ruling that a squatter's right to housing outweighed the State's interest in eviction, and about the limits of the criminal-eviction rule in Article 138a Sr, including whether the law should be changed so squatters are always prosecuted. The minister says the ruling is under appeal, defends the proportionality test set by the Supreme Court, sees no need for legislative change, and points to consistent eviction policy in Amsterdam.
I see no reason to amend the law.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot een wetswijziging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Serieverkrachter (18) loopt dagen vrij rond”

An MP asked why justice did not publicly raise alarm when a dangerous youth sex offender absconded for days, and whether a supervised medical outing was safe. The minister defended not issuing a public appeal to protect victims and society, said the outing followed the rules, will be evaluated internally, and rejected abolishing the PIJ measure.
However, the incident will be evaluated internally to learn lessons for similar cases in the future.
Wel zal het incident intern worden geëvalueerd om hieruit lering te trekken voor soortgelijke zaken in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Agema over het bericht “Woning oudere steeds vaker overvallen”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why burglaries of elderly people's homes are rising while overall robberies fall, and what will be done to protect seniors. The minister says the risk of victimisation is lower for the elderly but impact is greater, cites existing prosecution guidelines and sentencing considerations, and lists preventive measures such as information meetings, video doorbells and a toolkit for municipalities.
Precisely because of that great impact, tackling robberies is a national priority for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Juist vanwege die grote impact is de aanpak van overvallen een landelijke prioriteit voor politie en Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht "Gekonkel op luchtplaats gevangenis"

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that a shortage of exercise yards at the Geerhorst prison in Sittard could cause criminal cases in Limburg to go wrong, and that detainees under contact bans could communicate with co-suspects, asking whether the law allowing detainees to feel the rain should be changed and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service sees no indication that cases are harmed, that contact bans are enforced by separating detainees during exercise, and that temporary organisational measures are in place, so no additional measures are deemed necessary.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it has no indications that ongoing criminal cases have suffered or threaten to suffer harm.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten geen aanwijzingen te hebben dat lopende strafzaken schade hebben opgelopen dan wel schade dreigen op te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: “Slachtoffer vaak genegeerd”

An MP asked the state secretary whether victims and relatives of serious crimes are often not informed about offenders' leave and releases, and what measures will reduce this. The secretary said the Information Point reaches over 96% of victims, that the 20% figure was a wrongly reported OM statement now corrected, and that the OM is working with partners to reach 100% and to tailor contact to victims.
Every victim who wishes to be informed must be informed.
Elk slachtoffer dat geïnformeerd wenst te worden, moet geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat 15.000 veroordeelden vrij rondlopen

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that 15,000 convicted persons remain at large and whether this is acceptable, and whether extra prisons and measures would be taken. The state secretary said the enforcement of sentences is a priority, pointed to existing and expanded measures such as tracing teams, withholding social security and passport measures, and a new administrative centre, but rejected detaining all convicts pending sentence.
That is why active efforts are being made to trace persons who still have to serve their sentence.
Daarom wordt actief ingezet op het alsnog opsporen van personen die hun straf nog moeten ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Jong en Helder over het bericht Controle A2 op 23 juli in werking

Two PVV MPs asked whether traffic enforcement should focus on urban roads rather than motorway speed checks, whether the 100 km/h limit on the A2 should be raised, and whether the A2 speed trajectory checks should stop as a revenue measure. The minister replied that speed enforcement on motorways serves safety, air quality and noise goals, that the limit may be raised to 130 km/h at night and evening between Vinkeveen and Maarssen via a forthcoming traffic decision, and that the checks will not be stopped because they were agreed with neighbouring municipalities.
I am therefore not willing to stop this.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid hiermee te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Aanpak op maat voor zwaarste criminelen”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Rotterdam's person-focused approach to repeat violent and property offenders, why such criminals remain free after repeated convictions, and whether a three-strikes rule should apply. The Minister confirmed the approach aims to prevent offences through personal action plans and strict enforcement of breaches, declined to comment on judicial sentencing, and did not adopt the three-strikes proposal.
I do not intervene in the assessment of the sentences the judge imposes.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van de straffen die de rechter oplegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Rechter laat notoire geweldpleger snel vrij: slachtoffer verbijsterd

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a judge-commissioner suspended pre-trial detention of a repeat violent offender, questioning past sentences and the impact on public trust. The minister answered that the commissioner weighed the age of prior offences, the suspect's self-referral and treatment, and set conditions, declined to judge the commissioner's reasoning, and defended judicial lifetime appointments.
It is not for me to give a judgment on the judgment of the judge-commissioner.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over het oordeel van de rechter-commissaris.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het vervroegde verlof van Volkert van der Graaf

An MP asked whether Volkert van der Graaf, convicted of murdering Pim Fortuyn, could receive early prison leave 18 months before his conditional release date, and whether the new regime could block it, given his stated lack of remorse. The state secretary replied that detention phasing is decided case by case by the DJI selection officer using advice from probation and the prosecution, that recidivism risk and the offender's views will be weighed, and that the rules will be tightened (window cut to 12 months, new system from summer 2013).
I want to place the prisoner's own responsibility at the centre and let his behaviour and motivation determine whether detention phasing is granted.
Daarom wil ik de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gedetineerde centraal stellen en zijn gedrag en motivatie bepalend laten zijn voor het toekennen van detentiefasering.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Levensgevaarlijke messentrekker vrij na blunder”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a violent offender was released because the Public Prosecution Service filed a conditional-release request five days late, and how such errors will be prevented. The minister confirmed the late filing, explained the offender was released with special conditions, and described measures taken at the Utrecht parket and by the central conditional-release body.
This request was mistakenly filed five days late.
Deze vordering is abusievelijk vijf dagen te laat gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over de onbegrijpelijke uitspraak van Marokkaans scootertuig

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the acquittal of suspects in a fatal scooter chase, which they found incomprehensible, and whether the suspects were effectively rewarded for silence. The State Secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service disagrees with the acquittal and has referred the case to the Supreme Court, and that the appellate ruling must now be tested by the cassation judge, so no further substantive comment is given.
Since no final judicial ruling has yet been handed down in this case, I cannot go into this further.
Nu in deze zaak nog geen finaal rechterlijk oordeel is geveld kan ik hierop verder ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opvang Roma-familie kostte Utrecht nog meer dan 29.000”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the reported costs of housing a Roma family in Utrecht, reportedly over 29,000 euros and possibly higher, are correct, why the municipality withholds details of cash allowances on privacy grounds, and whether the total costs should be reclaimed. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports and referred back to earlier answers, stating that accountability for the choices made lies with the Utrecht municipal government and its council.
In it I indicated, among other things, that it is a matter for the Utrecht municipal executive to account to the municipal council for the choices made in this case.
Daarin heb ik onder andere aangegeven dat het een zaak is van het gemeentebestuur van Utrecht om verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad over de in dit geval gemaakte keuzes.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Coke-advocaat vrij door tijdgebrek”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a Rotterdam court suspended pre-trial detention of cocaine suspects because trial could only be scheduled in autumn, and demanded faster trial scheduling, evening or weekend sittings and an assessment of structural capacity problems. The State Secretary confirmed the suspension was based on the unusually long detention and no date being set, declined to judge an individual case out of respect for judicial independence, and said court capacity is one of several factors with no count of cases, pointing to ongoing efficiency programmes.
Out of respect for judicial independence, I refrain from judging such a decision in an individual criminal case.
In verband met de rechterlijke onafhankelijkheid past mij terughoudendheid bij het geven van een oordeel over een dergelijke beslissing in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Utrechtse Romafamilie logeert gratis in hotels”

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that a Roma family in Utrecht has been housed for free in hotels and holiday parks at municipal expense, and asked why such people are not arrested and whether the mayor will repay the costs. The minister answered that the municipality provided temporary humanitarian shelter, that accountability for the costs lies with the Utrecht municipal council, and referred to earlier correspondence on 'tuigdorpen'.

It is a matter for the Utrecht municipal government to account to the municipal council for the choices made, the housing costs and the payment arrangement agreed with those involved and paid by them.

Het is een zaak van het gemeentebestuur van Utrecht om verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad over de gemaakte keuzes, de kosten van de huisvesting en de met de betrokkenen overeengekomen en door hen afbetaalde betalingsregeling.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Krakers blij in gemeentepand’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Amsterdam failed to file police reports for all squatted municipal buildings, contrary to the Squatting and Vacancy Act, and why the mayor says the owning districts should decide. The minister answered that the owner decides whether to report squatters, that Amsterdam's districts filed in 3 of 6 cases, and that districts are accountable to their own councils rather than the central city.
It is up to the owner to decide what it does with its property, provided the use causes no nuisance or disturbs public order.
Het is aan de eigenaar om te bepalen wat deze met zijn pand doet, mits het gebruik geen overlast geeft of de openbare orde verstoort.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het opleggen van veel te lage straffen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice whether it is acceptable that a driver who caused a fatal accident under the influence of drugs received a fully suspended sentence and a 240-hour community service order, and whether a community service sentence of 120 hours for assaulting a police officer is adequate, and when the community service sentence will be abolished. The State Secretary responds that the courts set sentences independently, declines to comment on individual judgments, and states that community service is retained though it is unsuitable for serious violent offences, which has been restricted by law since early this year.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on the judgment of the court in an individual case.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over het oordeel van de rechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Vuurwerkwerper op vrije voeten”

An MP asks why a suspect in an attack on police officers was released from pre-trial detention and whether criminal group liability should be broadened. The minister explains the court suspended detention on personal circumstances rather than sentence length, and that Dutch criminal law rests on individual liability with a low evidentiary bar for public violence, pointing to a pending private member's bill.
The reason the court suspended pre-trial detention was not that the expected sentence on conviction is lower than the six months already served.
De reden voor de rechtbank om de voorlopige hechtenis te schorsen was niet dat de naar verwachting bij veroordeling op te leggen straf lager is dan de 6 maanden
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘In cel gezet na aanrijden dief’

An MP asked whether a mother and son were detained after accidentally driving into a caught diesel thief, whether the self-defence guidelines were applied, and how the public would be informed. The minister said suspicion of attempted manslaughter arose from doubts about the incident, that both were released after further investigation found no intentional ramming, and that the self-defence guideline did not apply because the suspect had fled and the car chase did not amount to noodweer.
Further investigation by the police and consultation with the public prosecutor led to the conclusion that there was no intentional ramming.
Nader onderzoek van de politie en overleg met het OM heeft tot de conclusie geleid dat er geen sprake is van opzettelijk aanrijden.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Van den Besselaar en Helder over de Midden- en Oost-Europese misdaadgolf die over ons land trekt

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Immigration and of Security and Justice about a Central and Eastern European crime wave, including whether the open borders policy was naive, whether a dedicated police chief should be appointed, and whether expulsion and entry bans are the most effective response. The minister replied that free movement brings economic benefits alongside crime risks, that measures on mobile gangs have been taken, that a separate police chief is unnecessary, and that expulsions and unwelcome declarations are used alongside preventive and European cooperation measures.
The cabinet has therefore taken measures to combat and prevent crime committed by mobile gangs from Central and Eastern Europe.
Het kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om criminaliteit die gepleegd wordt door mobiele bendes uit Midden- en Oost Europa te bestrijden en te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman en Helder over autodiefstal met stoorzender

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about car theft using signal jammers, including whether such devices should be banned and how police and justice tackle Eastern European theft gangs. The minister replied that jammers are already prohibited under the Telecommunications Act, that enforcement has been intensified with the Agentschap Telecom, and that stolen cars are flagged through Schengen and Interpol channels, though no figures on the scale of the problem are available.
It is known that this method is used. No figures are known about the scale of this problem.
Het is bekend dat deze methodiek wordt gebruikt. Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de omvang van dit probleem.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Bontes over het bericht ‘Angst rondtrekkende bendes bij winkelier’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that organised Eastern European mobile gangs are driving large-scale theft from shops, whether politicians concealed the scale of this crime before EU accession, and what will be done to recover the losses. The minister said the precise scale is unknown, denied deliberate concealment, noted a pilot for sharing camera images with retailers, and referred to a separate letter for the remaining questions.
To answer these questions I refer to the letter I sent to your House on 26 March 2012.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief die ik uw Kamer op 26 maart 2012 gestuurd heb
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Ruim 2600 veroordeelden ontlopen cel met succes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that over 2,600 convicts evaded prison through expiry of their sentences in 2010, and how many are actively at large. The state secretary confirmed the figures, attributed part of the rise to CJIB registration starting in 1996, outlined enforcement measures such as the Team Executie Strafvonnissen and tracking projects, and declined to extend pre-trial detention grounds.
I consider it of great importance that the penalties imposed by the judge are also actually carried out.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat de door de rechter opgelegde straffen ook daadwerkelijk ten uitvoer worden gelegd.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Werkstraffen voor geweld op voetbalveld”

An MP asked the state secretary whether a 40-hour community sentence for two footballers who kicked an opponent into hospital is acceptable, and how to prevent such sentences. The secretary answered that courts act independently, that the sentence reflected the defendants' lack of prior record and tuchtcommissie appearances, and that the new legal limits on community sentences for serious violence will be evaluated.
As State Secretary of Security and Justice, I cannot interfere with the independent judgment of a judge.
Als Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie kan ik niet treden in het onafhankelijke oordeel van een rechter.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het krantenartikel “Veilig, veiliger, veiligst”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a newspaper report on tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patients being granted escorted leave earlier, the 18-month rule, escort composition, escape reporting to police and a central emergency number. The State Secretary explains the fpc guideline timeframes, the individual risk-based leave assessment reviewed by the independent Avt, the phased escort system, and that escapes must be reported immediately to police, with fpcs asked to adjust service instructions; no central number is needed.
In practice the KLPD escape team in Leusden is also often informed and brought in after consultation with the public prosecution service.
In de praktijk wordt vaak ook het team ontrekkingen van het KLPD te Leusden geïnformeerd en ingeschakeld na overleg met het OM.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Dwing OM tot hoger beroep’

An MP asks whether victims should be able to force the Public Prosecution Service to appeal a judgment, as a citizens' committee proposed. The state secretary answers that victims' interests are weighed but the prosecution keeps sole discretion over appeals, and giving victims a say would amount to a disguised appeal they are not party to, which he rejects.
I consider that undesirable, apart from the consequences for the duration of criminal proceedings and for the capacity of the judiciary.
Ik acht dat onwenselijk, nog los van de gevolgen voor de doorlooptijd van een strafproces en voor de capaciteit van de rechterlijke macht.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de structurele terreur in Utrechtse wijken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration, Integration and Asylum about reported structural intimidation of a family in Utrecht neighbourhoods, whether mayors would be convened, and whether a police crackdown, neighbourhood evictions and denaturalisation would solve it. Minister Opstelten answered that the recent events fall within an earlier mayors' meeting, that the council judges the mayor's functioning, that the government is pursuing an ethnicity-neutral approach to youth crime, and that police investigated and arrested suspects.

Specifically regarding the events of 19 and 20 February 2012 in Utrecht, I can inform you that the police immediately launched an investigation and that suspects have since been arrested and taken into custody.

Specifiek ten aanzien van de gebeurtenissen op 19 en 20 februari 2012 in Utrecht kan ik u melden dat de politie direct onderzoek heeft ingesteld en dat er inmiddels verdachten zijn aangehouden en in hechtenis genomen.
