Antwoord vragen Helder en De Roon over het bericht ‘Ruim helft diplomaten betaalt boetes niet’

MPs Helder and De Roon asked whether foreign diplomats fail to pay over half of traffic fines and what the government does about it. The minister confirmed non-payment rates, explained that diplomatic immunity limits enforcement, and described diplomatic pressure and a planned annual reminder operation with CJIB and RDW.
That is not really possible for the period mentioned.
Dat is voor de genoemde periode niet goed mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Dader doodrijden Floor van der Wal vervroegd vrij’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the driver who killed Floor van der Wal was released early, questioning the sentence's proportionality, a reported cultural motive, the decision not to appeal, how victims' families were informed, and the reintegration programme. The minister said the court weighed reckless driving and leaving the scene, that the OM dropped appeal because a manslaughter conviction was unlikely, that the family was informed, and that the detention-phasing rules will be changed and conflicting advice will be escalated.
It does not befit me to pass judgment on the height of a sentence imposed by the judge.
Het past mij niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de hoogte van een door de rechter opgelegde straf.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht dat de islamitische schaamtecultuur medepalend is voor de strafmaat

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the Justice minister whether the 'Islamic shame culture' should influence sentencing and whether incidents like refusing to stand for judges signal Islamisation of the judiciary. Minister Opstelten answered that sentencing considers case-specific circumstances proven to be relevant, not group membership, and that the isolated incidents do not show Islamisation.
These are special circumstances that must be shown to exist and be relevant in the specific case brought before the judge, and not something assumed in general for certain categories of suspects.

Het gaat hier om bijzondere omstandigheden waarvan moet worden aangetoond dat zij zich voordoen en relevant zijn in het specifieke geval dat aan de rechter is voorgelegd, en niet om iets dat in zijn algemeenheid wordt aangenomen voor bepaalde categorieën verdachten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over de uitspraak van een kantonrechter dat de religieuze plicht zwaarder weegt dan de plicht te voldoen aan de Nederlandse wet

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a cantonal court ruling that a religious duty outweighs the duty to obey Dutch law undermines the rule of law and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that everyone must obey Dutch law, exceptions exist only where the law provides them, interpretation is for the courts, and he will not comment further because the prosecution has appealed.
The Public Prosecution Service has lodged an appeal against the cantonal judge's ruling.
Het OM heeft beroep tegen de uitspraak van de kantonrechter ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman over de zoveelste gewelddadige straatroof in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren, Helder and Brinkman asked ministers about repeated violent street robberies in Utrecht, whether they still trusted Utrecht mayor Wolfsen, what measures would be taken against him, and whether heavy sentences and denaturalisation of dual nationals would largely solve the problem. The government replied that the municipal council judges mayoral performance, referred to earlier answers on youth groups, stated that repressive and preventive measures are both needed, left sentencing to judges, and said a bill is being prepared so that Dutch nationality lapses after a final conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge the functioning of a mayor.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om te oordelen over het functioneren van een burgemeester.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de nieuwe veelpleger

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about reports of a 'new repeat offender', the role of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police chief, juvenile criminal law for 12-year-olds, and ethnic overrepresentation in crime statistics. The minister answered that the term distinguishes younger, more violent offenders from the 'old' repeat offender, that existing juvenile law suffices for 12-year-olds, and that all offenders should be prosecuted regardless of origin.
The cabinet is making a strong effort to reduce boundary-crossing behaviour among at-risk young people, individually and in groups.
Het kabinet zet stevig in op het terugdringen van grensoverschrijdend gedrag van risicojongeren, individueel en in groepen.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Brinkman over het artikel “Man steekt twee agenten in gezicht”

MPs Brinkman and Helder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a case in which a man stabbed two police officers in the face and headbutted a third, and asked whether the offender would stay in custody, receive a prison sentence rather than a community service order, and how prosecutors and judges would be pressed to punish such attacks harshly. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect remains in custody with a 90-day extension though the trial date is unknown, pointed to higher prosecution demands and a planned Raad voor de rechtspraak study for 2011 data, and declined to guarantee a prison sentence or abolish community service as a main penalty.
I have promised your House to send the results of this study before summer 2012.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd de resultaten van dit onderzoek voor de zomer van 2012 toe te zenden.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman, Helder en Van Klaveren over slechts een taakstrafje na mishandeling van een agent

PVV MPs Brinkman, Helder and Van Klaveren asked why a community sentence was imposed for assaulting a police officer, whether such sentences undermine public trust, and whether the community sentence should be removed from the Criminal Code and denaturalisation used. Minister Opstelten said the prosecution regrets not demanding a partly unconditional prison term and has appealed, that the cabinet wants to keep the community sentence but restrict it for serious violent crimes, and that a bill on loss of Dutch nationality for serious offences is in preparation.
Following this case, the prosecution leadership spoke with all officials involved to learn lessons from this case.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus heeft de parketleiding gesproken met alle betrokken functionarissen om uit deze casus lering te trekken.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Agent mikpunt oudejaarsgeweld’

An MP asks the minister about reports of violent attacks on police during New Year's Eve 2011–2012, including molotov cocktails and pepper spray, and whether preparing molotov cocktails constitutes a serious crime, attempted manslaughter, or terrorism warranting pretrial detention. The state secretary answers by referring to an earlier letter, explaining the legal framework (art. 46, 157, 287, 289, 83 Sr, arts. 67/67a Sv) and leaving the assessment of specific facts to the Public Prosecution Service and courts.

Whether in a concrete case preparing molotov cocktails is punishable preparation of a serious crime depends on the circumstances and is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the criminal court to assess.

Of in een concrete casus het klaarmaken van molotovcocktails een strafbare voorbereiding van een ernstig misdrijf is, hangt af van de omstandigheden van het geval en staat ter beoordeling van het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de strafrechter.
Vragen van de leden Helder en de Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «werkstraffen voor hooligans» (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice whether the community sentence (taakstraf) should be removed as a main penalty for lack of public support, and whether group liability in article 141 of the Penal Code should be strengthened for public violence by rioters. The government answered that research shows public support for community service and lower recidivism than prison, so it will keep it, and that a consultation on article 141 is ongoing with a report promised for January 2012.
The cabinet considers it important to retain the community sentence in the sanctions system.
Het kabinet acht het behoud van de taakstraf in het sanctiestelsel van belang.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het optreden van Prins Maurits in de uitzending van Pauw en Witteman van 11 november 2011 (ingezonden 16 nove

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether Prince Maurits' criticism of government policy in a November 2011 television broadcast was acceptable and what it says about ministerial responsibility. The minister answered that the prince did not criticise government policy, since he spoke before the vote on an amendment, and that ministerial responsibility for royal family members concerns conduct affecting the public interest, which was not at stake.
Prince Maurits did not criticise government policy.
Prins Maurits heeft geen kritiek geuit op het regeringsbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Meisje van 5 jaar loopt geslachtsziekte op» (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the list of serious diseases in the compulsory blood test law for suspects should be extended with sexually transmitted infections, so a suspect could be ordered to provide cell material when the victim is a minor, after a news report of a five-year-old girl contracting an STI. The minister answers that he considers it desirable to add syphilis, chlamydia and gonorrhoea to the list through a change to the implementing decree.
I consider it desirable to promote that three sexually transmitted diseases be added to these diseases, namely syphilis, chlamydia and gonorrhoea.
Ik acht het gewenst om te bevorderen dat aan deze ziekten, drie geslachtsziekten worden toegevoegd, te weten syfilis, chlamydia en gonorroe.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de hoeveelheid Nederlandse jihadisten (ingezonden 15 septe

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice how many Dutch passport holders take part in jihad abroad, whether they should be held in a terrorist ward on return, how many have dual nationality, and whether they should be denaturalised and expelled. The government answered that criminal investigations start on reasonable suspicion, that detention on a terrorist ward is possible under criteria, that AIVD data include Dutch, dual and foreign nationals, and that citizenship can be revoked for terrorist offences committed after 1 October 2010 provided it does not cause statelessness.
Under the Netherlands Nationality Act (RWN) it is possible to revoke Dutch nationality from a person irrevocably convicted of a terrorist offence.
Op basis van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap (RWN) is het mogelijk om het Nederlanderschap te ontnemen van een persoon die onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Zesvoudig moordenaar eist verlof» (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asks whether the state secretary knew of a decision not to grant leave to a six-times convicted life-sentence prisoner in a forensic psychiatric centre, and whether he will intervene if a court grants the prisoner's kort geding request. The state secretary confirms awareness of the report, explains the leave policy tightening for life-sentence prisoners and the RSJ ruling that gave him a right to supervised leave, and notes that the court rejected his claim for unsupervised leave on 9 September.
On 9 September the Hague District Court gave its ruling.
Op 9 september jl. heeft de Rechtbank te Den Haag uitspraak gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Vrouw in rolstoel mishandeld» (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported assault on a disabled woman and her assistance dog, and whether the prosecution guideline for assault should be changed to seek higher sentences. The minister said all assault is unacceptable, that the case is a violent street robbery rather than a guideline-governed assault, that the prosecutor tailors the sentence demand to the circumstances including the victim's wheelchair use, and that pre-trial detention is usually requested.
The Public Prosecution Service has no sentencing guideline for this type of case, because formulating the sentence demand is tailor-made work.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen strafvorderingsrichtlijn voor dit soort zaken, omdat het formuleren van de strafeis maatwerk is.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de regering van Curaçao gevangenen met een enkeltje na

MPs Lucassen and Helder asked ministers about reports that Curaçao wants to send prisoners back to the Netherlands one-way, and how Dutch authorities would prevent this. The state secretary replied that 22 prisoners convicted under Netherlands Antillean law will be transferred to the Netherlands in phases or to Bonaire after new prison construction, with the Netherlands paying Curaçao up to NAf 720,000 for interim housing, and that 7.2% of detained persons in the Netherlands come from the former Netherlands Antilles.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Helder (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «Betalen om aangifte te mogen doen» (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked whether victims in Greece must now pay 100 euros before filing a police report, and whether the Dutch embassy would advance the fee to stranded Dutch citizens. The government answered that the fee applies only to minor offences such as insult, slander, family theft and minor injury, that serious crimes are free, and that the consulate has received no complaints.
For offences such as robbery, mugging, theft or serious bodily injury no fee is payable.
Voor misdrijven zoals overval, beroving, diefstal of ernstig lichamelijk letsel is geen bijdrage verschuldigd.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van een terreurverdachte (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knows of the release of a terror suspect and whether terrorism suspects should always be held in pretrial detention, proposing a new ground in article 67a of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The minister acknowledges the report, rejects automatic detention, and says existing law already gives judges sufficient grounds, with the weighing left to the court in each case.
When imposing pretrial detention, it is important that it is always assessed case by case whether there is a necessity for it.
Bij het opleggen van voorlopige hechtenis is het van belang dat steeds per geval wordt beoordeeld of daartoe noodzaak bestaat.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voortgaande straatterreur door Marokkanen (ingezonden 1

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about a violent street attack by a group on a 17-year-old, whether the perpetrators should be denaturalised and deported, what measures would end such street violence, and how to interpret a German study linking Muslim youth to aggression. The government condemned the conduct, left sentencing to the prosecutor and courts, said denaturalisation applies only to certain offences and not to simple assault, pointed to existing local order instruments and a letter on criminal youth groups, and declined to draw a link between Islam and the incident.
If prosecution is pursued, it is for the public prosecutor to decide which penalty to request, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien tot vervolging wordt overgegaan is het aan het OM welke strafvordering wordt gedaan, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder, Agema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanhoudende ellende door Marokkaanse straatterro

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about recurring youth disturbances by Moroccan-background youths, including proposals to cut benefits to parents, a criminological study on Islam and violence, making offenders pay for police deployment, and snelrecht. The minister rejected cutting parents' benefits and police cost recovery, cited a study of German youths with caution, and said no prosecution arose in the Zandvoort case.
I do not share that view. Withdrawing a welfare benefit or allowances does not contribute to solving the problem.
Die visie deel ik niet. Het intrekken van een bijstandsuitkering of toeslagen draagt niet bij aan de oplossing van de problematiek.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Verkrachter vlucht na fout van justitie» (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a convicted rapist and robber who absconded during prison leave, and whether the prison and Justice had erred, what measures would prevent recurrence, and whether a one-year leave ban should be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged a miscommunication delaying notice to the victim, said existing disciplinary and parole-postponement tools already allow leave to be withheld after an absconding, and reported active tracing of the fugitive.
Due to a miscommunication between the CJIB and the Public Prosecution Service, the victim was not directly informed of the absconding.
Door een miscommunicatie tussen het CJIB en het Openbaar Ministerie is het slachtoffer niet direct over de onttrekking geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Tbs-vonnissen onder de loep» (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Security and Justice about press reports of two wrongly imposed or extended tbs (forced psychiatric detention) orders, the costs, whether the system is being undermined, and whether disciplinary action will follow. The state secretary confirms the two cases, says the Council for the Judiciary has set up a taskforce to review other extensions, sees no major effect on average stay length, and states that prosecutors did not warrant disciplinary punishment while judicial performance is not for him to assess.
To rule out that more errors were made, the Council for the Judiciary has decided to form a taskforce that will investigate possible other wrongful tbs extensions.

Om uit te sluiten dat er meer fouten zijn gemaakt heeft de Raad voor de rechtspraak besloten een taskforce te formeren die een onderzoek naar mogelijke andere onterechte tbs-verlengingen zal uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Marokko vertraagt de Mientjes-zaak» (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether Morocco is delaying the prosecution of the suspect in the killing of two elderly women in Nijmegen, and whether Netherlands can force a speedy trial. The State Secretary denied any delay, stating that the two countries cooperated closely, that the Netherlands handed the prosecution over to Morocco in November 2010, and that the Moroccan trial resumes in October 2011 with a verdict expected by year end.
There is no question of the Moroccan authorities delaying this criminal case.
Er is geen sprake van dat de Marokkaanse autoriteiten deze strafzaak vertragen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de extreme mishandeling van feestgangers door straatterroristen (i

PVV MPs asked the ministers about a violent assault on party-goers by a group of youths, including whether the perpetrators should receive the maximum sentence, how police will pursue them, and how victims can recover damages. The state secretary answered that sentencing is for the judge, police are investigating, the suspects are in custody, and victims' damages options are set out in a separate letter.
It is not for me but for the judge to decide on the punishment the perpetrators deserve.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de rechter om te oordelen over de straf die de daders verdienen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «Wachtlijst PBC vertraagt zaak» (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that waiting lists at the Pieter Baan Centre (PBC) delay a murder trial and other cases, and what measures will end the waiting lists. The state secretary confirmed roughly 20 cases are delayed, described capacity measures such as deploying more psychiatrists and freelancers, and said courts can defer cases until expert reports are complete.
The NIFP has therefore taken measures to reduce this number as much as possible.
Het NIFP heeft daarom maatregelen getroffen om dit aantal zoveel mogelijk terug te dringen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «Folkerts vrij man» (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a Hamburg court ruling that the Dutch life sentence of former RAF member Folkerts will not be enforced in Germany, and whether Dutch justice can still enforce it, and about failure to inform the widow of the murdered officer. The minister answers that the Dutch sentence remains in force and will be enforced if possible, that no appeal is available and Folkerts can be extradited if he leaves Germany, and that the widow learned of the ruling via the media but has a fixed contact person.
The Dutch position that enforcement of the sentence is still desired remains unchanged.
Het Nederlandse standpunt dat de tenuitvoerlegging nog altijd gewenst is, blijft ongewijzigd.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «Verkrachter half jaar eerder uit cel» (ingezonden 10 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a case where the Supreme Court cut a rapist's sentence by six months for exceeding the reasonable time limit, and whether this is common and what will be done. The minister confirms the sentence reduction under the ECHR, says the court counts are not registered separately, and lists measures to shorten case processing times.
Cases in which a sentence reduction is applied for exceeding the reasonable time limit are not separately registered at the Supreme Court.
Zaken waarin een strafkorting wordt toegepast vanwege het overschrijden van de redelijke termijn worden bij de Hoge Raad niet apart geregistreerd.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers van mensenhandel die maar in de helft van de gevallen aangifte doen (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why only half of human trafficking victims file a police report, whether further research will be done, and what will be done to raise reporting rates, and whether prosecution occurs when no report is filed. The minister referred to earlier answers on reporting, stated the Public Prosecution Service does not centrally record the percentage of prosecutions without a report, and explained that a report is not required for prosecution since evidence can come from other sources, with trafficking a Public Prosecution Service priority.
The Public Prosecution Service could not give me these percentages, because this data is not centrally registered.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij deze percentages niet kunnen geven, omdat deze gegevens niet centraal geregistreerd worden.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Helder (PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Minister Opstelten wil per korps top 10 van hooligans» (ingezonden 26 mei

MPs De Mos and Helder asked the Justice and Health ministers whether tightening the Dutch football law, such as nationwide stadium bans, makes a 'top 10 hooligans' list per police unit unnecessary, and about its costs and possibility of an English-style law. Minister Opstelten rejected that view, explained existing stadium-ban tools, said the list supports better targeting of those measures, could not give exact costs, and said the English model will be considered in the evaluation of the football law.
Gathering information, identifying subjects and developing a targeted tailored approach is part of the daily work of the police and various security partners.
Het verzamelen van informatie, het in beeld brengen van subjecten en het ontwikkelen van een gerichte aanpak op maat, is onderdeel van het dagelijkse werk van politie en diverse veiligheidspartners.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een weggepest gezin uit Utrecht (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that a family was driven out of a Utrecht neighbourhood by street harassment, and whether the mayor should be removed. The minister says all possible measures were taken, rejects removing the mayor, and lists existing tools such as area bans, behavioural orders and planned restraining measures while ruling out a lifelong area ban.
Inquiries with the municipality of Utrecht have shown that all possible efforts were made to reduce the nuisance.
Navraag bij de gemeente Utrecht heeft opgeleverd dat alle mogelijke inspanningen zijn verricht om de overlast te doen verminderen.
Vragen van de leden Dille en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat gehandicapten zijn bekogeld en bespuugd (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether disabled people are being spat at and pelted with stones in their neighbourhood, whether this is structural, and what will be done to protect them. The minister confirmed awareness, agreed that vulnerable people should not be victims, saw no sign of a structural problem, said police are investigating a small group of youths, and noted agreements with the care institution's security coordinator for quick response.
The police are working on tracing the perpetrators.
De politie is bezig met het opsporen van de daders.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de mishandeling van meisjes op een verjaardagsfeest (ingezonden 28

Two PVV MPs asked about a violent attack on girls at a birthday party, including release of suspects, prosecution, damages, sentencing, and the multicultural society and denaturalisation law. The government answered that suspects remain under investigation, the case is too complex for snelrecht, victims can claim damages as injured parties, and the denaturalisation question awaits a decision by autumn.
Soon the Public Prosecution Service will take a prosecution decision.
Binnenkort neemt het Openbaar Ministerie een vervolgingsbeslissing.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Nederland doet werk voor Turks OM» (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands should cooperate with a Turkish legal assistance request to hear a Turkish judge in an asylum procedure over insulting Turkish nationhood, and on what grounds such a request can be refused. The minister said the requests are still under review, cited ERV grounds for refusal including a reservation on persecution for belief or nationality, and committed to a case-by-case assessment.
After receipt of all the implementing documents, I will make an assessment of which information can be provided to the Turkish authorities and which cannot.
Na ontvangst van alle uitvoeringsstukken zal door mij een afweging worden gemaakt welke informatie verstrekt kan worden aan de Turkse autoriteiten en welke niet.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over hulpofficieren van justitie die slechts een taakstraf krijgen aangeboden terwijl zij valsheid in geschrifte plegen (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister why the Limburg prosecution offered community service to four unauthorised special investigating officers who forged official reports, and whether this is acceptable. The minister confirms the facts, defends the prosecution's transaction as proportionate given disciplinary measures already taken, cites privacy limits on detail, and refers to forthcoming letters on certificate renewal and evidence admissibility.
Given the privacy of those involved, I cannot go into further detail.
Gelet op de privacy van de betrokkenen kan ik niet verder in detail treden.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Topjurist Buruma in opspraak» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

The MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Buruma, chair of the TCEAS, is under scrutiny over how a criminal case was handled, questioning his pending appointment to the Supreme Court and whether it can be halted. The Minister replies that the TCEAS advice was sound, that no facts stand in the way of the appointment, that the Tweede Kamer's nomination is not bound by the Supreme Court list, and that the Minister will not monitor the pending review request.
From the information available to me, I have found no facts or circumstances that stand in the way of Mr Buruma's appointment as a member of the Supreme Court of the Netherlands.
Uit de informatie die mij ter beschikking staat zijn mij geen feiten of omstandigheden gebleken die in de weg staan aan de benoeming van de heer Buruma tot lid van de Hoge Raad der Nederlanden.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken over lekkende straatcoaches (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers about straatcoaches in Maassluis who reportedly leaked information, the reasons for their dismissal, the screening, and the municipality's targets for Moroccan-Dutch youth. The ministers replied that the municipality reported no police information was leaked but that relevant information was not passed to police, that the coaches were reassigned rather than dismissed, that local authorities decide on straatcoaches, and that stricter supervision and rules were agreed.
Enquiries with the municipality show that no police information was leaked, but that important information from the target groups was not passed on to the police by the street coaches.
Uit navraag bij de gemeente blijkt dat er geen politie-informatie is gelekt, maar dat belangrijke informatie afkomstig vanuit de doelgroepen door de straatcoaches niet aan de politie is doorgegeven.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over kartelafspraken op executieveilingen (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked about alleged cartel price-fixing by property traders at execution auctions, the scale of harm to former homeowners, supervision of the auctions, measures to make them accessible to private buyers, and whether traders face Tax Authority controls and prosecution. The government answered that the NMa has reported 15 persons and named several hundred traders for follow-up, that the notary supervises the auction, that regional auctions and a forthcoming bill aim to improve access, and that the NMa and Public Prosecution Service handle any violations.

No reliable figure can be given for the exact harm, because it is not known what the difference is between a price that would have been reached at an auction without agreements and the price reached at an auction with agreements.

Over de exacte schade kan geen betrouwbaar cijfer worden gegeven, omdat niet bekend is wat het verschil is tussen een prijs die tot stand zou zijn gekomen op een veiling zonder afspraken en de prijs die tot stand komt op een veiling met afspraken.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Vrouw (97) moet achter rovers aan» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a 97-year-old victim of a violent robbery is being left to pursue the damages owed by her attackers, and whether this undermines trust in justice, and asks about a planned bill on seizure and CJIB collection. The state secretary answers that the claim is incorrect, refers to earlier answers, says the bill is being prepared for early 2012, and states that the CJIB is already working on collecting the damages.
This bill is currently being prepared at the official level.
Dit wetsvoorstel wordt op dit moment op ambtelijk niveau voorbereid.

Vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «ROC Rijn IJssel treft schikking met OM» (ingezonden 22 april 2011)

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would dismiss or force a vocational school (ROC Rijn IJssel) to drop proceedings against a whistleblower, after the school settled with the public prosecutor over forgery and fraud, and whether whistleblowers should get statutory protection. The minister answered that the labour relationship is not for the government to intervene in, that settlement is an acceptable way to punish fraud and recover gains, and that since 2009 every mbo institution has a whistleblower protection scheme with no plans to change it.
Whistleblowers must be protected. Since 1 January 2009 every mbo institution has a scheme protecting whistleblowers.
Klokkenluiders moeten beschermd worden. Sinds 1 januari 2009 heeft iedere mbo-instelling een regeling die klokkenluiders beschermt.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «belastinggeld voor bendeleden» (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court award of 150,000 euros in damages to nine members of a Brabant drug gang after the case collapsed. The minister explained the case was declared inadmissible due to a tainted police interview, that damages are possible under article 90 Sv, and that the police unit has started a Masterplan to prevent similar errors.
Naturally I regret the inadmissibility of the Public Prosecution Service in the cases against the suspects, which ultimately led to this outcome.
Vanzelfsprekend betreur ik de niet-ontvankelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie in de zaken tegen de verdachten, hetgeen uiteindelijk tot deze uitkomst heeft geleid.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Driessen en Helder (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over straatcoaches (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether reported lying by street coaches (straatcoaches) to obtain subsidies was known, whether such subsidised projects should be stopped, and how lying coaches help keep neighbourhoods together. The minister answered that effectiveness and deployment are local matters, that coaches must behave properly with the responsibility of their employer and municipality, and that stopping subsidies is for the municipality to decide.
The decision to deploy street coaches, the way they are supervised and the assessment of their effectiveness is not for me but takes place at local level.
De keuze om straatcoaches in te zetten, de wijze waarop ze begeleid worden en de beoordeling van de effectiviteit is niet aan mij, maar vindt plaats op lokaal niveau.

Vragen van de leden Helder en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Slachtoffers in de kou» (ingezonden 11

PVV MPs asked whether victims of crime miss out on Slachtofferhulp aid because the police BVH system malfunctions and the consent question defaults to 'no'. The state secretary denied a system fault, said consent is not defaulted to 'no', and committed to have victim data forwarded automatically to Slachtofferhulp, with police asked to implement this quickly.
To ensure that victims consistently receive victim support offers from now on, it is necessary that victims' data are by default forwarded to Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat slachtoffers voortaan consequent slachtofferhulp krijgen aangeboden is het nodig dat standaard de gegevens van slachtoffers naar Slachtofferhulp Nederland worden doorgestuurd.

Vragen van de leden Helder en de Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat buschauffeurs van Connexxion in Flevoland noodgedwongen het werk neerleg

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment and of Security and Justice about a Connexxion bus driver work stoppage in Flevoland caused by rising violence, and about a proposed lifetime bus ban. The minister replied that Connexxion is taking measures with local partners, that a travel ban already exists and an automatic criminal penalty is pending legislation, that a lifetime ban is disproportionate, and that extra enforcement officers are being deployed.
However, I regard a lifetime bus ban as disproportionate and therefore not very realistic.
Een levenslang busverbod beschouw ik echter als disproportioneel en daarmee weinig realistisch.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Aso’s isoleren in Tuigdorpen» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper proposal to isolate repeat offenders in 'tuigdorpen' (tent or container villages), asking whether it would help and whether the government would implement it. The state secretary rejected the proposal, citing existing remand facilities, the Inrichting voor Stelselmatige Daders (ISD) measure, and the experience of earlier Skaeve Huse-type projects that struggled with locations.
When it comes to providing a facility pending a criminal case, I do not consider an open facility appropriate.
Als het gaat om het bieden van een voorziening in afwachting van een strafzaak vind ik een open voorziening niet passend.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Duitse veroordeling gehalveerd» (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a German sentence for a Dutch drug smuggler being reduced to 36 months by a Dutch court, and whether the Dutch transfer law should be reviewed. The minister replied that the outcome was foreseeable under the transfer guarantee procedure, that Nederland does not stand internationally ridiculed, and that he sees no reason to review the WOTS law.
It follows from my answers to questions 3 through 6 that I see no reason to do so.
Uit mijn antwoorden op vragen 3 tot en met 6 volgt dat ik daartoe geen aanleiding zie.

Vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Gevangenis huurt meer imams in en minder pastors en humanisten» (ingezonden 28 januari

PVV MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about a report that prisons were hiring more imams and fewer pastors and humanist counsellors, and whether this threatened integration. The government answered that the increase follows a preference survey of prisoners, denied any integration effect, and refused to introduce an imam stop, citing the legal duty to match religious care to inmates' beliefs.
I therefore see no reason whatsoever to introduce an imam stop (as spiritual caregiver) at DJI.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele aanleiding om een imamstop (als geestelijk verzorger) in te voeren bij DJI.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de passagier die na een valse bommelding gewoon werd vrijgelaten (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a passenger who caused a false bomb alert at Schiphol was released after questioning, and why detention options and cost recovery were not used. The Minister answered that the incident caused only a 15-minute check-in delay, that release after questioning was lawful as no further investigation was needed, that the Public Prosecution Service offered a 750 euro settlement, and that cost recovery was not appropriate.
Further deprivation of liberty of the suspect was not justified, because no further investigation was needed.
Verdere vrijheidsbeneming van de verdachte was niet gerechtvaardigd, omdat er geen verder onderzoek nodig was.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de ministe van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Verdachten terreur krijgen vergoeding» (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

PVV MPs Helder and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service paid compensation to nine of twelve Somali men arrested on Christmas Eve after an AIVD intelligence report, and whether this affects future AIVD reports and prosecutorial practice. The minister answered that the arrests were lawful on the facts known at the time, that the State is liable for harm found to be unlawful after further investigation, that the compensation does not change how AIVD reports are handled, and that no measures are needed.
Paying compensation has no consequences for the AIVD providing official reports to the Public Prosecution Service or for how the PPS handles those reports.
Het betalen van een schadevergoeding heeft geen gevolgen voor het verstrekken van ambtsberichten door de AIVD aan het OM of de wijze waarop het OM met die ambtsberichten omgaat.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Nederlandse hoofdrol o

PVV MPs asked ministers whether an investigation exists into the people behind radical extremist websites, whether citizenship could be revoked and they could be expelled, and whether such extremists increasingly operate from the Netherlands. The minister declined to give operational details citing the interests of investigation, said nationality revocation is only possible under narrow conditions and lacks sufficient data for a judgement, and referred to earlier answers for the remaining questions.
In the interest of the investigation I cannot give information about any ongoing criminal investigations or about the number of persons involved.
Ik kan in het belang van de opsporing geen mededelingen doen over eventueel lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken of over het aantal betrokkenen.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder, Kortenoeven en Fritsma (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijlating van Wesam al D., die in Amerika voor 25 jaar gevangenisstra

PVV MPs asked why Wesam al D., sentenced in the US to 25 years for plotting attacks on American soldiers, was released early after a Dutch court substantially reduced his sentence due to detention conditions, and whether they would prevent such reductions and revoke his Dutch nationality. The ministers answered that the court weighed additional information, that the case is exceptional and warrants no new measures, and that nationality revocation is not possible here because the relevant provision does not apply to offences committed before its entry into force.
As a rule, there is no reason for a judge converting a foreign sentence to moderate that foreign sentence on account of detention conditions.
In de regel is er voor de rechter bij de omzetting van een buitenlandse straf geen aanleiding voor matiging van de buitenlandse straf wegens detentieomstandigheden.
Vragen van de leden Helder, Brinkman en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Geen cel voor agent die spioneerde voor Marokko» (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a former police detective who passed secret police information to Morocco was really given only a 240-hour community sentence, whether that undermines the credibility of the justice system, whether community sentences should be available for such offences, and whether he also leaked information about an SP MP. The minister confirmed the sentence, declined to judge the independent court, said the sentence reflects the statutory framework and personal circumstances, noted a pending bill restricting community sentences for serious sex and violence offences, and declined to name the persons whose information was passed on, citing privacy.
For privacy reasons I make no statements about the persons about whom the convicted person provided information.
Uit privacyoverwegingen doe ik geen mededelingen over de personen over wie de veroordeelde informatie heeft verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Klinieken willen tbs’er sneller met verlof sturen» (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about proposals by twelve forensic psychiatric clinics to grant TBS patients leave earlier, and whether this undermines the TBS system and public safety. The minister answers that the clinics' proposals aim at transparency and efficiency, that leave is assessed individually by an independent advisory committee, and that TBS recidivism figures are favourable.
Leave granting is weighed on an individual basis.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie naar aanleiding van het bericht «Mohammed Bouyeri: «geen spijt moord Theo van Gogh»» (ingezonden 13 juli 2010)

MPs Wilders and Helder asked the Justice Minister how a life-sentenced prisoner, Mohammed Bouyeri, could send a letter expressing no regret for the Theo van Gogh murder via an outside Islamic group, and asked about detention regime strictness. The minister said the director judged the letter not refusable under the Penitentiary Principles Act, though he considers that assessment wrong and favours stricter screening, while rejecting loosening or tightening the regime beyond the existing individual-focused approach.
I consider this assessment incorrect since certain passages in my view can indeed be regarded as offensive to the victim's next of kin.
Ik acht deze afweging onjuist nu bepaalde passages mijns inziens wel degelijk als kwetsend voor de nabestaanden van het slachtoffer kunnen worden beschouwd.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over homo’s in zelfde straat aangevallen (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reported anti-gay attacks in an Amsterdam street, whether police should prosecute without a complaint, and whether a mobile police post should be opened. The ministers replied that prosecution can proceed without a complaint if evidence exists, that the Amsterdam-Amstelland force has a discrimination approach and two complaints led to arrests, and that no mobile post is warranted because the facts do not amount to street terror.
Without a complaint, facts are often hard to prove, but the police can also draw up a report without a complaint if evidence is obtained by other means.
Zonder aangifte zijn feiten vaak moeilijk bewijsbaar, maar de politie kan ook zonder aangifte een proces-verbaal opmaken als er langs andere weg bewijs kan worden verkregen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie over het bericht «Uitkeringsfraude Deventer» (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about a news report of benefit fraud in Deventer, where a couple received about 99,000 euros in social assistance before an anonymous tip exposed them, and whether the full amount plus interest should be reclaimed and whether the 180-hour community service sentence was too lenient. The minister confirmed awareness, said municipalities bear responsibility for enforcement and recovery under the WWB, noted the municipality is recovering the full amount and has seized assets, and declined to comment on the judge's sentence.
Since the introduction of the WWB in 2004, the authority to shape municipal enforcement policy lies entirely with the municipalities.
Sinds de invoering van de WWB in 2004 ligt de bevoegdheid om invulling te geven aan het gemeentelijke handhavingsbeleid volledig bij de gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over de toename van het aantal gevallen van diefstal met geweld met meer dan een kwart (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a reported 26% rise in violent theft and a 21% rise in robberies in 2009, and whether minimum sentences are the answer. The minister confirms the rise, points to the Taskforce Overvallen and a forthcoming study, and declines to commit to tougher sentencing, citing research that minimum sentences have no proven deterrent effect.
I therefore see no reason to urge the Public Prosecution Service to demand higher sentences.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om er bij het Openbaar Ministerie op aan te dringen om hogere straffen te eisen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie naar aanleiding van het bericht «Zesvoudig moordenaar mag toch met verlof» (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a report that a six-fold murderer, serving life, may take leave after the RSJ appeals committee annulled the withdrawal of his supervised leave permit, and whether the law should be changed urgently. The minister answers that the 2007 leave framework excludes leave for life-sentenced prisoners except humanitarian incidental leave, that this case is unique, that emergency legislation is not warranted, and that victims and next of kin are being informed and supported.
The current leave framework, which came into force in 2007, excludes leave for life-sentenced prisoners.
Het huidige verlofkader, dat in 2007 van kracht werd, sluit verlof voor levenslanggestraften uit.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht dat tbs-traject worden ingekort na terugloop van behandelingen (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice whether TBS (forensic psychiatric detention) treatment is being shortened because of falling treatment numbers, whether the sector is making treatment more attractive to patients, whether TBS is outdated given lawyers advising clients not to cooperate with psychiatric assessments, and whether abolishing TBS in favour of long prison sentences would better protect society. The Minister denies that treatment is being made more attractive, says a sector proposal sets norms for treatment stages while safety stays leading, promises a policy letter in autumn on reducing dependence on the suspect's cooperation, and rejects abolition as raising unacceptable recidivism risk.
As I already said in the question hour of 30 March, I will send Parliament a policy letter on TBS in the autumn.
Zoals ik in het vragenuur van 30 maart jl. reeds heb gezegd, zal ik in het najaar een beleidsbrief over tbs aan het parlement sturen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Tbs’er loopt mee met vierdaagse» (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a report that a tbs detainee (convicted of rape and murder, per the MP) was allowed to walk the Four Days Marches unsupervised as part of therapy, and whether such leave is acceptable. The minister says the man is in the final phase of treatment with unsupervised leave since 2008, that the walk was a leave permit weighed by the clinic, the Adviescollege verloftoetsing tbs and DJI, that the offences assumption is wrong, and that the outing is not an unacceptable part of a non-punitive measure.
The person concerned was granted a leave permit allowing him to walk the Four Days Marches without supervision.
Voor betrokkene is een verlofmachtiging verleend die de ruimte biedt om, zonder begeleiding, mee te lopen met de Vierdaagse.

m: Amendement van de leden Ronnes en Koşer Kaya ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het in de wet opnemen van de voorwaarde voor het toepassen van bestuursdwang dat overlast herhaaldelijk moet zijn
Amendment requires that nuisance be repeated, not a single incident, before a mayor may impose an order under administrative enforcement on a home occupant.
so that it is clear the mayor cannot use his power on the basis of a single incident
zodat duidelijk is weergegeven dat de burgemeester van zijn bevoegdheid niet gebruik kan maken op basis van één enkel incident
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya ter vervanging van nr. 65 over een stimulans voor het vergroeningsbeleid voor verstedelijkte gemeenten
Shifts 5 million euro from business policy to nature and biodiversity to fund greening in urbanised municipalities.
The budget statement is amended as follows
De begrotingsstaat wordt als volgt gewijzigd
Amendement van het lid Marcouch c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 32 over het meldpunt internet discriminatie
Amendment moves 23,000 euro within the budget to keep subsidy for the internet discrimination reporting office (MiND) at its 2016 level, funded by a reserve.
This amendment provides that an amount of 23,000 euro is made available for the internet discrimination reporting office (MiND).
Dit amendement regelt dat een bedrag van € 23.000 wordt vrijgemaakt voor het meldpunt internet discriminatie (MiND)
Motie van het lid Geurts c.s. over een tweewekelijkse update
Asks the government to give the House a biweekly update on the status and planned actions regarding the dairy sector package and the Nitrates Directive action programme.
requests the government to give the House a biweekly update on the state of affairs and the actions to be taken
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer tweewekelijks een update te geven van de stand van zaken en de te ondernemen acties
Amendement van het lid Marcouch c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 24 over het meldpunt internet discriminatie
Moves 23,000 euros from the Nominal and Unforeseen budget item to the Security and Crime item to keep the MiND internet discrimination reporting point's subsidy at its 2016 level.
This amendment provides that an amount of 23,000 euros is made available for the internet discrimination reporting point (MiND).
Dit amendement regelt dat een bedrag van € 23.000 wordt vrijgemaakt voor het meldpunt internet discriminatie (MiND)
Amendement van het lid Marcouch c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het meldpunt internet discriminatie
Amendment restores budget funding of EUR 23,000 for the internet discrimination reporting office by shifting money from the nominal and unforeseen reserve.
This amendment provides that an amount of 23,000 euro is made available for the internet discrimination reporting office (MiND).
Dit amendement regelt dat een bedrag van € 23.000 wordt vrijgemaakt voor het meldpunt internet discriminatie (MiND)
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over een inventarisatie van de wensen in de lokale democratie voor experimenten met democratische vernieuwing
Asks the government to inventory local democracy wishes for experiments with democratic renewal and examine removing obstacles to them.
requests the government to inventory which wishes exist in local democracy regarding experiments with democratic renewal
verzoekt de regering, te inventariseren welke wensen er vanuit de lokale democratie leven ten aanzien van experimenten met democratische vernieuwing
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya over de samenwerking tussen Europese inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten
Motion asking the government to optimise European intelligence cooperation and give the EU intelligence body INTCEN a full mandate with democratic oversight.
and to pursue a full mandate with accompanying democratic control for the European intelligence service INTCEN
en in te zetten op een volwaardig mandaat met bijbehorende democratische controle voor de Europese inlichtingendienst INTCEN
Motie van het lid Fokke c.s. over een actieplan om jongeren meer bij de politiek te betrekken
Asks the government to produce an action plan to involve young people more in politics, building on existing initiatives.
requests the government to come up with an action plan to involve young people even more in politics
verzoekt de regering, met een actieplan te komen om jongeren nog meer bij de politiek te betrekken
Motie van de leden De Caluwé en Koşer Kaya over de eigen regie van burgers over hun gegevens

Asks the government to investigate how citizens could get control over their data, including insight into which officials viewed or shared it and the option to automatically share limited data with chosen bodies.
so that they gain insight into which official has viewed, used or passed on which data
• zij inzage krijgen in welke functionaris welke gegevens heeft ingezien dan wel gebruikt of aan een ander verstrekt heeft;
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya Kaya over de ontwikkeling van een antidiscriminatieaanpak met maatschappelijk draagvlak

Asks the government to talk with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, interest groups and municipal anti-discrimination services to develop a broadly supported and workable anti-discrimination approach.
requests the government to enter into talks with the College for Human Rights, interest organisations and (municipal) anti-discrimination services
verzoekt de regering om, met het College voor de Rechten van de Mens, belangenorganisaties en (gemeentelijke) antidiscriminatievoorzieningen in gesprek te gaan
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya ter vervanging van nr. 16 over voldoende fosfaatruimte als voorwaarde voor de verkrijging van fosfaatrechten
Allows transfer of phosphate rights only if the recipient farm has enough phosphate space to use the full right, giving the minister grounds to refuse registration.
Transfer of a phosphate right is only possible insofar as the holder to whose farm the right must pass has sufficient phosphate space to fully exercise the right.

Overgang van een fosfaatrecht is slechts mogelijk voor zover de belanghebbende naar wiens bedrijf het fosfaatrecht moet overgaan, beschikt over voldoende fosfaatruimte om het fosfaatrecht geheel te kunnen uitoefenen.
Amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya over een impuls aan de anti-discriminatie-agenda van de regering
Shifts 3 million euro within the Interior Ministry budget to fund an anti-discrimination agenda and a discrimination reporting point.
This amendment therefore frees up 3 million euro within the Interior Ministry budget for a boost to the government's anti-discrimination agenda.
Dit amendement maakt daarom binnen de begroting van Binnenlandse Zaken 3 miljoen euro vrij voor een impuls aan de anti-discriminatie-agenda van de regering.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya ter vervanging van nr. 17 over een voorhang bij de ministeriële regeling in artikel 38a
Adds a four-week pre-consultation (voorhang) period before the ministerial regulation on phosphate bank conditions can be adopted.
The ministerial regulation may not be adopted earlier than four weeks after its draft has been submitted to both chambers.
De ministeriële regeling, bedoeld in het eerste lid, wordt niet eerder vastgesteld dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp ervan aan beide kamers der Staten Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya over meer inzicht in de besteding van landbouwsubsidies
Asks the government to examine how more insight into the spending of agricultural subsidies can be given, in a reusable data format, within legal privacy limits.
requests the government to examine how, within existing information flows, for the accountability of subsidies, more insight can be given into subsidy spending
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke wijze, binnen de bestaande informatiestromen, ten behoeve van de verantwoording van subsidies
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya over het correct uitvoeren van de Wet hergebruik overheidsinformatie
Asks the government to ensure the NVWA correctly implements the Public Sector Information Re-use Act and resolves technical problems.
requests the government to ensure that the NVWA implements the Public Sector Information Re-use Act correctly as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering, er zorg voor te dragen dat de NVWA zo spoedig mogelijk de Wet hergebruik overheidsinformatie correct uitvoert
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya over een analyse van de huidige wet- en regelgeving voor landbouw, milieu en natuur
Asks the government for an analysis of existing agriculture, environment and nature rules with improvement proposals, a regulatory review that does not directly concern checks on the executive.
requests the government to come up with an analysis of and improvement proposals for current laws and regulations for farmers and nature
verzoekt de regering, ten behoeve van boer en natuur met een analyse van en verbetervoorstellen voor de huidige wet- en regelgeving te komen
Motie van het lid Koşer Kaya over ziekteschade als gevolg van onveilig voedsel
Asks the government to introduce a presumption of causation so consumers who prove they ate food subject to an NVWA warning and fell ill need not prove causality themselves.
requests the government to introduce a presumption of evidence that the damage suffered (illness) is the result of the food consumed
verzoekt de regering, een bewijsvermoeden in te voeren dat de opgetreden (ziekte)schade het gevolg is van het tot zich genomen voedsel
Motie van het lid Dijkgraaf c.s. over de beschikbaarheid van biologische gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor de fruitteelt
Asks the government, with the fruit sector, to present a plan so that organic plant protection products become more available for fruit growing, including structural exemptions.
requests the government, in consultation with the fruit sector, to come up with an action plan in the short term
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de fruitteeltsector op korte termijn te komen met een plan van aanpak
Amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya over een bedrag waarmee verstedelijkte gemeenten hun vergroeningsbeleid een stimulans kunnen geven
Adds five million euro to the municipal fund so urbanised municipalities can fund greening policy, funded by cutting the TKI allowance budget.
In article 1 of the municipal fund, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 5,000 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 1 gemeentefonds worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 5.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Koşer Kaya over een verlaging van de middelen voor de TKI-toeslag
Lowers the budget for the TKI innovation allowance by 5 million euro and moves the money to the municipal fund for urban greening.
This amendment therefore frees 5 million euro to add to the municipal fund
Dit amendement maakt daarom 5 miljoen euro vrij om toe te voegen aan het gemeentefonds
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Dik-Faber en Koşer Kaya ter vervanging van nr. 21 over geen generieke korting voor grondgebonden bedrijven
Exempts farms with negative phosphate space from the generic reduction of rights, where extra manure is fully applied on their own land.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over door waterkrachtcentrales gedode alen
