Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht 'Geen 'tegenprestatie' in de bijstand? Dan géén vrijheid'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the imposition of a 'tegenprestatie' (counter-performance) in welfare is a municipal competence, whether the Participatiewet experiments are valid despite wording differences in municipal ordinances, and whether linking experiment eligibility to ordinance wording is improper. The State Secretary answered that municipalities regulate the tegenprestatie by ordinance under council oversight, that experiments require municipalities to comply with the law, and that the exact wording of ordinances is secondary as long as they conform to the Act.
The municipal council has a supervisory task over the implementation of the policy laid down in ordinances.
De gemeenteraad heeft een controlerende taak op de uitvoering van het in verordeningen vastgelegde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de voorspelde toename van intimidatie en bedreiging van politieke bestuurders

The MP asked how threats and intimidation of political office-holders stemming from the fight against organised crime are being addressed, whether the programme has been revised, and why the minister asks parliament for extra funds. The minister answered that local government is central to the approach, that threats are dealt with firmly, that a monitoring study and a WODC study are pending, and that extra funding of 7 to 10 million euros a year plus 14 million for the Public Prosecution Service has been allocated.
I have no information available about the expected threats and intimidation.
Over de te verwachten bedreigingen en intimidaties heb ik geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het couperen van paarden

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the ban on docking horses' tails, in force since 2001, is widely evaded and why enforcement is ineffective, and about inspection and sanctions at horse markets and exhibitions. The State Secretary says docking without veterinary necessity is prohibited and amounts to animal cruelty, that the number of docked horses is unknown, and refers to earlier answers for enforcement, while promising to report on an administrative enforcement track before year-end.
On the progress of the administrative enforcement track I have initiated, I will inform your House before the end of this year.
Over de voortgang van het bestuursrechtelijke traject dat ik heb ingezet, zal ik uw Kamer voor het eind van dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Jij ziet er helemaal niet uit als een politieman!’

MPs Swinkels and Koşer Kaya asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of a Dutch-Surinamese man's treatment by police, alleged ethnic profiling in the police (including the arrest of rapper Typhoon), measures against and training on ethnic profiling, and data on people of non-Dutch background in custody and prosecution. The minister said an internal investigation is ongoing, denied a systemic trend of ethnic profiling while acknowledging the problem, described diversity and training programmes, and declined to provide ethnicity-based statistics because such registration is not permitted.
No, I cannot provide you with such figures.
Nee, ik kan u dergelijke cijfers niet doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over natuurbegraven

An MP asked the government about natural burial sites: how many exist, whether they are concentrated in certain regions because of groundwater levels, their environmental effects, and the rule in the burial decree requiring graves to lie 30 cm above the highest average groundwater level. The minister answered that there is no single definition and about 20 sites exist, that effects on nature are limited with proper management, and that a possible exception to the groundwater rule will be considered in a further review of implementation practice.
No figures are known on the number of burials in nature.
Van het aantal begrafenissen in de natuur zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over besmette zandbakken in speeltuinen

An MP asked the government about contamination of playground sandpits with dog and cat faeces that can carry toxoplasmosis and toxocariasis, including infection rates, disease course, and whether the NVWA oversees sandpit surfaces. The Minister replied that infection rates are not tracked, the NVWA supervises owners' duty to keep surfaces safe, and advised parents and owners on hygiene and sand use without committing to new measures.
There is no notification obligation for Toxoplasma or Toxocara. There is therefore no overview of the number of cases.
Er bestaat geen meldingsplicht voor Toxoplasma of Toxocara. Er is dus geen overzicht van het aantal gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Wetgeving hoeft niet te worden veranderd om voor levenloos geboren kinderen een geboorteakte op te maken’

Two D66 MPs asked whether stillborn children can be registered and whether parents are informed of the option to receive a birth record, and whether a national register is possible. The ministers answered that a death-register record is made under art. 1:19i BW without a gestation minimum, that such children are not entered in the BRP, that the minister will study registration options and report before summer, and that the government has improved information for parents.
I would point out that the record of a stillborn child is kept in the civil registers and is therefore findable and consultable.
Ik wil erop wijzen dat de akte van een levenloos geboren kind wordt bewaard in de registers van de burgerlijke stand en daardoor vindbaar en raadpleegbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Koser Kaya en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Politicus Bonaire werd onterecht bespioneerd’

MPs Pechtold, Koşer Kaya and Van Laar asked whether the AIVD unlawfully collected data on former Bonaire minister Jopie Abraham and other Bonairean politicians, and how access refusals were tested. The Minister declined to discuss the CTIVD's non-public ruling or operational matters, stated that access refusals are tested under the Wiv 2002 on knowledge-protection grounds, and saw no reason to request further investigation.
The CTIVD's assessment of the complaint by Mr Jopie Abraham is not public.
Het oordeel van de CTIVD inzake de klacht van de heer Jopie Abraham is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Geurts en Koser Kaya over het rapport van de Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer over de kansen en knelpunten voor eiwitrijke veevoergrondstoffen

MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Raad voor Regionaal Veevoer report on increasing regionally grown protein feed and whether he would adopt its recommendations and a protein vision. The State Secretary agreed that regional protein production has potential, committed to exploring public-private initiatives, topsector focus and raising EU-level barriers, but said direct state steering of cultivation is not the preferred route and the transition will proceed more slowly than the report envisages.
I agree that regional cultivation and sale of protein crops can contribute more to improving the regional cycle.
Ik onderschrijf dat met de productie van regionale teelt en afzet van eiwitgewassen meer kan worden bijgedragen aan het verbeteren van de regionale kringloop
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over een vergunning voor een nertsenhouderij in Bergeijk

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a permit for a mink farm in Bergeijk, whether it is a new farm, and how it fits the 2024 fur farming ban. The State Secretary answers that the permit is a Natuurbeschermingswet permit for relocating an existing mink farm, that relocation is allowed under the ban if animal numbers do not increase and the old site is closed, and that the permit is separate from the ban.
The granted permit concerns a permit under the Nature Conservation Act 1998.
De verleende vergunning betreft een vergunning in het kader van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de relatie tussen openbaarmaking van interne tijdschriften van de MIVD en het geheimhouden van de AIVD-tapstatistieken

An MP asked whether publishing MIVD internal magazine content reveals its working methods, and why AIVD wiretap statistics cannot be published. The government answered that the MIVD publications gave no insight into working methods and that the Minister of Interior will take a new decision on AIVD wiretap statistics after a Council of State ruling, so nothing more can be said until then.
Until this assessment has been completed, nothing can be added to the earlier answers to the written questions from MP Koşer Kaya.
Tot het moment waarop deze beoordeling is afgerond, kan er niets worden toegevoegd aan de eerdere beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bestrijden van wildlife crime

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the enforcement of wildlife crime, the adequacy of penalties and detection, the use of the EUR 4 million budget, and the EU action plan. The State Secretary answered that existing rules and enforcement by NVWA, police, Customs and the Public Prosecution Service suffice, that penalties are relatively high, and that he will report on the conference results and the EU action plan later.
I will send you my response to the EU action plan together with the results of the conference.
Ik zal u mijn reactie op het EU-actieplan toesturen tezamen met de resultaten van de conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over een met het verboden bestrijdingsmiddel Aldicarb vergiftigd persoon

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the banned pesticide aldicarb used on a chrysanthemum grower and whether NVWA knew of its use in the Netherlands. The government answered that NVWA had no indication of wide use, that a criminal investigation is ongoing and that it cannot comment on its status.
A criminal investigation under the direction of the Public Prosecutor of the Zwolle Office is ongoing.
Een strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van de Officier van Justitie van Parket Zwolle is gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht "Het geringe broedsucces van broedvogels in het Waddengebied”

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the poor breeding success of coastal birds in the Wadden Sea, the causes, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answered that causes are complex, fishing is not clearly the cause, and listed a trilateral action plan and the Rijke Waddenzee programme as measures.

By continuing this breeding success monitoring and gathering more knowledge, including from the projects named in my answer to question 5 and discussed and shared at trilateral level, I want to try to gain more insight into this complex subject in this dynamic area.

Met het continueren van dit reproductiemeetnet en met het vergaren van meer kennis, die onder meer wordt opgedaan in de projecten die bij mijn antwoord op vraag 5 zijn benoemd en op trilateraal niveau worden besproken en gedeeld, wil ik trachten meer inzicht te verkrijgen in deze veelzijdige materie in dit dynamische gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Koolmees over het bericht dat de pachttermijn van zes jaar voor landbouwgrond te kort is

MPs Koşer Kaya and Koolmees asked about reports that six-year farm lease terms are too short to protect soil fertility in Flevoland and elsewhere, and about lease prices, farm incomes, Rijksvastgoedbedrijf practices and possible lease discounts for sustainable soil management. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of the soil concerns, describes the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's soil-quality checks and building plans, provides lease price and income data, and declines to introduce a lease discount while exploring a broader review of the lease system.
I am not prepared to introduce a lease discount.
Ik ben niet bereid een pachtkorting te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Koser Kaya over het suikergehalte in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dijkstra and Koşer Kaya asked about Foodwatch findings that children's drink cartons contain more sugar than Coca-Cola, the child-targeted marketing of these products, and whether the 2020 sugar-reduction target is adequate. The minister points to the Product Composition Agreement, a stepwise approach to sugar reduction, EU-level action, and existing health education programmes, without committing to a stricter target.
A stepwise approach is needed to achieve sustainable results, both because of consumer taste adaptation and because of feasibility for industry.
Een stapsgewijze aanpak is nodig om duurzaam resultaat te behalen, zowel vanwege smaakgewenning bij de consument als vanwege haalbaarheid voor het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘De kust zou leeg blijven. Toch gaat het volbouwen door’

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister how construction plans in Groote Keeten, Nieuwvliet-Bad and Hollum are legally based and whether they predate the withdrawn Barro expansion for building in dunes. The minister answered that these sites lie landward of the coastal foundation, so municipal and provincial rules under the Wro and Wabo govern them, and that the Barro coastal rules do not apply there.
These fall under the competence of the relevant municipality and province.
Deze vallen onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over de vondst van MDMA-resten van XTC-productie in maïsplanten

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked about MDMA residues from ecstasy production found in maize plants on a Someren farm, including risks, NVWA oversight, police cooperation and whether regulation of the market would reduce risk. The state secretary replied that the detected levels pose no health risk, outlined the division of responsibilities between police, municipality and NVWA, and rejected market regulation from a public health perspective.
If the situation gives cause for it, as also happened in this specific case, the NVWA is called in.
Als de situatie daar aanleiding voor geeft, zoals ook in dit specifieke geval is gebeurd, wordt de NVWA ingeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Boer en adviseur vissen achter subsidienet

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a report claiming agricultural subsidies mostly go to research institutes rather than farmers, and whether subsidies for sustainable farm investment have declined since 2012. The State Secretary disputes the report's completeness, notes that most farm subsidies are EU income support and that about 80% of ministry agricultural subsidies go to innovation and research, reports that rijkssubsidies were cut after 2012 with provinces taking over co-financing, and declines to bring forward evaluations or a subsidy-efficiency study.
I see no reason to bring these evaluations forward.
Ik zie geen reden om deze evaluaties naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de samenwerking van de AIVD in Europees verband via de Counter Terrorism Group

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the AIVD's cooperation in the Counter Terrorism Group (CTG) versus the EU's IntCen, the new CTG platform, and oversight of it. The minister explained that CTG is an intelligence-service cooperation outside EU institutions, that the CTG oversight commission (CTIVD) covers AIVD's participation, and that national security remains a national competence, so a democratically legitimised EU intelligence service is not pursued.
This therefore also applies to international cooperation, such as the AIVD's participation in the CTG.
Dit geldt dus ook voor de internationale samenwerking, zoals de AIVD deelname in de CTG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Dit is wat teveel energiedrank met je lichaam doet’

MPs Koşer Kaya and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister how consumers, including minors, can learn from energy drink packaging that heavy consumption may cause serious health effects, and whether labelling and corporate responsibility are adequate. The minister replied that mandatory high-caffeine warnings already apply under EU rules, that industry's voluntary code adds further labelling and marketing limits, and that the government promotes information via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes.
Yes, see answer 2. In addition, I am focusing, for example, via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes on targeted information about healthy and unhealthy food
Ja, zie antwoord 2. Daarnaast zet ik bijvoorbeeld via het Voedingscentrum en schoolprogramma's in op gerichte voorlichting over gezonde en ongezonde voeding
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vervuiling van een drinkwaterbron in Zuid-Holland

MPs Koşer Kaya and Hachchi (D66) asked about pesticide pollution of a drinking water source in Zuid-Holland, including incident frequency, substances and health risks, and what support and enforcement measures exist against the polluter. The minister answered that pesticide norm exceedances cause near-annual intake stops at several Maas and Lekkanaal intake points, that the source lies in the Bommelerwaard under the Waterschap Rivierenland's responsibility, and that the waterschap has administrative enforcement tools, with Rijkswaterstaat offering help.
The Waterschap Rivierenland has administrative enforcement instruments available to address the discharge in the Bommelerwaard.
Het Waterschap Rivierenland heeft voor de aanpak van de lozing in de Bommelerwaard bestuurlijke handhavingsinstrumenten tot haar beschikking
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het oordeel van de Raad van State dat de weigering tapstatistieken van de AIVD te verstrekken onvoldoende gemotiveerd is

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD's wiretap statistics and CTIVD report 40 would be published after the Council of State ruled the refusal insufficiently reasoned, and what lessons would be drawn. The minister confirmed awareness of the ruling and said he will take a new decision on the request as the Council of State ordered.
In the cited ruling the Council of State orders that I must take a new decision on the request submitted by the appellant. I will do so.
In de genoemde uitspraak bepaalt de Raad van State dat ik een nieuw besluit op het door appellant ingediende verzoek moet nemen. Dit zal ik doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over mesthuwelijken

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked whether limiting transfer of the dairy phosphate reference to relatives in the first to third degree forces farms to shrink, whether it encourages sham marriages or adoptions, and how this fits modern family forms. The government replied that the limit already applies since 1 January 2015 under the Fertilisers Act, does not force shrinkage but may raise manure-processing costs, follows the Dutch civil code definition of blood and affinal relatives, and that it has no concrete signals of 'manure marriages' or problematic adoptions.
I have no concrete signals of the occurrence of so-called manure marriages.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen over het voorkomen van zogenaamde mesthuwelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over bouwen in de duinen

An MP from D66 asked how the planned removal of the general ban on new building outside built-up areas in the coastal zone fits with the Van Veldhoven amendment on protecting landscape values, and whether coastal provinces plan to designate their coast as provincial landscape. The minister answered that provinces may pursue landscape policy under the new Nature Conservation Act and that it is not yet clear whether coastal provinces will designate their coast.
Under the draft amendment to the General Rules for Spatial Planning Decree (Barro), provinces and municipalities can pursue policy in the coastal area in the interest of spatial quality.

Ingevolge het ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit algemene regels ruimtelijke ordening (Barro) kunnen provincies en gemeenten in het belang van de ruimtelijke kwaliteit beleid voeren in het kustgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Weyenberg over DigiD in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked whether a German resident of Belgium with a former Dutch business cannot obtain a DigiD, and so cannot access his pension and health insurance data online, and how this squares with EU free movement. Minister Plasterk confirmed that DigiD requires Dutch nationality for non-residents, justified as identity-fraud prevention, and said this may change once the EU eIDAS regulation takes effect, while stating that EU free movement rights do not include a right to digital communication with foreign authorities.
That will probably become possible in the near future.
Dat zal in de nabije toekomst wel tot de mogelijkheden kunnen gaan behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht dat visverwerkers oude vis oplappen met verboden middelen met waterstofperoxide

MP Koşer Kaya asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers whether fish processors use banned hydrogen peroxide agents to disguise old fish, and why the NVWA did not detect it. Minister Schippers replied that the NVWA cannot confirm the practice but will pay more attention to it, that hydrogen peroxide is lawful as a processing aid, and that she cannot rule out unsafe fish reaching consumers pending NVWA investigation.
The NVWA cannot confirm this suspicion, but takes the signal seriously and will pay attention to it during inspections.
De NVWA kan dit vermoeden niet bevestigen, maar neemt het signaal wel serieus en besteedt hier bij de controles aandacht aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht “Illegale opvangers vrijuit om wanbeleid Pieterburen”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how he assessed a court ruling that acquitted two unlicensed seal carers, and whether he saw a financial rather than animal-welfare motive at a licensed seal centre, and what intervention or mediation was possible. The State Secretary answered that the public prosecutor has appealed so the case is before the courts, and that the government is exploring possible solutions with provinces and stakeholders, with a follow-up promised.
The Public Prosecution Service lodged an appeal on 16 October against the court's ruling.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft op 16 oktober jl. hoger beroep ingesteld naar aanleiding van voornoemde uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het verstrekken van persoonsgegevens van niet-kerkgangers aan de Stichting Interkerkelijke Ledenadministratie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about personal data of non-churchgoers passed from the population register to the church membership body SILA, including how it is checked that a person is a church member, safeguards, and the opt-out system. The minister answered that data flows only for registered church members without objections, that confidentiality is legally required, and that he sees no reason to switch to opt-in.
I see no reason to adapt the current options as regulated for the BRP into an opt-in system
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de huidige mogelijkheden zoals geregeld voor de BRP aan te passen in een opt-in systeem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Koser-Kaya, Karabulut en Schouten over de brief ‘Eerste tussenmeting banenafspraak’

MPs asked about Wsw sheltered-employment placements, waiting-list trends, hours worked and job counts under the banenafspraak (jobs agreement) for disabled workers in 2013-2014. The state secretary answered with Panteia and UWV figures, showing a shift from sheltered workshops to external placements and an increase of 7,304 unique extra jobs, and said the 2015 results would follow around summer 2016.
You will receive the answers in advance of the General Consultation on the Participation Act of 29 October.
U ontvangt de antwoorden voorafgaand aan het Algemeen overleg Participatiewet van 29 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de vermelding van de geboorteplaats op de geboorteakte

An MP asked why birth records must state the municipality of birth, questioning its relevance and whether the place of residence or parents' wish should be recorded instead. The Minister defended the current rule as preserving authenticity and legal certainty and declined to change it, while noting officials' verification powers.
Under these circumstances, there is no reason for me to change the current statutory arrangement.
Onder deze omstandigheden bestaat er voor mij geen aanleiding om de huidige wettelijke regeling te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een verboden emulgator in frisdranken AH en Jumbo zit

Two D66 MPs asked how a banned emulsifier could end up in soft drinks sold by AH and Jumbo without enforcement, and how import controls by the NVWA work. The minister answered that businesses are responsible for food safety, the NVWA uses risk-based inspection, the chain acted after a signal, and full certainty cannot be given.
The NVWA enforces compliance with food legislation. It deploys its capacity and resources based on risk assessments.
De NVWA handhaaft de naleving van de levensmiddelenwetgeving. Zij zet haar capaciteit en middelen in op basis van risico-inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Een risico omdat hij homo’s sprak’

An MP asked whether a security clearance was wrongly not renewed because the AIVD treated a Muslim friend of a gay man as a partner, and whether prejudice played a role. The minister said the Council of State ruled the partner concept was interpreted too broadly, denied any role for sexual orientation, described existing safeguards, and declined to discuss individual cases or compensation.
Following this ruling, it is still being considered whether this definition should be adjusted.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak wordt nog bezien of deze definitie aangepast dient te worden.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over het beperkte aantal re-integratietrajecten voor 45-plussers

An MP asked the minister about the low number of re-integration trajectories for workers over 45 and the poor job-finding rate of older unemployed people. The state secretary answered that UWV and municipalities decide on instruments, that research shows no age difference in net effectiveness, and that older people need other measures alongside re-integration.
The UWV and municipalities are responsible for implementing re-integration policy; they decide which instrument is used for whom.
Het UWV en gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het re-integratiebeleid; door hen wordt besloten welk instrument voor wie wordt ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht dat homoseksuele en niet-christelijke paren nog steeds geen kinderen uit Zuid-Afrika mogen adopteren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether same-sex and non-Christian couples can adopt children from South Africa despite a 2010 law banning such exclusions, and what steps will be taken. The State Secretary answered that ABBA Adoptions applies no exclusionary conditions and that same-sex and non-Christian couples can already adopt through the Vereniging Wereldkinderen and ABBA cooperation, recently confirmed by a cooperation arrangement between the central authorities.
As I indicated in my earlier answer to parliamentary questions, ABBA Adoptions does not apply any exclusionary conditions.
Zoals ik in mijn eerdere beantwoording van Kamervragen heb aangegeven worden er door ABBA Adoptions geen uitsluitende voorwaarden gehanteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de situatie rond het asbest in woningen in de Utrechtse wijk Kanaleneiland

An MP asked about the implementation of a motion requiring agreements with housing associations to inform tenants of asbestos, whether Mitros knew of asbestos in its homes in Kanaleneiland, and whether residents can be warned in advance of renovations. The minister points to a Handboek Asbest produced with Aedes, says Mitros's own inventory showed asbestos and that the question of what it should have known awaits further investigation, and states that no list of asbestos buildings exists while mandatory inventories apply to pre-1994 buildings before work.
Whether Mitros should reasonably have known this, and how it handled the asbestos find during the work, will have to emerge from the promised further investigation.
Of Mitros dit redelijkerwijs had moeten weten en hoe met deze vondst van het asbest tijdens de werkzaamheden is omgegaan zal uit het toegezegde nader onderzoek moeten blijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over "Meer klachten over discriminatie"

An MP asked about reported rises in discrimination complaints, especially in the workplace, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said complaint counts do not prove more discrimination, pointed to general measures and a planned SER advisory request on labour-market discrimination, and said the local anti-discrimination evaluation is under way.
The cabinet intends to ask the Social and Economic Council (SER) for advice on discrimination in the labour market.
Het kabinet voornemens is om aan de Sociaal Economische Raad (SER) een advies te vragen over het onderwerp discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over interlandelijke adoptie uit Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked whether non-Christian and same-sex couples can now adopt from South Africa through Wereldkinderen and the local partner ABBA Adoptions, and whether a second bilateral agreement can be pressed for. The minister answers that non-Christian and same-sex applicants are now accepted and actively mediated, that the South African authority sees no room for a second Dutch licence-holder, and that he sees no reason to press for a second agreement.
Vereniging Wereldkinderen accepts requests for mediation from non-Christian prospective adoptive parents and same-sex prospective adoptive couples.
Vereniging Wereldkinderen neemt verzoeken om bemiddeling in behandeling van niet-christelijke aspirant-adoptiefouders en aspirant-adoptiefparen van gelijk geslacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koser Kaya over de aanhoudende problemen met koopkracht en belastingdruk op de BES-eilanden

Two D66 MPs asked about the state of the interdepartmental studies on purchasing power, inflation, tax revenue and poverty in Caribbean Netherlands, and about a double-taxation problem with Sint Maarten. The government answered that the Ecorys purchasing-power study and the poverty exploration were completed and sent to parliament in June 2012, that a first revenue estimate was requested, and that talks with Sint Maarten on double indirect taxation were constructive.
Only in autumn 2012 will definitive clarity on the revenue of the new tax system be possible.
Pas in het najaar van 2012 zal definitieve duidelijkheid over de opbrengst van het nieuwe belastingstelsel kunnen worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over de representativiteit bij verplichtstelling van cao's

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether representativeness figures for the temp-agency collective agreement (ABU cao) and the StiPP pension fund's mandatory declaration rest on dubious data, including the use of FTE figures rather than headcounts and the gap between 200,000 and 700,000 temp workers. The minister answers that the figures meet the legal majority requirement, that the sources were accepted as reliable and verified by an accountant, and that the ministry checks submissions and plans further improvements.
In the present case, the representativeness figures submitted meet the requirements set for them.
In het onderhavige geval voldoen de aangeleverde representativiteitscijfers aan de eisen die daaraan worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vroege pensioenleeftijd van het overheidspersoneel

Two D66 MPs asked why the public sector has a low average retirement age, what early-retirement schemes and age-related measures exist for civil servants, and what effects this has on wages and the wider labour market. Minister Spies answered that the low average is driven mainly by police and defence, that the general public-sector retirement age has risen, that remaining early-exit schemes are being phased out, and that no spillover effects to other sectors are expected.
The cabinet's policy is aimed at encouraging people to keep working longer.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht om het langer doorwerken te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya over discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the minister about labour-market discrimination against non-Western migrants, citing SCP research showing lower invitation rates to job interviews and higher unemployment among these groups. The state secretary answered that discrimination plays a role alongside qualification and cultural factors, and listed existing anti-discrimination instruments such as municipal antidiscrimination services and police-prosecution coordination, without committing to new measures.
Every discriminatory act is unacceptable and must be prevented and combated with force.
Elke discriminatoire handeling is onacceptabel en dient met kracht te worden voorkomen en bestreden.

m: Amendement van het lid Ortega-Martijn over het verlenen van voorrang bij de woningtoewijzing aan personen die mantelzorg ontvangen
Extends priority in housing allocation to people receiving informal care, not only those giving it.
In article 12, third paragraph, after 'verlenen' is inserted: or receive
In artikel 12, derde lid, wordt na «verlenen» ingevoegd: of ontvangen.

qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over kinderrechten op Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked about children's rights on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including whether differential treatment and the lack of a coordinating minister meet the UN Convention and the Constitution. The State Secretary answered that the islands receive tailored policy, that ministries coordinate via departmental coordinators, and that more action is planned, but declined to pre-judge the forthcoming UNICEF report.

I do not yet wish to anticipate the possible content of this report, its recommendations, and the possible action I may or may not take, in cooperation with other responsible ministries and government services.

Ik wil nu nog niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke inhoud van dit rapport, de aanbevelingen en de mogelijke actie die ik al dan niet in samenwerking met andere verantwoordelijke ministeries en overheidsdiensten zal nemen.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked why the government did not act on long-standing corruption rumours on Bonaire, why the international corruption investigation was halted, and how public integrity will be strengthened. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service is pursuing criminal investigations, that earlier reports were forwarded to prosecutors, that the case was dismissed in 2011 but partly revived by a court in 2012, and that integrity is primarily the responsibility of the local administration with ministry-set preconditions.

On 13 September 2012 the Court declared the complaint well-founded for two dossiers forming part of the total investigation and instructed the Public Prosecution Service to prosecute the suspects for those offences.

Het Hof heeft deze klacht op 13 september 2012 gegrond verklaard voor twee dossiers die deel uitmaakten van het totale onderzoek, en het OM opgedragen de verdachten alsnog voor die feiten te vervolgen.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn over de begeleiding van Wajongers door jobcoaches

MP Ortega-Martijn asked the state secretary whether employers are ending Wajong contracts because job coaching stops after three years, and how this fits the goal of higher employment for people with disabilities. The state secretary denies that the conclusion follows, says UWV can extend coaching in individual cases, and states that the stage job coach experiment will not be continued.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op leerlingenvervoer

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the education minister whether municipalities are cutting pupil transport budgets, leaving children with disabilities at home and charging parents fees for special-needs transport. The minister replied that the central government is not cutting this transport, that only one municipality (affecting seventeen pupils) is reviewing its decisions, and that enforcement of the transport rules rests with the courts rather than with the minister.
I am not authorised to act against municipalities that might not comply with the law.
Ik ben niet bevoegd op te treden tegen gemeenten die zich eventueel niet aan de wet zouden handelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over het bericht dat scholen massaal de klassen vergroten

An MP asked the education minister about reports that schools are enlarging classes after budget cuts, and about trends in class size, cost and funding, and the effect on policy. The minister rejects the claim that cuts cause larger classes, says the student-teacher ratio has fallen over time and funding per pupil has risen, and says class size is for schools to decide, with the financial management evaluation to follow in autumn.
I do not recognise the picture that emerges from the research.
Ik herken het beeld dat uit het onderzoek naar voren komt niet.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn inzake het probleem van pesten op school

An MP asked the education minister about a 16-month absence from school of a pupil bullied in Eindhoven, the reported 850 truant pupils, the extent of school bullying, and whether anti-bullying duties are in inspection frameworks and teacher training. The minister answered that the Eindhoven case is resolved, that bullying is one of several causes of truancy with no separate count, that the social safety monitor and inspection frameworks cover bullying, and that existing teacher competence rules already cover it.
I therefore have no figures on the number of pupils staying at home because they are victims of bullying.
Ik heb dan ook geen cijfers over het aantal leerlingen dat thuiszit omdat ze slachtoffer zijn van pesterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over de brief van Own Your Own Home Foundation te Saba

An MP asked the minister about a letter from Own Your Own Home Foundation on Saba, which says it lacks funds for housing maintenance and asks for rent subsidies or compensation. The minister answered that the foundation is not a regulated housing association so there is no financial oversight, rent subsidies will not be introduced because they do not fit the Caribbean tax system, and the funding gap was addressed through the spring budget.
I have no insight into the financial situation of OYOHF because OYOHF is not a recognised institution to which the Social Rental Sector Management Decree applies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de financiële situatie van OYOHF daar de OYOHF geen toegelaten instelling waarop het Besluit beheer sociale huursector (Bbsh) van toepassing is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why the rekenkaart (calculation aid) is banned in exams for pupils with dyscalculia, whether a one-year postponement was possible, why the ERWD protocol arrives late, and whether schools must be exempted under equal-treatment law. The minister refused postponement, said pupils had ample notice via the College voor Examens, noted the protocol supports schools, and argued that allowing the aid would lower exam requirements.
Postponing the tightening of the exam requirements is not an option.
Uitstel van de aanscherping van de exameneisen is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de aanhoudende problemen met de postvoorziening op de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Hachchi asked about persistent postal failures on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including residents receiving reminders and fines for bills they never received, and whether postcodes, UPU country codes and enforcement would fix the problems. The state secretary admitted the service still falls short of concession terms, said enforcement via an instruction or fine is being considered, and noted liability for losses is a matter for the courts while a review of alternatives to the concessionaire is underway.
I have now commissioned an external agency to explore whether, and under what conditions, parties are willing to take on (parts of) the postal service for the Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik heb inmiddels een extern bureau opdracht gegeven om een verkenning uit te voeren of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden partijen bereid zijn om (delen van) de postvoorziening ten behoeve van Caribisch Nederland op zich te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why a student with dyscalculia may not use a formula card in the final exams, despite a Commissie Gelijke Behandeling ruling against the school, and whether exam rules should be changed. The minister declined to follow the ruling, citing exam requirements known in advance, risk of inequality and timing, while promising a possibly adapted formula card and further guidance and research.
I have decided not to give the school room to deviate from the applicable rules for the central exam.
Ik heb besloten de school geen ruimte te geven om van de geldende regels voor het centraal examen af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over de aanstaande Tweede Kamerverkiezingen op de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the readiness of the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for the upcoming Tweede Kamer elections, including training, voter information, responsibility, and funding. The minister replied that the islands are capable of organising the elections, announced a voter information campaign, and said funding and election costs are borne by the public bodies while a separate evaluation will follow.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn over "de efficiëntie van de Nederlandse schuldhulpverlening”.

An MP asked the state secretary about the effectiveness and efficiency of Dutch debt relief, citing low success rates and unclear public spending. The government answered that success rates rose to 38 percent, explained rejections by gemeenten, said it does not track total municipal debt-relief spending, and pointed to the new Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening as the remedy.
The cabinet does not keep data on municipal spending on debt relief.
Het kabinet houdt geen gegevens bij over gemeentelijke uitgaven aan schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Van der Staaij inzake de grote verschillen in leges die gemeenten berekenen voor grafrechten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about large differences between municipalities in cemetery grave fees and whether a cost model has produced transparent cost structures. The Minister acknowledges the differences, says the VNG cost model supports transparency, that fees are set by municipal councils within cost-recovery limits, and that individuals can appeal to the courts.
Applying the cost-justification model leads to a clear justification of the costs the municipality recovers.
Het hanteren van het model van kostenonderbouwing leidt tot een duidelijke onderbouwing van de kosten die de gemeente verhaalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over het bericht dat de vrije uitkering voor de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked the minister whether the free allowance to the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is structurally too low, the size of any shortfall, and whether the government will commit to correcting it per the reference-framework study. The minister replied that the cabinet will set out its position in the spring after consultation with the public bodies, and that the questions will be taken into account then.
I consider it desirable to first reach a cabinet position within the Cabinet and to send it to your House in the spring, after also discussing it with the public bodies.
Ik acht het wenselijk om nu eerst binnen het Kabinet te komen tot een kabinetsstandpunt en dat in het voorjaar – na ook bespreking met de openbare lichamen – aan uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn "over de gevolgen van de wijziging van de ingangsdatum van het AOW-ouderdomspensioen naar de dag van de verjaardag"

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the income gap created when the AOW pension start date moved to the birthday, affecting early-retirement schemes that were not adjusted. The minister said there is no overview of adjusted schemes, that early-retirement schemes are a matter for social partners, and that pension funds had enough preparation time since talks began in early 2011.
An overview of which early-retirement schemes have been adjusted and which have not is not available.
Een overzicht van welke vroegpensioenregelingen aangepast zijn en welke niet is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over gedetineerden uit Saba en St. Eustatius in Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked the Dutch government about prisoners from Saba and St. Eustatius being held and tried on Bonaire, covering defence-lawyer access, video-link problems, prison conditions, juvenile offenders, reintegration, family visits and the facility location. Minister Opstelten largely rejected the critiques, said conditions are equal to other prisons and improving, and promised a new prison on St. Eustatius by 2014 and an examination of weekly video contact for families.

Since 10 October 2010 a slightly different situation has arisen, namely that suspects detained longer than 18 days are now transferred to Bonaire instead of St. Maarten, but the suspect's detention rights have remained unchanged.

Sinds 10 oktober 2010 is weliswaar een iets andere situatie ontstaan dan daarvoor, namelijk dat verdachten die langer dan 18 dagen gedetineerd zijn nu naar Bonaire worden overgebracht in plaats van naar St. Maarten, maar de rechten van de verdachte in het kader van detentie zijn onveranderd gebleven.
Vragen van het de leden Slob en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de betoging in Dordrecht (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about arrests at a Sinterklaas parade in Dordrecht, including the balance between free expression and demonstration rights and whether showing text on a T-shirt breaches a demonstration ban. The Minister answered that the case is still under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, so no further information can be given.
At the request of the Public Prosecution Service, this case is still under investigation. For that reason, no further information can be provided at this time.
In opdracht van het Openbaar Ministerie is deze zaak nog in onderzoek. Om die reden kunnen op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie van kinderen op Bonaire (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister about the situation of children on Bonaire, including poverty, neglect, abuse, drugs, crime and teen pregnancy, and about responsibilities and action plans. The state secretary acknowledged serious problems, described improved youth facilities, a 2012-2014 plan and a joint action plan with the island government, and said follow-up with the public body would follow in early 2012.
Early 2012, VWS will discuss the follow-up of this plan with the Public Body.
Begin 2012 zal VWS met het Openbaar Lichaam over de follow-up van dit plan spreken.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het instellen van een keurmerk voor de glazenwassersbranche (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

The MP asks whether the government shares concerns about intimidation and extortion by rogue operators in the window-cleaning sector, how widespread this is, and whether a quality mark should be introduced. The minister agrees the practices are worrying, says no exact figures exist, refers to existing enforcement routes (police, Openbaar Ministerie, FIOD, NMa), and sees no need for further government measures beyond encouraging sector-led initiatives.
I do not have exact figures on how often these occur because they are not always reported to the designated authorities.
Ik beschik niet over exacte cijfers over de mate waarin deze voorkomen omdat hiervan niet altijd melding wordt gemaakt bij de daarvoor aangewezen instanties.

Vragen namens de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de geruchtenstroom van een mogelijke terbeschikkingstelling van faciliteiten op Bonaire ten behoeve va

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Voordewind asked whether there are plans to make facilities on Bonaire available for the US FOL (Forward Operating Locations) agreement, and whether the government will state clearly that no such plans exist. Minister Rosenthal answered that the government has no such plans, that no facilities on Bonaire will be made available for US aerial reconnaissance under the FOL agreement, and that the Bonaire authorities have been informed.
No facilities for American aerial reconnaissance activities on Bonaire will be made available for the FOL agreement.
Er worden geen faciliteiten voor Amerikaanse luchtverkenningsactiviteiten op Bonaire ten behoeve van het FOL-verdrag ter beschikking gesteld.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Schouten (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de positie van de woningcorporatie op Bonaire (

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the turnover tax (ABB) and the introduction of the US dollar on Bonaire make social rents unaffordable for tenants of the local housing corporation, and whether the state will investigate or grant an exemption. The state secretary answered that the ABB is in principle more favourable than the former turnover tax, that no exemption is legally possible, that no separate study will be launched beyond an existing interdepartmental economic study, and that cost control is the corporation's responsibility.
I will not start a specific investigation into the impact of the ABB as such on the cost price of new-build homes.
Ik zal geen specifiek onderzoek starten naar de invloed van de ABB als zodanig op de kostprijs van nieuwbouwwoningen.

Vragen namens de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-Van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorgverzekering op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 28 september 2011

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the health minister about the health insurance system on the BES islands, including whether private insurers were ordered to cancel policies, whether insured people were informed, whether the new scheme is less favourable and cannot be supplemented, and whether the ID card is recognised abroad for medical care. The minister replied that insurers were not ordered to cancel, that transitional rules let broader private coverage continue and allow supplementary insurance, and that access to specialist care abroad is arranged through contracts and agreements with neighbouring facilities.
The reasonableness and fairness of such a cancellation is a matter for the judge to assess.
De redelijkheid en billijkheid van een dergelijke opzegging staat ter beoordeling aan de rechter.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de voordracht van een kandidaat voor de functie van waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger voor de openbare l

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the Sint Eustatius executive board was consulted before proposing an acting Governor-General's representative, and whether that proposal conflicts with the law on impartiality given the candidate's active party membership. The minister answered that the executive boards of Bonaire and Saba had no objections, that the Sint Eustatius board was sounded through its governor, and that the candidate is expected to rise above party interests.
Is it correct that for this nomination the executive board of Sint Eustatius was not consulted as required by Article 188(3) WolBES?
Vraag 2 Klopt het dat bij deze voordracht het bestuurscollege van Sint Eustatius niet is geconsulteerd zoals conform artikel 188, lid 3 WolBES 2 vereist is?

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toename van de wachtlijsten voor de schuldhulpverlening (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising waiting lists for municipal debt assistance, whether maximum waiting times would be met under the proposed Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening, and whether predatory private debt intermediaries would be controlled. The state secretary said he could not forecast waiting times, would rely on the statutory maximum waiting times and municipal councils to hold municipalities accountable, and would report on supervision and enforcement against malafide intermediaries before year-end.
If a municipality unexpectedly does not comply with this statutory obligation, it is up to the municipal council to hold the college of mayor and aldermen to account.
Indien een gemeente zich onverhoopt niet houdt aan deze wettelijke verplichting, is het aan de gemeenteraad om het college van B en W daarop aan te spreken.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de begeleiding aan BES-bursalen (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asked the education and interior ministers about the guidance of BES-island students in the Netherlands after the Curacao foundation withdrew, the new requirements, budget responsibility, and dropout rates. The minister said S4 would take over Bonaire guidance, the new requirements were still being drafted, the education ministry holds the budget, and dropout rates for BES-origin students are higher than average.
At this moment I therefore cannot specify to what extent this deviates from the requirements previously set for SSC and S4.
Op dit moment kan ik dus niet specificeren in hoeverre dit afwijkt van de eisen die voorheen aan SSC en S4 werden gesteld.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de begeleiding van BES-bursalen (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

An MP asked the education minister why BES student-support services were moved from SSC to St. Maarten Student Services (S4) without consulting island organisations, and whether staffing and local ties were adequate. The minister answered that the switch was made for continuity and experience, that no survey of other island bodies was done, and that S4 has committed to adequate staffing for the 2011-2012 year, with a new tender planned for later years.
No investigation was carried out into the willingness of other parties located in the BES islands to take on the care of the students.
Er is geen onderzoek geweest naar de bereidheid van andere partijen, gelegen in de BES-eilanden, om de zorg voor de studenten op zich te nemen.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat gezakte leerlingen de dupe zijn van de nieuwe exameneisen (ingezonden 26 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Education Minister whether pupils who failed their exams and move to adult secondary education (vavo) are unfairly hit by new exam requirements, and whether an transitional arrangement is possible. The minister rejected changing the rules for these pupils, calling the change a correction of a flaw and offering only a limited hardship clause via the state examination committee.
No, it concerns a correction of a flaw in the final examination decree, and the tightened rule applies to all pupils who sit exams after 1 August 2011.
Neen, het betreft een correctie op een weeffout in het eindexamenbesluit en de nieuwe aanscherping geldt voor alle leerlingen die na 1 augustus 2011 examen doen.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister vanSociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetalingsdatum van arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkeringen door het UWV (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about complaints and hardship caused by UWV shifting the payment date of disability benefits, the handling of advance-payment requests, the clarity of information given to clients, and cost savings. The minister reported about 207 complaints all handled within three weeks, roughly 7% of shifted payments received advances with some refused as late, that individual solutions were offered in hardship cases, and that the shift saves about 19.5 million euro per year by retiring an old system.
UWV has indicated that in future cases it will go into more detail on the reasons for the shift.
UWV heeft aangegeven dat het in de toekomst in voorkomende gevallen uitgebreider zal ingaan op de redenen van de verschuiving.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechten

MPs Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn and Braakhuis asked the state secretaries about labour and environmental abuses in electronics supply chains (Foxconn/Apple), transparency laws, and government procurement safeguards. The government condemned the abuses, pointed to OECD guidelines, industry initiatives and procurement criteria, but declined a Dutch supply chain transparency law as disproportionate and costly.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het beperken van de mogelijkheden voor begeleiding van Wajongers op de werkvloer (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MP Ortega-Martijn asks the minister whether limiting job coach support for Wajong beneficiaries to three years and reducing the support rate to 10% will cause employers to end contracts, and how UWV's implementation and exception procedure will be improved. The state secretary replies that the protocol aligns with the goal of independent employment, exceptions allow a 15% rate with justification, UWV's concerns are addressed by a 2.5-year notification, and the revised protocol will not be sent to parliament in advance as UWV is an independent body.
I have asked UWV to examine how the Personal Support facility can be deployed more selectively and effectively
Ik heb aan het UWV gevraagd te bezien hoe de voorziening Persoonlijke Ondersteuning selectiever en effectiever kan worden ingezet

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over mogelijk misbruik van ontheffing ingezetenschap door wethouders (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether a Langedijk alderman's exemption from the residence requirement, which was not complied with, reflects misuse and whether the exemption should be contested by the Crown, and how often exemptions are granted. The minister says he reaffirms the residence requirement as the rule, declines to assess the specific case or to forward a nullification request, and agrees to investigate the frequency and reasons for extensions of exemptions by autumn.
I am willing to examine further how often extensions of exemption were granted in the first half of 2011 and what the experience of the councils involved is with the decision-making on this.
Ik ben bereid nader te onderzoeken hoe vaak in de eerste helft van 2011 verlenging van ontheffing is verleend en wat de ervaring is van betrokken raden bij de besluitvorming hieromtrent.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de opslag van biometrische gegevens (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether central storage of biometric passport data conflicts with privacy and the right against self-incrimination, whether the data is vulnerable to hackers, and whether the plan will be dropped despite municipal motions against it. The Minister answered by referring to the explanatory memorandum, a district court ruling, and a letter of 26 April 2011, without substantive answers on the privacy or hacking points.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter of 26 April 2011 and to what was discussed in the General Consultation
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 26 april 2011 en naar hetgeen is besproken in het Algemene Overleg

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van scheiding van kerk en staat op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Interior Minister whether the separation of church and state on the BES islands left Protestant congregations, especially on Bonaire, without a transitional arrangement comparable to the one for Catholic priests, and whether this amounted to unequal treatment. The minister replied that all clergy employed by the former Netherlands Antilles are treated the same, that existing legal positions are respected, that no separate arrangement exists, and that the liquidation commission will examine unmet pre-October 2010 obligations.
I have received no information from the former Netherlands Antilles about an impending appointment, or a commitment to one, of a new Protestant minister on Bonaire
Ik heb van het land Nederlandse Antillen geen informatie ontvangen over een op handen zijnde aanstelling, dan wel een toezegging daartoe, van een nieuwe predikant van de Protestantse kerk op Bonaire
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetalingsdatum van uitkeringen door het UWV (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister why UWV is moving benefit payments for WAO, WIA and WAJONG recipients from around the 15th to the 23rd of the month, why recipients were not told the reasons, and whether a longer transition or bridging advance is possible. The minister explained the move consolidates payment systems and aligns with salary timing, that UWV gave only brief notice without reasons, and that an advance of up to the monthly net benefit is available, so no further measures are planned.
UWV informed those involved briefly about the shift in payment date. It did not go into the reason for the shift.
UWV heeft betrokkenen beknopt over de verschuiving van het betaalmoment geïnformeerd. Daarbij is niet ingegaan op de reden van de verschuiving.

Vragen van de leden Ulenbelt (SP), Ortega Martijn (ChristenUnie), Klaver (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over machtsmisbruik, intimidatie en falende leiding bij d

Four MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuse of power, intimidation and failed leadership at the sheltered workplace Pauw Bedrijven, including what workers can do and what measures will prevent such abuses. The state secretary answered that this is a matter for the employer, works council, union and local authorities, that an independent investigation has been commissioned, and that no further measures or known signals elsewhere exist.
This concerns a matter for the implementing organisation and the administrators involved.
Dit betreft een kwestie van de uitvoeringsorganisatie en de betrokken bestuurders.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van d

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob ask whether newspaper publishers, who face little competition in national distribution and cannot easily switch contractors, can fairly be fully fined under the Dutch Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) chain liability. The ministers answer that competition is irrelevant to compliance, publishers must ensure lawful outsourcing, and fines are moderated only where the client bears reduced culpability, with pending court cases to clarify this.
A client is in principle held to account and fined for violations by subcontractors or service providers.
Een opdrachtgever wordt in beginsel aangesproken en beboet voor overtredingen van onderaannemers of dienstverleners.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksaangelegenheden over de rechtmatigheid van de Kamerverkiezingen voor wat betreft de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 9 maart 2

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Dutch Caribbean islands (BES) can make their voice heard in the national system of proportional representation, given that together they do not reach the electoral quota, and whether the government will examine ways to secure representation for peripheral areas. The minister confirmed the quota point, said there is no room in proportional representation to reserve seats for regions, and pointed to consultation mechanisms in the WolBES law and a 2010 letter on involving Bonaire in relevant rules.
within the Dutch system of proportional representation there is no room to reserve a seat in parliament for certain parts of the country
binnen het Nederlandse bestel van evenredige vertegenwoordiging geen ruimte is om voor bepaalde delen van het land een zetel in het parlement te reserveren

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minster van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van de scheiding van kerk en staat op de BES-eilanden sinds 10 oktober 2010 (ingezonden 10 fe

An MP asks the minister whether the abrupt end of state financial contributions to churches on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba after the 2010 transition threatens church closures, whether congregations were informed, and whether a transitional scheme like the Dutch 1983 church-state settlement will be provided. The minister replies that the state never had regular church contributions in the Netherlands, that the government does not promote Actie Kerkbalans, that the islands were broadly informed, and that a one-to-one transitional scheme is not comparable, though hardship cases may be addressed in the ongoing asset division.
In the ongoing asset division process I will pay attention to cases where the transition of the islands turns out to have sudden negative effects on parts of society.

In het voortdurende traject van de boedelscheiding zal ik wel aandacht hebben voor gevallen waarbij de transitie van de eilanden plotseling negatieve effecten op onderdelen van de samenleving blijkt te hebben.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichten dat een Nederlands bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) asked whether a Dutch company, supported by a loan from FMO, was involved in alleged slavery-like labour in Argentina, and what sanctions and CSR enforcement would follow. The state secretary answered that the allegations are unsubstantiated, FMO is reviewing the case with an independent consultant, withdrawal of investment is possible only for gross contract breach, and he sees no reason to change enforcement of CSR declarations.
I see no direct reason to change my policy on this point.
Ik zie geen directe aanleiding om mijn beleid op dit punt te veranderen.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de wijziging van de datum waarop de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen gehouden zullen worden in 2014 (ingezonden

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 2014 municipal elections, moved because of carnival, should avoid Biddag voor gewas en arbeid, since many Protestants attend church that day, and whether the electoral law change would take this into account as in 2006. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, agreed the date falls on that day, and said yes to taking it into account in the amendment.
Are you prepared to take this into account when amending the electoral law so that the elections are not held on the Biddag voor gewas en arbeid?
Bent u bereid om bij de wijziging van de kieswet hier rekening mee te houden zodat de verkiezingen niet op de biddag voor gewas en arbeid gehouden zullen worden

Vragen van de leden Slob en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van tenders (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MPs Slob and Ortega-Martijn asked whether the government had halted new Rijksgebouwendienst investment projects, what compensation and costs market parties face, whether the investment team capacity and PPP market are harmed, and how this fits the Hoge Raad PPP tender. The minister confirmed a temporary investment stop on new housing and ICT projects, said no compensation is in principle due, and expected no lasting harm to the PPP market.
No, the government has no insight into the costs that private parties incur to make offers.
Nee, de overheid heeft geen inzicht in de kosten die private partijen maken voor het doen van aanbiedingen.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onrechtmatigheid van de statenverkiezingen van 2 maart 2011 (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 2011 provincial elections are unlawful because the Caribbean Netherlands islands have no voice in Eerste Kamer elections, and whether Dutch equality law requires voting rights there. The minister rejected the view that the elections are unlawful, citing constitutional and treaty grounds, and said a constitutional amendment giving island councils a vote in Eerste Kamer elections is in preparation and will soon go to the Raad van State.
Nevertheless, I consider it desirable to also involve the island councils in the electorate of the Eerste Kamer.
Wel acht ik het wenselijk om de eilandsraden ook in het electoraat van de Eerste Kamer te betrekken.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA), Van Bochove (CDA) en Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Steenrijk e

MPs asked the minister for Interior Affairs to respond to criticism in the Steenrijk en Straatarm report of Maastricht housing corporation Servatius's sales plan, and to explain when the central housing fund and ministry were informed of Servatius's financial problems and why a formal instruction took six months. The minister rejected the report's criticism as one-sided, said the fund raised concerns once in 2009, and explained the 2008 delay by noting the ministry was not formally notified and checked legal robustness before issuing a pre-announced instruction.
The former ministry of VROM received no signals in June 2008 about the financial problems surrounding Servatius's campus project.
Het toenmalige ministerie van VROM heeft in juni 2008 geen signalen ontvangen over de financiële problematiek rond het campusproject van woningcorporatie Servatius.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Financiën over de tijdelijke voorziening van de omwisseling van de Antilliaanse gulden in Nederland via GWK-kantoren in de periode van 18 januari 2011

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the temporary exchange facility for Netherlands Antillean guilders in the Netherlands was limited to mid-2011, why the public was informed and why exchange was not offered at more ABN Amro branches, and when a Caribbean Netherlands exchange scheme would be in place. The minister answered that the facility was a response to a parliamentary motion, that DNB and the media publicised it, that exchange is a commercial matter for ABN Amro, and that the island exchange offices were designated by DNB on 18 January 2011.

The period until 30 June 2011 is long enough to give travellers who were surprised last year by GWK/Travelex's decision to stop buying Antillean guilders ample opportunity to sell their remaining guilders.

De geboden termijn tot en met 30 juni 2011 is lang genoeg om reizigers die vorig jaar verrast werden door het besluit van GWK/Travelex om geen Antilliaanse guldens meer aan te kopen, ruimschoots in de gelegenheid te stellen hun overgebleven Antilliaanse guldens alsnog te verkopen.

Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP), Van Bochove (CDA), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Voortman (GroenLinks), Monasch (PvdA) en De Boer (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de verliezen va

MPs asked the minister how negative results on subsidiaries (deelnemingen) of housing associations were reflected in the 2010 assessment letters, and how those results break down across core, social and commercial property activities. The minister answered that subsidiary results were not explicitly addressed in the letters, that the CFV will examine more associations in 2011, and that the data do not allow the requested breakdown, while noting that most subsidiary losses likely relate to commercial activities.
The CFV will in 2011 examine more associations where there is an increased risk of unnecessary erosion of the socially bound assets.
Het CFV zal in 2011 meer corporaties onderzoeken waar een verhoogd risico is op onnodige aantasting van het maatschappelijk gebonden vermogen.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gevolgen van ketenaansprakelijkheid op grond

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked about court rulings holding PCM Distributiebedrijf and newspaper publishers liable for illegal deliverers under the Dutch Foreign Workers Act, whether fine-setting should reflect culpability, communication with industry, evaluation of the broad employer concept, and bankruptcies from fines. The minister answered that the Council of State found publishers fully culpable, that fine guidelines already reflect culpability, that communication and consultation with the press sector occur, that the broad employer concept will be kept, and that payment arrangements are available though bankruptcy data are not kept.
It is not known whether, and if so how many, companies have gone bankrupt as a result of administrative fines.
Het is niet bekend of en zo ja, hoeveel bedrijven er naar aanleiding van bestuurlijke boetes failliet zijn gegaan.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gevolgen van de in te stellen inkomensgrens voor toewijzing van sociale huurwoningen (ingezonden 10 dece

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about the effects of the new income ceiling for allocating social rental housing, including people staying below the threshold, long waiting lists, and sufficient affordable supply in Purmerend. The Minister denies signals of widespread income reduction, argues corporations have a 10% allocation margin above the ceiling, and says Purmerend's supply is insufficient for all income groups while acknowledging pressure on those below the threshold.
I will also make additional questions (and answers) that have emerged in recent weeks, and that will emerge in the coming period, available on the Ministry's website.

Ik zal daarnaast aanvullende vragen (en antwoorden) die in de afgelopen weken naar voren zijn gekomen en die in de komende periode naar voren zullen komen eveneens beschikbaar stellen op de website van het Ministerie.
