Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toename van het aantal mensen dat in Nederland in armoede leeft (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about rising poverty in the Netherlands, whether targets to halve child social exclusion still stand, whether welfare benefit levels suffice for basic needs, and about volunteer support after 2012. The state secretary said the child low-income rise reflects the 2009 crisis, that benefits are tied to the minimum wage, that no adequacy study will be done, and that municipalities are responsible, with the volunteer projects to be evaluated in 2011.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over positie van starters op de woningmarkt (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the falling borrowing capacity of first-time buyers, the compatibility with affordability goals, the timing of a housing vision, the EU state-aid rules limiting social rental access, abolishing transfer tax for starters, and bank mortgage rates. The minister attributed the capacity drop to tax and premium changes, defended the NHG cost limit, promised an integral housing vision by summer 2011, rejected the state-aid concern, rejected abolishing transfer tax on cost and enforcement grounds, and referred the bank rate question to the Finance Minister.

The cabinet will, partly in response to the motion by Senator R. de Boer (CU) adopted in the Senate on 16 November 2010 and to the debate in the House during the Interior Ministry budget, present an integral vision on the housing market before summer 2011.

Het kabinet zal, mede naar aanleiding van de motie van senator R. de Boer (CU) die in de Eerste Kamer op 16 november 2010 is aangenomen en naar aanleiding van het overleg in de Tweede Kamer bij de behandeling van de begroting van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, voor de zomer van 2011 komen met een integrale visie op de woningmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het betalingsgedrag van de overheid (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

An MP asked ministers about EU plans to charge 8% extra interest on late payments by public bodies, the current payment performance of central and local government, what the government will do to speed up payments, and whether a faster Dutch timetable is possible. The minister supported the EU directive (30-day terms, ECB rate plus 8%, EUR 40 recovery fee), reported that 81.4% of central government invoices were paid on time, said local payment is a matter of municipal autonomy with VNG being urged to act, and said implementation would proceed promptly.
Especially for smaller claims, a stimulating effect can be expected, both on the debtor to pay and on the creditor not to passively wait after the payment term has expired.

Vooral bij kleinere vorderingen kan daarvan een stimulerend effect worden verwacht, zowel op de debiteur om te betalen als op de crediteur om niet lijdzaam af te wachten na het verstrijken van de betaaltermijn.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over bouwregelgeving brandveiligheid voor parkeergarages en andere grote bouww

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Interior and of Justice and Security about the absence of mandatory sprinklers in parking garages and large buildings, the fire compartment rules, the 30- versus 60-minute search time, and planned risk-based regulation. The minister replied that Dutch building rules are performance-based with no sprinkler mandate, that sprinklers are one accepted equivalent solution, and that risk-based regulation with standardisation will follow in five to eight years, while rejecting mandatory sprinklers.
Mandatory prescription of (expensive) sprinkler installations is not necessary for this purpose.
Het wettelijk voorschrijven van (dure) sprinklerinstallaties is hierbij niet nodig.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het plaatsen van containercellen op Bonaire (ingezonde

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Interior about planned container cells on Bonaire, including their location, ventilation, insects, and humane detention standards. The government answered that the temporary facility meets international rules, is run by DJI, and that it will itself look into the situation soon.
I will however inform myself about the situation within a reasonable time.
Ik ga me wel zelf op de hoogte stellen binnen afzienbare tijd.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het omwisselen van de Naf (Antilliaanse gulden) (ingezonden

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked why Antillean guilders can no longer be exchanged in the Netherlands, why the fixed-rate exchange into US dollars is limited to Caribbean Netherlands residents, how citizens were informed, and what remedy exists for travellers holding guilders. The minister explains that GWK/Travelex stopped buying guilders, that the restriction aims to prevent license fee avoidance, that an information campaign was run, and that DNB may be asked to consider a temporary exchange facility in the Netherlands.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Economic Affairs minister about labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including KPR Mills, its SA8000 certification, and government risk lists. The government answered that the companies have tried to influence the supplier, that it does not subsidise or supervise them, and that it will continue dialogue with the sector and the Indian government without committing to new binding measures.
We see no role for the government in this.
Wij zien hierbij geen rol voor de overheid.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het niet naleven van de vrijstelling van de sollicitatieplicht voor alleenstaande ouders met kinderen tot

An MP asked the state secretary why municipalities reject exemptions from the job-seeking obligation for single parents with children under five, despite the statutory right created in 2009, and whether the government will sanction them or ensure information and evaluation. The state secretary replied that municipalities have discretion in implementing the exemption and reintegration, that individual exemptions are granted on general grounds, that the government intends to abolish the specific exemption, and that no measures against municipalities or evaluation are planned.
Municipalities state as their reason that granting exemptions on this ground also suffices for single parents with children under five.
Gemeenten geven hierbij als reden aan dat ontheffen op deze grond ook voor alleenstaande ouders met kinderen jonger dan vijf jaar volstaat.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het door werkgevers onterecht gedeeltelijk ziekmelden van werknemers die terugkeren van ziekteverzuim (ingezonden

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers partially sick-reporting returning employees is undesirable, whether sanctions or labour inspection apply, whether further research and stricter Poortwachter rules are warranted, and whether employees fear job loss when requesting a UWV expert opinion. The minister replied that no duty exists to report recovery, so no sanction or inspection role arises, that existing rules and the courts adequately protect employees, and that no new measures or research are planned.
I therefore do not intend to take legislative or other measures in this matter, nor to conduct research into the scale of the problem.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om wettelijke of andere maatregelen te treffen ter zake dan wel onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van de problematiek.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over ex-landsambtenaren BES (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba) die een deel van hun salaris later krijgen (ing

An MP asked the Interior Minister about roughly 300 former Antillean civil servants on Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius who received only two-thirds of their October salary, and whether the new Caribbean Netherlands service (RCN) acted badly as employer. The minister explained the payment responsibilities were split with the former Netherlands Antilles, that the RCN advanced 40% of the net salary, and that a liquidation commission will settle the remaining claims.
The RCN will consult with the liquidation commission on the manner and timing of the payment.
De RCN zal in overleg treden met de vereffeningscommissie over de wijze en het moment van de uitbetaling.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister van Justitie over het plaatsen van containercellen op Bonaire (ingezonden 24 september

An MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about the placement of container cells for detainees on Bonaire, including the tropical climate, cooling, compliance with detention norms, permit requirements, humane detention, and whether the government would halt the practice. The government answered that the open-sided cells use wind for cooling, meet international detention standards, were permitted by local authorities, and that it declined to stop the practice, while the DJI will continue improving conditions.
No. This method of detention was deliberately chosen.
Neen. Er is bewust gekozen voor deze wijze van detineren.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het aanbieden van beleggingsrekeningen als spaarrekeningen door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en Re-integratie (PWR

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about losses on the PWRI pension fund's investment-based AOV scheme, which was presented as savings, and whether the AFM could act. The minister replied that the scheme is a legacy savings fund supervised by DNB rather than the AFM, that no benefits were cut, that members were informed, and that three complaints are under supervision.
I cannot say anything about possible enforcement measures, because this information is confidential.
Over eventuele handhavende maatregelen kan ik geen mededeling doen, omdat deze informatie vertrouwelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) en Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over kinderbijslag ten behoeve van ontwikkelings

Three MPs asked why Dutch development workers abroad lose child benefit despite a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and why the export rules name development workers, and asked about the lengthy SVB reclaim procedure on return. The minister replied that these workers are not insured so the rules do not apply to them, that the procedure follows standard timelines with retroactive payment, and that no change is planned.
These persons are after all not insured. These persons therefore cannot invoke article 7b or the Decree either.
Deze personen zijn immers niet verzekerd. Deze personen kunnen zich dus ook niet beroepen op artikel 7b of het Besluit.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de gebrekkige werking van de toerismebepaling in de Winkeltijdenwet (ingezonden 10 augustus 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Economic Affairs minister how to address the court ruling that let a shop open on Sundays under the tourism clause of the Winkeltijdenwet, whether the amendment is adequate, and what the effects on competition and freedom of contract are. The minister answers that the amendment adds a 'substantial scale' requirement, that the ruling does not create a snowball effect, that no broader change to the law has parliamentary support, and that shop opening remains the retailer's own choice.
Under the bill, there must be autonomous tourism of substantial scale in the municipality.
Op grond van het wetsvoorstel moet er sprake zijn van autonoom toerisme van substantiële omvang in de gemeente.

Vragen van het de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over MVO-criteria voor banken (i

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government will require a transparent CSR policy and a minimum CSR level in all tenders for financial services, and whether it will exclude banks linked to cluster munitions or harmful firms. The minister replied that CSR criteria will be considered case by case under proportionality rules, that a minimum CSR level is not suitable, and that financial services already fall under Duurzaam Inkopen and generic social criteria.
In future tenders for financial services, the central government will consider which criteria focusing on the socially responsible conduct of the contractor can be included.
Het Rijk zal bij toekomstige aanbestedingen van financiële diensten bezien welke criteria kunnen worden meegenomen die zich richten op het maatschappelijk verantwoord handelen van de opdrachtnemer.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de registratie van de afkomst van werkloze jongeren (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked ministers whether the UWV's linking of population register data to register the origin of unemployed youth would help them find jobs, and why the government does not focus on strengthening young people's social position. The minister defended the GBA-SONAR linkage as a means to better insight into jobseekers for regional service delivery, acknowledged that social disadvantage matters more, and promised to examine the tool's usefulness.
I consider this an undesirable situation that calls for better insight into the jobseeker files.
Ik vind dit een ongewenste situatie die vraagt om een beter inzicht in de bestanden met werkzoekenden.

Vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Economische Zaken over het bericht dat Nederla

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about the European Commission's move to take the Netherlands to the European Court over Noord-Holland's requirement of organic or fairtrade coffee in a coffee-machine tender, and whether governments have enough clarity on sustainability criteria. The minister answered that the rules allow sustainability criteria meeting transparency, non-discrimination and proportionality principles, that the Commission's case is a question for the European Court, and that a factsheet and guidance on social criteria are being prepared.
It is desirable that this question be answered by the European Court of Justice.
Het is wenselijk dat deze vraag door het Europese Hof van Justitie wordt beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over koopsubsidie (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

An MP asks the housing minister why the homebuyer subsidy (koopsubsidie) was closed on 13 April although its budget was reportedly exhausted by 29 March, how applications were still processed after that date, and how much money is needed to honour the 1353 applications received. The minister answers that applications are processed in order of receipt, the budget was only confirmed exhausted on 13 April, Agentschap NL published warnings from 19 March onward, and about 10 million euro would be needed for the 1353 applications.
Only on 13 April was it clear that the applications up to and including 29 March would exhaust the available budget.
Pas op 13 april was duidelijk dat met de aanvragen tot en met 29 maart het beschikbare budget zou zijn uitgeput.
qn: Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de positie van allochtonen op de arbeidsmarkt. (Ingezonden 15 februari 2010)

Ortega-Martijn asked ministers whether rising discrimination against non-Western migrants in the labour market, including within government, undermines participation goals, and what the government will do about it. The ministers acknowledged discrimination as a problem, pointed to a forthcoming 2009 discrimination monitor, cited existing diversity targets, public-sector measures, and a 2008 action plan, without committing to new inquiries beyond ongoing studies.
In addition, a letter was sent to the House of Representatives in June 2009 announcing additional measures.
Daarnaast is in juni 2009 een brief aan de Tweede Kamer verzonden waarin aanvullende maatregelen worden aangekondigd.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Lucassen ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het niet tot stand komen van een huurverhoging indien het huishoudinkomen in t-1 lager is dan 43.000 euro
Adds a rule that a landlord cannot raise rent if the tenant shows that household income in the year after the reference year is at or below 43,000 euros.
the rent cannot be raised by a landlord if the tenant can show that household income in the year following the reference year is equal to or lower than 43,000 euros
de huurprijs niet kan worden verhoogd door een verhuurder indien de huurder kan aantonen dat het huishoudinkomen in het jaar volgend op het peiljaar gelijk aan of lager is dan € 43 000
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het niet tot stand komen van een huurverhoging indien het huishoudinkomen in t-1 lager is dan € 43 000
Provides that a rent increase cannot take effect if the tenant can show household income in the year after the reference year is below 43,000 euro.
An agreement to change the rent does not come into being if the tenant can show that household income in the calendar year after the reference year is lower than
Een overeenkomst tot wijziging van de huurprijs komt niet tot stand indien de huurder kan aantonen dat het huishoudinkomen in het kalenderjaar na het peiljaar lager is dan
Motie Lucassen over een te hoge voorlopige toekenning van de huurtoeslag
Motion asking the government to redesign the housing allowance application procedure to limit too-high provisional awards.
requests the government to shape the housing allowance application procedure so that too-high awards and the need for high reclaims are limited
verzoekt de regering de aanvraagprocedure voor huurtoeslag zodanig vorm te geven dat te hoge toekenningen en daardoor de noodzaak tot hoge terugvorderingen worden beperkt
Motie Lucassen c.s. over het vergroten van kansen voor starters
Asks the government to evaluate existing support schemes for first-time home buyers and analyse obstacles they face, then propose measures.
Requests the government to evaluate existing support schemes for starters.
verzoekt de regering om een evaluatie van bestaande ondersteunende regelingen voor starters
Motie Lucassen over een verplichte keuring voor ventilatiesystemen
Asks the government to introduce a mandatory biennial inspection of mechanical ventilation systems in housing association dwellings.
requests the government to introduce a mandatory biennial inspection for mechanical ventilation systems in housing association dwellings
verzoekt de regering te komen tot een verplichte tweejaarlijkse keuring voor mechanische ventilatiesystemen in corporatiewoningen
Motion asks the government to give 65-plus seniors who leave a social rental home the same allocation priority as other vulnerable groups.
requests the government to promote that 65-plus people who leave a social rental home get the same priority in allocating exempt housing stock
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat bij de toewijzing van het vrijgestelde woningbestand aan 65-plussers die bij verhuizing een sociale huurwoning achterlaten, dezelfde prioriteit wordt gegeven
Asks the government to actively encourage temporary student housing rentals for the duration of study, so-called campus contracts, among housing associations and private landlords.
requests the government to actively encourage the temporary rental of student housing for the duration of study, the so-called campus contracts
verzoekt de regering de tijdelijke verhuur van studentenhuisvesting voor de duur van de studie, de zogenaamde «campuscontracten», actief te stimuleren
Motie-Lucassen over een nieuw actieplan studentenhuisvesting
Asks the government to draw up a renewed student housing action plan based on an accurate inventory of supply and demand, and to tackle restrictive legislation.
requests the government to draw up a renewed student housing action plan, based on an accurate inventory of supply and demand
verzoekt de regering een hernieuwd actieplan studentenhuisvesting op te stellen, gebaseerd op een nauwkeurige inventarisatie van vraag en aanbod
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het beperken van de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel tot eigenaars die een recreatiewoning bewonen
Limits the statutory entitlement to an environmental permit for permanent occupation of recreational homes to owners of such homes.
this amendment limits the statutory entitlement to an environmental permit enabling permanent occupation to owners of recreational homes
wordt met dit amendement de wettelijke aanspraak op een omgevingsvergunning die permanente bewoning mogelijk maakt, beperkt tot eigenaren van recreatiewoningen
Motie Lucassen over vrije vestiging van Nederlanders
Asks the government to guarantee Dutch citizens' right of free settlement on the BES islands and to periodically test local housing ordinances for legality.
to periodically test the adoption and enforcement of housing ordinances on the islands for legality
de vaststelling en handhaving van huisvestingsverordeningen op de eilanden periodiek te toetsen op rechtmatigheid
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het aanpassen van de tariefstructuur voor de inkomstenbelasting en loonbelasting aan die in Nederland
Replaces the income tax tariff table for the BES islands with a Dutch-style structure and raises the corporate-type rate, increasing tax revenue from the islands.
The aim of the proposed amendment is to arrive at a tariff structure that does justice to the new position of the BES islands
Het oogmerk van het voorgestelde amendement is om te komen tot een tariefstructuur die recht doet aan de nieuwe positie van de BES-eilanden
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het in lijn brengen van de tariefstructuur voor de algemene bestedingsbelasting met de in Nederland geldende tariefstructuur voor de BTW
Amends the general consumption tax (ABB) rate structure for the BES islands to match the Dutch VAT rates of 19% and 6%, and removes the temporary reduced rates for Sint Eustatius and Saba.
With this amendment, the proposed tax rate structure for the general consumption tax is brought in line with the tax rate structure for VAT in the Netherlands.
Bij dit amendement wordt de voorgestelde tariefstructuur voor de algemene bestedingsbelasting in lijn gebracht met de in Nederland geldende tariefstructuur voor de BTW.
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het gelijktrekken van het tarief voor de opbrengstbelasting met het in Nederland geldende tarief voor de dividendbelasting
Raises the profit-tax rate for the BES islands from 5% to 15% to match the Dutch dividend tax rate.
With this amendment the proposed profit tax rate (5%) is aligned with the Dutch dividend tax rate (15%).
Bij dit amendement wordt het voorgestelde tarief voor de opbrengstbelasting (5%) gelijk getrokken met het in Nederland geldende tarief voor de dividendbelasting (15%).
Amendement van het lid Lucassen over het gelijktrekken van het tarief voor de overdrachtsbelasting op de BES met dat in Nederland
Raises the transfer tax rate in the Caribbean Netherlands from 5 to 6 percent to match the rate in the Netherlands.
In article 7.12, '5 percent' is replaced by: 6 percent.
In artikel 7.12 wordt «5 percent» vervangen door: 6 percent.
Motie Lucassen over stopzetten van de schuldsanering en overige steunmaatregelen aan Curaçao
Asks the government to immediately stop debt relief and other support measures to Curaçao after the island decided to move toward independence.
to immediately stop the debt restructuring and other support measures to Curaçao
de schuldsanering en overige steunmaatregelen aan Curaçao met onmiddellijke ingang stop te zetten
Motie Lucassen over niet uitvoeren van het koninklijk besluit
Asks the government not to implement the royal decree bringing into force the Statute amendment dissolving the Netherlands Antilles.
requests the government not to implement the royal decree bringing into force the Kingdom Act amending the Statute in connection with the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles
verzoekt de regering het koninklijk besluit tot inwerkingtreding van de Rijkswet wijziging Statuut in verband met de opheffing van de Nederlandse Antillen niet uit te voeren
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat banken geen kredieten meer verlenen aan woningcorporaties

An MP asked whether commercial banks are ceasing to lend to housing corporations and what the consequences would be for their finances, construction output and rating of the guarantee fund WSW. The minister answered that banks are only more critical, mainly on non-DAEB activities, that BNG and Waterschapsbank remain available, and that the WSW rating is unchanged, while promising no concrete new action.
As already indicated in the answer to question 2, it still has to be seen to what extent there will actually be more limited credit provision to housing corporations.
Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 2 reeds is aangegeven, zal nog moeten blijken in hoeverre er daadwerkelijk sprake zal zijn van een beperktere kredietverlening aan woningcorporaties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw heeft meegewerkt aan het gebruik van risicovolle financiële producten door woningcorporaties

MP Lucassen asks whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW) failed to act against risky derivatives used by housing associations, including Vestia, and whether it had adequate information and any supervisory failure. Minister Spies replies that lessons must be learned by all parties, the Woningwet and derivative rules will be tightened, an external commission will advise, and that the WSW is a private guarantor without a public supervisory task, though it will be held to account for lessons learned.
However, the WSW has no supervisory task based on public law.
Het WSW heeft echter geen op publiekrecht gebaseerde toezichthoudende taak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat de minister van Justitie van Curaçao persoonlijk ingrijpt in een lopende strafzaak

An MP asked whether the Curaçao Justice Minister personally asked the United States to lift seizure of a suspect's assets in a criminal case, and whether this raised suspicions of abuse of power. The minister confirmed the request, explained that the Procureur-generaal has long been the competent authority, said the Kingdom will raise the issue at the June 2012 ministers' meeting, and left judgement on abuse of power to the Curaçao parliament.
However, it is for the Staten of Curaçao to pronounce on whether this is the case here.
Het is evenwel aan de Staten van Curaçao om zich uit te spreken over de vraag of dit in het onderhavige geval aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucassen inzake het lekken van gegevens door de Veiligheidsdienst Curaçao

MP Lucassen asked the Interior Minister about reported leaks of data by the Curaçao security service and demanded an independent investigation into the Curaçao prime minister's role. The minister answered that the VDC is primarily a matter for Curaçao, that the AIVD and MIVD are making inquiries, that no leak of Dutch data has been established, and that data sharing is not suspended.
It is up to the country of Curaçao to take appropriate measures when confidential data leaks from the VDC.
Het is aan het land Curaçao om geëigende maatregelen te nemen wanneer er sprake is van lekken van vertrouwelijke gegevens uit de VDC.
Antwoord vragen Lucassen over het bericht dat PvdA-prominenten zichzelf bevoordeelden in Amsterdams bouwproject

An MP asks whether former commissioner Roel de Wit and former minister Ed van Thijn, both PvdA, favoured themselves in a 1960s Amsterdam housing project. The minister answers that the project followed normal municipal procedures, that no preferential treatment or open allocation applied as now understood, and that no grounds for further investigation are seen.
On the basis of the above, I see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie op basis van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding tot het doen van nader onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Lucassen over het bericht op elsevier.nl van 8 februari 2012 “Topman van Vestia bouwt een villa op Bonaire tussen BN’ers"

MP Lucassen asked the Minister of Interior whether the former Vestia executive was building a large villa on Bonaire, how much salary he earned, what exit arrangements applied, and whether he could be held liable and his assets seized. The minister confirmed the villa construction, disclosed annual pay of roughly EUR 450,000-500,000 and a EUR 3.5 million reserve released on departure, called this inappropriate, and said Vestia should pursue recovery of damage through civil or criminal channels.

I consider the level of the former executive's remuneration, as shown in the picture sketched in answer 3, as well as the scope of the other arrangements that emerge from the information provided by Vestia, to be inappropriate for a housing corporation, also given the timing.

Ik vind de hoogte van de beloning van de voormalig bestuurder zoals die blijkt uit het bij vraag 3 geschetste beeld, alsmede de omvang van de overige afspraken die uit bovenstaande informatie van Vestia blijkt, ongepast voor een woningcorporatie, ook gelet op de timing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Van Vliet en Lucassen over het bericht dat banken weigeren om tweeverdieners met een modaal inkomen een hogere hypotheek te verstrekken

PVV MPs asked whether the AFM's objection to relaxed mortgage rules for dual-earner households with modal incomes, and its view on the limits of lending, was consistent with its supervisory role, and whether supervisors should refrain from commenting on the housing market. The minister replied that the AFM may state what it considers responsible lending under the open norm, and that the AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to comment on the housing market while respecting existing rules.
The AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to express views on the housing market.
Het staat de AFM en DNB als onafhankelijk toezichthouder vrij om zich uit te spreken over de woningmarkt.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat bestuurders van woningcorporaties 30 miljoen in eigen zak staken (ingezonden 27 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation executives had embezzled nearly 30 million euro and whether supervisors should be held liable and banned from the sector. The minister said the sums were not yet established as unlawful, pointed to the pending Herzieningswet strengthening internal supervision, and said corporations should pursue recovery of damages and supervisors could be held liable for improper performance.
That is why the Herzieningswet includes provisions to strengthen internal supervision.
Daarom zijn in de Herzieningswet bepalingen opgenomen ter versterking van het interne toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over activiteiten van de Colombiaanse veiligheidsdienst op Curaçao (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the Colombian security service is active on Curaçao at the request of the Curaçao government, and whether that is desirable. The minister confirmed reports of Curaçao seeking contact with the Colombian service, stated that national security is each country's own responsibility, and noted that regional security cooperation is legally provided for while the Kingdom's interests must be kept in view.
Concern for national security is a matter for which each country of the Kingdom has its own responsibility and uses its own security service.
De zorg voor de nationale veiligheid is een aangelegenheid waarvoor ieder land van het Koninkrijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft en zich bedient van een eigen veiligheidsdienst.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de benoeming tot gedeputeerde van een wegens corruptie en fraude vervolgde politicus op Bonaire (ingezonden 14 septembe

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether Burney Elhage, a suspect in the Zambezi fraud and corruption investigation, was appointed island councillor on Bonaire, and about the status of that investigation, the likelihood of conviction, whether the minister was informed in advance, and whether the appointment undermines government credibility. The minister confirmed the appointment and that the investigation was reopened by court order, declined to comment on prospects of conviction, explained the asset-declaration safeguard, and rejected the claim that governance had lost credibility.
Now that the investigation must be resumed on the order of the Court, I do not consider it appropriate to make a statement on this.
Nu het onderzoek op last van het Hof dient te worden hervat acht ik het niet gepast hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Online onderhuren makkie voor toerist» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether illegal subletting of social housing is adequately controlled and whether intermediaries can be prosecuted. The minister said corporations and municipalities have sufficient tools (ontbinding, administrative fines, Ymere's approach), that criminal prosecution of intermediaries is not possible since illegal subletting is not a criminal offence, and that municipalities could consider a licensing scheme.
It is known that dwellings are illegally sublet, particularly in tight housing market areas.
Bekend is dat er woningen illegaal worden onderverhuurd, met name in gespannen woningmarktgebieden.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de schoffering van staatssecretaris Weekers door de regering van Curaçao (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Curaçao finance minister's refusal to meet a Dutch state secretary was a snub, and whether the government will demand an apology. The government confirms the refused meeting, attributes it to a poor relationship with the Central Bank president, says contact is being arranged, and declines to demand an apology.
Despite his request, the state secretary of Finance was unable to hold a conversation with the Curaçao finance minister during his visit to Curaçao.
Ondanks zijn verzoek heeft de staatssecretaris van Financiën tijdens zijn bezoek aan Curaçao geen gesprek kunnen voeren met de minister van Financiën van Curaçao.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Lucassen (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Nederlandse militairen en hun familieleden doodsbang zijn voor lo

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Interior ministers about reports that Dutch military personnel and families on Curaçao fear local criminals and that such attacks are increasing. The ministers denied any increase in burglaries or greater violence, described existing protective measures (alarms, patrols, Kmar cooperation with local police), and said Aruba sees no rise in crime against soldiers.
There are no indications that the number of burglaries against military personnel on Curaçao has increased in recent years or that the incidents have become more violent.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat het aantal inbraken bij militairen op Curaçao de afgelopen jaren is toegenomen of dat de incidenten gewelddadiger zijn geworden.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Tony van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het bericht dat tweeverdieners veel minder hypotheek krijgen (ingezonden 29

PVV MPs asked whether young dual-income couples can borrow much less mortgage than single earners on the same income and whether stricter rules or hypothecary lender agreements cause this. The minister explained that the Nibud method applies the highest earner's cost percentage to joint income, which the Nibud chose because a second earner's loss is harder to offset, that a more proportionate buffer is under discussion with the WEW and Nibud, and that the method was not changed under the new code.
On a responsible relaxation of this point, we are currently in discussion with the Waarborgfonds Eigen Woningen and the Nibud.
Over een verantwoorde verruiming op dit punt zijn wij momenteel in gesprek met het Waarborgfonds Eigen Woningen en het Nibud.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht over een schietpartij in de gevangenis van Curaçao (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a shooting incident in the Curaçao prison, questioning the prison's security, alleged corruption, and whether the Curaçao justice minister should resign. The Minister replied that prison governance on Curaçao is the responsibility of that country's justice minister, declined to comment on the policy or the smuggling, and rejected calls for resignation.

Since the prison system is the responsibility of the Minister of Justice of the autonomous country of Curaçao, I do not consider it appropriate to make statements about the policy regarding this institution

Aangezien het gevangeniswezen de verantwoordelijkheid betreft van de minister van Justitie van het autonome land Curaçao, acht ik het niet opportuun uitspraken te doen over het beleid met betrekking tot deze inrichting

Vragen van de leden Agema en Lucassen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat hoogbejaarde ouderen in D

PVV MPs asked why elderly residents in Delft were confined to their homes for weeks during lift renovation and urged action against housing corporation Woonbron. The minister said the renovation was necessary, temporary measures were taken, a stairlift was not feasible, and the matter is a dispute between tenant and landlord, so no further action is planned.
It is correct that Woonbron is renovating the building's only lift over fifteen working days.
Het klopt dat Woonbron de (enige) lift van het woongebouw in vijftien werkdagen renoveert

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de regering van Curaçao gevangenen met een enkeltje na

MPs Lucassen and Helder asked ministers about reports that Curaçao wants to send prisoners back to the Netherlands one-way, and how Dutch authorities would prevent this. The state secretary replied that 22 prisoners convicted under Netherlands Antillean law will be transferred to the Netherlands in phases or to Bonaire after new prison construction, with the Netherlands paying Curaçao up to NAf 720,000 for interim housing, and that 7.2% of detained persons in the Netherlands come from the former Netherlands Antilles.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de minister van Financiën van Sint Maarten de controlerende bevoegdheden van het College Financieel Toe

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that Sint Maarten's finance minister wants to limit the Financial Supervisory Board's (CFT) powers by removing its second approval of budgets. The minister answered that no such request was received from the Sint Maarten government, and that the issue can be avoided if the Estates ensure the Council of Ministers submits budgets only after CFT approval.
Incidentally, no request has been received from the government of Sint Maarten to amend the Kingdom Act.
Van de zijde van de regering van Sint Maarten is overigens geen verzoek ontvangen tot wijziging van de Rijkswet.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat een woningcorporatie door een blunder vijf miljoen euro heeft verloren (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

Lucassen (PVV) asked the minister of Interior whether housing corporation Lefier lost five million euros through a blunder in a land purchase, whether internal oversight failed, and whether he would investigate and see responsible persons removed. Minister Donner confirmed the loss (about 5.5 million euros written off), stated the corporation is financially sound, said a forensic inquiry led to tighter controls, and declined a government investigation, leaving judgement on personnel to the corporation's boards.
No, see the answer to question 4.
Nee, zie het antwoord op vraag 4.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht: «Donner: Geen onderzoek naar regering Curaçao» (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that a commission would investigate the integrity of Curaçao's central bank and its director, but not the Curaçao government, including its composition, powers, legal basis, and alleged corruption. The minister's communication states that all these written questions were already answered in a parliamentary debate on 29 June, so no further written answers are required.
All these questions were raised and answered in the debate on this subject on 29 June.
Al deze vragen zijn aan de orde gekomen en beantwoord in het debat over deze materie op 29 juni jl.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het instorten van balkons van een flat in Leeuwarden (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether 1950s-1960s flats face elevated collapse risk, how they are inspected, and whether balconies are the main defect source after a balcony collapse in Leeuwarden. The minister said there is no evidence of elevated risk, owners must ensure safety under the Woningwet, inspection methods are not prescribed and municipal oversight is limited to complaints, and that only 3 of 163 reported defects concerned balconies; he referred to earlier answers on the investigation.
I have no information showing that these residential buildings face an elevated risk of collapse compared with other existing buildings.
Ik beschik niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat deze woongebouwen een verhoogd risico lopen op instorting in vergelijking met andere bestaande gebouwen.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over kartelafspraken op executieveilingen (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked about alleged cartel price-fixing by property traders at execution auctions, the scale of harm to former homeowners, supervision of the auctions, measures to make them accessible to private buyers, and whether traders face Tax Authority controls and prosecution. The government answered that the NMa has reported 15 persons and named several hundred traders for follow-up, that the notary supervises the auction, that regional auctions and a forthcoming bill aim to improve access, and that the NMa and Public Prosecution Service handle any violations.

No reliable figure can be given for the exact harm, because it is not known what the difference is between a price that would have been reached at an auction without agreements and the price reached at an auction with agreements.

Over de exacte schade kan geen betrouwbaar cijfer worden gegeven, omdat niet bekend is wat het verschil is tussen een prijs die tot stand zou zijn gekomen op een veiling zonder afspraken en de prijs die tot stand komt op een veiling met afspraken.
Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onafhankelijkheid van Curaçao. (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

The PVV MP Lucassen asked the minister whether Curaçao's government had declared it would become independent by 2014 and leave the Kingdom, and asked what the Netherlands would do to make Curaçao and Aruba follow suit. The minister answered that the government's 2010-2014 programme does not say this, the slogan refers only to a sovereign Curaçao, and the other questions are answered by the same reply.
No. The 2010-2014 government programme of the Curaçao government also does not show this.
Nee. Uit het regeerprogramma 2010–2014 van de regering van Curaçao blijkt dit ook niet.

The minister confirmed the absence, said he did not know the reason, reported renewed talks with the Sint Maarten cabinet, and stated that any deficits will not be financed by the Netherlands.
Any deficits on Sint Maarten will not be financed by the Netherlands.
Eventuele tekorten op Sint Maarten zullen niet door Nederland gefinancierd worden.

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they support Utrecht's plan to force residents to insulate their homes, and whether aerial thermal scans identifying individual homes go too far. The minister opposed compulsory insulation, said it would not become national policy, left the choice to owners, and said thermal scans give only global information and detailed assessment requires owners' consent.
However, it always remains up to building owners themselves to decide whether and which measures they take.
Het blijft echter te allen tijde aan gebouweigenaren zelf om te bepalen of en zoja welke maatregelen zij nemen.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over onderzoek naar vermeende witwaspraktijken en corruptie door politici op Bonaire (ingezon

An MP asked ministers about a prosecution of a Bonaire council member and a former Antillean minister for money laundering and corruption, and about Dutch support and integrity safeguards. The government answered that the case was dismissed on 17 February 2011 after a court-set deadline, that the investigation was led by the Curaçao prosecutor with Rijksrecherche support, and that integrity policy is primarily the responsibility of the public body itself, with some legal disclosure duties for Bonaire officials.
The prosecution appealed the investigating judge's order, but the Joint Court of Justice of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba declared the appeal inadmissible.

Het OM is in hoger beroep gegaan tegen de beschikking van de rechter-commissaris, maar werd door het Gemeenschappelijk Hof van Justitie van de Nederlandse Antillen en Aruba niet ontvankelijk verklaard.

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister about flooding in Dutch military housing in Jongbloed, Curaçao, and what measures were taken, who bears liability for damage, and whether Defence remains a good employer. The minister answered that drainage measures were taken, damage to housing is Defence's responsibility while contents are the occupant's, and tenants are now warned in their lease about flood risk.
Damage to defence housing is the responsibility of Defence as owner.
Schade aan defensiewoningen is de verantwoordelijkheid van Defensie als eigenaar.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Lucassen beiden (PVV) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Nederlandse militairen op Curaçao – volgens een hoge militair van

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether a Marine lieutenant-colonel and NLDA researcher had called for mandatory integration courses on Curaçao, whether he should be corrected or sanctioned for political statements, and whether he had previously criticised the Afghanistan mission. The minister confirmed the article (a Marineblad piece by an anthropologist) and said Defence already offers language and culture lessons, that the officer is retired, and that no sanction is warranted.
I see no reason, and also no possibilities for measures as referred to in question 7.
Ik zie geen enkele aanleiding, en ook geen mogelijkheden voor maatregelen zoals bedoeld in vraag 7.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Lucassen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over aanpassing van de casinoregels op Sint Maarten (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the sudden change of casino rules on Sint Maarten, which may allow a casino linked to alleged organised crime to open, undermines integrity and warrants a prosecutorial investigation of officials. The state secretary answered that casino policy is an autonomous island competence, that the Public Prosecutor's office cannot be instructed by the Netherlands, and that he will ask the commissioner for an explanation of the motives, but has no information warranting a criminal investigation.
I can therefore assure you that I will ask Mr Marlin to explain the underlying motives for amending the casino rules on Sint Maarten.
Ik kan u dan ook toezeggen dat ik de heer Marlin zal vragen een toelichting te geven op de achterliggende motieven om de casinoregels op Sint Maarten te wijzigen.

PVV MPs asked the housing minister about foreign students being housed in hotels in Wageningen at a low nightly rate, questioning whether this reflects a housing shortage and unequal treatment of Dutch students. The minister answered that the arrangement is a local initiative to add units, that allocation is by travel distance without nationality distinction, and that hotel rooms are not cheaper or more luxurious than regular furnished rooms.
It appears that the hotel rooms in Wageningen are not more luxurious or cheaper than regular furnished student rooms.
Het blijkt dat de hotelkamers in Wageningen niet luxer of goedkoper zijn dan reguliere gemeubileerde studentenkamers.

Referring to the answer to question 3, I dispute that regular housing seekers are victims of the quota arising from the Housing Act, and I therefore see no reason to take measures.

Met verwijzing naar het antwoord op vraag 3, bestrijd ik dat reguliere woningzoekenden de dupe zijn van de uit de Huisvestingswet voortvloeiende taakstelling en ik zie derhalve geen redenen maatregelen te treffen.

requests the government to have the Commissie Draagkracht consider to what extent and what types of costs households with children face compared with households without children

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about a Belgian proposal for a state bond to attract savers, the low savings rates offered by banks, and the banks' large profits. The minister answered that savings rates are lagging behind ECB rate rises, referred the competition question to the ACM, said DNB and the ECB monitor bank profits, and promised a letter on policy options including the state bond within months.

As I indicated in the committee debate of 13 September, I will inform your House within a few months in more detail about my assessment of the pros and cons of possible policy options, including the state bond.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het commissiedebat van 13 september jl. zal ik uw Kamer binnen enkele maanden nader informeren over mijn appreciatie van de voor- en nadelen van mogelijke beleidsopties, waaronder de staatsbon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht 'Telegram treedt niet effectief op tegen op grote schaal delen van contactgegevens en naaktfoto’s van vrouwen'

MPs Kuik and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government will act against Telegram's failure to curb mass sharing of women's contact details and nude photos in exposure groups, including whether police and prosecutors can block such groups, identify account holders, protect minors, and whether fines like Germany's should apply. The minister answered that the government takes it seriously, is pressing platforms via the DSA and other EU instruments and a public-private partnership, notes that identifying anonymous posters and acting against Telegram are hard legally and technically, and says Dutch law (WBAOKM) only covers child sexual abuse material.
The cabinet is increasing efforts to hold these parties to their responsibilities, partly through new legislative instruments.
Het kabinet verhoogt de inspanningen om deze partijen op hun verantwoordelijkheden te wijzen, deels met behulp van nieuwe wetgevende instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht 'Het internet is vervuilender dan de luchtvaart, met dank aan alle mails, crypto’s, videogesprekken, streams en de cloud'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about reports that internet use is more polluting than aviation, including Dutch digital emissions, government monitoring of its digital footprint and the French 'sobriété digitale' idea. The minister answered that estimates vary, no integral picture of Dutch digital emissions exists yet, research and a plan for a sustainable digital sector are under way, and that sobriety-based steering should be approached cautiously.
At this moment I do not have an integral picture of the sustainability effects of our digital economy.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over een integraal beeld van de duurzaamheidseffecten van onze digitale economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Niet-afgedekt renterisico maakt private equity opeens kwetsbaar'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether unhedged interest rate risk threatens private equity funds and their portfolio companies, and what regulation or monitoring is needed. The minister answered that PE funds and portfolio firms are responsible for hedging their own rate risk, that additional rules are not currently warranted, and that DNB and the AFM will discuss the economic impact with the minister.
I will discuss the possible impact on the Dutch economy of interest rate rises for PE funds and their companies with DNB and the AFM.
Ik zal de mogelijke impact op de Nederlandse economie als gevolg van rentestijgingen voor PE-fondsen en hun bedrijven bespreken met DNB en de AFM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Ontslagen bij KPMG om toetsfraude, commissaris Van Boxtel stapt op'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that KPMG dismissed staff over examination fraud and whether the Ministry, the AFM, the audit firms and the sector's culture and quality indicators should respond. The Minister answered that the sector bears primary responsibility, that the firms' investigations are ongoing and awaited, that the AFM has enforcement tools and a bill strengthening them is in preparation, and that the cultural reform reports will follow in autumn 2023.
I am awaiting the results of these investigations.
Ik wacht de resultaten van deze onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Kinderen opgelicht met virtuele muntjes voor gameplatform Roblox’

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about reports of children being defrauded with virtual currency in the Roblox game, including data on child fraud, the vulnerability of children to phishing, the role of pay-to-win and loot box mechanics, EU action, and police capacity. The government acknowledged no specific police registration for game fraud, pointed to child-rights design tools, EU consumer-protection work on loot boxes, and public awareness programmes, but gave no hard figures and few firm new commitments.
The police do not use a specific registration category for the type of online game in these reports.
De politie hanteert bij deze aangiften geen specifieke registratiecategorie voor het type online game.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht 'WhatsApp en Signal dreigen VK te verlaten vanwege breken encryptie' van AG Connect

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about reports that WhatsApp and Signal might leave the UK over encryption-breaking provisions in the Online Safety Bill, and whether scanning messaging apps for child abuse material should outweigh encryption. The Minister answered that the UK bill is still pending, that the EU CSAM regulation is under negotiation, that the government supports no proposal making end-to-end encryption impossible in line with the Van Raan motion, and that client-side scanning is being considered within those limits.
The Netherlands does not support European proposals that make end-to-end encryption impossible, in line with the motion-Van Raan adopted by the House of Representatives.
Nederland steunt geen Europese voorstellen die end-to-end encryptie onmogelijk maken, in lijn met de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie-Van Raan c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Griekenland gaat staatsschuld eerder aflossen als gebaar naar beleggers’

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister about Greece's plan to repay part of its bilateral eurozone loans early, whether credit rating agencies should feed into the SGP, whether a credible debt reduction conflicts with countercyclical policy, and whether Greece should serve as a model for Italy, France, Spain and Portugal. The minister welcomed the Greek move as a positive signal, rejected a role for rating agencies in the SGP, argued debt reduction and countercyclical policy are compatible, and said Greece's experience cannot simply be transferred to other countries.
Your House will be informed about this as usual.
Uw Kamer wordt daarover zoals gebruikelijk geïnformeerd.

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs why child benefit (kinderbijslag) was negatively indexed from 1 July 2023 and whether the government would compensate families, including past negative indexations, budget effects, other benefits at risk, why the WML freeze mechanism was not used for child benefit, and whether family impacts will be shown in purchasing-power figures. The minister answered that a generic compensation is not suitable and will be considered in the August decisions, that the indexation was a shortfall versus the budget assumption, that the mechanism will be reviewed and reported in December, and that the government will implement the Palland/Stoffer motion on showing child impacts.
As promised during the Social Security Implementation committee debate on 29 June, I will examine whether adjusting the indexation method is possible and desirable.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Commissiedebat Uitvoering Sociale Zekerheid op datum 29 juni jl. zal ik kijken of aanpassing van de wijze van indexeren mogelijk en wenselijk is.

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that websites with severe child sexual abuse material doubled in two years, and why many are hosted on Dutch servers, what measures will be taken, and how encryption affects detection. The minister agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to voluntary takedown codes and a planned regulator (ATKM) with enforcement powers, and said encrypted communication makes investigation difficult while promising continued cooperation with the sector.
No figures are known for 2022 on sanctioning websites.
Over 2022 zijn geen cijfers bekend van het sanctioneren van websites.

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance why only six Dutch audit firms hold the license to audit public-interest entities, why Value8 could not find an auditor, and whether the AFM can review a Portuguese firm's audits and whether the Dutch quality requirements should apply to foreign firms. The Minister answered that audit firm choices are individual, that the AFM can review files of foreign firms but cannot apply the same license test, that the Netherlands will keep its extra national requirements, and that the government will propose an appointment power for the NBA.
I am not considering abolishing the additional national requirements that apply to Dutch audit firms wishing to audit public-interest entities here.
Ik overweeg niet om de aanvullende nationale eisen, die gelden voor Nederlandse accountantsorganisaties die hier organisaties van openbaar belang willen en mogen controleren, te laten vervallen.

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister and the State Secretary for the Interior about deepfake TikTok advertisements luring young people to loan sites, and about legal responsibilities, bank claims, shareholder action and protection measures. The government answered that enforcement is for courts and independent regulators, listed the applicable consumer, financial, e-commerce and DSA rules, said banks have had ads removed, and pointed to media-literacy and awareness campaigns and the EU AI Act.
It is for the courts or supervisory authorities to establish violations, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan de rechter of toezichthouders om overtredingen vast te stellen, en niet aan het kabinet.

The minister answers that the AVG and existing supervisors apply, points to a draft law in consultation that would give the government conditions and oversight powers over the BKR, and declines to extend the AP's or AFM's role beyond current remits.
With this bill, the Minister of Finance will be given a power to set conditions for the BKR and for credit institutions' connection to the BKR.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt een mogelijkheid voor de Minister van Financiën gecreëerd om voorwaarden te stellen aan het BKR en de aansluiting van kredietinstellingen bij het BKR.

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether banks structurally discriminate against Muslims through anti-money-laundering (Wwft) risk profiling and whether an independent investigation is needed. The minister said discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to DNB supervision and an ongoing DNB study, and committed to talks with stakeholders and to reporting to parliament in the autumn.
In response to these signals, among others, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Ik wil naar aanleiding van, onder andere, deze signalen de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about an Court of Audit report on digital identity, fearing that stricter login security from 1 July 2023 could leave many citizens unable to log in to government services because a central connection point is not yet ready. The State Secretary replied that SMS login remains available, that connection of service providers will be gradual through 2024-2026 with DigiD and eHerkenning kept in place until then, and that the government will consult parliament before changing SMS login policy.
I have indicated that I will consult with your House before any changes are made to this policy starting point.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ik in overleg met uw Kamer zal treden voordat er wijzigingen plaatsvinden in dit beleidsuitgangspunt.

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries about a report linking smartphone and social media use to worsening mental health among teenage girls, including Dutch data on depression, suicide and self-harm. The government answered that Dutch data are limited, that a causal link between social media and depression is not established, and listed prevention measures, platform engagement and a forthcoming child-protection policy letter.
There is no data available on self-harm among young people in the Netherlands.
Er is geen data beschikbaar over automutilatie onder jongeren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Krul over het bericht ‘Laat KLM zich aan de afspraken over miljarden aan coronasteun houden’

MPs Slootweg and Krul asked whether the government will enforce KLM's compliance with corona aid conditions, including legal action, use of the 2 billion NOW aid and tax deferral, and pressure via the shareholder Air France-KLM. Minister Kaag answered that the contract could not be terminated for partial non-compliance, litigation was judged uncertain, generic measures cannot be used as leverage, and the government will assess compliance and consider further steps.
The cabinet will use its shareholder powers to keep questioning and assessing KLM's board and supervisory board on this matter.
Het kabinet zal zijn aandeelhoudersbevoegdheden inzetten om het bestuur van KLM en de raad van commissarissen hierover te blijven bevragen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Steekspel rond mysterieuze datadiefstal; Bedrijven delen data van klanten met hun leveranciers, maar hoe veilig is dat?'

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary about the Nebu data leak, which parties are liable in data-sharing chains, and whether current rules are sufficient to protect consumers. The minister said the number of affected Dutch clients is unclear, that a court ordered Nebu to provide information and an independent forensic investigation, and that liability and chain obligations already fall under the GDPR, so no new rules are needed.
At this moment it is unclear how many customers, companies and organisations in the Netherlands have been affected by the data leak.
Op dit moment is het onduidelijk hoeveel klanten, bedrijven en organisaties in Nederland zijn getroffen door het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Peelland Truckrun afgelast vanwege verzekeringskwestie’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about truckruns cancelled over insurance problems, and whether event insurance is becoming scarce for volunteer organisers. The minister answered that the problem stems from an insurance uncertainty about passengers without seatbelts, that insurers cover the trucks and seated, belted passengers, and that there is no sign of a broad insurance problem, so no new government measures are proposed beyond monitoring.
I have no indications that insuring events organised by volunteers in a broad sense is increasingly becoming a problem.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het verzekeren van evenementen die worden georganiseerd door vrijwilligers in brede zin steeds vaker een probleem is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht ‘Social Media is a Major Cause of the Mental Illness Epidemic in Teen Girls. Here’s the Evidence'

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked whether Dutch longitudinal studies exist on social media use and teen mental health, and how the government views the claim that social media is a major cause of depression and anxiety in teen girls. The government answered that no simple direct causal link has been established, listed Dutch longitudinal studies, outlined prevention and regulatory measures, and promised a broader policy letter.
As stated above, we do not yet see a scientific consensus on a simple and direct causal relationship between social media use and the development of depression and anxiety.
Zoals boven gesteld zien wij nog geen wetenschappelijke consensus over een eenvoudige en directe causale relatie tussen sociale mediagebruik en de ontwikkeling van depressie en angsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht dat miljoenen overheidsgeld op het spel staan na het stilleggen van een biomassacentrale in Gelderland

Two CDA MPs asked why the Primco biomass plant in Duiven stopped operating, whether public money is at risk, and what measures prevent further subsidised biomass projects from failing. The minister answered that the company bears the price risk, that the state's subsidy and investment support total about 6 million euro so far, that the state would be a creditor for overpaid SDE+ subsidy in bankruptcy, and that the government has no active role in restarting the plant, while declining to answer the question on how many projects are affected.
No. It concerns many projects with very specific business operations and agreements on both costs or revenues for the use of biomass and revenues for the supply of heat.
Nee. Het betreft veel projecten met zeer specifieke bedrijfsvoeringen en afspraken zowel qua kosten of inkomsten voor de inzet van biomassa als qua opbrengsten voor de levering van warmte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Heinen over de berichtgeving in de media naar aanleiding van het omvallen van de Amerikaanse banken SVB en Signature

MPs Slootweg and Heinen asked the Finance Minister about media coverage of the failures of SVB and Signature Bank, their exposure to Dutch savers, pension funds and banks, and systemic risks from interest rate policy. The minister answered that Dutch exposure is small, that the US banks had specific business-model weaknesses and lighter US regulation, and that Dutch banks are well capitalised, while acknowledging some global vulnerability and defending existing bank regulation.
I do not know how many Dutch savers and businesses held money at Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) or Signature Bank.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse spaarders en bedrijven geld bij Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) of Signature Bank hadden staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg over het bericht “Miljardensteun voor Credit Suisse, beleggers reageren opgelucht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about the rescue of Credit Suisse, the risks to Dutch and European banks, the state's ABN AMRO sell-down, and possible effects on the construction sector. The Minister answered that Switzerland's own authorities are responsible, that Dutch and European banks are more resilient, and that the sell-down continues under an agreed floor price, but did not disclose that price.
I cannot make public statements about the level of the floor price, as this could negatively affect the success of the sales programme.
Over de hoogte van de bodemprijs kan ik geen openbare uitspraken doen aangezien dit een negatieve impact kan hebben op het succes van het verkoopprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Aanjagers accountancy zien heel langzaam zelfbewustzijn in sector groeien'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the pace of culture change in the accountancy sector, how costs and oversight have evolved, and whether small organisations can access accountants. The minister answers that culture change is under way but slow, that oversight costs have risen and shifted to the AFM, and that the number of accountancy firms has fallen from 429 to 261.
I will await these activities and reports in order to then weigh whether additional actions and measures are necessary.
Ik wacht deze werkzaamheden en rapportages af om vervolgens een afweging te kunnen maken of aanvullende acties en maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Rekening geblokkeerd na gift aan kleinzoon, bank belooft beterschap'

Opposition MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether Rabobank's automatic blocking of a private account after a transfer to an unknown account, reportedly without notifying the customer and possibly reflecting ethnic profiling, was proportionate and how such practices are governed. The minister answered that the case itself cannot be assessed, that banks block accounts only on fraud indicators with customer notification being important, that no agreements with banks exist on automatic blocking or algorithmic profiling, and that the matter will be considered in implementing a related motion.
I cannot make statements about this individual case, because I am not familiar with the details of the matter.
Over deze individuele casus kan ik geen uitspraken doen, omdat ik niet bekend ben met de details van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Overheidsfinanciën in gevaar door verouderde ict van Belastingdienst’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether the outdated Cool:Gen ICT systems behind income and wage tax could be replaced in time, and whether the risks to tax collection were real. The State Secretary answered that the continuity risk is unfounded, the systems are stable but costly to change, a multi-year modernisation portfolio and mitigation measures are in place, and the planning to finish by end 2026 is still feasible.
The fear that the continuity of tax collection is at stake is unfounded.
De vrees dat de continuïteit van de belastingheffing op het spel staat is ongegrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over recente berichten over ict-storingen en cyberaanvallen in onder andere het Maastricht UMC en het UMC Groningen

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked about IT outages and cyberattacks at Maastricht UMC and UMC Groningen, and about whether ICT security risks in hospitals are structural. The minister replied that the DDoS attacks caused only limited website unavailability while care continuity was maintained, that the Maastricht outage was a technical EPD failure affecting outpatient clinics and operations, and that Z-CERT sharing, NEN 7510 compliance and a risk-based Z-CERT membership strategy are being pursued.
I will elaborate on this in answering question 13.
Ik ga hier verder op in bij de beantwoording van vraag 13.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Bankkantoren met een loep zoeken: ABN heeft er nog maar 27'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that bank branches have fallen sharply, and whether this leaves vulnerable groups excluded from banking. The minister answered that banks should offer non-digital alternatives, that banks have committed to keep non-digital basic services available and expanded pilots, and that the minister is in talks with banks and will report back in June 2023.
I am already in talks with the banks about the availability of physical financial service points for customers.
Ik ben reeds in gesprek met de banken over de beschikbaarheid van fysieke financiële dienstverleningspunten voor klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'EY-accountants leveren licentie in vanwege Wirecard-echec'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about voluntary licence surrender by accountants after the Wirecard affair, the frequency of licence withdrawal, lessons for supervision, rules on board seats at former clients, and whether accountants can keep their title while barely practising. The minister answered in detail that the Netherlands has titles rather than licences, that AFM can only file disciplinary complaints, and that existing rules and oversight are considered adequate.

I am of the view that the requirements for licensing by the AFM, the NBA's codes of conduct, the operation of disciplinary law and possible civil liability sufficiently guarantee the adequate performance of assignments by accountants.

Ik ben van mening dat de eisen die worden gesteld aan de vergunningverlening door de AFM, gedrags- en beroepsregels van de NBA, de werking van het tuchtrecht en eventuele civielrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid voldoende waarborgen bieden voor een adequate uitvoering van opdrachten door accountants.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Tegen ongezond eten kunnen gemeenten vrijwel niets doen'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported lack of municipal tools to limit unhealthy fast-food outlets, especially in poorer areas, and about links to the Omgevingswet, Warenwet, NS stations and food-chain policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the link between unhealthy food supply and health inequality, said the legal options for a healthier food environment are still being explored and will be reported to parliament in autumn, and pointed to the National Product Improvement Approach and NS's own retail ambitions.
This autumn I will inform the House in more detail about this, in my letter on nutrition and overweight.
Dit najaar zal ik de Kamer, in mijn brief over voeding en overgewicht, nader informeren hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat fors meer kinderen zich in Nederland in hun eentje voor asiel melden

An MP asked the State Secretary whether unaccompanied minors are sent ahead to benefit from family reunification and whether the rules can be changed, and asked about Council of State and European case law. The government answered that the family reunification rules do not disadvantage minors, that Dublin rules for minors are distinct, that changing policy to deter sending children ahead would be undesirable, and cited court rulings on Greece, Malta, Croatia and Hungary.
Together with other member states, the cabinet therefore urges the European Commission to present a concrete plan to fully resume Dublin transfers to Greece.
Samen met andere lidstaten spoort het kabinet de Europese Commissie dan ook aan om een concreet plan te presenteren om Dublintransfers naar Griekenland weer volledig te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Oneigenlijk gebruik van opvang'

Slootweg asked whether arbitrage workers from Ukraine who are not war refugees lack a legal basis to be refused temporary protection shelter, benefits and housing, and how many there are nationally.
