The State Secretary answered that such workers are also displaced and may use the ROOO scheme unless they have work income or housing elsewhere, that no national figures exist, that the IND will not actively pursue return, and that post-expiry policy is still being worked out.
No integrated figures are available on the number of Ukrainian labour migrants already in the Netherlands who fall under the Temporary Protection Directive.
Er zijn geen integrale cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal arbeidsmigranten uit Oekraïne die al in Nederland verbleven en onder de Richtlijn Tijdelijke Bescherming (RTB) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked about a report that drug shipments by post were rising sharply and about customs seizures, staff safety, and cooperation with the US and other countries. The government answered that seizures rose from 4,080 in the first half of 2021 to nearly 13,500 in the first half of 2022, attributed partly to increased customs inspection capacity, described safety measures for postal staff, and said cooperation with the US, Australia and New Zealand is intensive, with a joint postal team planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het rapport ‘World Drug Report 2022, Drug Market Trends Canabis and Opioids‘ van de United Nations office on Drugs and Crime’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the UNODC World Drug Report 2022 findings on cannabis legalisation in US states (higher use, THC levels, drug-driving, violence) and the Dutch cannabis experiment. The minister answered that effects vary by state, that the Dutch experiment is a limited four-year regulated trial, not legalisation, and that Bibob screening applies to investors including tobacco or alcohol industry ones.
In the cannabis experiment, a uniform and limited four-year trial examines whether and how a closed coffeeshop chain can be set up.
In het wietexperiment wordt in een uniform en beperkt experiment van vier jaar bekeken of en hoe een gesloten coffeeshopketen kan worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Als studenten zelf alarm slaan over hun cocaïnegebruik, dan is er wat aan de hand’

MPs Slootweg and Van der Molen asked the government about reports of rising hard drug use among students since COVID, the 12.5% lifetime cocaine use figure, trends, prevention in student houses, public campaigns and cooperation with student associations. The state secretary answered that monitors show no excessive rise, outlined existing prevention programmes, said mass public campaigns risk backfiring, and promised continued contact with student associations.

Because the signal from the student association is worrying, I have had periodic consultations with the National Chamber of Associations, the national student association cooperative, and will continue this contact to keep a finger on the pulse.

Omdat het signaal van de studentenvereniging verontrustend is, heb ik periodiek overleg gehad met de Landelijke Kamer van Verenigingen, het landelijke samenwerkingsverband van studentenverenigingen, en zal dit contact voortzetten om een vinger aan de pols te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Nederland koploper naturalisatie: ruim 45.000 asielzoekers kregen paspoort‘

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a report that the Netherlands led the world in naturalising asylum seekers in 2021, and about related questions on comparisons with other EU states, immigration policy, naturalisation conditions, and Dublin transfers to Greece. The State Secretary declined to compare the figures without knowing their definitions, pointed to Eurostat data, referred to EU migration pact initiatives, said naturalisation conditions were stated but not reconsidered, and promised a separate letter on Greek beneficiaries of protection.
I cannot substantively address the comparison named, as it is not known which definitions were used for the figures cited in the report.
Op de genoemde vergelijking kan ik niet inhoudelijk ingaan, aangezien niet bekend is welke definities gehanteerd zijn bij de in het bericht genoemde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Geen cel maar taakstraf voor drugsuithalers: 'Dit is een enorme domper'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Court of Appeal ruling replacing prison sentences for drug-haul runners in Rotterdam port with suspended sentences and community service, and whether the new offence article 138aa Sr remains effective. The minister defended the law, said sentencing is for independent judges, promised to monitor jurisprudence and report back, and suggested port companies bear responsibility for barriers.
It is not for me to comment on sentences imposed in individual criminal cases. That is for the independent judge to assess.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over opgelegde straffen in individuele strafzaken. Dat is aan de onafhankelijke rechter ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Fastfood rondom scholen neemt sterk toe.’

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that fast-food outlets near schools, especially in deprived areas, are increasing, and what measures will be taken on food environments, including municipal powers and product reformulation. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, promises a letter after the summer on the prevention approach and possible legal measures, and says a legal exploration of municipal instruments is underway.
I am currently exploring legal measures to achieve a healthier food environment.
Ik verken op dit moment wettelijke maatregelen om tot een gezonde(re) voedselomgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Medewerkers die klaagden over seksueel geweld binnen de VN werden ontslagen’

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about a report that UN staff who complained about sexual violence were dismissed, and about reporting, retaliation, sanctions and whistleblower protection. The minister acknowledged concerns about inaction and a culture of fear, pointed to UN mechanisms (Clear Check, OIOS, immunity waiver, whistleblower reforms) and said the Netherlands can cut funding, as recently done with UNOPS.
It is concerning that a number of UN staff still experience that the procedures fall short and speak of a culture of fear and impunity.
Het baart zorgen dat een aantal VN-medewerkers nog steeds ervaart dat de procedures tekortschieten en spreekt over een cultuur van angst en straffeloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Frontex left 'traumatised' says caretaking leadership'

MP Slootweg (CDA) asks the State Secretary about reports that Frontex staff refuse to work amid poor rights records, the impact of the executive director's departure, the Greek operation, returns figures and risk analyses. The State Secretary says operations continue, the director's exit does not affect returns or risk analysis, Frontex retains powers to suspend operations, and the government condemns rights violations at the border while leaving primary responsibility to member states.
The cabinet takes a position against all forms of human rights violations at the external border.
Het kabinet neemt stelling tegen alle vormen van het schenden van mensenrechten aan de buitengrens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Havens in Noord-Nederland moeten 'beducht zijn' voor snellere toename drugscriminelen, als Rotterdam overstapt op zwaardere controles’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister and the Finance State Secretary about a report that northern Dutch ports are poorly controlled and vulnerable to drug smuggling if Rotterdam tightens checks, and about whether 100% controls, displacement risks and the 24 million euro package would address this. The government replies that customs, Marechaussee and police have a good information position, that smuggling volumes in northern ports are relatively stable, that it monitors displacement and will not adopt 100% checks on specific goods, and that the structural funds focus on five major hubs with regional funds available for other hubs.

The Politie en Wetenschap research is however a reason to examine, both separately and jointly, what options exist to further strengthen the information position on possible dubious practices in the northern seaports.

Het onderzoek van Politie en Wetenschap is echter wel een aanleiding om, zowel afzonderlijk als in gezamenlijkheid, te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de informatiepositie over de mogelijke malafide praktijken in de Noordelijke zeehavens verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over berichten over wangedrag in azc’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of violence and drug-related incidents at asylum reception centres, including whether an asylum seeker who attacked staff would be deported and what measures protect staff. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, stated that deportation follows detention and that staff safety is under review, and promised further information before the summer recess.
As your House is aware, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, kan ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat gemeenten die Oekraïners particulier opvangen niet worden gesteund

An MP asked whether the government excludes refugees housed privately from its reception targets and whether municipalities doing private placements deserve support. The Secretary of State answered that private hosting is voluntary, that targets apply only to municipal reception, and that municipalities receive reimbursement and compensation for private-host costs.
Providing shelter to a displaced person from Ukraine in a private home is a voluntary choice of a host household.
Het onderdak bieden aan een ontheemde uit Oekraïne in een particuliere woning is een vrijwillige keuze van een gasthuishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘België wil verbod op gokreclames: Gokken is het nieuwe roken’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about Belgium's plan to ban gambling advertising, the rise in online gambling hours and young people gambling since legalisation, and what the government will do about problem gambling. The minister rejects a total ban, announces a ban on untargeted advertising for risky games via an amendment to the advertising decree, and says data on gambling addiction will only be available again in the autumn.
That is why I am taking additional measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het te veel uitkeren van kindgebonden budget aan arbeidsmigranten

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration pays the single-parent supplement of the child budget to migrant workers whose partners live abroad, and why the problem has persisted despite earlier warnings. The government acknowledges structural data gaps for non-resident partners, describes partial fixes and ongoing work, admits it cannot count affected migrant workers, and postpones the answers.
It is known that a total of about 5,000 single parents whose child does not live in the Netherlands were granted the child budget.
Wel is bekend dat in totaal aan circa 5.000 alleenstaande ouders waarvan het kind niet in Nederland woont kgb is toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt hebben gesteld over de witwaspraktijken bij ING

MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked the Finance and Justice ministers about money-laundering practices at ING, including whether DNB re-tested the top leadership's fitness after the settlement, what conditions attached to the state capital injection, what DNB, ECB or prosecutors told ING's board, and whether ING's compliance department was cut. The minister declined to comment on individual prosecution and supervisory matters, citing supervisory confidentiality, and said the archive shows no such letters to the ministry, while promising to check officials' mailboxes and report back.

Under the legally anchored supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor cannot and may not make statements, not even to me, on whether re-testing in individual cases was considered, takes place or has taken place.

Op grond van de wettelijk verankerde toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder geen uitspraken doen, ook niet naar mij, over de vraag of hertoetsing in individuele gevallen is overwogen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de berichten ‘Bevrijdingsdefilé in Wageningen dreigt voorgoed te verdwijnen’ en ‘Geen tweede kans voor 75 jaar vrijheid: opnieuw streep door defilé in Wageningen, ook in Groes

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, jointly with the Minister of Defence, about reports that the Wageningen liberation parade may disappear, and about commemoration of 4 and 5 May for veterans unable to attend. The government denied that Defence refused cooperation outright, said Defence will review its support given operational capacity limits, and described online and alternative commemorations for 2021.
In response to the concerns about the future of the parade, the agreements are being reviewed.
Naar aanleiding van de zorgen die zijn ontstaan over de toekomst van het defilé worden de afspraken herbezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht 'vertraging ggz-indicaties in de Wlz door hoge aantal aanvragen'

MPs Slootweg and Peters asked why GGZ Wlz indication requests far exceeded the expected 9,500, how long applicants will wait, what the dedicated CIZ team and transitional arrangements involve, and what the shift means for Wmo funding and care hours. The state secretary answered that the initial estimate was too low because ambulant clients and providers were initially hesitant, that over 16,000 clients are expected to receive Wlz GGZ indications, that a noodplan with extra staff is in place, that Wmo decisions were extended to 1 July 2021, and that the Wmo-to-Wlz transfer will be recalculated budget-neutrally for municipalities.
At the end of 2020 I made agreements with the CIZ on an emergency plan containing various measures to clear the backlog of applications as quickly and carefully as possible.
Eind 2020 heb ik met het CIZ afspraken gemaakt over een noodplan, waarin verschillende maatregelen zijn opgenomen om het stuwmeer aan aanvragen zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over Conservatrix

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about the 2017 transfer of insurer Conservatrix to Trier Holding for 1 euro, the promised capital injection, and why funds ended up with a Barbados reinsurer. The minister confirmed the promised recapitalisation was legally binding, described the injections and later deterioration, withheld the transfer plan and related documents from public disclosure (available confidentially), declined responsibility for the supervised firm, and committed to an independent evaluation of DNB and ministry conduct from 2017 onward, with the scope and evaluators to be reported to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Slootweg en Omtzigt over de terugvordering van bijstand

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a benefit recipient was ordered to repay about 7,000 euro for donated food and the hardship of recovery rules, the discretion of municipalities, and the treatment of food-bank parcels. The State Secretary acknowledged concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, pointed to municipal discretion and hardship exceptions, announced working groups and a review of harsh rules, but declined to judge individual cases and promised results in the second quarter of 2021.
From my systemic responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge individual cases.
Vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid past het niet dat ik oordeel over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Rabobank sluit helft filialen om winst op peil te houden'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the decline in bank branches, including Rabobank's closures, is desirable and what the role of the state and DNB is in keeping banking accessible to vulnerable groups. The minister answered that digital banking explains most closures, that banks are primarily responsible with DNB chairing the MOB to monitor accessibility, and promised a mid-2021 interim evaluation and a DNB study on cash infrastructure.
I do not have information on how many full-time equivalents are involved in this.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over hoeveel fte hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de Italiaanse overheid die de ECB zou verzoeken schulden kwijt te schelden

MP Slootweg asked the Finance Minister whether Italy had formally asked the ECB to write off sovereign debt, and asked about ECB holdings, euro-area debt levels, the legal basis for ECB bond purchases, and ESM options. The minister answered that the ECB cannot cancel government debt, that no formal Italian request is known, and that the ESM reform will require debt sustainability checks and single-limb CACs.
The ECB cannot decide to write off government debts.
De ECB kan niet beslissen om schulden van overheden kwijt te schelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Slootweg over het bericht 'Militairen betaalden te veel voor pensioen’

MPs Van Helvert and Slootweg asked whether seven former military personnel who sued over pension premiums charged from 2004 to 2018 were overcharged, and whether Defence should compensate them. The State Secretary answered that the correct premiums were charged under annual agreements with the unions, rejected compensation, and promised to inform the House of the court outcome.
Defence takes the position that the correct pension premium was always charged, as agreed annually with the unions.
Defensie stelt zich op het standpunt dat altijd de juiste pensioenpremie in rekening is gebracht, zoals die (jaarlijks) is overeengekomen met de vakbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het tekort aan griepprikken

Two CDA MPs asked why there is a shortage of flu vaccines, whether healthcare workers can be prioritised, and how supply will be secured next year. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that extra vaccines were purchased and additional stock may arrive, that the state is not directly responsible for healthcare employers' vaccination offers, and that preparations for 2021 are being brought forward.
Vaccination of healthcare staff helps to prevent this transmission.
Vaccinatie van zorgpersoneel helpt om deze overdacht te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over ‘een flinke groei van het aantal mensen dat een beroep moet gaan doen op voedselbanken’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rising demand at food banks, falling food supply from supermarkets, the use of the EUR 4 million corona subsidy, and whether supermarkets' turnover gains could support food banks. The State Secretary acknowledged the supply problem and said the subsidy is held as a safety net, with supermarkets free to decide on support and EU ESF+ funding under discussion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over het recht op partnerpensioen op risicobasis na beëindiging dienstverband

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Social Affairs minister about survivors' pension rights after a switch from capital-based to risk-based partner pension, the requirement of informed consent, and limitation periods. The minister answered that compensation depends on the case, that a dynamic incorporation clause requires good information, and that no standardised claims procedure is needed because hardship clauses in pension schemes provide a route.

In my view, this ruling does not mean that in all cases where there was no conscious consent to the switch from a survivors' pension on accrual basis to one on risk basis, the survivor is entitled to compensation.

Mijns inziens betekent deze uitspraak niet dat in alle gevallen waarin geen welbewuste instemming is geweest met de overgang van een nabestaandenpensioen op opbouwbasis naar een nabestaandenpensioen op risicobasis, recht bestaat op een schadevergoeding voor de nabestaande.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Slootweg over de berichten 'Mkb'ers maar matig op de hoogte van financieringsmogelijkheden' en 'Kredietverzekeraar: Nederland wacht volgend jaar grote faillissementsgo

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about SMEs' limited awareness of financing options and about a predicted bankruptcy wave, including whether insolvency law could intervene earlier and whether a temporary protection for healthy firms should be introduced. The state secretary answered that many support schemes exist, that bankruptcies remain low due to support packages and court delays, that the WHOA restructuring law is the chosen tool, and that a general protection measure is rejected as too broad, while committing to a Kamer report on the annual SME action plan and a bank-data analysis.

I have not made a commitment that, in addition to the existing CBS monitoring commissioned by EZK, periodic reporting will be provided on the use of the guarantee schemes in general and specifically on rejections.

Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan dat er aanvullend op de bestaande monitoring door het CBS in opdracht van EZK (periodiek) gerapporteerd wordt over het gebruik van de garantieregelingen in het algemeen en specifiek over afwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Slootweg over "de effectiviteit van het tijdelijk verlagen van de btw en het invoeren van een kinderbonus"

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the ministers whether a German study showing a child bonus is more effective than a VAT cut for stimulating consumption applies to the Netherlands, and whether the CPB should be asked to do similar research. The minister answered that extra costs for households with children are limited and varied, that the government will not add a child bonus but raises the child-related budget for large low-income families, and that CPB evidence favours income tax cuts over VAT cuts or transfers.
Given the findings from the German study, it is relevant that the Dutch cabinet has allocated funds for the purchase of digital learning materials to make home schooling accessible to all children.

Gelet op de bevindingen uit het Duitse onderzoek is relevant dat het Nederlandse kabinet middelen heeft vrijgemaakt voor de aanschaf van digitale leermiddelen om thuisonderwijs voor alle kinderen toegankelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Amhaouch en Palland over het met contant geld kunnen blijven betalen in winkels

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether shops are increasingly refusing cash, whether COVID plays a role, what is done for groups dependent on cash, and how costs for small businesses will develop. The minister answered that no current data exist, a DNB/Panteia study is pending, cash acceptance is a commitment under MOB agreements, and further research on cash infrastructure is planned.
There is currently no up-to-date data available on the number of retail outlets concerned and the extent to which corona plays a role.
Er zijn op dit moment geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal toonbankinstellingen dat dit betreft en in hoeverre corona hierbij een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over gebrekkige transparantie bij particuliere woonzorgbedrijven

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about weak transparency at private care-home operators, including the reported 7% return on dementia housing, foreign ownership, staffing norms, and split of rent and service costs. The minister said the Wlz profit ban does not cover this housing, promised a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution, and said staffing norms and oversight by the IGJ and care offices apply, while many details were left to providers and care offices.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider operations, in which I want to introduce the option of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution for sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over mensen die van tafel en bed gescheiden zijn, dezelfde mantelzorgregels van toepassing voor de Algemene Ouderdomswet (AOW) als op mensen die niet getrouwd zijn

CDA MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked whether separated-from-bed-and-board spouses face the same AOW pension cohabitation rules as unmarried people, including the two-dwelling rule, and why website information on this is lacking. Minister Koolmees answered that married persons who live separately are assessed like married couples on whether they live durably apart, that the two-dwelling rule applies only to unmarried people, and that the ministry will explore simplifying the cohabitation rules and has updated the SVB website, but gave no evaluation of the checks.
No evaluation of the approach to checking durable separate living is available.
Er is geen evaluatie van de aanpak van controle van duurzaam gescheiden leven beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Slootweg over het bericht 'Verstrekken van leningen/kredieten zonder vergunning is strafbaar'

MPs Van Dam and Slootweg asked about a report that unlicensed high-interest lending in Bonaire is criminal, the trend in this crime, consumer protection, and whether enforcement bodies are adequately equipped amid COVID-related financial distress. The minister answered that the case was already prosecuted, outlined existing licensing and interest-rate rules, planned a law amendment, extra prosecutorial capacity and training, and noted that bank de-risking is being addressed through tighter AML rules.
In addition, the fight against undermining and financial-economic crime is also being intensified in the Caribbean Netherlands.
Daarnaast wordt de bestrijding van ondermijning en van financieel economische criminaliteit ook op Caribisch Nederland geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de noodremprocedure

Two CDA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Commission can pay out recovery funds after three months if the Council does not agree on a Dutch-raised emergency brake concern, and how the procedure works. The government confirmed the procedure, explained that the Council must reach unanimity, that the Commission can fall back on the EFC route, and that the procedure was agreed with Commission and Council presidency involvement.
The starting point is that the procedure from the moment of consultation of the EFC generally lasts no longer than three months.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de procedure vanaf het moment van raadpleging van het EFC in de regel niet langer dan drie maanden duurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Slootweg over de berichten 'Banken zijn 180.000 ondernemers en consumenten tegemoetgekomen’ en ‘Bedrijven bij nieuwe bank krijgen geen krediet’

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks prioritise existing clients over new business customers, which may block new credit to firms during the coronavirus crisis, and about the lack of published rejection figures and the status of a Qredits loan. The government partly recognises the picture, says banks are now also serving new customers, promises to report on rejection data after the summer recess, and says the Qredits transaction should close at the end of July.
I am periodically in consultation with the banks regarding the corona monitoring they publish.
Ik ben periodiek in overleg met de banken ten aanzien van de coronamonitoring die zij uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Huizenkopers betalen straks bedrag aan notaris voor negatieve rente’

An MP from the CDA asks whether notaries' clients should bear negative interest that banks charge on notaries' third-party-funds accounts, and whether a consultation or legal exemption is possible. The Minister of Finance answers that he sees no reason to intervene in pricing now, that notaries are legally required in principle to net interest but may agree otherwise with clients, and that price arrangements with banks are restricted by competition law.
I will take up the subject again if the options for ordinary savers to bank at a bank that does not charge negative interest are significantly restricted.
Ik zal het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen indien de mogelijkheden voor gewone spaarders significant worden beperkt om te bankieren bij een bank die geen negatieve rente rekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Wie doet na 400 jaar binnenkort het licht uit bij onze financiële sector?'

CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper piece claiming the Dutch financial sector is being handed to foreign parties, and about foreign acquisitions, procurement, government banking, FinTech and critical infrastructure. The minister rejects the premise, says there is no overview of acquisitions by nationality, notes that EU procurement rules bar selecting on location, and states that existing legal tools allow intervention in unwanted foreign takeovers.
There is no overview of how many and which Dutch financial institutions have passed to foreign parties over the past ten years, or the reverse.
Er is geen overzicht van hoeveel en welke Nederlandse financiële instellingen de afgelopen tien jaar zijn overgegaan naar buitenlandse partijen en andersom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het beperkt aantal wettelijke verlofdagen in een verpleeghuis

An MP asked the health minister about the limit on leave days for residents of long-term care facilities, after a broadcast reported a 42-day cap. The minister answered that the total declarable absence is 146 days per year, that the NZa is willing to discuss and adjust the rules with care providers, and that the answer was delayed by the corona crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het terugstorten van heffingen door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about the AFM refunding about 555,000 euros in levies to Today's Tomorrow after it failed twice to issue an extension decision for a curator, and what follow-up measures were taken. The minister confirmed the omission was acknowledged and corrected, that the refund is spread across supervised institutions with minimal tariff effect, and that internal measures and a central enforcement unit were introduced.
An internal measure has been taken that ensures timely signalling when an extension decision needs to be taken.
Er is intern een maatregel genomen die zorgt voor een tijdige signalering indien een verlengingsbesluit genomen dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het onderzoek naar mogelijk AOW-fraude bij duurzaam gescheiden koppels

MP Slootweg (CDA) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about AOW pension fraud investigations targeting couples living apart together, including home visits, water-use checks, and whether grandparents' visits are used as evidence. The minister answers that investigations are risk-based and proportionate, reports 2019 figures (622 corrections, 122 retroactive reductions, about EUR 7.2 million handling costs), and promises an official review of the living-arrangement system.
No data are available on the number of people who entered the AOW in 2019 in combination with data on supplementary pension.
Er zijn geen data beschikbaar over het aantal mensen dat in 2019 in de AOW zijn ingestroomd in combinatie met gegevens over aanvullend pensioen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peters, Van der Molen en Slootweg over de uitgestelde invoering van het nieuwe woonplaatsbeginsel

Three CDA MPs asked why the new woonplaatsbeginsel (residence principle for youth care funding) was postponed and whether municipalities such as Goirle are financially harmed. The minister answered that the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ care is extended by a year and raised to 30 million euros, and that postponement to 2022 was chosen to ensure careful implementation given the COVID-19 workload on municipalities.
Now that the introduction of the youth residence principle has been postponed by one year, the compensation scheme for guardianship and 18+ is extended by one year.
Nu de invoering van het woonplaatsbeginsel jeugd met een jaar is uitgesteld, wordt de compensatieregeling voogdij en 18+ met een jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat veel private equity en buitenlandse partijen betrokken zijn bij fusies in de zorg

An MP asked the health minister about private equity and foreign takeovers of care providers, including the Stepping Stones/Korian case, covering client and works council involvement, NZa powers to assess quality and affordability, board composition, and funding and staffing. The minister answered that councils have advisory rights, that the NZa currently cannot refuse a merger on quality or affordability grounds though tightening is being considered, and gave factual answers on the Stepping Stones board, funding and staffing.
However, the NZa currently does not have the power to reject a merger request on the basis of possible consequences for the quality and affordability of care.
De NZa heeft echter momenteel niet de bevoegdheid een fusieverzoek af te wijzen op basis van mogelijke gevolgen voor de kwaliteit en betaalbaarheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het effect van het verbod op plastic rietjes op mensen met een beperking

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about the effect of the EU-based ban on plastic straws on people with disabilities who depend on them. The minister acknowledges that no adequate alternatives exist yet, points to the medical-device exemption, says a consultation with stakeholders and the ministry of Infrastructure is underway, and offers to organise a meeting with the target group and manufacturers.
I am willing (together with the Ministry of IenW) to organise such a consultation to examine which alternative options exist.
Ik ben bereid (samen met het Ministerie van IenW) om zo’n overleg te organiseren om te onderzoeken welke alternatieve mogelijkheden er zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Eerste uitkeringen slachtoffers en nabestaanden NS-transporten’ en over het bericht ‘NS komt overlevenden en nabestaanden Holocaust financieel tegemoet’

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's compensation scheme for WWII deportation victims, including whether the state as shareholder was consulted and whether resistance fighters and reprisal victims are covered. The government answered that NS decided independently on the commission and scheme, that the shareholder imposed no restrictions, and that NS will involve other victim groups in a collective recognition, with a decision expected around summer.
Determining the scope of the scheme NS has put in place, however, is not for the cabinet but for NS.
Het bepalen van de reikwijdte van de regeling die NS heeft getroffen is echter niet aan het kabinet, maar aan NS
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Slootweg over het bericht 'Consumentenbond: Producten van webwinkels buiten de EU vaak onveilig'

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond report finding many products from non-EU webshops unsafe, and about level-playing-field concerns, platform liability, the Amhaouch motion on EU liability officers, import controls and consumer awareness. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to EU platform pledges, a planned SER advice on platform liability, the market surveillance regulation requiring EU contact points from July 2021, and an awareness campaign, but declined generic import blocks as contrary to WTO rules.
I will discuss the latest state of affairs regarding the Product Safety Pledge with the European Commission.
Ik ga met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over de laatste stand van zaken met betrekking tot de Product Safety Pledge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht inzake SGP flexibiliteit voor Italië

MP Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about reports that Italy seeks more flexibility under the Stability and Growth Pact to address COVID-19 economic effects, the flexibility Italy received in past crises, and EU/Eurogroup financial measures. The minister confirmed Italy's request is pending with the Commission, listed past flexibility clauses, outlined Eurogroup and Commission measures, and pointed to the meeting minutes.
It is now up to the European Commission to assess this request.
Het is nu aan de Europese Commissie om dit verzoek te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hijink over het rapport van de Inspectie Gezondheid en Jeugd inzake DeSeizoenen

MPs Slootweg (CDA) and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the IGJ report on DeSeizoenen, including the governance structure, service arrangements with Care Shared Services, transparency of costs and dividends, legal costs of the dispute with the Central Client Council, and alleged pressure on vulnerable clients. The Minister answered that the personal union is expected to end by 1 July 2020, that the IGJ found no basis to pursue dividend or Belastingdienst information, and that no continuity or bankruptcy signals were received, while describing pressure on vulnerable clients as unacceptable.
Het onder druk zetten van kwetsbare mensen is onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling Woerden dreigt gehandicapt stel uit elkaar te halen: Het is mensonterend’

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health why seven disabled residents of a Woerden care facility must move by 1 February 2020 to distant locations, and whether the process fits the target group. The Minister acknowledged the disruption, said the facility could not keep providing the needed nursing care nearby, and stated that no residents must move to Friesland, Drenthe or Overijssel, while noting some residents still lacked a final choice and that the Inspectorate has followed the developments closely.
Together with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate I have closely followed developments and consulted with various parties involved.
Samen met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd heb ik de ontwikkelingen intensief gevolgd en ben ik met verschillende betrokken partijen in overleg gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over "Het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen weigert die specialistische hulp nodig hebben"

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about reports that Pluryn, a care institution, is refusing children needing specialist help and is in financial trouble, including rising personnel costs, acquisitions, staffing, property costs and regulator involvement. The minister gave figures on costs, revenue, depreciation, clients and FTEs, declined to discuss governance, acquisitions and property costs as internal matters, and said the NZa had no supervisory role in youth care.
From my position, I do not consider it desirable to intervene in the conduct, relationships and dynamics between the management, supervision and works councils within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in het optreden, de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

CDA MPs asked why youth care provider Pluryn is closing De Hoenderloo Groep, how the roughly 200 youths and 500 staff will be placed elsewhere, and what the financing of special education for the Gelderse Vallei consortium implies. The minister answers that Pluryn has announced the closure citing quality, finances and regional care, that a one-year phase-out plan with individual placements is in preparation under IGJ and education inspectorate supervision, and that funding changes and a planned AMvB on realistic youth care prices are being pursued, while the education funding issue has been corrected by a recovery action.
The IGJ is already involved and will assess this plan and actively supervise the care transfer of the youths currently staying at De Hoenderloo Groep.
De IGJ is reeds betrokken en zal dit plan beoordelen en actief toezien op de zorgvuldigheid van de zorgoverdracht van de jeugdigen die nu bij De Hoenderloo Groep verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over de sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep youth care institution, including inspection signals, staff complaints, Pluryn's finances and governance, and tariffs. The minister answered that the inspectorate had found shortcomings and reviewed an improvement plan, declined to comment on the relationship between the board and supervisory bodies in a specific organisation, and gave financial figures from Pluryn's accountability document.
From my position, I consider it not desirable to intervene in the relationships between the board, supervision and employee participation within a specific organisation.
Vanuit mijn positie acht ik het niet wenselijk te treden in de relaties en verhoudingen tussen het bestuur, toezicht en medezeggenschap in een specifieke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Renkema over berichten dat kwetsbare ouderen en mensen met een beperking verstoken zijn van huisartsenzorg

MPs Slootweg and Renkema asked about reports that frail elderly people and people with disabilities lack GP care, including the role of specialist elderly care physicians and physicians for people with intellectual disabilities and the cost-sharing rules. The minister answered that consultation with parties is ongoing toward a convenant, that the NZa is conducting a quickscan of contracting problems, and that GP care is not subject to the insurance deductible by design, while committing to further follow-up.
I have now asked the NZa to map, with a quickscan, the experiences with contracting SOs and AVGs in primary care.
Ik heb inmiddels de NZa gevraagd om met een quickscan de ervaringen met de contractering van de SO en de AVG in de eerste lijn in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat de IRMA-app wordt gebruikt in een huisartsenpost

An MP asked about a GP-practice portal in Uden that lets patients log in with the IRMA app, raising privacy, legal basis and BSN concerns. The Minister says the legal position is still open: the Dutch Data Protection Authority has not excluded IRMA, national rules on private login means await the Digital Government Act, and the government is cautiously positive about attribute-based authentication while keeping DigiD as the current standard.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has not yet ruled out IRMA.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens heeft IRMA nog niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over berichten dat ziekenhuizen en verpleeghuizen zo vol zijn dat ouderen verzorgd worden in een hospice

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about reports that hospices in Twente are full and that elderly people on waiting lists for nursing homes end up in hospices. The Minister answered that no recent figures exist for Twente, that such placements are not intended, that regional agreements are being made, and that extra budget is available to tackle nursing home waiting lists.
No recent figures are available on the number of people who could not be admitted to a hospice in Twente.
Er zijn geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat niet kon worden opgenomen in een hospice in Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over negatieve spaarrente

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about negative deposit rates in Germany and whether Dutch banks will pass them on to savers, and about bank stress tests, ECB liquidity reserves and the Consumentenbond's call for a ban. The minister answered that banks set their own pricing, that the MFI statistics do not show higher pressure in Germany than in the Netherlands, that a ban on negative rates is discussed in a separate letter, and that Dutch reserves at the central bank have only slightly changed.
At the general meeting on the effects of ECB policy on 24 September 2019 I committed to your House to hold talks with banks.
Bij het algemeen overleg effecten van het ECB-beleid op 24 september 2019 heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om in gesprek te gaan met banken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over subsidie voor een nazorgsysteem

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister for Medical Care why the ministry subsidised a rival aftercare system (HartslagNu) instead of scaling up Hart4all, a proven aftercare system for volunteer first responders. The minister replied that the €1 million subsidy stemmed from the De Lange amendment, required a single alerting network (now achieved) and allowed aftercare innovation, that talks with Hart4all did not yield a joint solution, and that organisations may choose their own aftercare system.
Organisations are free to choose for themselves which aftercare system they use.
Het staat organisaties vrij om zelf te kiezen van welk nazorgsysteem zij gebruik maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de beschikbaarheid van respijtzorg in gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Health about respite care for overburdened carers in municipalities such as Zaanstad, and whether contracting problems mean carers must wait years for support. The minister answered that municipalities are legally obliged to support carers under the Wmo 2015, disputed the newspaper's picture of Zaanstad, and described recent contracts and a national approach to improve visibility of respite care.

Municipalities have the statutory duty to provide social support to residents where needed, promote informal care, and make provisions to prevent carer overburden, including through support and respite care options.

Gemeenten hebben de wettelijke opdracht om, waar aangewezen, maatschappelijke ondersteuning te verlenen aan ingezetenen, mantelzorg te bevorderen en voorzieningen te treffen om overbelasting van mantelzorgers, onder meer door ondersteuning en mogelijkheden van respijtzorg, te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de toenemende schuld van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven

Senator-level MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about rising corporate debt in the Netherlands, its comparison with the IMF analysis, parallels with the financial crisis, zombie firms, ECB bond-buying effects, pensioner exposure to CLOs, and whether the government is prepared for domino failures. Minister Hoekstra answered that the debt level is explained largely by multinationals, that Dutch firms are relatively sound, that the government has no active policy to reduce corporate debt beyond the earnings-stripping interest deduction limit, and that the effects of ECB policy are hard to isolate.
This information is not directly available.
Deze informatie is niet direct beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Palland over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Ouderdomsregelingen ontleed'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Court of Audit report on old-age schemes, which found 34,000 to 51,000 entitled households not claiming the AIO, and about the SVB's ability to address non-take-up using pension-register data and records of incomplete AOW accrual. The minister acknowledged the non-take-up as undesirable, accepted responsibility for the scheme's functioning, promised further research and a possible proportionate data-sharing proposal, and admitted an earlier commitment on self-employed disability insurance was not met.
I consider the scale of non-take-up reported by the Court of Audit significant and undesirable.
Ik vind de omvang van het door de Algemene Rekenkamer gerapporteerde niet-gebruik fors en onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over “de ANW-hiaatverzekering”

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether insurer Loyalis actively marketed ANW gap insurance, supplementary survivors' pension and IPAP disability cover to public-sector employees, whether their end dates tied to age 65 or the AOW age were disclosed, and whether the Pensioenkamer and the minister should act on policyholders left uninsured after the AOW-age increase. The minister answered that Loyalis responded to client requests and employer requests, informed affected policyholders and offered choices, and that the ministers have no responsibility for a private insurer, so they decline to convene the Pensioenkamer.
The Ministers of SZW and BZK have no responsibility for a private insurer.
De Ministers van SZW en BZK hebben geen verantwoordelijkheid voor een private verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over zorgorganisatie DeSeizoenen die de gedragscode voor de zorg schendt

MPs Hijink and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health about conflicts of interest and governance failures at care provider DeSeizoenen, including shared directors with Care Shared Services and weak administration. The Minister said conflicts of interest are unacceptable, that the provider has committed to restructuring its governance by next year, and that further measures will be set out in a letter to parliament.
I find it undesirable when care providers violate the governance code for care.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als zorgaanbieders de governancecode zorg schenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Nijboer over “de uitzending van Radar over ANW-hiaatverzekeringen”

MPs Slootweg and Nijboer asked about a Radar broadcast on ANW survivor-gap insurance that ABN AMRO stopped paying at age 65 despite policy terms tying payments to the AOW age, and about how widespread this is, how UPO and Mijn Pensioenoverzicht display the AOW change, and how to enforce compliance. The minister said ABN AMRO corrected the case and reviewed similar cases, that sector data on policy numbers is insufficient, that supervision by DNB and AFM is risk-based and will act on structural signals, and that complaints go through internal procedures and alternative dispute bodies, while calling on insurers to explain payment durations clearly.
This led ABN AMRO Levensverzekering to acknowledge that this woman was not correctly informed and ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen has remedied this.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat ABN AMRO Levensverzekering heeft erkend dat deze mevrouw niet correct is voorgelicht en ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen dit heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de uitspraken van mevrouw Lagarde, toekomstig president van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB), en de noodzaak voor een review van het ECB beleid

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the government about Christine Lagarde's remarks favouring jobs and growth over savers, and whether the ECB's monetary policy should be reviewed as parliament had requested. The minister answered that the ECB's independence limits government comment, that the government supports periodic reviews in general, and that the minister-president would convey parliament's view when the opportunity arises.
Given the independence of the ECB, the cabinet does not express a view on the necessity or desirability of a review.
Gezien de onafhankelijkheid van de ECB spreekt het kabinet zich niet uit over de noodzaak of wenselijkheid van een review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het stoppen met het herindicatie circus voor mensen met een chronische aandoening of een beperking

MPs Bergkamp, Raemakers and Slootweg asked whether the one-time diagnosis rule for chronically ill people (no repeated reassessments) would apply equally to Wmo and Jeugdwet support, and what would be done about repeated re-indication for blind people and people with disabilities. The minister answered that the Zvw change covers only health insurance, that Wmo and youth support require individual assessment, and that the VNG will survey municipal practice without a uniform legal change.
For young people with a disability, the need for help will change over time, and it is desirable to reassess the required help to best match their needs.
Voor jongeren met een beperking zal met het verstrijken van de tijd de hulpvraag veranderen en is het wenselijk de benodigde hulp opnieuw te inventariseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het manifest van Ieder(in) en de Vereniging Gehandicaptenzorg Nederland (VGN) over de toegang tot huisartsenzorg voor mensen met een beperking

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a manifesto by Ieder(in) and VGN reporting that growing numbers of people with intellectual disabilities receiving Wlz care are being refused or dropped by GPs and GP posts, and about the LHV guideline excluding Wlz clients in institutions from basic GP care. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said he finds problems with access to medical-generalist care undesirable, commissioned an NZa study due early 2020, and reported a 15 October 2019 meeting with stakeholders agreeing short- and long-term actions, with a fuller approach promised by year-end.
I commissioned the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) at the end of August to research the signals about declining accessibility of medical-generalist care for this patient group.
Ik heb de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) eind augustus een opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de signalen over afnemende toegankelijkheid van de medisch-generalistische zorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het  bericht dat  de overheid wist van financiële misstanden bij Privazorg, maar niets deed

MP Slootweg asked whether the tax authority knew of Privazorg executives paying themselves from care funds since 2007 and not sharing this with the inspectorate, and about the role of accountancy firm Grant Thornton and multi-entity structures in care organisations. The minister declined individual cases citing tax secrecy, said the inspectorate and NZa lack direct powers over Grant Thornton, and announced legislation on conflicts of interest, internal supervision and transparency.
Due to the tax secrecy obligation under article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht ingevolge artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur 'Zorg voor complexe gehandicapten nog steeds niet op orde'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Health about a Nieuwsuur broadcast showing that care for people with complex disabilities is still not adequate, including how many extra places have been created and how the 100 planned places are distributed. The Minister acknowledges the problem, describes the joint inventory of regional shortages due by March 2020 and the programme Volwaardig Leven, but gives no figures on places added or on the regional allocation, and says the extramuralisation effect is not measurable.
For that reason I cannot make a concrete statement on whether the reduction of intramural beds in mental health care has led to more pressure on the disability sector.
Ik kan mede daarom geen concrete uitspraak doen of de afbouw van intramurale bedden in de GGZ geleid heeft tot meer druk op de gehandicaptensector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht dat zorgcowboys binnen twee jaar miljonair worden in de thuiszorg

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about reports that home-care providers are making very high profits, including the Karmel/De Kroon and Faveo/Emmen cases, and about supervision of such profits. The minister said very high margins are unacceptable, pointed to municipal contract oversight and new measures, and acknowledged past unlawful dividend payments while withholding a full overview of sector profits.
I do not have a complete picture of this, but I want to emphasise that achieving very high profit margins is socially unacceptable.
Ik heb hier geen integraal beeld van, maar wil benadrukken dat ik het behalen van zeer hoge winstmarges maatschappelijk onacceptabel vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het artikel in de Volkskrant ‘Vijf jaarsalarissen als nabestaandenpensioen’

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about a Volkskrant report that social partners are developing a survivor's pension of five annual salaries, and about related data. The minister said the Stichting van de Arbeid advice is not yet ready, that the requested statistics are not available to the ministry or to DNB, the Pensioenfederatie or the Verbond van Verzekeraars, and that the cabinet will respond after the advice in early autumn.
I have made inquiries with DNB, the Pensioenfederatie and the Verbond van Verzekeraars. The parties concerned have indicated that they likewise do not have this data.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij DNB, de Pensioenfederatie en het Verbond van Verzekeraars. De betreffende partijen hebben aangegeven eveneens niet over deze gegevens te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over berichten dat de Europese Commissie voorstellen zal doen om het Stabiliteits-en Groeipact (SGP) aan te passen

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government had seen Commission plans to loosen the Stability and Growth Pact, whether any loosening had been proposed, and what position the Netherlands takes. Minister Hoekstra answered that no proposal had been made, that the Netherlands wants the pact reformed for stricter enforcement and less flexibility, and that it opposes loosening.
No. No proposal has been made to amend the European budget rules.
Nee. Er is geen voorstel gedaan om de Europese begrotingsregels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over weeffout in de wet op financiering van het Passend Onderwijs

CDA MPs Rog and Slootweg asked about a funding flaw in the Passend Onderwijs law that leaves the Gelderse Vallei special-needs region bearing costs for pupils released from a secure youth institution, and what the government will do. Minister Slob answered that a residence-based funding issue is being addressed through transitional measures, with a letter to neighbouring regions and a policy review promised after summer.
I will send a letter to the surrounding cooperation associations asking for their cooperation given the specific situation in Deelen.
Ik zal een brief versturen aan de omliggende samenwerkingsverbanden waarin hen om medewerking wordt gevraagd gezien de specifieke situatie in Deelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Idealistische' zorgbaas De Blok sluist miljoenen naar eigen bv’s van RTL-Z

An MP asks the health minister whether Buurtzorg's CEO routing public care funds to his own companies is consistent with earlier inspection findings and the governance code, and whether laws should change. The minister says the inspectorate found no grounds for enforcement, the situation is not comparable to Alliade, and he will examine possible new statutory powers for external supervision and inform parliament around summer.
In consultation with the NZa and IGJ, I am examining how this can be given further substance and whether, and if so which, additional statutory provisions are desirable.
In overleg met de NZa en IGJ bekijk ik hoe daar nadere invulling aan kan worden gegeven en onderzoek ik of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende wettelijke bepalingen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Geurts en Slootweg over de aanpak van knooppunt Hoevelaken

MPs of the CDA ask the minister about the stalled redevelopment of the Hoevelaken junction after the contract with BAM and Van Oord was reportedly terminated, including the delay to construction, traffic costs and possible coordination with the A1/A30 Barneveld project. The minister confirms the planned start of 2021 is now delayed to after the route decision (expected 2020), promises to inform the Chamber on re-tendering later, and gives partial answers on other points.
I will inform you at a later moment about how the realisation will be re-tendered.
Ik zal u op een later moment informeren over de wijze waarop de realisatie opnieuw wordt aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over schuldenlast

CDA MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the state secretary about the societal costs of problem debt, a general debt pardon, compulsory administration (bewind) for at-risk people, and the number of young people and children affected. The government answered that the cost figures come from reliable but non-linkable sources, rejected a general debt pardon and compulsory bewind as undesirable, and said national representative data are not yet available, with a CBS study expected in 2020.
Nationally representative figures on the extent of debt problems in the Netherlands broken down by household background characteristics are currently lacking.
Landelijke representatieve cijfers over de omvang van schuldenproblematiek in Nederland uitgesplitst naar achtergrondkenmerken van huishoudens ontbreken op dit moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat private equity goed is voor recordaantal overnames in Nederlandse zorg

An MP asked the health minister about private equity-backed takeovers in Dutch elder care, including Korian's planned acquisition of Stepping Stones, rental and service fees, the role of the NZa and IGJ, and whether the NZa should be able to review such takeovers. The minister said the government is studying how to tighten merger oversight for care and will inform parliament before summer, while stating the inspectorate's role is to check care quality against legal standards.
I aim to inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hier voor de zomer over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht dat private equity goed is voor recordaantal overnames in Nederlandse zorg

Member Slootweg (CDA) asked the health minister about reports that private equity overseas acquisitions in Dutch healthcare hit a record, including transaction volumes, foreign buyer shares, quality, staffing, real estate and patient selection. The minister answered that the NZa reviewed 167 concentrations in 2018 (four with foreign parties), that quality rules and IGJ supervision apply regardless of ownership, and that he has no concrete signals of risk selection or market power abuse, while stating he lacks data on several points.
When asked, the NZa does not have exact information on the transaction sums or on the involvement of private equity parties, which can be both Dutch and foreign.
Desgevraagd heeft de NZa geen exacte informatie over de transactiesommen en over de betrokkenheid van private equity partijen, die zowel Nederlands als buitenlands kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Slootweg over Nederlandstalige informatie over de staatsschuld

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg asked why the annual Outlook on state debt financing is published only in English, whether this obscures the per-capita debt burden, and whether essential information should also be available in Dutch. The minister answered that the Outlook is in English since 2008 because its audience is English-speaking, that the essential content is available in Dutch elsewhere, and that Dutch press releases and publications on debt are issued, while rejecting the suggestion of deliberate obscuring.
Only information on turnover in the so-called secondary market regarding maturity, type of investor and geographic location of trading activity is not separately published in Dutch.
Alleen informatie over omzet op de zogenaamde secundaire markt inzake de looptijd, type investeerder en geografische locatie van de handelsactiviteit wordt niet apart in het Nederlands gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Weyenberg en Slootweg over de uitwerking FATCA voor Nederlandse burgers en signalen dat bankrekeningen geblokkeerd gaan worden

MPs from VVD, D66 and CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about FATCA's effects on Dutch citizens with US ties, including banks threatening to block accounts without a US TIN/SSN. The State Secretary answered that banks may refuse or end services but must still offer basic payment accounts, that the number of affected people cannot be confirmed, and that the government is engaging US authorities on the SSN procedure and extending the transitional arrangement.
I assume the "white list" refers to banks that qualify as Participating FIs under FATCA.
Ik ga ervan uit dat met de «witte lijst» de banken worden bedoeld die kwalificeren als deelnemende bank (Participating FI) op grond van FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het artikel op Zorgvisie ‘30 procent van de cliëntenondersteuners kan niet onafhankelijk werken’

CDA MPs asked the health minister about a survey showing that about a third of client support workers feel their independence is under pressure from care offices and municipalities, and that some issue decisions for clients they also support. The minister called this undesirable, committed to separating the support and decision-making functions via the VNG, and said the findings will be shared with care offices and municipalities.
I therefore consider it undesirable that a client support worker issues decisions for clients to whom they also provide client support.
Ik vind het dus ongewenst dat een cliëntondersteuner beschikkingen afgeeft voor cliënten aan wie ze tevens clientondersteuning bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Von Martels over zorgvervoer en privacyregels

MPs Slootweg and Von Martels asked whether online booking of patient transport is becoming more common, whether strict GDPR privacy rules force two-factor login that burdens users, and whether booking confirmations can show reserved wheelchair space. The minister answered that internet communication is increasing, that GDPR and existing national rules apply, that two-factor login is separate from the booking confirmation which is the transporter's responsibility, and that no concrete change or action was promised.
Without further information about the reason for your question, or without further explanation, it is not possible for me to answer this question precisely.
Zonder nadere informatie over de aanleiding van uw vraag cq. zonder nadere duiding, is het voor mij niet mogelijk deze vraag precies te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Omtzigt en Van den Berg over voorbereidingen om mogelijke medicijntekorten te voorkomen door een harde Brexit

MPs Slootweg, Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked how medicine shortages from a hard Brexit would be prevented, including supply continuity, registration, stockpiling, patient coverage and Dutch doctors' diploma recognition. The minister answered that the CBG is mapping critical medicines dependent on the UK, IGJ exemptions and alternatives are planned, and the rules for approval and healthcare coverage would be adjusted in a no-deal scenario.
To secure the supply reliability of the critical medicines on the list, several steps will be taken.
Om de leveringszekerheid van de kritieke geneesmiddelen op de lijst te borgen, zullen verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van den Berg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Zorginstelling omzeilt winstverbod'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health whether the affiliated property, service and management structures of DeSeizoenen BV circumvent the profit ban in care and whether the WNT pay rules were respected. The minister answered that the IGJ and NZa are investigating and that they will share no further information for now, so he awaits the outcome.
The inspectorate and the NZa have indicated that, in the interest of their investigation, they are not providing further information at this time.
De inspectie en de NZa hebben aangegeven om in het belang van hun onderzoek op dit moment geen nadere informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Rog over de maatschappelijke diensttijd en de status van het diplomasupplement na het vervullen hiervan

CDA MPs Slootweg and Rog asked the State Secretary for Health about the preference a diploma supplement might give youths who completed the civic service in government hiring, the use of certificates, and the involvement of education and defence in pilots. The State Secretary answered that the award form is still being designed, that diversity must be preserved, and that a certificate and a more compulsory variant will be explored in pilots.
I consider it too early at this time to indicate how this recognition can be given a good form by the government from an employer's perspective.
Ik vind het op dit moment te vroeg om aan te geven hoe deze waardering een goede invulling kan krijgen door de overheid vanuit het werkgeversperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de crisis bij Careyn

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a crisis at care provider Careyn, including the forced relocation of 22 elderly residents, client council advice, ministerial questions on appeal rights, staff sick leave and the IGJ supervisory order. The Minister answered most questions, saying the IGJ will publish its findings on the supervisory order around early 2019 and that the relocation is Careyn's responsibility, while declining to name the auditor or explain the council chair's resignation.
When the IGJ sees reason to do so, it examines whether care is safe and of sufficient quality.
Wanneer IGJ daar aanleiding toe ziet, onderzoekt ze of zorg veilig en van voldoende kwaliteit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Gemeenten verschillen te veel bij toewijzing langdurige zorg?'

An MP from the CDA asked the Health Minister about large differences between municipalities in rejecting long-term care (Wlz) applications for children, and whether affected families receive the care municipalities are responsible for. The minister confirmed the figures are correct but said the causes are unclear, pointed to knowledge gaps among municipalities, providers and families, noted the CIZ assesses applications objectively, and pledged outreach and better client support.
I have no reason to assume that municipalities that quickly request a Wlz assessment provide less good care.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat gemeenten die snel een Wlz-indicatie aanvragen misschien minder goede zorg bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het bericht 'Hulpbehoevenden aansporen om hun omgeving in te zetten werkt niet'

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about a study finding that encouraging frail elderly and chronically ill people to draw on their own networks often fails, with help obtained in only 3 of 64 keukentafelgesprekken. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the policy is not being revised, pointed to Langer Thuis and a respite-care coordinator, and gave partial answers on respite care, mantelzorg numbers and sollicitatieplicht exemptions, withholding the counts of exemptions.
I have no insight into the number of exemptions from the job-application obligation due to informal care.
Ik heb geen inzicht in aantallen vrijstellingen van de sollicitatieplicht vanwege mantelzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Slootweg over de wenselijkheid van initiatieven als het ‘Kindergasthuis de Boeg’

Two MPs asked the government whether initiatives like Kindergasthuis De Boeg, a family guest house near hospitals, are desirable, how many exist, their costs compared with hospital stays, and how they could be supported. The minister answered that the houses are valuable for families but not a government responsibility, offered no overview or budget, and said hospitals remain primarily responsible for medical aspects.
I have no overview of the number of initiatives.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de aantallen initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht  'Inspectie: Arduin moet direct stoppen met behandelen van cliënten in Aagtekerke'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked about the Inspectorate's order that Arduin stop treating clients at Aagtekerke, including whether only seven clients were affected, how care is guaranteed, the board's responsibilities, and board and supervisory pay and profit since 2014. Minister De Jonge answered that the Inspectorate found acute danger in coercion-related care, four of six involuntarily admitted clients were transferred and the order has ended, responsibility lies with the board and supervisory board under the Wkkgz, and provided pay and profit tables.

The Inspectorate considers that, although the conditions for good coercion-related care are currently insufficiently secured, the shortcomings no longer pose an acute danger to the safety or health of the clients.

De inspectie is van oordeel dat, hoewel op dit moment de voorwaarden voor goede bopz-gerelateerde zorg onvoldoende zijn geborgd, de tekortkomingen geen acuut gevaar meer vormen voor de veiligheid of gezondheid van de cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Personeel Arduin slaat alarm'

MPs Slootweg and Van den Berg asked the health minister about staff shortages at Arduin, a disability care provider, after staff raised alarm, and how the Inspectorate (IGJ) monitors it. The minister says the Inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, including unannounced visits and an order at one location, and points to the national 'Werken in de zorg' programme and Arduin's participation in the regional plan.
The inspectorate follows Arduin intensively, as also appears from my answer to earlier parliamentary questions.
De inspectie volgt Arduin intensief, zo blijkt ook uit mijn beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de verhuizing van een pensioenfonds van AON naar België en het feit dat de dekkingsgraad enkel door de verhuizing met 11% stijgt vanwege het verschil in toezicht

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether a Dutch pension fund moving to Belgium gains about 11 points of funding ratio from looser supervision, whether DNB may block such transfers, and how a 3.5% discount rate can be prudent. The minister answered that Belgian principle-based supervision differs, that DNB must approve cross-border transfers under IORP rules, and that the government considers avoidance-driven transfers undesirable but has no evidence of it.
For completeness, it should be noted that there is no relocation, i.e. transfer of seat, of a Dutch pension fund.
Voor de volledigheid wordt nog opgemerkt dat er geen sprake is van een verhuizing, oftewel zetelverplaatsing, van een Nederlands pensioenfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Koolmees: Ondernemers flexibel genoeg om in te spelen op klimmende AOW-leeftijd'

The CDA MP Slootweg asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the AOW-gap faced by self-employed people and freelancers whose disability or early-retirement insurance ended at 65 after the AOW age was raised, and whether they can use the bridging scheme (OBR). The Minister answers that the OBR is available to self-employed people who meet its conditions, that the number affected is not known, and that the self-employed bear primary responsibility for insuring against disability risk.
It is not known how many self-employed people and freelancers with an early-retirement and/or disability insurance face an AOW-gap.
