Het is niet bekend hoeveel zelfstandigen en zzp-ers met een prepensioen- en/of arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering geconfronteerd zijn met een AOW-gat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over een weeffout in de wet aangaande de financiering van het Passend Onderwijs (herdruk)

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister about a funding flaw in the special education financing law that makes the Gelderse Vallei partnership bear disproportionate costs for youths released from the Deelen closed youth institution. The minister answered that the problem stems only partly from the residence-principle, that the Variawet amendment only partly helps, that the Inspectorate is studying the issue, and that she is willing to explore improvements to the funding system.
I am willing to explore what options there are for refining and improving the funding system for education at a school attached to a residential institution.

Ik ben bereid te verkennen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om te komen tot een verfijning en verbetering van de systematiek van bekostiging van onderwijs op een school die verbonden is aan een residentiële instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

CDA MPs asked about cost increases, implementation status, employer error handling, EU worker eligibility, and the evaluation of the low-income benefit (LIV) and youth LIV. The minister answered that ICT implementation is on schedule, that targeted evaluations will follow, but that employment effects cannot yet be assessed since payments have not yet started.
The first LIV payment will be made by mid-September 2018 at the latest, and the youth LIV a year later.
De eerste betaling van het LIV zal uiterlijk medio september 2018 zijn en voor het jeugd-LIV een jaar later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Help verstandelijk gehandicapten gezonder te leven’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a blog reporting worse health and substance use among people with intellectual disabilities, and about prevention efforts and the role of the VGN in the National Prevention Agreement. The State Secretary answered that data are scarce but risk of problematic use is higher, pointed to existing programmes such as Open en Alert and ZonMw research, and explained the VGN's current role in the agreement process.
According to Van der Nagel there are no hard figures on alcohol and drug use among people with mild intellectual disabilities, and the estimates vary widely.
Volgens Van der Nagel zijn er geen harde cijfers over alcohol- en drugsgebruik bij mensen met LVB en de schattingen lopen zeer uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over het bericht “Koopkracht gezinnen in veertig jaar amper gestegen”

MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the minister about a report that household income has barely risen over forty years, and about child poverty and child benefit spending compared with other countries. The government answered that standardised disposable income is about 25 percent higher than in 1977, that child poverty has fallen since 2014 but is above 2000-era levels in some years, that the Netherlands compares poorly with several neighbours, and listed measures such as higher child benefit and municipal anti-poverty funds.
The coalition agreement made an extra 80 million euro available for combating debt and poverty, particularly in families with children.
In het regeerakkoord is 80 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar gesteld voor de bestrijding van schulden en armoede – in het bijzonder in gezinnen met kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hermans over het bericht dat publiek zorggeld van Stichting Buurtzorg naar privébedrijfjes zou zijn gesluisd

MPs Slootweg and Hermans asked whether Stichting Buurtzorg funnelled over a million euros of public care money to private companies linked to its founder, and about oversight, a tax repayment arrangement and foreign activities. The minister answered that providers are responsible for their own governance, that the inspectorate sees no quality problems and is gathering information, that the NZa does not oversee such flows, and that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure of the arrangement.
The NZa does not supervise money flows between care providers and affiliated legal entities.
De NZa houdt geen toezicht op geldstromen tussen zorgaanbieders en gelieerde rechtspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Toename van spoedposten voor ouderen in ziekenhuizen'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about a press report on growing numbers of geriatric outpatient clinics and trauma units in hospitals, asking about their working method, volumes, regional distribution and effect on emergency departments. The minister said there is no fixed model, the clinics are not separately registered, their effect on emergency room pressure is expected but not measured, and regional partnerships (ROAZ) are the main vehicle for tackling acute care pressure.
This concerns acute care; treatments at geriatric outpatient clinics or geriatric trauma units are not registered separately.
Het gaat hier om acute zorg, de behandelingen op ouderenpoli’s of geriatrische trauma units worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het bericht 'Loek Winter omzeilt winstverbod zorg'

CDA MPs Ronnes and Slootweg asked the Minister of Health whether profit restrictions in care can be circumvented via subcontractors, BV structures, property arrangements and tenant-council rights, and whether the IGJ and WNT cover these. The Minister acknowledged the risks, promised a position letter on profit distribution by spring and a bill to bring subcontractors under the WNT by year-end, but deferred or deflected several questions to other bodies.
Therefore, together with the Minister of the Interior, work is underway on a legislative process to bring subcontractors under the WNT and thereby tackle avoidance constructions.
Daarom wordt, samen met de Minister van BZK, gewerkt aan een wetstraject om onderaannemers onder de WNT te brengen en zodoende ontwijkconstructies aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over een brede open studie naar het zorgstelsel en de zorgkosten

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government and the WRR would carry out a broad open study of the healthcare system and rising healthcare costs, as promised in the budget debate. The minister replied that the government supports the request, is consulting the WRR, and that the WRR will decide on its work programme this spring.
Yes, we have discussed your request and wholeheartedly support it.
Ja, wij hebben uw verzoek besproken en steunen het verzoek van harte.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het niet-opgevolgde advies van het Bureau ICT Toetsing (BIT) om het ICT project Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein gedeeltelijk uit te stellen

Members Omtzigt, Heerma and Slootweg (CDA) asked why the government did not follow the BIT advice to postpone part of the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein ICT project, why the advice was not sent to parliament within the required four weeks, and about costs, readiness, privacy assessments, staffing and oversight. The minister acknowledged the late transmission, said the deviation was made deliberately after end-to-end testing, and gave detailed assurances on implementation progress, while declining to give a timeline for some cost and readiness details and deferring some answers.
I regret that I was unable to inform your House within the four-week response period.
Ik betreur het dat ik uw Kamer niet binnen de reactietermijn van vier weken heb kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Door ziekteverzuim lekt half miljard weg uit de zorg'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Health about a report that sick leave in healthcare is costing half a billion euros, including questions on long-term absence by subsector, function, institution and management turnover. The minister confirmed that sick leave in health and welfare care is structurally higher than average, that the half-billion figure appears plausible based on Vernet data, and that no breakdown by function or institution is available, while pointing to existing programmes and a broader labour market action plan.
The CBS statistics do not break down sick leave by individual care institution.
In de statistieken van het CBS wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt van het ziekteverzuim per zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Slootweg over het bericht 'Boer kan fipronil-mest niet kwijt'

MPs Geurts and Slootweg asked why farmers forced to burn fipronil-contaminated manure at an incineration plant must pay waste tax while the Moerdijk plant is exempt, and whether the levy should be waived. The minister confirmed the tax applies by law, rejected a temporary exemption given greening policy in the coalition agreement, and pointed to a protocol and other processing options.
Amending the Wbm to include an exemption or zero rate in the waste tax for incidental cases is not appropriate.
Een aanpassing van de Wbm om in de ASB voor incidentele gevallen een vrijstelling of nihiltarief op te nemen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Molen en Slootweg over overfinanciering bij agentschappen en ZBO’s

MPs Van der Molen and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether agencies and zbo's are over-financed, citing a November 2017 article, and whether the government will reclaim the surplus funds. Minister Hoekstra denies the over-financing picture, citing audited 2016 annual reports showing fixed assets exceed long-term debt and reserves, and points to existing supervisory instruments, while rejecting any need to recover funds.
I do not recognise the picture that unnecessary funds go to agencies and zbo's and therefore see no need for this.
Ik herken me niet in het beeld dat er onnodige middelen naar agentschappen en zbo's gaan en zie hiervoor daarom geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Slootweg over het bericht 'Draagvlak mantelzorg is tanende'

CDA MPs asked the minister about a report showing declining public support for informal care and whether municipalities and insurers consider caregivers' capacity, awareness of support options, and shared decision-making. The minister acknowledged the strain on caregivers and promised talks with municipalities, Mezzo and insurers, plus a later SCP publication and a Langer Thuis programme with concrete agreements.

I will therefore enter into discussion with municipalities, Mezzo and caregivers themselves to see how we can jointly ensure that informal care remains bearable and that care remains adequate for the care recipient.

Ik zal daarom met gemeenten, Mezzo en mantelzorgers zelf in gesprek gaan om te kijken hoe we gezamenlijk ervoor kunnen zorgen dat mantelzorg dragelijk blijft en dat de zorg toereikend blijft voor de zorgvrager.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Slootweg over het verdwijnen van pinautomaten

MPs Ronnes and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about reports that a quarter of cash machines may disappear, the joint management of ATMs by Rabobank, ABN AMRO and ING via Geldservice Nederland, competition concerns, municipal input, outage data, cash volumes and security. The minister confirmed the plan, said the 5 km access norm would be maintained with coverage of 99.73%, that the ACM saw no competition problem, and pointed to existing consultation channels, while admitting no data exists on outage durations.
No figures are known on the number of hours that outdoor cash machines are out of use due to a fault or being empty.
Over het aantal uren dat geldautomaten in buitenmuren buiten gebruik zijn vanwege een storing of leegstand zijn geen cijfers bekend.

Asks the government to lobby within UPOV for a broader interpretation and an exemption for small-scale and self-sufficient farmers from plant variety rules.
requests the government to actively advocate within UPOV for a broader interpretation and an exemption for small-scale and self-sufficient farmers.
verzoekt de regering om binnen UPOV actief te pleiten voor een ruimere interpretatie, en een uitzonderingspositie van kleinschalige en zelfvoorzienende boeren te bewerkstelligen
Motie van het lid Hirsch over 25 miljoen vrijmaken voor het aanpakken van de grondoorzaken van armoede en 25 miljoen voor de wederopbouw van Gaza

Motion asks the government to free 25 million euro each for tackling root causes of poverty and for rebuilding Gaza, to be covered within the 2024 foreign aid budget, with a proposal within four weeks.
requests the government to free up 25 million euro for tackling the root causes of poverty
verzoekt de regering om 25 miljoen euro vrij te maken voor het aanpakken van de grondoorzaken van armoede
Motie van de leden Bamenga en Hirsch over het ongedaan maken van het besluit over de toekomstige financiering van UNRWA
Asks the government to reverse its decision on UNRWA's future funding and assess UNRWA requests case by case rather than rejecting them in advance while the UN investigation runs.
requests the government to reverse the decision on the future funding of UNRWA
verzoekt de regering om het besluit omtrent de toekomstige financiering van UNRWA ongedaan te maken
Amendement van het lid Hirsch over extra middelen voor de wederopbouw van Gaza
Adds 50 million euro to the 2024 development budget for Gaza reconstruction, offset by a cash shift from 2028.
adds 50 million to article 4 of the development budget for 2024, financed by a cash shift from 2028
voegt 50 miljoen toe aan artikel 4 aan het OS-budget voor 2024, waarvoor de dekking wordt gevonden door middel van een kasschuif
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Dobbe, Piri en Hirsch over berichten in de uitzending Pauw & De Wit op NPO1 van 6 oktober 2025 over het Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports on mistreatment of Dutch participants in the Global Sumud Flotilla intercepted by Israel, and whether the Netherlands would support an independent investigation, file an ICC complaint, or seek legal justification for the interception. The minister answered that the government raised detention conditions with Israel, requested Israel's legal basis for the interception (still awaited), declined to take further steps such as an ICC complaint, and promised no new concrete action beyond continued diplomatic pressure.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities for a justification of the legal basis for Israel's actions following the interception of the ships.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen naar aanleiding van de onderschepping van de schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het artikel ‘Nederlandse mijnbouwer verzweeg miljardenomzet voor Congolese staat’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether a criminal investigation exists into Dutch subsidiaries of ERG over possible bribery or sanctions violations, whether the government has discussed the matter with Kazakhstan, and how supervisors, FIOD/OM capacity, Congo mining transparency and conflict-mineral rules are configured. The government declined to comment on individual cases or criminal investigations, referred to existing supervisory, capacity and anti-corruption measures, and promised no specific new action.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases or the content of any criminal investigations.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gevallen of de inhoud van eventuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de herziening van het beleid voor het klachtenmechanisme van FMO

The MP asks the State Secretary about the revision of FMO's independent complaints mechanism policy, its purpose, and the role of the expert panel. The State Secretary answers that FMO is responsible for the revision, the aim is to strengthen the mechanism in line with best practice, and the panel's views were taken into account while the policy is not yet finalised.
FMO is at arm's length from the State and, together with DEG and Proparco, is itself responsible for the independent complaints mechanism and its revision.
FMO staat op afstand van de Staat en is, samen met DEG en Proparco, zelf verantwoordelijk voor het onafhankelijke klachtenmechanisme en de herziening hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekeringen voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG project, including resumed dredging by Van Oord, security risks in Cabo Delgado, monitoring of harms and whether the state's obligations are fulfilled. Minister Heinen answered that the state is bound by the issued policies under Dutch insurance law, that the dredging was Total's own decision, that the government sees no breach of environmental and social standards, and that Total has since dropped the Dutch-insured financing so no reassessment remains.

As previously set out in answers to parliamentary questions of 1 and 29 September 2025 and in my letter of 11 November 2025, it is correct that Van Oord, on behalf of Total and anticipating a project restart, carried out preparatory dredging works.

Zoals eerder uiteengezet in de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 1 en 29 september 2025 en in mijn brief van 11 november 2025 klopt het dat Van Oord in opdracht van Total, anticiperend op een herstart van het project, voorbereidende baggerwerkzaamheden heeft uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Stultiens over het bedrijf Pluspetrol

MPs Hirsch and Stultiens asked the state secretaries about the OECD NCP final statement on Pluspetrol, including trade support, tax transparency and OECD Guidelines uptake. The government answered that Pluspetrol cannot claim trade-instrument support under fossil-fuel phase-out agreements, that tax secrecy prevents disclosing individual firms' tax data beyond new country-by-country reporting, and that the 2023 target of 90% OECD Guidelines endorsement was missed at 41%.
The cabinet does not see the possibility for the government to make more information public about the tax position of individual taxpayers given the fiscal secrecy obligation.
Het kabinet ziet niet de mogelijkheid om vanuit de overheid meer informatie openbaar te maken over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Dobbe over het artikel 'De schade van Schoof, Nederlands geld voor bijna 3.200 ontwikkelingsprojecten stopt dit jaar'

MPs Hirsch and Dobbe asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Investico report that about 3,200 development projects face funding cuts after the Versterking Maatschappelijk Middenveld framework ends in December 2025, including child labour projects and delays in access to the new Focus framework. The State Secretary rejects the claim that projects are being stopped, says the new framework starts in the first half of 2026 with EUR 600 million available, and states no extension with extra budget will be provided, while noting the government will not implement a motion for a transitional scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Kröger over het artikel 'Door creatief boekhouden hoeven we voorlopig geen euro extra te betalen voor klimaatschade in arme landen'

MPs Hirsch and Kröger asked the ministers about a Follow the Money article claiming the Netherlands pushed for a low, vague climate finance target at COP29 to avoid paying extra. The government denied this characterization, stated its position was a broad target with a public core, rejected the idea of a burden-sharing key, and said it will consider the questions in its legal analysis of the ICJ advisory opinion.
This is not a correct representation of the Dutch position.
Dit is geen juiste weergave van de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en over exportkredietverstrekking aan LNG-project Cabo Delgado, Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked why an export credit insurance policy for Van Oord covers preparatory dredging work at the Cabo Delgado LNG project while the government has said the project is on hold pending a re-assessment and an independent study. The minister replies that the Van Oord exporter policy is legally separate from the frozen financing policy, that it remains in force and cannot be cancelled absent fraud or negligence, and that the independent study is a condition for the re-assessment of the financing policy.
On the investigation or the decision-making process of the British UKEF, I cannot make any statements, as previously indicated.
Over het onderzoek of het besluitvormingsproces van het Britse UKEF kan ik, zoals eerder aangegeven, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Kröger en Teunissen over de verplichtingen van staten met betrekking tot klimaatverandering

MPs Hirsch, Kröger and Teunissen asked the government how the ICJ's July 2025 climate advisory opinion affects Dutch fossil fuel subsidies, corporate regulation, adaptation finance, loss and damage funding, and EU climate commitments. The government answered that the opinion does not create new obligations, that its fossil support and climate policies comply with international law, that it sees no need for a new analysis of fossil support, and that it will share a fuller legal reaction later.
The ICJ advisory opinion requires a careful legal analysis, which is currently taking place.
Het advies van het IGH vergt een zorgvuldige juridische analyse, die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Ceder over het bericht dat investeren in ontwikkelingssamenwerking gunstig is voor de Nederlandse economie

MPs Hirsch and Ceder asked the government about a study claiming Dutch aid boosts exports and jobs, whether cuts to development cooperation were properly assessed, and whether it will commission research on the broader costs and benefits. The Staatssecretaris called the econometric findings a reasonable but non-conclusive indication, said the cabinet sees no added value in a new study of the cuts, and gave no answer on commissioning research on wider effects beyond referring to an OECD report and a letter.
For the aforementioned reason, the cabinet sees no added value in a study of the broader societal costs and benefits of the recent cuts to development cooperation in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet ziet om voornoemde reden geen toegevoegde waarde van een onderzoek naar de brede maatschappelijke kosten en baten van de recente bezuinigingen op ontwikkelingssamenwerking in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een baggerproject in de Filipijnen

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked about the 1.5 billion euro export credit insurance for Boskalis's Manila Bay land reclamation, environmental impact reports, harm to fishers and coral, and compensation. The minister answered that the insurance was approved with conditions, that monitoring and an independent second opinion found the project adequate, and that compensation is primarily the project owner's responsibility, while refusing to comment on unrelated projects.
Export credit agency Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) only takes note of environmental impact reports for projects for which an insurance application has been submitted.
Ekv-uitvoerder Atradius Dutch State Business (ADSB) neemt alleen kennis van de milieueffectrapportages voor projecten waar een verzekeringsaanvraag voor is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de inzet om patiënten die urgent medische behandeling nodig hebben, uit Gaza naar functionerende behandelcentra te brengen

An MP asks the government about the evacuation of seriously ill patients from Gaza for treatment, including whether the Netherlands will treat them domestically and whether Israeli approval for evacuations can be pursued. The government answers that it focuses on regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support, that no patients without residence rights have been evacuated to the Netherlands since October 2023, and that it will pursue wider evacuation options with Israel and regional partners without giving a precise count of Israeli-approved requests.
This figure is not known to the cabinet.
Dit cijfer is bij het kabinet niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Dobbe over het artikel 'Nederland levert militair materieel aan dubieuze regimes'

MPs Hirsch and Dobbe asked the government about arms exports to regimes with human rights concerns, including Egypt, the IOB evaluation, the Aachen treaty and the 2023 lifting of national restrictions on Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Turkey. The minister answered that export licences are assessed against the EU Common Position criteria, that a clear risk leads to refusal, and that the 2023 changes aimed at European defence cooperation without weakening the criteria.
It follows from the EUGS that where a clear risk of such use is identified, a licence application must be refused.
Uit het EUGS vloeit voort dat, daar waar een duidelijk risico op dergelijk gebruik wordt vastgesteld, een vergunningaanvraag dient te worden afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over het bericht van SOMO over Israëlische wapenindustrie

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked whether the government will act on SOMO reporting that Dutch businessmen direct SASMOS, which exported arms components to Israel, and on Israel-related genocide and international-law obligations. The minister answered that the government does not comment on individual companies, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and described existing export restrictions and a broader policy of discouraging trade with settlements.
In principle, the cabinet does not make public statements about individual companies or persons.
Het kabinet doet in beginsel geen publieke uitspraken over individuele bedrijven of personen.
Antwoord op de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de stand van zaken omtrent een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs asked about the status of an independent review of security and human rights risks behind an export credit guarantee for the Mozambique LNG project, whether Van Oord resumed work under force majeure, and related questions on Rwandan troop payments, UK Export Finance, NGO involvement, UN investigation and corruption. The Minister says the external analysis is not yet complete and expected after summer, the Dutch decision on amending the financing policy is pending, the export policy remains in force for Van Oord's exporter policy, and the government will not commit to a UN-led investigation, referring to Mozambique's own prosecutor.
I expect to be able to share the final report with your House after the summer, except for any confidential elements.
Ik verwacht het definitieve rapport, behoudens eventuele vertrouwelijke elementen, na de zomer met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over de detentie van mensenrechtenverdediger Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces

MPs asked why Colombian human rights defender Inés Estela Pérez Arregoces was held over 20 hours at Schiphol and then removed, and how this fits with protection of human rights defenders, interpreter and legal assistance rights, and privacy. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing privacy, described the general Schengen Border Code framework and appeal options, and said he saw no reason for policy changes.
I cannot, also in connection with privacy considerations, go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Ik kan, ook in verband met privacyoverwegingen, niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden van dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over de berichtgeving rondom de levering van kritieke grondstoffen uit China

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked about China's export licensing requirement on rare earths and magnets, its impact on Dutch industry, the role of the Netherlands Materials Observatory (NMO), and possible copper shortages. The ministers answered that the government was informed only hours before the measure, that companies face delivery delays and uncertainty without quantifying sectoral impact for security and confidentiality reasons, and that the government is raising the issue with the European Commission and working on supply security under the national raw materials strategy.
For security reasons and commercial confidentiality, no further statements can be made about specific Dutch sectors or individual companies most affected by the export control measure.

Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt en bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen nadere uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke Nederlandse sectoren of individuele bedrijven waarop de exportcontrolemaatregel de grootste impact heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bericht van WNL dat hulporganisaties met overheidsgeld rechtszaken aan zouden spannen

An MP asked whether Development Minister Klever wrongly implied that government funds paid for NGO lawsuits such as the Oxfam Novib F-35 case, and about the cost of the State's cassation appeal. The minister denied any inaccuracy, said the F-35 case was crowdfunded, confirmed NGOs may sue the State, and said no total cost overview of the F-35 procedures exists.
The ministry does not have a total overview of those costs.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over een totaaloverzicht van die kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de betrokkenheid van CSO’s bij het Global Gateway-programma

An MP asked the foreign minister about civil society participation in the EU Global Gateway programme, including membership, selection, consultation and oversight of the CSO/LA Platform, and the Global Gateway Forum. The minister answered that the government will push for a role for civil society once the new MFK proposals arrive, describes the platform's membership and selection criteria, and says concrete plans for expansion do not yet exist and that the forum's details are not yet known.
The cabinet is committed to properly involving civil society in the implementation of Global Gateway projects to which the Netherlands contributes.
Het kabinet zet in op het goed betrekken van het maatschappelijk middenveld bij de uitvoering van Global Gateway -projecten waar Nederland aan bijdraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht 'FNV-economen: Europese bedrijven in de knel? De winsten zijn nog nooit zo hoog geweest'

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a newspaper report claiming European regulation harms productivity, citing the Draghi report, EIB investment survey data, OECD PMR benchmarks and productivity gaps with the US. Minister Karremans answers that regulation is one factor among several, that EU-level regulation and market fragmentation are a real burden, and that the cabinet pursues a competitiveness agenda while defending the value of proportionate regulation.
I intend to take further steps in this area in the coming period.
Ik ben voornemens om hier de komende periode verdere stappen op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Hirsch over de verwerking van ingezamelde kleding door modeketens

MPs Gabriëls and Hirsch asked about Radar's finding that clothing collected by fashion chains is often exported to developing countries rather than reused or recycled, and about transparency, consumer information, enforcement and export rules. Minister Madlener answered that export data and transparency are limited, that the UPV Textiel reporting and enforcement are still being built out, and that the revised EU waste shipment regulation and waste framework directive will tighten export rules from 2027.
There is currently little transparency about what happens to the clothing after it has been collected.
Er is op dit moment weinig transparantie over wat er met de kleding gebeurt nadat het is ingezameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de nieuwe regels en controles op (wapen)export naar Israël

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the government only now amended general export licences for Israel, what changed in the security situation, which goods were exported under those licences, and whether individual licences remain. The minister answered that the ceasefire breakdown and Israeli operations in Gaza drove the changes, that Israel is now excluded so all transactions require prior individual review, and that seven individual military licences remain valid while the cassation appeal against the F-35 parts ruling continues.
With this change, all individual transactions of strategic goods to Israel are checked before export and transit.
Met deze wijziging worden alle individuele transacties van strategische goederen naar Israël voorafgaand aan uitvoer en doorvoer getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Dobbe over de beschieting van diplomaten op de Westoever door het Israëlische leger

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Israeli forces fired on a diplomatic delegation in the West Bank, whether Dutch diplomats were present, and whether the government would condemn it, summon the Israeli ambassador, or revise cooperation. The minister confirmed shots near the delegation and a Dutch diplomat's presence, condemned the incident and asked Israel for clarification and its investigation outcome, but did not summon the ambassador and only said further steps are being considered.
The cabinet condemns the shooting incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about attacks on aid workers in Sudan and Gaza, EU sanctions and trade talks with the UAE, accountability and the scope of Dutch jurisdiction under the International Crimes Act. The Minister condemns attacks on aid workers, says accountability is primarily a matter for the states concerned and international courts, and declines to commit to new sanctions, extra funding or state liability claims due to budget constraints and legal conditions.
Given the sensitive nature of such considerations and discussions at European level, I cannot make further statements on this.
Gezien de gevoelige aard van dergelijke overwegingen en besprekingen in Europees verband kan ik daar geen verdere uitlatingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de IOB-evaluatie van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about the IOB evaluation of Dutch human rights policy, covering export credit insurance, trade missions to high-risk countries, and human rights in bilateral consultations. The minister responded that human rights are considered within export credit risk assessments, that budget cuts limit embassy capacity, that transparency of human rights impact assessments remains primarily a matter for project owners, and that trade missions will continue to receive risk briefings without making disclosure of the MVO self-scan a condition for participation.
The cabinet will therefore not make public disclosure of the individual companies' MVO self-scan a condition for participation in trade missions to high-risk countries.
Het kabinet zal openbaarmaking van de «MVO-zelfscan» van individuele bedrijven dus niet als voorwaarde voor deelname aan handelsmissies naar hoog-risicolanden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over het artikel “Europa hééft wel grondstoffen voor halfgeleiders, maar kan er niet bij”

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Economic Affairs about a newspaper article claiming EU critical-raw-materials partnerships have not proven effective, and how to reduce dependence through local value addition, recycling and concrete targets. The government answered that it is too early to judge the partnerships, stressed reciprocity, circularity and the National Raw Materials Strategy, and said it will study setting national targets once risks are better mapped.
It is a long process, so it is still too early to judge whether MoUs have proven effective.
Het is een lang proces, waardoor het nog te vroeg is te oordelen of MoU’s effectief zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Hirsch over het EU-Mercosur-akkoord

MPs Teunissen and Hirsch asked the minister about the EU-Mercosur agreement's content and decision-making, including pesticides, deforestation, the rebalancing mechanism, labour rights and the Dutch appraisal. The minister replied that a full cabinet appraisal will come in spring 2025 after the final texts, and answered several technical points (EUDR scope, the EUR 1 billion fund, mixed-agreement procedure) while deferring most substantive questions to that appraisal.
The Chamber is expected to receive a cabinet appraisal of the EU-Mercosur agreement in the spring, based on the draft texts of the negotiated agreement of 6 December 2024.
Naar verwachting ontvangt uw Kamer in het voorjaar een kabinetsappreciatie van het EU-Mercosur akkoord op basis van de conceptteksten van het onderhandelaarsakkoord van 6 december 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van der Lee en Hirsch over het over het bericht 'EU Omnibus: EU finance ministers back proposal, Parliament heavily divided'

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about the Ecofinraad discussion of the 'stop-the-clock' proposal delaying CSRD sustainability reporting, and whether the minister urged extending the pause to first-wave companies. The minister confirmed he suggested that first-wave companies also receive a pause, citing the Commission's planned scope reduction and simplification of ESRS, while stating the NFRD remains in force and the Chamber would be informed in time.
However, I made clear in the Ecofin Council that the Netherlands is still studying the proposal and there is not yet an official cabinet position.
Wel heb ik in de Ecofinraad duidelijk gemaakt dat Nederland het voorstel nog aan het bestuderen is en er nog geen officiële kabinetspositie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Troebele Hollands glorie in de Baai van Manilla: hoe baggeraar Boskalis zich vertilde aan een prestigeproject'

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about the Dutch export credit guarantee for the Manila Bay airport project by Boskalis and San Miguel, raising sea-level rise, habitat compensation, relocated families and transparency concerns. The government answered that the project meets international standards, that compensation is being monitored and largely delivered, and that it sees no reason to change its decision.

An independent evaluation of the monitoring of this project, recently shared with your House, shows that it is robust and adequately designed to address any irregularities in implementation in a timely manner.

Uit een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de monitoring van dit project die recent met uw Kamer is gedeeld, blijkt dat deze robuust is en adequaat is ingericht om eventuele misstanden in de uitvoering tijdig te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over de situatie in de Democratische Republiek Congo en de rol van de Europese Unie

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, the effects of the US freeze of USAID, the EU-Rwanda raw materials memorandum, sanctions and MONUSCO. The ministers answered that the Netherlands funds humanitarian aid, calls for a ceasefire and Rwandan withdrawal, supports EU discussions on suspending the MoU and sanctions, and will send a separate letter on the humanitarian situation and MONUSCO.
The Netherlands raises Rwanda's support for M23 and its violation of DRC sovereignty bilaterally, through the EU and through the International Contact Group for the Great Lakes.
Nederland spreekt Rwanda bilateraal, via de EU, en via de International Contact Group for the Great Lakes (ICG) aan op zijn steun voor M23 en zijn schending van de soevereiniteit van de DRC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over de beschieting van het Wereldvoedselprogramma door Israëlische troepen

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the government about the Israeli shooting at a clearly marked WFP convoy in January 2025, whether such attacks breach international humanitarian law, and whether the Netherlands signalled concern to Israel. The minister answered that attacks on humanitarian workers violate IHL, that a court and Israel itself must establish the facts before a breach can be judged, and that the Netherlands raised concerns with Israel and urged compliance.
The cabinet does not have all the relevant facts.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over alle relevante feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de protesten in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about the post-election protests in Mozambique, police violence, Rwandan troops funded by EU money, and Dutch trade interests. The minister said the Netherlands condemns violence against civilians via the EU and bilaterally, denies that Rwandan troops are involved in repression, and sees no reason for independent investigation.
In my view there is no reason for an independent investigation.
Tot een onafhankelijk onderzoek bestaat naar mijn mening geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een project in Kazachstan

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about a 2014 Dutch export credit guarantee for a Van Oord canal project at Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan, including corruption, UBO ownership of the debtor Tenizservice, environmental and social risk assessment, and monitoring. The ministers answered that no claims were paid, the project was assessed under the 2014 policy with risks judged mitigated, UBO identification was not then required, and monitoring was introduced only from 2022.
No, at the time the policy was issued monitoring was not yet laid down in the policy.
Nee, ten tijde van afgifte van de polis was monitoring nog niet vastgelegd in het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Hirsch over het bericht dat Nederland inzet op een bilaterale handelsrelatie met de VS

MPs Thijssen and Hirsch asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands was pursuing a bilateral trade relationship with the US, including contacts with Trump's team, the role of the EU, and the risk of undermining joint EU trade policy. The government answered that it maintains broad stakeholder contacts, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence while member states may pursue bilateral economic cooperation, and that it will keep coordinating within the EU while strengthening bilateral economic ties with the US.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Hirsch over de uitkomsten van de COP29

Two MPs asked the Climate and Foreign Trade ministers whether they were satisfied with COP29's outcomes, including the climate finance goal, fossil fuel phase-down, and the protection of human rights and gender equality. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is partly satisfied, commits to the Paris goals and to a meaningful climate finance contribution, and points to further discussion in 2025 without committing to new funding.
The cabinet has chosen to first send the letter to the Chamber appraising the outcomes of COP29.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om eerst de Kamerbrief met de appreciatie van de uitkomsten van COP29 te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Hirsch en Nordkamp over de handhaving van de internationale rechtsorde ten aanzien van Israël

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel, journalist access to Gaza, and Israel's halt on visas for international NGO staff. The minister answered that two military export licences were granted since 7 October 2023, 28 dual-use licences in 2024, that F-35 parts and engines are no longer exported to Israel after the court ruling, and that Israel should allow journalists and aid workers access but no sanctions or consequences were announced.
The Netherlands calls on Israel to facilitate the work of aid organisations, including by improving visa issuance.
Nederland roept Israël op om het werk van hulporganisaties te faciliteren, inclusief middels verbetering van visumverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Zeedijk over steun aan het maatschappelijk middenveld wereldwijd

MPs Hirsch and Zeedijk asked the minister about pressure on civil society worldwide, its role in supply chains and development, and whether the Civic Space Fund will be maintained. The minister largely agreed with the concerns and described existing business-NGO cooperation, but on the Civic Space Fund and the motion-based questions referred to a letter on new policy and gave no concrete commitment.
On the new policy I have informed you in the letter Future cooperation with civil society organisations in development aid.
Over het nieuwe beleid heb ik u geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief Toekomst samenwerking met maatschappelijke organisaties in ontwikkelingshulp
Antwoord op op vragen van het de leden Piri en Hirsch over de brief inzake het contact tussen de minister van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp en de Oegandese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Piri and Hirsch asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about his meeting with Uganda's foreign minister, including whether returning rejected asylum seekers from the Netherlands to Uganda was discussed and whether a meeting report exists. The minister confirmed the letter, said asylum reception and returns were discussed (returns previously at official level), and said a report of the whole Uganda visit exists with the meeting included, though no separate report was made.
A report was made of the entire visit to Uganda. The conversation with the Ugandan Minister of Foreign Affairs is included in this report.
Van het gehele bezoek aan Oeganda is een verslag gemaakt. Het gesprek met de Oegandese Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken is in dit verslag opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Hirsch over recente ontwikkelingen in Israël-Palestina

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government how it views Israeli laws threatening UNRWA's operations in the occupied Palestinian territories, whether the Netherlands should join partner statements against them, and about humanitarian access, the Israeli 'General Plan' and possible responses. The government answered that the laws are worrying, that Israel as occupying power must ensure alternatives to UNRWA services and humanitarian access, and that it is too early to speculate on consequences while it presses Israel through bilateral, EU and UN channels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het aanstaande werkbezoek aan Oeganda

The MP Hirsch asks the minister about a planned visit to Uganda, including whether the minister will meet NGOs opposing the EACOP oil pipeline, how the government assesses the project and the arrests of activists, and the anti-homosexuality law. The minister answers that the visit already took place in October, lists meetings held, says the government has no own appreciation of the pipeline, and states that human rights and the anti-LGBTI law were raised in the bilateral meeting with the Ugandan justice minister.
The cabinet has no own appreciation of this project and its consequences.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigen appreciatie van dit project en de gevolgen hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Thijssen over Chinese dreigementen om ASML van Chinese markt te weren

MPs Hirsch and Thijssen asked whether China has threatened to exclude ASML from its market, what the consequences would be, and whether the Netherlands will adopt additional US-style export restrictions. Minister Klever declined to discuss diplomatic contacts or speculate on impacts, stating that Dutch export controls are national security decisions and that further measures would be pursued multilaterally and in EU coordination.
The cabinet cannot go into the content of confidential diplomatic conversations.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de inhoud van vertrouwelijke diplomatieke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Hirsch over de veroordeling van milieuactivisten in Cambodja

Hirsch (GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the ministers whether they will condemn and press for the release of ten Mother Nature environmental activists convicted in Cambodia, and whether the shrinking civil society space is unacceptable. Minister Veldkamp answers that UN experts found due process was not respected, that the embassy in Bangkok monitors the case and raises human rights in bilateral and UPR settings, and that a decision on civil society policy under the new cabinet will follow later.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the matter and speak out where possible and appropriate.
Nederland zal de kwestie blijven volgen en zich uitspreken waar dat mogelijk en passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het nieuwe Oxfam-rapport Water War Crimes van 17 juli

An MP asked the government about an Oxfam report alleging Israel uses water deprivation as a weapon in Gaza, citing per-capita water access figures, ICJ provisional measures and Dutch water diplomacy. The minister acknowledged the severe shortage, urged Israel to comply with ICJ measures and said Nederland will keep raising the issue bilaterally, while stating that consequences for Israel are not yet linked to the failure to improve access.

The Netherlands sees diplomatic engagement with Israel, both bilaterally and multilaterally, together with the funding and support for aid organisations mentioned in answer 8, as currently the most effective way to achieve results.

Nederland ziet diplomatieke inzet richting Israël, zowel bilateraal als multilateraal, in samenhang met de onder antwoord 8 genoemde financiering en steun aan hulporganisaties, op dit moment als de meest effectieve manier om resultaten te bereiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Bushoff over het besluit van Nederland om vooralsnog niet in te gaan op de oproep van de WHO om mpox-vaccins naar Afrika te sturen

MPs Hirsch and Bushoff asked why the Netherlands is not donating mpox vaccines to Africa despite WHO's call and the international emergency, and how the risk trade-off was made. The Minister replies that the Netherlands keeps its national stockpile of about 100,000 doses, cannot donate because of its national safety buffer and expiring stock, and contributes EUR 3 million to WHO's response plan instead.
I am currently not making vaccines available for donation to other countries, because the stock in the Netherlands would then fall below the national safety buffer.
Ik stel op dit moment geen vaccins beschikbaar voor donatie aan andere landen, omdat de voorraad in Nederland daarmee onder de nationale veiligheidsbuffer zou zakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de situatie in Bangladesh

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development how the Netherlands will support a peaceful, democratic transition in Bangladesh after the fall of Sheikh Hasina, investigate alleged human rights violations during protests, and protect garment workers. The government answered that it supports human rights defenders, backs a UN OHCHR inquiry, supports monitoring, and works with ILO, IFC and partners on garment-sector labour conditions.
The Netherlands intends to continue this support during this important transition period in Bangladesh.
Nederland is voornemens deze steun voort te zetten in deze belangrijke tijd van transitie in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken waarschuwde voor humanitaire gevolgen stop steun UNRWA’

An MP asked whether the government was warned in a February memo that suspending UNRWA funding would cause regional destabilisation and human suffering, and how the January suspension decision was reached. The minister answers that the memo concerned risks of prolonged or suspended committed support, that funding was paused to signal seriousness about allegations, and that the decision lies with the minister for foreign trade and development, without detailing internal disagreement.
The decision on financing to UNRWA falls within the responsibility of the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Assistance.
Het besluit over financiering aan UNRWA ligt binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Piri over het bericht 'Anti-Palestijnse desinformatie in de Kamer: ‘Dit is niet hoe het hoort te gaan’'

MPs Hirsch and Piri asked the ministers about a Groene Amsterdammer report that former minister Van Leeuwen suspended UNRWA funding unilaterally, whether he consulted advisers, his deleted social media posts, and UNRWA's role. Minister Klever answered that the decision was within his responsibility, no advisory memo was prepared, no evidence has been provided that UNRWA funds were used in the 7 October attack, and that the deleted posts were not managed by the ministry, though most questions were answered only in part and some were declined as not appropriate to account for.
A Minister is entitled to ask civil servants for advice before decision-making (and to decide whom to ask), but is not obliged to do so.
Een Minister is bevoegd om voorafgaand aan besluitvorming advies aan ambtenaren te vragen (en te beslissen aan wie), maar is daartoe niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bloedbad bij studentenprotesten in Bangladesh

Hirsch asked the ministers about the deadly crackdown on student protests in Bangladesh, its impact on stability, communication shutdowns, the bilateral relationship, and what Netherlands and EU steps are being taken. The government condemned the violence, described the situation and the EU's suspension of PCA talks, and said it is pressing for a peaceful democratic transition and independent investigation.
The Netherlands and the EU immediately strongly condemned the violence by the Bangladeshi authorities against peaceful demonstrators and called for the protection of peaceful demonstrators.
Nederland en de EU hebben het geweld van de Bangladeshi autoriteiten richting vreedzame demonstranten onmiddellijk sterk veroordeeld en opgeroepen tot bescherming van vreedzame demonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch and Teunissen asked the government about the export credit insurance for the TotalEnergies LNG project in Mozambique, including the 2021 Palma attacks, independent investigations, security conditions, civil society input and the transparency of the review by Atradius DSB. The Secretary of State answered that the review is ongoing, that the Palma events are part of it, that no claims have been made under the policies, and that the government will keep the usual decision procedure without parliamentary discussion beforehand, while promising to inform parliament once the decision is final.

The cabinet attaches great value to transparent implementation of the export credit insurance, but at the same time takes into account commercial confidentiality and competition considerations and an international level playing field for a well-functioning system.

Het kabinet hecht veel waarde aan een transparante uitvoering van de ekv en er wordt tegelijkertijd voor een goed functioneren van de ekv rekening gehouden met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke- en concurrentieoverwegingen en een internationaal gelijkspeelveld.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de situatie in Soedan

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian crisis in Sudan, regional arms supplies, access for local aid groups and Emergency Response Rooms, EU and Jeddah-process diplomacy, civil society involvement in peace talks, and support for accountability and monitoring mechanisms. The Minister answered that Nederland is engaging regional partners and the EU, funds local organisations through the Sudan Humanitarian Fund and the Dutch Relief Alliance, supports civil society in peace processes, and backs accountability efforts including the Fact Finding Mission, while noting UN funding constraints.
The Netherlands will work to extend the mandate of the Fact Finding Mission on Sudan at the September session of the Human Rights Council this year.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor verlenging van het mandaat van de Fact Finding Mission on Sudan tijdens de septemberzitting van de Mensenrechtenraad dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over hoe Nederlandse klimaatfinanciering ten goede komt aan vrouwen en gemarginaliseerde groepen

An MP asked the minister how Dutch climate finance through the Dutch Fund for Climate and Development (DFCD) benefits women and marginalised groups, citing an ActionAid report and evaluations. The minister acknowledged that more attention to marginalised groups and gender is needed in DFCD implementation, noted the fund's primary aim of climate-resilient growth, and described measures and other programmes reaching these groups, while leaving the design of a successor fund to a new minister.
The cabinet appreciates it when third parties such as ActionAid carry out research.
Het kabinet waardeert het als derden zoals ActionAid onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor de baggersector

MPs Hirsch and Teunissen asked the government about export credit insurance for dredging projects in Brazil, Egypt, the Philippines, the Maldives, Mozambique and Indonesia, including harms to fishers and farmers, the Mozambique LNG reassessment, human rights risks, withdrawal of cover, compliance with a 2018 motion, and transparency of ESAPs. The government answered that it does not recognise the report's picture, that a reassessment of Mozambique LNG is underway with results to be communicated, that it will not withdraw the policies, and that OECD and ADSB transparency rules limit publication of contract documents.
The cabinet is not considering withdrawing the export credit insurance for these projects.
Het kabinet overweegt niet om de exportkredietverzekeringen in te trekken voor deze projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de betrokkenheid van Nederland bij Ibu Kota Nusantara Indonesië

The MP asks the minister about Dutch involvement in Indonesia's new capital Nusantara, including concerns over land grabs, corruption, indigenous rights and the human rights impact of the new president. The minister answers that the Netherlands is not currently running activities in Nusantara, has only held talks on water management and SDG-aligned cooperation, and refers to general anti-corruption and due diligence expectations for Dutch companies.
The Dutch government is not currently carrying out any activities of its own concerning the new capital.
De Nederlandse overheid voert op dit moment zelf geen activiteiten uit rondom de nieuwe hoofdstad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga en Stoffer over toegenomen Nederlandse importen uit de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MPs Ceder, Hirsch, Bamenga and Stoffer asked whether Dutch imports from Xinjiang rose, whether Oeigoeren forced labour is increasing, and how businesses, consumers and the EU forced-labour regulation and CSDDD address this. The minister could not verify the trade figures, said the government cannot confirm the Zenz findings, expects companies to apply OECD and UN guidance, and said enforcement of the forced-labour regulation will apply from around autumn 2027.
However, the government has no independent information position on the situation on the ground and therefore cannot confirm the specific conclusions of this research.
Het kabinet heeft echter geen eigenstandige informatiepositie over de situatie ter plaatse en kan de specifieke conclusies van dit onderzoek dus niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de laatste stand van zaken rondom de 36 Afghaanse studentes

An MP asked the development minister about the latest on 36 Afghan female students at the NAEC in Kabul who were given diplomas without completing their education, and whether the embassy still keeps contact and what support is planned. The minister answered that the embassy no longer has contact, that a Qatar option proved unfeasible for practical and security reasons, and that the embassy is exploring work-placement options via a UN partner without results so far.
So far, talks on offering work placements to the graduated students have not yet produced any result, but the embassy continues to make efforts in this regard.
Vooralsnog hebben gesprekken over het aanbieden van werkervaringsplekken voor de afgestudeerde studentes nog geen resultaat opgeleverd, maar de ambassade blijft zich hiervoor inspannen.

m: Motie van de leden Six Dijkstra en Van Waveren over de mogelijkheid onderzoeken voor een boetebepaling of andere sanctiemechanismen bij overtreding van integriteitsregels

Asks the government to examine adding fines or other legal or administrative sanctions for breaches of integrity rules for former ministers and state secretaries, and to consider this in the statutory evaluation.
requests the government to examine the possibility of adding, in addition to the Post-Ministerial Positions Act, a fine provision or other legal or administrative sanction mechanisms

verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheid te onderzoeken om in aanvulling op de Wet regels vervolgfuncties bewindspersonen een boetebepaling of andere juridische of bestuurlijke sanctiemechanismen op te nemen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Waveren ter vervanging van nr. 18 over aanvullende uitzonderingen op de adviesplicht

Extends the exemption from the advisory obligation for former ministers taking up posts such as MEPs, mayors, aldermen and Raad van State or Audit Office members, thereby removing advisory review for those appointments.
The submitter therefore proposes extending the exception to the list of functions above.
Indiener stelt daarom voor om de uitzondering uit te breiden naar de lijst met bovenstaande functies.
Amendement van het lid Van Waveren over een systeem van ontheffing voor het aanvaarden van functies met de mogelijkheid van handhaving middels bestuurlijke boete
Requires former ministers to obtain a Prime Minister's exemption for post-office jobs within two years, backed by an administrative fine for violations.
This amendment provides that a former minister is obliged, in the two years after leaving office, to ask the Prime Minister for an exemption.
Dit amendement regelt dat een gewezen bewindspersoon in de periode van twee jaar na het neerleggen van zijn ambt verplicht is om de Minister-President te verzoeken om een ontheffing.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Waveren ter vervanging van nr. 14 over aanvullende uitzonderingen op de adviesplicht
Amendment extends the exemption from the advisory requirement for former ministers taking up posts such as mayor, alderman, King's Commissioner or EU Commissioner.
The submitter therefore proposes to extend the exception to these functions.
De indiener stelt daarom voor om de uitzondering uit te breiden naar deze functies.
Amendement van de leden Wijen-Nass en Van Waveren over het instrueren door de volmachtgever op welke kandidaat de gemachtigde moet stemmen
Adds to the postal/proxy voting rules that the voter must instruct the proxy holder on which candidate to vote for.
and instructs the proxy on which candidate the vote must be cast on his behalf
en instrueert de gemachtigde op welke kandidaat de stem namens hem moet worden uitgebracht
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Wijen-Nass en Van Waveren ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het instrueren door de volmachtgever op welke kandidaat de gemachtigde moet stemmen
Requires that a voter who gives a proxy also instruct the proxy holder on which candidate to vote for or to vote blank.
The proxy-giver timely informs the proxy holder how he wants the proxy exercised
De volmachtgever informeert de gemachtigde tijdig over de wijze waarop hij wil dat de volmacht wordt uitgeoefend
Amendement van het lid Van Waveren over de ontheffingsbevoegdheid bij de minister-president beleggen
Shifts the power to grant exemptions to former office holders from individual ministers to the Prime Minister, centralising the process and advice.
by establishing that the advice is requested by and also given to the Prime Minister
door vast te leggen dat het advies door de Minister-President wordt gevraagd en ook aan hem wordt uitgebracht
Amendement van het lid Van Waveren over een voorhang van benoemingsbesluiten voor leden van het ARPA
Amendment requires that appointment proposals for ARPA members not be submitted until four weeks after the draft decree is laid before both Houses, giving parliament a pre-review.
The proposal for a royal decree under article 11(1) of the Framework Act on advisory bodies is not made earlier than four weeks after the draft is submitted to both Houses.

De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in artikel 11, eerste lid, van de Kaderwet adviescolleges wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Van Waveren over een uiterlijke inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2026
Sets 1 July 2026 as the latest entry-into-force date for a bill strengthening integrity safeguards and political accountability, while allowing earlier entry by royal decree.
especially where the legislation concerns strengthening integrity safeguards and political accountability
zeker waar het wetgeving betreft die integriteitswaarborgen en politieke verantwoordelijkheid versterkt
Amendement van het lid Van Waveren over aanvullende uitzonderingen op de adviesplicht
Amendment extending the advisory-obligation exemption for former ministers taking up posts such as mayor, alderman or EU commissioner, to other public offices.
This however leaves other public offices, such as mayors, aldermen, and commissioners of the King, out of consideration.
Dit laat echter andere publieke ambten, zoals burgemeesters, wethouders, dijkgraven, gedeputeerden, commissarissen van de Koning en eurocommissarissen, buiten beschouwing.
Motie van het lid Van Waveren over de toegang tot de Kiesraad voor klachten verduidelijken
Asks the government to clarify which complaints and signals, including from individual citizens, can lead the Kiesraad to issue procedural instructions during elections.
requests the government to clarify access to the Electoral Council for complaints about the electoral process
verzoekt de regering de toegang tot de Kiesraad voor klachten over het verkiezingsproces te verduidelijken
Motie van het lid Van Waveren over aanvullende waarborgen in de Wet bescherming klokkenluiders om klokkenluiders in het kader van anonimiteit en veiligheid beter te beschermen
Motion asks government to examine additional safeguards for whistleblowers' anonymity and safety in the Whistleblower Protection Act amendment.
to better protect whistleblowers at these organisations in terms of anonymity and safety
om klokkenluiders bij deze organisaties in het kader van de anonimiteit en de veiligheid beter te beschermen
Motie van het lid Van Waveren over in beeld brengen welke constateringen of oordelen van de autoriteiten grondslag bieden om overtreders van de Wet bescherming klokkenluiders te sanctioneren
Asks the government to map which findings or judgments by authorities could already sanction violators of the whistleblower protection act, and inform the House before summer.
requests the government to map which findings or judgments of the authorities provide sufficient basis to sanction violators now already
verzoekt de regering in beeld te brengen welke constateringen of oordelen van de autoriteiten voldoende grondslag bieden om overtreders nu al te sanctioneren
qa: Antwoord op het lid Van Waveren over de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid en de ontwikkeling van de Rijksdienst

An MP asked whether the government still backs its targets for regional distribution of central government jobs, how the coordinating role of the Minister of Interior has been implemented, what concrete relocations have resulted, and how the budget cut (taakstelling) affects regional spreading. The minister answers that the government continues the effort, cites examples and an upcoming annual report, but says concrete results are limited so far and that the cut is left to individual ministers, with a principle that shrinkage happens mainly in the Randstad.

In the annual report on the state of the regional distribution of central government jobs (letter to parliament to be sent in early September), an overview of cases worked on over the past year will be presented, as promised in the committee debate of 5 February 2025.

In de jaarlijkse rapportage over de stand van de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid (Kamerbrief te verzenden begin september) wordt, zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat Regio's en grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van 5 februari 2025, een overzicht gepresenteerd van casussen waaraan het afgelopen jaar is gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Waveren en Idsinga over de bezorging van overheidspost

MPs Van Waveren and Idsinga asked ministers about the National Ombudsman's warning that late or failed delivery of government post harms citizens. The minister answered that complaint data is kept centrally via PostNL under the Rijksbrede postcontract, that responsibility for mail delivery and legal consequences is shared across departments and courts, and that the ACM study on the postal market will inform further policy.
There is no record within the Ministry of Economic Affairs or the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations of such internal reports.
Er is binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geen registratie waarin dergelijke interne meldingen staan.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Waveren over de inzet van het kabinet voor de versobering van de Algemene Bestuursdienst (ABD)

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why the proposed reform of the Algemene Bestuursdienst (ABD) removing salary scale 15 from its target group is presented as austerity, how it affects HR, recruitment and external intake, and why scales rather than organisational roles were used. The minister answered that the options are still under study, that decentralising services to departments is expected to substantially reduce ABD service provision (though it is not primarily a cost measure), that conditions for talent oversight and central development will be kept, and promised a letter before the summer recess.
