The cited decision memorandum does not describe any considerations.
In de genoemde beslisnota staan geen afwegingen beschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Waveren over het puntensysteem dat de gemeente Utrecht hanteert bij de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken en in strijd is met de wet

Van Waveren asked the Minister of Interior whether Utrecht's point-based prioritisation of Woo requests, which deducts points for multiple requests and treats journalists differently, is lawful and whether the ministry oversees such practices. The minister said the municipality may prioritise within Woo limits, that no oversight body supervises decentralised Woo handling beyond objection and appeal, and that an evaluation of the Woo will start at the end of this year.
There is no body that supervises the handling of Woo requests by decentralised governments.
Er is geen instantie die toezicht houdt op de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken van decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Waveren en Van Campen over het bericht “EU betaalt voor 'groene promotie'; Subsidie aan milieuclubs in ruil voor lobby”

MPs Omtzigt, Van Waveren and Van Campen asked the Foreign Minister whether EU Commission subsidies to NGOs for lobbying MEPs on climate plans ("lobbycontracten") were known to the Dutch government, whether the Commission should be pressed for disclosure, and whether Dutch ministries have similarly commissioned lobbying. The minister answered that the Dutch government had no knowledge of these contracts, that no transparency rules were reported broken, that the government awaits the Commission's follow-up, and that no central overview of Dutch subsidies for lobbying is kept.
The cabinet awaits further steps from the Commission.
Het kabinet wacht nadere stappen van de Commissie af.

m: Amendement van het lid Boekestijn over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op vaccinatie van kinderen (GAVI Alliance)
Shifts 6 million euro in the foreign affairs budget from one aid article to another to restore funding for child vaccination through GAVI.
this amendment therefore aims to reduce the cut to the GAVI Alliance organisation
met dit amendement wordt dan ook beoogd om de bezuiniging op de organisatie GAVI Alliance terug te dringen
Amendement van het lid Boekestijn over het terugdringen van de overheidsfinanciering van ngo's
Cuts development aid spending across several ODA budget articles, mainly NGO funding and aid to South America and Asia, and reduces NGO government financing to 25%.
In the recalculation of the CPB counter-budget, the VVD found it could cut 1.39 billion from the development cooperation budget.
In de doorberekening van de tegenbegroting van het CPB bleek dat de VVD 1,39 miljard kon bezuinigen op de begroting voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Motie-Eijsink/Boekestijn over een volwaardig onderzoek naar het functioneren van de MGGZ

Asks the government to have the health inspectorates conduct a full investigation into the functioning of military mental health care, including direct client experiences, and to report to the House within a year.
requests the government to instruct the IMG and IGZ to conduct a full investigation into the functioning of the military mental health care
verzoekt de regering de IMG en IGZ alsnog de opdracht te geven tot een volwaardig onderzoek naar het functioneren van de MGGZ
Amendement van het lid Boekestijn over het invoeren van een expliciete redelijkheidstoets
Adds a reasonableness defence so soldiers who reasonably believe their use of force follows lawful duties and rules are not criminally liable, leaving courts room to assess circumstances.
Not punishable is the soldier who may reasonably assume that the force he uses occurs in the lawful exercise of his duty
Niet strafbaar is de militair die er redelijkerwijs vanuit mag gaan dat het geweld dat hij gebruikt, geschiedt in de rechtmatige uitoefening van zijn taak
Motie Boekestijn over afzetten van gerealiseerde prestaties tegen voornemens in de begroting
Asks the government to compare realised performance in the 2009 annual report with the plans in the budget, paying special attention to the investment quota, so the Chamber can exercise control.
requests the government in the 2009 annual report to set the realised performance against what the Ministry of Defence had planned in the budget
verzoekt de regering in het jaarverslag 2009 de gerealiseerde prestaties af te zetten tegen wat het ministerie van Defensie zich in de begroting had voorgenomen
Motie Boekestijn over een tijdpad voor de invoering van een betrouwbaar tracking- en tracingsysteem
Asks the government to provide the House every half year with a timeline, financing, interim targets and results for a reliable weapons tracking and tracing system.
requests the government to provide the House every half year with a timeline with financing, interim targets and achieved results
verzoekt de regering de Kamer halfjaarlijks een tijdpad te overleggen met de financiering, tussendoelen en bereikte resultaten
Motie Boekestijn en Eijsink over aangeven van de begrenzingen in tijd, geld en resultaat per deelproject
Asks government to report in an additional half-yearly report the time, money and result limits per sub-project in the Defence project, so the House can exercise control.
so that the House can exercise its supervisory task
zodat de Kamer haar controlerende taak kan uitoefenen
Motie van het lid Boekestijn over een convenant met de reservistenorganisaties over ondersteunende taken
Asks the government to support reservist organisations in tasks to be laid down in a new convenant and to report to the House by 1 October 2009.
requests the government to support the reservist organisations in these areas and to record these supporting tasks in the convenant to be drawn up
verzoekt de regering de reservistenorganisaties op deze gebieden te ondersteunen en deze ondersteunende taken in het op te stellen convenant vast te leggen
Motie Knops c.s. over onderzoek naar de inzet van reservisten in andere landen
Asks the government to research how the US, Canada and Australia use reservists, including operational deployment and costs, and report to the House.
requests the government to conduct research in countries with much experience using reservists within the armed forces: the US, Canada and Australia
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen in landen met veel ervaring met de inzet van reservisten binnen de krijgsmacht: de VS, Canada en Australië
Motie Van Bommel / Boekestijn over geen grote Nederlandse missie in Afghanistan na 2010
Declares that no new large Dutch military mission will be undertaken in Afghanistan after 2010, citing the strain on the armed forces.
declares that there will be no new large Dutch mission in Afghanistan after 2010
spreekt uit dat er geen nieuwe grote Nederlandse missie in Afghanistan zal zijn na 2010
Motie Eijsink c.s. over uiterlijk in de maand september 2009 aanbieden van de blauwdruk Opleiding &Training
Asks the state secretary to submit the Training and Education blueprint to the House by September 2009 rather than vaguely 'in time for the budget debate'.
requests the government to submit the Training and Education blueprint to the House no later than September 2009
verzoekt de regering de blauwdruk Opleiding & Training uiterlijk in de maand september 2009 aan de Kamer aan te bieden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boekestijn ter vervanging van nr. 62 over het laten vervallen van de bijdragen aan medefinancieringsorganisaties
Cuts development aid budget lines, including payments to co-financing organisations (MFOs), to reduce spending and redirect funds.
According to the ministry's statement, a total of 729 million euros of the budget goes to co-financing organisations
Volgens de opgave van het ministerie gaat in totaal 729 miljoen euro van de begroting naar medefinancieringsorganisaties
Motie Voordewind c.s. over eigen UAV-capaciteit ter vervanging van de Sperwer
Asks the government to develop its own UAV capability to replace the Sperwer reconnaissance drone, instead of hiring civilian intelligence capacity, preferably by 2011.
requests the government, as part of developing counter-insurgency capacity, to ensure as soon as possible and preferably before 2011 its own UAV capability to replace the Sperwer

verzoekt de regering in het kader van de ontwikkeling van capaciteit gericht op counter insurgency, zo snel als mogelijk en bij voorkeur vóór 2011, zorg te dragen voor een eigen UAV-capaciteit ter vervanging van de Sperwer
Motie Van der Staaij / Boekestijn over de budgettaire consequenties van de verkenningen
Asks government to state in the final defence exploration report the budgetary consequences and policy conclusions that can be drawn already in this cabinet term.
also explicitly consider which budgetary consequences and policy conclusions can already be attached to the explorations in this cabinet term
ook uitdrukkelijk te bezien welke budgettaire consequenties en beleidsconclusies reeds in deze kabinetsperiode kunnen worden verbonden aan de verkenningen
Motie van het lid Boekestijn over reductie van de termijn waarbinnen innovatieve projecten tot wasdom komen
Motion asks the government to explore how to shorten the time innovative defence projects take to mature.
requests the government to explore how the period in which innovative projects mature can be reduced
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken hoe de termijn waarbinnen innovatieve projecten tot wasdom komen, kan worden gereduceerd
Motie Boekestijn / Van der Staaij over verruiming van de HGIS-afspraken
Asks the government to explore broadening the HGIS budget arrangements so that the extra costs of crisis-management operations can be financed from the designated fund.
requests the government to examine the possibilities for broadening the HGIS arrangements on financing crisis-management operations
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoek om te komen tot verruiming van de HGIS-afspraken ten aanzien van de financiering van crisisbeheersingsoperaties
Motie Eijsink c.s. over rapportage over de voortgang van het SPEER-project
Asks the government to report to the Chamber on progress of the SPEER IT project, including concrete time, money and result limits, with the first supplementary budget.
requests the government to submit to the Chamber a progress report on the SPEER project no later than the first supplementary budget for 2009
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk bij de aanbieding van de eerste suppletoire begroting over 2009 de Kamer een rapportage aan te bieden over de voortgang van het SPEER-project
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Boekestijn ter vervanging van nr. 29 voor het schrappen van de bijdrage aan medefinancieringsorganisatie (MFO's) en andere posten
Cuts the development budget by removing contributions to co-financing organisations (MFOs) and several other line items, redirecting the freed funds to tax relief and debt reduction.
Motie Diks c.s. over een vrouwenparagraaf in de "stand van zaken"-brief
Asks the government to add a women's rights paragraph to country 'state of affairs' letters where relevant.
requests the government to add a women's paragraph to each country state-of-affairs letter where relevant
verzoekt de regering om, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, in elke «stand van zaken»-brief over een land een vrouwenparagraaf toe te voegen
Motie Boekestijn over het verbreken van alle banden tussen de Inspectie Ontwikkelingssamenwerking en Beleidsevaluatie en het ministerie
Asks the government to cut all financial, personnel and administrative ties between the development evaluation inspectorate and the ministry and send its reports directly to parliament.
Sever all financial, personnel and administrative ties between this inspectorate and the ministry and in future send the reports directly to the House of Representatives.
alle financiële, personele en bestuurlijke banden tussen deze inspectie en het ministerie te verbreken en de rapporten in het vervolg direct naar de Kamer te zenden
Motie Boekestijn over het niet meer meestijgen van het OS-budget met de groei van het BNP
Asks the government to stop linking the development aid budget to GDP growth so that it no longer rises automatically with GDP.
requests the government not to let the development aid budget rise with GDP growth any more
verzoekt de regering het OS-budget niet meer mee te laten stijgen met de groei van het BNP
Motie Boekestijn over het niet geven van begrotingssteun aan Rwanda
Asks the government not to give budget support to Rwanda's government in 2009 because of its support for rebels in eastern Congo.
requests the government to give the government of Rwanda no budget support in 2009
verzoekt de regering om in 2009 de regering van Rwanda geen begrotingssteun te geven
Amendement van het lid Boekestijn voor het schrappen van de bijdrage aan medefinancieringsorganisaties (MFO's) en andere posten
Cuts foreign aid budget lines, including contributions to co-financing organisations, to free funds for tax relief.
the freed-up funds, namely 1 billion euro, serve to cover tax relief proposals
De vrijvallende middelen, te weten 1 miljard euro, dienen ter dekking van de lastenverlichtingvoorstellen

Amendement van het lid Boekestijn om de belastinbetaler een daadwerkeleijke financiële vergoeding te geven van 190.00 euro als compensatie voor het ten onrechte aan mw. Herfkens als 'huursubsidie' uit
Cuts the Foreign Affairs budget by 190,000 euro so that the amount wrongly paid to Ms Herfkens as housing subsidy is returned to the treasury.
Wrongly, 190,000 euros was paid out of general funds to Ms Herfkens in the form of a housing subsidy.
Ten onrechte is van de algemene middelen € 190 000,– uitgekeerd aan mevrouw Herfkens in de vorm van huursubsidie.
Motie Boekestijn over het starten van een rechtszaak om de aan mevrouw Herfkens uitbetaalde huursuppletie terug te vorderen
Asks the government to sue former minister Herfkens to recover a rent supplement she wrongly received.
requests the government to start a lawsuit to recover the wrongly paid rent supplement from Ms Herfkens
verzoekt de regering een rechtszaak te starten om de onterecht uitbetaalde huursuppletie terug te vorderen van mevrouw Herfkens
Motie Pechtold c.s. over wegnemen van de onrust bij de Krijgsmacht
Asks the government to quickly remove unrest in the armed forces caused by the defence minister's statements.
requests the government to remove this unrest in the short term
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn deze onrust weg te nemen
Motie Lempens over het aanvullen van het inkomen van deelnemers tot minimaal 100% van het minimumloon
Asks the government to amend the pilot bill so that participants' income is topped up to at least 100% of the minimum wage.
requests the government to amend the bill by memorandum so that participants' income is topped up to at least 100% of the minimum wage
verzoekt de regering het wetsvoorstel bij nota van wijziging zodanig aan te passen dat het inkomen van deelnemers aan de experimenten wordt aangevuld tot minimaal 100% van het minimumloon
Amendement van de leden Ulenbelt en Lempens om het budget voor de Sociale Werkvoorziening structureel te verhogen
Shifts €200 million structurally from the re-integration budget to the sheltered employment budget (Sociale Werkvoorziening).
This amendment provides for a structural increase in the budget for Sociale Werkvoorziening of 200 million, charged to the re-integration budget.
Dit amendement regelt een structurele verhoging van het budget voor de Sociale Werkvoorziening met 200 miljoen ten laste van het re-integratie budget.
Amendement van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Burg dat beoogt te voorkomen dat een (buitengewoon) ambtenaar van de burgerlijke stand uit gewetensbezwaren kan weigeren zijn taak te verrichten
Ensures civil registry officials cannot refuse to perform marriages or partnership registrations on grounds of conscience, and dismissal for such refusal is not deemed unreasonable.
to prevent a (special) civil registry officer from refusing to perform their duties on grounds of conscience
voorkomen dat een (buitengewoon) ambtenaar van de burgerlijke stand uit gewetensbezwaren kan weigeren zijn taak te verrichten
Amendement van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Çörüz ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een beperkte loslating van de indeling in sectoren

Removes the conditions allowing administrative refusal or withdrawal of subsidies and permits only for designated sectors, widening executive discretion and dropping the parliamentary pre-consultation requirement.
As a result, the pre-consultation requirement attached to Article 7, second paragraph, will also lapse.
Ten gevolge hiervan komt uiteraard ook de voorhangbepaling te vervallen die is verbonden aan artikel 7, tweede lid.
Amendement van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over een beperkte loslating van de indeling in sectoren
Amendment removes conditions limiting withdrawal of subsidies and municipal permits under the Bibob integrity act to designated sectors and regulations, widening the power to refuse or revoke.
Naming sectors to which the Bibob Act applies carries the risk that criminal activities shift to sectors outside the act
Het benoemen van sectoren ten aanzien waarvan de Wet Bibob van toepassing is, kent het risico dat criminele activiteiten worden verplaatst
Motie Slob c.s. over versterking van het brandpreventiebeleid
Asks the government to explore additional ways to strengthen fire prevention policy and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with relevant parties, to examine what additional options exist to further strengthen fire prevention policy
verzoekt de regering in overleg met betrokken partijen te onderzoeken welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er nog zijn
Motie Helder c.s. over een herdenkings- en bezinningsplaats ter ere van de slachtoffers van zinloos geweld
Asks the government to provide 38,000 euro to realise a memorial and reflection place for victims of senseless violence.
requests the government to make an amount of 38,000 euro available to make the realisation of the monument financially possible
verzoekt de regering een bedrag van € 38 000 ter beschikking te stellen om de realisatie van het monument financieel mogelijk te maken
Motie Çörüz c.s. over een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Asks the government to consult the police field on creating a veterans policy for police officers deployed abroad, modelled on Defence's policy.
requests the government to consult the field to gauge the need for developing a veterans policy for deployed police officers
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met het veld om de behoefte te peilen aan de ontwikkeling van een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Motie Brinkman c.s. over uniformiteit van competenties, taken, bevoegdheden en zichtbaarheid van de bestuurlijke toezichthouders
Asks the government to counter fragmentation of municipal enforcement by making competences, tasks, powers and uniform clothing of municipal supervisors uniform.
requests the government to counter this fragmentation of enforcement in the public domain
verzoekt de regering deze versnippering van de handhaving in het publieke domein tegen te gaan
Motie Elissen c.s. over erkenning van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers als officiële gesprekspartner
Asks the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner.
requests the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner
verzoekt de regering om de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers te erkennen als officiële gesprekspartner
Motie Hennis-Plasschaert c.s. over regionalisering van de brandweer
Asks the government to move towards regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law.
requests the government to proceed to regionalisation of the fire service within the Veiligheidsregio's law
verzoekt de regering over te gaan tot regionalisering van de brandweer binnen de wet Veiligheidsregio's
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over het door Shell georganiseerde festival Generation Discover 2017

Two MPs asked whether Defence and the national police, through paid stands and programme roles at Shell's Generation Discover festival, should withdraw support given Shell's fossil-fuel messaging to children. The Justice minister replied that no state subsidy was given, the stands were rented at market rates, and the government sees the partnerships as technology and cybercrime outreach, with no intention to withdraw.
There is no question of financial state support in the form of, for example, a subsidy.
Er is geen sprake van financiële rijkssteun in de vorm van bijvoorbeeld subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over de benoeming van een nieuw hoofd van de Griekse “Parliamentary Budget Office”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the appointment of Mr Koutentakis, a former government finance official, as head of the Greek Parliamentary Budget Office and whether this threatens its independence. The minister answered that the procedure appears to have been followed, that former civil servants can work independently, and that independence is for Greece to guard, with the ESM programme supporting it.
As far as is known, the applicable procedure was followed in this appointment.
Voor zover bekend is bij deze benoeming de hiervoor geldende procedure gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in Target2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins) asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 balances, financial fragmentation, possible capital flight, deposit discouragement, and whether TARGET2 should be an EU policy indicator. The minister replied that fragmentation persists but is declining, that the current balances stem from ECB asset purchases rather than capital flight, that discouraging deposits is undesirable, and that the government works on EU reforms to reduce the underlying imbalances.
As I also indicated in my answer to question 2, the current rise in TARGET2 balances differs fundamentally in origin from the rise during the crisis.
Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 2 heb aangegeven, verschilt de huidige oploop van TARGET2-saldi wezenlijk in oorsprong van de oploop ten tijden van de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in TARGET2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

MPs Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert and Bruins asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 imbalances across euro countries, whether they are better balanced than in 2012, whether mitigation is desirable, and how the risks (including exit scenarios and accounting) are assessed. The minister answered with the country balances, explained the post-2015 rise as driven by QE, stated that the euro-exit scenario is speculative and that TARGET2 balances are not a government-debt indicator, and noted no EU plans to rebalance TARGET2.
There are no plans on the European agenda to rebalance the TARGET2 system.
Er zijn geen plannen op de Europese agenda om het TARGET2-systeem meer in balans te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de mishandeling van een Oegandese Gaypride bezoeker

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether suspects in the assault of an Ugandan Gay Pride visitor had been arrested, whether they belonged to a Ugandan party, their nationality, whether a doubled prosecution demand applies for discriminatory assault, and what measures will be taken against homophobia imported from other countries. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing so no details can be shared, that the Discrimination Directive would apply with a 50% or 100% increase in the demand if the case is prosecuted, and that discriminatory expression and violence are punishable regardless of the convictions behind them.
This investigation is still ongoing, which is why I make no further statements about it.
Dit onderzoek loopt nog, reden waarom ik daar verder geen mededelingen over doe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over een verbod op het in groepsverband dragen van jasjes (MC leden in colors)

Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) asked whether a ban on groups of outlaw motorcycle club members wearing 'colors' could be introduced in municipal bylaws after intimidating crowds in Enschede, and whether Arnhem-style agreements with bars and a UK ban could be followed. Minister Opstelten answered that wearing colors cannot itself be banned, but that existing tools (assembly ban, public order powers, group bans, bar house rules) can address intimidating conduct, and that he will draw municipalities' attention to these and the UK has no specific ban only a gang injunction.
I will draw extra attention to the possibilities these instruments offer against this form of public order disturbance to the municipalities.
Ik zal de mogelijkheden die genoemde instrumenten bieden tegen deze vorm van ordeverstoringen extra onder de aandacht brengen bij de gemeenten.

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about witness protection, including division of responsibilities, procedural safeguards, the limits of anonymous testimony, protection versus the general protection scheme, financial compensation and identity changes. The minister answered that consultations are ongoing, that the current separation of tracks is justified, and that concrete proposals will be sent to parliament in autumn 2012.
I am consulting with the Public Prosecution Service and the police on witness protection. I will inform your House about this in the course of this autumn.
Ik ben in overleg met het openbaar ministerie en de politie over getuigenbescherming. Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in de loop van dit najaar berichten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over een zwarte lijst van helers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a blacklist of fences (helers) should be created and whether markets such as gold buyers and auction sites should be obliged to supervise themselves, including ID checks. The minister answered that police and prosecutors act on suspicions of handling stolen goods, that existing initiatives such as stopheling.nl and a pilot digital buyers' register continue, and that current rules already require buyers' registers, without committing to new obligations.
Police and justice therefore act when there is a suspicion of handling stolen goods.
Politie en justitie treden daarom op bij een vermoeden van heling.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het nut en de noodzaak van een Nationaal Fraude Autoriteit

Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) asked whether the roughly 23 fraud reporting points hinder a coherent information position and systematic financial enforcement, and whether a National Fraud Authority should be set up under the minister. Teeven answered that multiple reporting points are acceptable if citizens know where to go and the bodies cooperate, that the Fraudehelpdesk is becoming a central point, and that he is studying the UK model without yet deciding on responsibility.
Are you willing to have yourself informed in the short term about the possibilities of establishing a National Fraud Authority and to inform the House of Representatives about it?
Bent u bereid om u op korte termijn nader te laten informeren over de mogelijkheden om tot een Nationale Fraude Autoriteit te komen en de Tweede Kamer hierover in te lichten?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over C2000 en P2000

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the aging P2000 paging network, the C2000 maintenance contract timeline, outsourcing options and governance of C2000. The minister answered that a preference for upgrading P2000 is being elaborated, the C2000 maintenance tender will be completed before the deadline, outsourcing options will be examined, and a final choice on tactical management will be made in the tender.
The tender for the maintenance of C2000 will be completed before the stated date.
De aanbesteding van het onderhoud van C2000 zal voor de genoemde datum zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Ten Broeke inzake Antwoorden het bericht 'Politieweb aan grens in gevaar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the national police merger would end the mobile cross-border police teams at the German border, and about results, funding and possible use of Koninklijke Marechaussee teams. The minister answered that cross-border cooperation under the Treaty of Enschede continues, that the Twente joint team's funding runs to July 2013 with a continuity commitment, and that the team's form may change after evaluation.
The ministry is periodically informed about project progress and the (interim) results and deployment of the GPT.
Het ministerie wordt periodiek geïnformeerd over de projectvoortgang en de (tussentijdse) resultaten en de inzet van het GPT.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur over het bericht "frustratie na 'vondst'gestolen ipad"

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van der Steur asked why the public prosecutor refused a house search even though an owner had located his stolen iPad via an app, and whether this could change. The minister answers that the law sets strict proportionality and subsidiarity requirements for house searches, refers to earlier answers, and sees no reason to think police and prosecution do not use available techniques.
The law sets strict requirements for the use of the intrusive coercive measure of searching a home, including the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
De wet stelt zware eisen aan het inzetten van het ingrijpende dwangmiddel van doorzoeking van een woning, waaronder de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het gratis toegankelijk maken van informatie uit basisregistraties ten behoeve van opsporing

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether police and prosecutors are hampered by paying per query for Chamber of Commerce and cadastral register data, and whether free access should be restored as the Emergo report recommends. The government replied that budget financing since 1 January 2012 removed invoicing for police and prosecution, that free use of basic registers is the aim by 2015, and that a decision on the end-state is expected at the end of 2012.
The cabinet aims to remove as far as possible the financial barriers to using basic registers, not only within government but also outside it, and to increase their use.

Het kabinet streeft ernaar dat de financiële drempels voor het gebruik van basisregistraties, niet alleen binnen de overheid maar ook daarbuiten, zo veel mogelijk verdwijnen en dat het gebruik ervan toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Passchaert en Ziengs over het doen van aangifte door bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister why companies filing online reports are still asked to come to the police station, why camera evidence cannot be attached, and whether reports are refused when employees damage company vehicles off-duty. The minister replied that evidence should be collected fully, that the police are expanding internet reporting and a tracking system, that complex cases are invited to the station, and that police must take a report unless no offence is possible.
The law prescribes that investigating officers are obliged to record a report (article 163, fifth paragraph, Sv).
De wet schrijft voor dat opsporingsambtenaren verplicht zijn een aangifte op te nemen (artikel 163, vijfde lid Sv).
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over openbaarmaking van gegevens van 112-bellers

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about websites publishing personal data of 112 callers relayed over the P2000 alarm system, and whether this breaches data protection. The minister found it undesirable, will ask meldkamer boards to be more restrained, and plans encryption when P2000 is replaced around 2014.
I will therefore once again point out to the boards of control rooms that they should be more restrained in disclosing private data in relaying messages via the P2000 alarm system.
Ik zal daarom de besturen van meldkamers er nogmaals op wijzen om terughoudender om te gaan met het verstrekken van privé gegevens in de doormelding via het P2000 alarmeringssysteem.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff en Hennis-Plasschaert over het artikel 'Politici verzwegen bewust omvang Oost-Europese misdaad'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice whether politicians deliberately concealed the scale of Eastern European organised crime before EU accession, and what is being done about it. The government denies deliberate concealment, says organised crime is addressed within accession Chapter 24 and EU bodies, and promises a separate letter on mobile criminal gangs from Central and Eastern Europe, without giving figures.
The problem of crime from Eastern Europe was not deliberately concealed or covered up in the run-up to the respective accessions.
Het probleem van misdaad uit Oost-Europa is in aanloop naar de respectievelijke toetredingen niet bewust verzwegen of toegedekt.

An MP asked whether Dutch law protects children against threatened international abduction, whether attempts are punishable, and how many abduction cases occur; the state secretary replied that article 279 Sr together with the general attempt and preparation provisions (arts. 45-46 Sr) gives police and the Marechaussee sufficient powers to intervene, that the Hague Convention is generally well observed, and that a checklist (Baliekaart) for police and prosecutors exists and is being updated. The answers are substantive and largely committal on existing powers, without a new commitment to legislative change.
In my view, the police and the Royal Marechaussee have sufficient legal tools to act against an abducting parent in the case of a planned international child abduction.

Naar mijn oordeel beschikken politie en de Koninklijke Marechaussee over voldoende juridische handvatten om bij een voorgenomen internationale kinderontvoering op te treden tegen de ontvoerende ouder.
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Gent over christelijke homotherapie

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Gent asked the health minister how the Health Care Inspectorate investigated the Christian 'homotherapy' provider Different, whether it spoke to former clients, and what the treatment entails. The minister answered that the inspectorate made a site visit, interviewed clients and management, found weak diagnosis practices, and ordered improvements with a follow-up check within two months.
The IGZ will monitor these improvement measures over the coming period and will carry out a new check within 2 months, focused on sound diagnosis, information provision and codes of conduct.
De IGZ monitort deze verbetermaatregelen de komende periode en zal binnen 2 maanden een nieuwe toets uitvoeren, gericht op deugdelijke diagnosestelling, voorlichting en gedragscodering.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de stationering van politiehelikopters (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police helicopter fleet is wholly based at Schiphol, whether current basing is optimal, and whether high Schiphol fees and mandatory routes justify relocation. The minister replied that the fleet is based at Schiphol, Volkel and Rotterdam with a flexible network of locations, that basing is continuously reviewed, and that Schiphol remains necessary for 24-hour availability.
Reconsideration of the basing (form) is part of this.
Heroverweging van de stationering(vorm) maakt hier onderdeel van uit.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Mulder over christelijke homotherapie

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister whether insurers are legally obliged to pay for Christian 'homotherapy' and what measures would end this. The minister answered that such therapy is not covered by the basic insurance package, insurers may not reimburse it, and no such obligation exists.
Insurers are not permitted to reimburse care that does not belong to the package.
Het is zorgverzekeraars niet toegestaan zorg te vergoeden die niet behoort tot het pakket.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV) en Hennis- Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Burgemeester gezag kwijt» (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Hennis-Plasschaert asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Flevoland Commissioner of the King really said mayors would lose all say over local policing once the national police is introduced, and whether the minister would brief him. The minister confirmed the reported concerns exist, rejected them as unfounded, stated the mayor retains authority over public order and police, and said he would explain his position to the Commissioners of the King at an opportunity.
The mayor is and remains responsible for public order and safety in his municipality and retains full authority over the police.
De burgemeester is en blijft verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde en veiligheid in zijn gemeente en behoudt onverminderd het gezag over de politie.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verhoging van boetes (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reported 2012 traffic fine levels were correct, whether fines remain proportionate compared with other fines such as shoplifting, and whether tariffs should be differentiated more. The minister confirmed the fine amounts are in the Wahv annex, clarified that the 340 euro fine concerns unnecessary noise by a motor vehicle driver rather than honking, and said no further differentiation is currently planned.
I therefore see no reason at this time to differentiate the tariffs further.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om de tarieven verder te differentiëren.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een vergoeding van secundaire geslachtskenmerken voor transgenderoperaties (ingezonden 18 november

Two MPs asked the minister about a Transgender Remembrance Day and whether secondary sex characteristics should be covered by insurance for gender-affirming treatment, citing an adopted motion. The government acknowledged the importance of these characteristics for transgender people but said it sees no room in the Health Insurance Act to extend coverage or provide funding.
However, the cabinet currently sees no room to extend the entitlements under the Health Insurance Act on this point or otherwise make funding available for this.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment echter geen ruimte om de aanspraken ingevolge de Zorgverzekeringswet op dit punt uit te breiden of anderszins hiervoor financiering ter beschikking te stellen.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wapenvergunning van Tristan van der V. (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether information about the granting of a weapons permit to Tristan van der V. had been deleted, whether that was lawful, and what retention rules apply to weapons-permit documents and departing police staff's correspondence. The Minister answered that a PDF attachment was lost when the info desk converted an email, that the Rijksrecherche and NFI could not locate it, and that retention follows the Wet Politiegegevens, with disciplinary rather than criminal consequences for wrongful destruction.
It has emerged that the info desk emailed a PDF file to the Bijzondere Wetten department.
Gebleken is dat door de infodesk een pdf-bestand aan de afdeling Bijzondere Wetten is gemaild.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de veroudering van het HKS-register (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police HKS criminal records system is outdated and wrongly lists people as suspects, and when a replacement will be in use. The minister confirmed the report, referred to earlier answers, said the old system will be absorbed into the new police basic system over several years, and said incorrect data will be cleaned before conversion, without giving a firm deadline.
Insofar as there is talk of incorrect data, the police forces will clean the file before conversion.
Voor zover er sprake is van «foute»gegevens zullen de korpsen het bestand voor conversie schonen.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Politie heeft geen zicht op wapenvergunningen» (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

The MP asks whether the police have an accurate overview of issued weapons permits, whether a responsible official was appointed after the 2009 IOOV report on firearms handling, and what measures will fix the Verona records system. The minister acknowledges the importance of complete information, reports protocol implementation and a new Beslag-Interventieteam, and says the Verona weaknesses will feed into the 2012 ICT plan.
It is indeed important that the police can have a complete overview of all issued weapons permits.
Het is inderdaad belangrijk dat de politie over een volledig overzicht van alle verleende wapenvergunningen kan beschikken.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verplicht centraal melden van vermissingen (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether mandatory central reporting of missing persons should be introduced, following a call by AMBER Alert Nederland and an earlier promise by a predecessor. The minister agrees to introduce a reporting obligation for the most urgent (category 1) cases and says he will write to force managers that week.
I am in favour of introducing a reporting obligation for the regional police forces to the KLPD for the most urgent missing persons cases (category 1).
Ik ben voorstander van het invoeren van een meldingsplicht van de regionale korpsen aan het KLPD van de meest urgente vermissingen (categorie 1).
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het intact blijven van het salaris van de korpschefs (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether top police officers (korpschefs) keep their salaries and allowances after the police reorganisation, and whether these can be withdrawn. Minister Opstelten answered that a suitable function will be sought, that he intends to limit allowances and bring the police top under new pay policy, but that this requires an agreement with the police unions on transitional rules.
It is my intention to bring the entire police leadership under the new terms-of-employment policy within a foreseeable period.
Het is mijn voornemen om de gehele politietop binnen afzienbare tijd onder de werking van het nieuwe arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de inhuur van externe expertise (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper interview in which an IT firm (Fox-IT) describes pressure on prosecutors and police, and whether dependence on this single specialist supplier is risky. The minister says the remarks concern calls for more investigative powers, that the firm had no influence on investigations, and that external expertise is needed for niche high-tech crime, with police and prosecutors keeping tactical control.
In individual criminal investigations in which the services of the interviewee's company were used, there has of course been no question of any steering of the course of the investigation.
In individuele opsporingsonderzoeken waarin gebruik werd gemaakt van de diensten van het bedrijf van de geïnterviewde is uiteraard geen sprake geweest van enige sturing op de loop van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de draagwijze van veiligheidsvesten (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police may still not wear protective vests over clothing, whether positive experiences exist, and whether the minister will immediately grant the officers' wish. The minister replied that a tender for a vest wearable both over and under clothing was launched in June 2011, with delivery expected mid-2012 and a wear trial planned with police representatives.
On 6 June 2011 I instructed the VTSPN to start the European tender for a protective vest that can be worn both over and under clothing.
Op 6 juni 2011 heb ik aan de VTSPN opdracht verstrekt voor de start van de Europese aanbesteding van een veiligheidsvest dat zowel boven als onder de kleding kan worden gedragen.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een sms-noodnummer (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an SMS emergency number for police is desirable and whether it will be opened. Minister Opstelten answered that SMS is not suitable for emergencies (no priority, delivery delays, no location data, misuse risk), and that smartphone-based alternatives are being discussed at European level.
Opening an emergency number to alert the police by SMS is not a good idea in my view.
Het openstellen van een noodnummer om de politie per SMS te alarmeren acht ik geen goede gedachte
Vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Gay Pride in Servië (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether Serbian authorities' reluctance to help organise and secure a Gay Pride threatened the event, and whether Serbia is making progress on protecting sexual minorities and whether the Netherlands would press Serbia and raise the issue in the EU Council. The minister replied that authorities are in principle positive but have not committed to cooperation, that discrimination remains a problem, and that the Netherlands will ensure minority rights are considered in assessing Serbia's EU application.
I will ensure in the Council of EU ministers that the rights of minorities are taken into account in the assessment of Serbia's EU membership application
Ik zal er in de Europese Raad van ministers op toezien dat de rechten van minderheden worden meegenomen in de beoordeling van de Servische EU-lidmaatschapsaanvraag
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over transportcriminaliteit (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about delays in the cargo-theft (transportcriminaliteit) approach, including late setup of a rapid intervention team and national prosecutor, funding issues for the project team, the need for a structural approach and permanent police teams, and the measurement of theft in the transport sector. The minister confirms the delays, says the prosecutor and project team will continue in 2012, and says a structural approach is a precondition for ending temporary measures, while deferring permanent police teams to the national police debate.
Securing this in a structural approach is a precondition before the temporary arrangements can be ended.
Dit borgen in een structurele aanpak is een randvoorwaarde alvorens de tijdelijke voorzieningen te kunnen beëindigen.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over Nederlanders woonachtig in het buitenland (niet-EU) en de onmogelijkheid om een Nederlandse identiteitskaart

An MP asked why Dutch nationals living outside the EU and certain European countries cannot apply for a Dutch identity card in their country of residence, and whether this would be changed. The minister explained the card is only valid in listed countries and that a pending Paspoortwet amendment will end its travel-document status, so he sees little reason to extend applications abroad given the costs.

Especially against that background, I see little reason to make it possible for people living in a country where they cannot use the Dutch identity card as an identity card, nor as a travel document to the Netherlands, to still obtain the Dutch identity card in their country of residence.

Zeker tegen die achtergrond zie ik weinig aanleiding om het mogelijk te maken om mensen die wonen in een land waar ze de Nederlandse identiteitskaart niet kunnen gebruiken als identiteitskaart en deze ook niet kunnen gebruiken als reisdocument naar Nederland, de mogelijkheid te bieden de Nederlandse identiteitskaart toch in hun land van verblijf te krijgen.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over (transport)criminaliteit, en gestolen mobiele telefoons in het bijzonder (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about stolen mobile phones, after police found many phones from a 3000-phone robbery active on Dutch networks, and why Dutch providers do not block IMEI numbers as Belgium and the UK do. The state secretary answers that a bureau report is pending and will be considered with Economic Affairs, that Dutch providers stopped structural IMEI blocking due to non-unique IMEI numbers and easy spoofing, and that blocking has serious drawbacks.

Once I have received the final version of the administrative file from the Bovenregionale Recherche Midden Nederland, I will, in consultation with my colleague of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, examine whether it is possible and necessary to take measures.

Als ik de definitieve versie van het bestuurlijk dossier van de Bovenregionale Recherche Midden Nederland heb ontvangen, zal ik in afstemming met mijn ambtgenoot van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie bezien of het mogelijk en nodig is maatregelen te nemen
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV), Hennis Plasschaert (VVD) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Moord Hillis gefilmd» (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

MPs Brinkman, Hennis Plasschaert and Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the murder of a criminal figure was filmed by police, including whether evidence was lost, whether police had prior knowledge, and whether the case compares to the IRT affair. The minister confirmed a police helicopter filmed the attack during an unrelated wiretap operation, declined to discuss the footage or the ongoing investigation, denied friction between the national and Amsterdam police, and rejected any comparison with the IRT affair.
I will not go into the content of the footage or conclusions that may or may not be drawn from it while the investigation is ongoing.
Op de inhoud van de beelden en conclusies die daaraan al dan niet kunnen worden verbonden, ga ik lopende het onderzoek niet in.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over problemen rondom het burgerlijk huwelijk (i

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether civil registrars may marry couples already religiously wed, how a legal ban could work, and how to ensure couples understand the ceremony. The minister answered that religious ceremonies have no legal effect, a statutory ban would be counterproductive, and registrars must be satisfied couples understand, with interpreters arranged if needed.
Giving formal status to an earlier religious ceremony would undermine the principle that the Netherlands recognises only civil marriage.
Het geven van een formele status aan een eerdere religieuze plechtigheid zou afbreuk doen aan het uitgangspunt dat Nederland alleen het burgerlijk huwelijk kent.

Vragen van de leden Rik Janssen (SP) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Nederland de Verenigde Staten nauwgezet op de hoogte houdt van lopende terreuronderzoeken (

MPs Janssen and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether the Netherlands has agreements with the United States on removing information about people later found wrongly suspected of terrorism, and whether it receives confirmation of such removal. The state secretary answered that no specific agreements exist, that the trust principle applies, and that Dutch police share exonerating information with foreign counterparts under the Police Data Act criteria.
No specific agreements have been made on how the US handles information about persons later found to have been wrongly identified as suspects.
Over de wijze waarop de VS omgaan met informatie over personen die later blijken ten onrechte als verdachte te zijn aangemerkt, zijn geen specifieke afspraken gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht van het Korpsbeheerdersberaad (KBB) «ICT Politie Volledig Vernieuwen» (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Korpsbeheerdersberaad proposal to completely renew the police ICT infrastructure and organisation via a Datacenter Politie Nederland, and whether the minister endorses it, its pace, its consequences for daily practice, reliance on the Algemene Rekenkamer study and its financial impact. The minister confirmed awareness, said the proposal seems sensible, announced responsibility for the ICT file passes to him on 1 May, promised careful review using Audit Dienst and Rekenkamer findings, and said financial consequences will be sent to parliament after the summer.
I will inform your House directly after the summer about my action plan, its financial elaboration and the resulting budgetary consequences.
Ik zal uw Kamer direct na de zomer informeren over mijn plan van aanpak en de financiële uitwerking ervan en de daaruit voortvloeiende budgettaire consequenties.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over wanorde in de Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about internal conflict and disorder at Veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord, including the suspension of the regional fire commander, whether the inspectorate is involved, and the roles of municipal councils and the board. The minister says the regional board is primarily responsible, that the inspectorate has taken note of the report, and declines to take concrete measures pending the follow-up investigation.
Taking measures is therefore not opportune at present.
Het treffen van maatregelen acht ik momenteel dan ook niet opportuun.

Vragen van de leden Straus, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bosman en De Boer (allen VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid door centralisatie overheidsdiensten (inge

MPs of the VVD asked whether preserving administrative employment in shrinking regions is crucial and what measures the government takes so that central government reorganisations strengthen the economic structure and jobs in those regions. Minister Donner answered that regional authorities are responsible for regional economic vitality, that location choices weigh efficiency and service above regional employment, and that earlier analysis showed no disproportionate regional job effects.
The initiative for successful cooperation between these parties lies with governments at the regional level.
Het initiatief voor een succesvolle samenwerking tussen deze partijen ligt bij de overheden op regionale schaal.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne en Van der Steur (allen VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbeslagname servers door Stichting Brein (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Stichting Brein seized servers without a court order, accessed private data, and invoked Article 28 of the Copyright Act, and whether this amounts to vigilantism. The state secretary answered that the servers were handed over by the provider under Article 28, that a court later allowed judicial custody and seizure, that the parties dispute the legality and access issues and must resolve them or go to court, and that existing remedies suffice.
In the first instance it is up to the parties to resolve this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen om hier uit te komen.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een diepgravend onderzoek naar de precieze toedracht van het overlijden van Michelle Mooij (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary how the investigation into the death of Michelle Mooij began and when it will close, whether suicide is still considered, how the family is informed, and why GGZ, probation and the prosecutor took no further action against the suspect. The minister says a full investigation started on the day the body was found, a counter-expertise has just been completed and an end date cannot yet be given, suicide is considered, the family is kept informed, and the failure to enforce the suspended sentence is regretted with measures taken by the Amsterdam prosecutor's office.
However, it was wrongly judged that the deadline for filing the claim had already passed, and it was not filed.
Ten onrechte is echter geoordeeld dat de termijn voor het indienen van de vordering reeds was verlopen en is deze niet ingediend.
Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over pleegkinderen zonder nationaliteit (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

MPs Dibi and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether a foster child born in the Netherlands, whose Moroccan mother died and father is unknown, can obtain Dutch or Moroccan nationality, and how this fits the UN Children's Rights Convention. The minister answered that the child is likely Moroccan by law, that nationality for foster children is governed by the Dutch Nationality Act with exceptions under article 10, and that a concrete assessment requires an application.
Regarding the case as described in the letter, no definitive answer can be given without an application and examination of the relevant circumstances.
Over de casus zoals deze in de brief is geschetst kan zonder een aanvraag en onderzoek van de relevante omstandigheden geen uitsluitsel worden gegeven.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over handmatige acties en controles bij tap- of referentieverzoeken (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

MPs asked the Justice minister about a misdirected fax containing wiretap data, whether tap orders are sent by fax without adequate authentication or logging, and whether automated secure systems should replace manual steps. The minister called the incident an isolated manual error, said the KLPD process is already automated with logging, authentication and secure networking, and announced tightened procedures.
Measures have been taken to reduce the chance of such an incident in the future, including tightening procedures and instructing staff.
Er zijn maatregelen genomen om de kans op een dergelijk incident in de toekomst te verkleinen, onder andere door het aanscherpen van procedures en het instrueren van medewerkers.

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de registratie van een tweede nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie (GBA) (in

MPs Schouw and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether Dutch treaty obligations require automatic GBA registration of a second nationality and how this compares with Belgium, France and Germany, and what the effects of non-registration would be for public tasks, citizens, denaturalisation and foreign authorities. The minister answered that no treaty obliges registration, that registration is declaratory, that the government sees no reason to change the current law, and that non-registration would hamper statutory tasks and burden citizens.
The purpose of the GBA is to provide unambiguous information that is necessary for applying the law.
Doel van de GBA is om eenduidige informatie te verstrekken welke nodig is met het oog op de toepassing van de wet.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over diepgravend onderzoek naar de precieze toedracht van het overlijden van Michelle Mooij (ingezonden 11 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the investigation into the death of Michelle Mooij was thorough, whether Dutch law requires a deeper inquiry, and whether the cause of death (suicide or murder) remains unclear given the victim's prior complaints against a suspect. The minister answered that other causes besides suicide are being examined, a counter-expertise is ongoing, the minister agrees a thorough investigation is needed, and no further measures are currently warranted.
This counter-expertise has not yet been completed.
Deze contra-expertise is nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Europees Kaderbesluit wederzijdse erkenning op geldelijke sancties (inge

MPs Aptroot and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether French traffic fines can be collected in the Netherlands via the CJIB under the EU framework decision on mutual recognition of financial penalties, and whether it can be used against Dutch drivers who refuse to pay. The government answered that the framework decision lets the CJIB collect final fines from other EU states for offenders living in the Netherlands, that transfer is not mandatory, and that it does not regulate how offences are sanctioned or whether fine amounts are excessive; it saw no need to contact the Commissioners.
The framework decision provides that fines can be transferred to an EU member state other than the one where they were imposed, so that these sanctions can be enforced more easily.

Antwoord 3, 6 Het «kaderbesluit» regelt dat boetes overgedragen kunnen worden naar een andere EU-lidstaat dan waar ze opgelegd zijn, zodat deze sancties gemakkelijker ten uitvoer gelegd kunnen worden.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onbevoegd optreden als hulpofficier (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asks the minister of Security and Justice about police officers acting as auxiliary officers of justice without proper authorization, which may affect ongoing criminal cases. The minister agrees this is unacceptable, says unauthorized officers must stop immediately, promises a national police protocol and an inventory of unauthorized auxiliary officers per force, and refers to earlier answers on disciplinary measures.
I will ask the police to draw up one national protocol based on regional best practices to prevent situations like the one in Twente.
Ik zal de politie vragen om op basis van regionale best-practices één landelijk protocol op te stellen om situaties zoals in Twente te voorkomen.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van de politie ten behoeve van opsporing (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in the Netherlands refuse to take reports of crimes and fail to pursue investigations, notably transport and cargo theft, and asked about registration and a public-private convenant. The Minister answered that police must take reports under the Code of Criminal Procedure with investigation decisions based on the prioritisation criteria, that a common registration definition and data sharing will be introduced, and that an additional convenant on foreign mutual legal assistance is not considered necessary.
The police are obliged under Article 163(5) of the Code of Criminal Procedure to record reports of criminal offences.
De politie is op grond van artikel 163 lid 5 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering verplicht om aangiftes van een strafbaar feit op te nemen.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï, Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie over publicaties van Wikileaks (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Three VVD MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about WikiLeaks publications, including who can access SIPRNET, how allies store and control access to sensitive information, whether passenger data access is limited, and whether the government will seek clarification and safeguards. The minister answered that details of US systems are not disclosed, that NATO inspections and bilateral responsibility govern information security, that the Netherlands was pre-informed of publications, and that the need for additional measures is under study.
Regarding how the system is managed and who has access to it, no statements are made given the classification of the system.
Over de vragen hoe het systeem wordt beheerd en wie daartoe toegang heeft worden gezien de classificatie van het systeem geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verkiezingen in Wit-Rusland (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrests of opposition candidates, journalists and activists after Belarus's December 2010 election, the reported unfair vote and violence, and what the government would do. The minister condemned the election and arrests, called for release of detainees, and said he asked the EU to consider reimposing a travel ban and to formulate further steps.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de jihadwebsite Ansar Al Mujahideen (ingezonden 1

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether Dutch Islamist extremists run, fund and host the jihadist website Ansar Al Mujahideen and related sites, whether Dutch persons co-produce the magazine Inspire, and what action the government will take. The minister answered that jihadist websites generally target Western youth, that he has no information showing increasing Dutch operation or involvement, that he cannot publicly discuss specific Dutch involvement and will brief the intelligence committee, and that both sites have since gone offline.
In public I cannot make statements about the involvement of Dutch nationals or details of other kinds in relation to the specific websites
In het openbaar kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de betrokkenheid van Nederlanders of details van andere aard in relatie tot de specifieke websites

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het DNA-verdrag tussen Nederland en de Verenigde Staten (VS) (ingezonden 25 november 2010)

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about the Dutch-US DNA and fingerprint data exchange treaty, covering reciprocity, the purpose of serious-crime solving, privacy safeguards, the link to US Visa Waiver requirements, comparable treaties with other EU states, and EU coordination. The government answered that access is granted case by case through national contact points, that privacy is protected because reference data are not traceable to individuals, that the treaty was driven by slow manual matching rather than specific cases, and that EU coordination was informal.
As for reciprocity, I refer to my answer to question 3 from MP Schouw of your House.
Wat betreft de wederkerigheid verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op vraag 3 van het lid Schouw van uw Kamer
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een onderzoek van Fier Frieslân (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and of Health whether they knew of the shocking findings of a study by Fier Fryslân on girls fleeing honour-related violence, and whether policy should be tightened quickly. The state secretary acknowledged the findings as worrying, said the national partnership against sexual violence will be asked to advise, and promised to inform parliament once the commission's report on women's shelter arrangements is received.
Therefore I will ask the national Partnership Against Sexual Violence to advise me on the problems identified.
Daarom zal ik het landelijke Partnership Aanpak Seksueel Geweld 2 vragen mij over de gesignaleerde problematiek te adviseren.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Snelle opsporing wijkt voor contract» (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported agreements between police/prosecution and media partners that may give priority to contracts over investigative interests, and whether all media should receive footage simultaneously. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, stated that media choice is decided case by case, and that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving remains leading with no standard agreements obstructing investigations.
There are no standard agreements that obstruct the investigation of criminal offences.
Er zijn geen standaardafspraken die de opsporing van strafbare feiten belemmeren.
Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over de BKR-registratie en privacy (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MPs Van der Steur and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether the 8 June 2010 Arnhem court ruling on BKR credit registration and the Personal Data Protection Act should lead to changes in BKR policy, including proportionality of registration, the complaints committee, and a right to request removal. The minister declined to comment on the pending Supreme Court case, stated that registration is legally required and that the existing correction and complaint routes remain available.
In the case in question, cassation has been lodged with the Supreme Court. Therefore I cannot go into this case, nor anticipate the outcome of the further proceedings.
In de genoemde zaak is cassatie ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad. Daarom kan ik niet op deze zaak ingaan, noch vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de verdere procedure.

Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie voor persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

The MP asks to what extent commercial companies without public tasks, such as invoicing firms, can access or receive data from the municipal personal records database (GBA), and under what conditions. The state secretary answers that only public bodies and non-governmental bodies with a public or special social interest (e.g. pension funds, health insurers) may receive GBA data under articles 98-100 of the GBA Act, that commercial firms fall outside this, and that the forthcoming basic registry law will exclude them explicitly.
To prevent data from being provided to commercial companies and institutions without a public or special social interest, the bill makes provision to such companies and institutions impossible.

Om te voorkomen dat aan commerciële bedrijven en instellingen zonder publiek of bijzonder maatschappelijk belang gegevens worden verstrekt, maakt het wetsvoorstel de verstrekking aan dergelijke bedrijven en instellingen niet mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het horen van een journalist als verdachte van opruiing en bedreiging (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a journalist suspected of incitement and threats after quoting an online threat against politicians, and whether reporting such threats is permitted. The minister said the case is an ongoing criminal investigation, the OM will decide on prosecution, and journalists may report such material provided they stay within the law.
This concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
Het betreft hier een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Justitie naar aanleiding van de antwoorden op de Kamervragen van 30 juni 2010 inzake internetfilters (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Teeven asked the Justice Minister how Netherlands pressures other countries to ratify cybercrime treaties and why it claims website blocking helps fight child abuse images, citing a 2008 study. The minister said Netherlands promotes ratification through international bodies and bilateral contacts, stressed prosecution and takedown as primary tools, and refused to list specific websites targeted, citing the risk of aiding offenders.

The request for a specific overview of websites Netherlands has tried to target, directly or via legal assistance channels, I cannot grant, because it would give third parties the opportunity to deliberately search for images of sexual abuse of children.

Het verzoek om een specifiek overzicht van websites die Nederland – al dan niet via rechtshulpkanalen – heeft proberen aan te pakken, kan ik niet inwilligen, omdat daardoor aan derden de mogelijkheid zou worden geboden om gericht op zoek te gaan naar afbeeldingen van seksueel misbruik van kinderen.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bij voorbaat uitsluiten van alleenstaanden voor een IVF-behandeling (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether IVF clinics still exclude single women in advance, whether this complies with other rules, and whether measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged some fertility centres exclude single women, said they must follow current rules, and committed to writing to the clinics by end 2010 that single women with a medical indication must not be excluded in advance.
I am of the view that single persons with a medical indication may not be excluded in advance from fertility treatments.
ben ik van mening dat alleenstaanden met een medische indicatie niet bij voorbaat mogen worden uitgesloten van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het «Eindrapport Audit CIOT 2009» (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether telecom providers, investigative and intelligence services and the CIOT had adequately acted on earlier audit recommendations, and whether planned policy changes are needed. The minister said providers made corrections and a central 'no hits' registration is being built, the CIOT met requirements, but the intelligence and investigation services largely left three key audit weaknesses unchanged, which he finds unacceptable, and he has asked them to remedy the shortcomings.
I find this unacceptable. I have asked the BIOD's by letter to take the necessary measures to remove the shortcomings identified in the audit.
Ik acht dit niet acceptabel. Ik heb per brief de BIOD's gevraagd om de nodige maatregelen te nemen om de in de audit geconstateerde tekortkomingen weg te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het publiceren van historische stukken door de Koninklijke B

MPs Van der Ham and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether Justice had warned the National Library it could face prosecution for putting wartime NSB and communist newspapers online, and how such historical material should be judged. The minister answered that online publication for news reporting is not punishable under article 137e of the Criminal Code, that prosecution and judgment are for the Openbaar Ministerie and the courts, and that he is consulting the Library on technical safeguards such as warnings to users.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to examine, on the basis of the facts, whether conduct qualifies for criminal prosecution.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om op basis van de feiten te bezien of gedragingen in aanmerking komen voor strafrechtelijke vervolging.
Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over Europese richtsnoeren staatssteun zeehavens (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the transport minister whether he knows the European Commission has delayed its draft state aid guidelines for seaports and whether he will press for swift adoption in the Transport Council and directly with the Commission. The minister confirmed the delay, said he has repeatedly raised it with the Commissioner and will do so while in office, and announced that officials will brief DG Competition and a joint Dutch-German position is being prepared.
On several occasions I have raised with the Commissioner the failure to produce the guidelines.
Verschillende malen heb ik de Commissaris aangesproken op het uitblijven van de richtsnoeren.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over inzet politie bij evenementen (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about police capacity strain from large events, whether organisers should pay for policing, whether a structural solution is needed, and the Minister's role.
