The Minister answers that mayors decide on events under the Municipalities Act, that organisers bear primary responsibility, that cost recovery could be considered in budget decisions, and that he will consult partners and ask for a national guidance document.
I take the concerns raised seriously and will therefore consult with the parties involved on these issues in the short term.
Ik neem de geuite zorgen serieus en zal daarom op korte termijn met betrokken partijen in overleg treden over deze vraagstukken.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bezuinigingen bij de politie Fryslân (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether the Fryslân police face a structural shortfall of €10-15 million and whether recommendations such as differentiated response times and reduced investigative capacity endanger citizen safety, and whether measures will be taken. The minister answers that the regional college and police chief are primarily responsible, that the shortfall stems from budget mutations, high interest and personnel costs, that citizen safety remains the regional college's responsibility, and that the ministry may provide extra funding depending on future decisions.
The police force manager and the Regional College are primarily responsible for the management of the regional police force Fryslân.
De korpsbeheerder en het Regionale College primair verantwoordelijk zijn voor het beheer van het regionale politiekorps Fryslân.
Vragen van de leden Elias en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over een nieuwe clausule in de privacyvoorwaarden van Apple (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MPs Elias and Hennis-Plasschaert asked the economics minister whether she knew Apple's new privacy clause allowing collection, use and sale of user location data, and whether anonymised data can be traced to individuals. The minister confirmed awareness, said the CBP may assess lawfulness, and referred the questions to the Ministry of Justice for review by the CBP.
I have therefore referred the issue to the Ministry of Justice.
Ik heb het vraagstuk daarom doorgeleid naar het Ministerie van Justitie

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Justitie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het buiten functie stellen van een commissaris bij Europol (ingezonden 5 juli 2

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Teeven asked the Justice Minister about a crisis at Europol involving its deputy director, alleged leaking of internal recruitment information to Dutch National Crime Squad staff, and whether the official is seconded. The minister called it an internal Europol matter, said the DNR leadership knew of questions about it, and said the person is not seconded but was granted special leave as KLPD manager.
I regard the matter as an internal affair of Europol.
Ik beschouw de aangelegenheid als een interne zaak van Europol.
Vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het zogenaamde SWIFT-akkoord (ingezonden 24 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the new EU-US SWIFT agreement on sharing financial messaging data with the US Treasury, questioning timing of its adoption as an A-item, parliamentary involvement, and whether it meets EP conditions on data protection. The minister says the government supports the agreement, that parliament was informed by letter, and that the new text adds data protection and redress safeguards.
For this reason I today sent both chambers a letter describing the latest state of the negotiations between the EU and the US on the new SWIFT agreement.
Mede daarom heb ik heden beide Kamers een brief gestuurd met een beschrijving van de laatste stand van zaken in de onderhandelingen tussen de EU en de VS over de nieuwe SWIFT-over eenkomst.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat geprobeerd wordt de smartphones van NAVO-troepen te hacken

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence about reports that smartphones of NATO troops were being hacked, including whether Dutch soldiers were affected during Baltic exercises and what measures the armed forces take. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to give details on Dutch incidents or past exercises for operational security, described general cyber defence measures, and said cyber defence is a structural NATO priority.
For reasons of operational security, I cannot make any statements about this.
Om redenen van operationele veiligheid kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Van den Bosch over landen die in Nederland onderdelen voor massavernietigingswapens proberen te kopen

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers whether countries such as Iran, Syria and Pakistan are procuring weapons-of-mass-destruction components in the Netherlands, what has been done about successful purchases, what extra measures are needed, how businesses and SMEs are made aware of the risk, and whether a blacklist of intermediaries exists. The government confirmed the risk, described export-control and awareness measures, and declined to publish a blacklist or specific case details for national security reasons.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case matters that touch on the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Karabulut over seksueel misbruik in het leger

MPs Diks and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister about alleged sexual abuse in the armed forces, including the handling of a 2015 report to the Inspector-General and the number of reports and prosecutions. The minister answered that a confidential investigation commission has been set up, that 54 reports of possible sexual misconduct were filed with the Royal Marechaussee since 2013 and 39 cases reached the prosecutor, and listed existing integrity and prevention measures.
Defence has meanwhile set up a commission of inquiry to establish the facts as far as possible.
Defensie heeft inmiddels een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld om de feiten zoveel mogelijk te achterhalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van den Hul over het pleidooi van de militaire vakbond voor het instellen van een onafhankelijk meldpunt naar aanleiding van berichtgeving door de Volkskrant over een oud-militai

MPs Belhaj and Van den Hul asked the Defence Minister about a union call for an independent reporting point for sexual abuse in the armed forces, after a Volkskrant report on a former soldier abused in the 1980s, and about training, anonymity, time-barred cases and disciplinary action. The Minister answered that existing channels (COID, KMar, supervisors) are adequate and that fragmentation is undesirable, that anonymous reports are possible, and that a commission of inquiry is examining the specific case, with action depending on its outcome.
Defence has set up a commission of inquiry that specifically focuses on the case in question.
Defensie heeft een commissie van onderzoek ingesteld die zich specifiek richt op de casus in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van den Bosch over het bericht “Laat een prachtig huwelijk niet op de klippen lopen”

MPs Ziengs and Van den Bosch asked about the naval shipbuilding cluster's economic importance, the lack of new orders, and whether the Defence Materiel Organisation has enough capacity for several naval projects. The ministers answered that the cluster is important, that a study on its economic value is planned for early 2018, and that investment decisions are for the next cabinet.

Decision-making on new investments, for example investments in naval equipment, and the possible consequences for the personnel capacity of Defence and of the DMO in particular, is for the next cabinet.

Besluitvorming over nieuwe investeringen, bijvoorbeeld investeringen in marinematerieel, en de eventuele gevolgen hiervan voor de personele capaciteit van Defensie en van de DMO in het bijzonder, is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de nieuwe terreurdreiging van rechts komt

An MP asked the ministers whether far-right extremist groups exist within the armed forces, whether the government downplays right-wing extremism, and how much capacity is devoted to countering it. The government answered that the MIVD investigates threats from extremists within defence, that right-wing extremism is addressed generically without separate capacity figures, and that the threat is not underestimated.
It is therefore not possible to provide an overview of deployed capacity or financial resources on extremism with a specific ideological background.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van ingezette capaciteit of financiële middelen op extremisme met een specifieke ideologische achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het beleidsplan 'Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit'

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the 'Diversity & Inclusiveness' policy plan, its goals, KPIs, timeline, recruitment via the Multicultural Network, training, reporting willingness and regulations. The minister answered in general terms, citing the plan's focus on a socially safe, respectful workplace and ongoing activities, and promised a review of regulations, with few quantified targets.
Should this review show that current regulations insufficiently support or even hinder an inclusive working climate, they will be revised.
Mocht uit deze doorlichting blijken dat huidige regelgeving een inclusief werkklimaat onvoldoende ondersteunt of zelfs hindert, dan zal die worden herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Fox IT houdt zeggenschap staat af’

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether the government secured co-control over Fox Crypto after NCC Group's takeover, dropped its first right of purchase, and what safeguards protect state secrets. The minister confirms ICT separation and contract transfers are done, says co-control and ownership terms are still under discussion, and gives only partial, procedural answers on secrecy safeguards, declining operational details for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into specific questions about the protection of state secrets.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet in op specifieke vragen over de beveiliging van staatsgeheimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Özütok over het bericht dat het bedrijf Fox-IT de zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Defence and Interior ministers whether negotiations with Fox-IT over state control of its cryptographic subsidiary were still unfinished, why the state dropped its first right to buy shares, what safeguards protect state secrets, and whether other vital-company takeovers caused problems. The government replied that talks are constructive and near conclusion with no plan B, that dropping the first right of purchase poses no risk because other measures exist, that ABDO security requirements and state supervision apply, and it referred to earlier letters for the remaining questions.
Dropping the first right of purchase has no consequences for the cryptographic protection of state secret information.
Het afzien van het eerste recht van koop heeft geen consequenties voor de cryptografische bescherming van staatsgeheime informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over oneerlijke concurrentie

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about the ministry allegedly awarding itself a contract to transport two Fokker aircraft to Peru, in breach of the Market and Government Act, and the consequences for unfair competition. The minister answered that Defence disputed the ACM ruling, that the court rejected the appeal on 22 June 2017, that no damages claims were filed, and that a bill to tighten the Act is in consultation.
A bill tightening the Market and Government Act is currently going through an internet consultation round.
Momenteel doorloopt een wetsvoorstel dat de Wet Markt en Overheid op enkele punten aanscherpt een consultatieronde via internet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht 'Stationsschip Zr. Ms. Zeeland gerepareerd en bevindt zich weer op zee in Caribisch gebied'

Baudet (FvD) asked the Defence Minister whether the Zeeland station ship should be redeployed to the Mediterranean given the migration flows from Africa, and what measures the government takes against those flows. The minister answered that the ship is needed in the Caribbean for coast guard tasks, that Dutch navy ships already serve Mediterranean operations, and that the EU-wide approach and NATO support to EUNAVFOR MED Sophia address the migration problem.
Defence makes a station ship available to the Coast Guard in the Caribbean for 92 sea days per year to carry out law enforcement tasks.
Defensie stelt voor 92 vaardagen per jaar een stationsschip beschikbaar aan de Kustwacht in het Caribisch gebied voor de uitvoering van rechtshandhavingstaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken, Wilders en Graus over het bericht dat de marechaussee onervaren en ongewapenden burgers gaat inzetten op Schiphol

PVV MPs asked whether deploying inexperienced, unarmed reservists at Schiphol border control, as reported, endangers security given the terror threat, and whether more money will be invested in border control. The ministers confirmed the report, said about 200 fully trained ex-marechaussee reservists exist and a single trainee reservist is in a pilot (unarmed, always paired with an armed colleague, to be evaluated), and pointed to €7.5m extra for 2017 and €20m structurally from 2018 for border control.
The starting point is that no compromises are made on security.
Voorop staat dat er geen concessies worden gedaan aan de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Bosch over de beveiliging door de Marechaussee op Schiphol

An MP asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether untrained or minimally trained reservists were being used for border passport checks at Schiphol, and about the risks and whether this is a pilot. The ministers answered that about 200 fully trained reservists exist, that one reservist in a pilot, unarmed and always paired with an armed colleague, is limited to passport checks, and that a decision will follow evaluation.
After evaluation of the pilot with this one reservist, a decision will be made on whether the Royal Marechaussee continues with this.
Na evaluatie van de pilot met deze ene reservist wordt beslist of de Koninklijke Marechaussee hiermee doorgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over toegangspassen tot de Koningin Maximakazerne die zijn gevonden in een auto die eerst eigendom van Defensie was

MP Popken asked the Minister of Defence how access passes and parking cards for the Koningin Maximakazerne were found in a former military police car, how often sold vehicles were not fully cleared, and whether the sale of defence equipment will be evaluated. The minister replied that no passes giving access to a defence site were left behind, that the parking vignettes were no longer in use, that the case was a human error without security consequences, and that personnel will be reminded of the procedure.
I do not consider this necessary, as the procedure is adequate and this concerns a human error without (potential) consequences for (state) security.
Ik acht dit niet nodig, aangezien de procedure toereikend is en het om een menselijke fout gaat zonder (potentiële) gevolgen voor de (staats)veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het stilleggen van oefeningen en opleidingen van de commando’s

An MP asks the Defence Minister about reports that nearly all training and shooting exercises for the Korps Commandotroepen were halted, the reasons, duration, effects on readiness, and why parliament was not informed. The minister answers that the halt follows OVV recommendations after the Ossendrecht shooting accident, that a controlled review of all 63 courses is underway with most resuming in September-October, that deployments remain fully prepared, and that a Defence investigation and a policy response to the OVV will be sent to parliament.
Defence will provide the OVV with a comprehensive policy response within the six-month term, and as much sooner as possible. The House will of course receive this policy response.
Defensie zal de OVV binnen de gestelde termijn van zes maanden, en zoveel sneller als mogelijk, een uitgebreide beleidsreactie aanbieden. De Kamer zal deze beleidsreactie vanzelfsprekend ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) evenveel geheugen heeft als een Iphone

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether reports that the F-35 has less data storage than an iPhone are true, and whether the Netherlands should stop the programme. The minister answered that the reports concern the UK's F-35B variant, that data storage can be adapted, that the F-35 is still in development testing, and that the Netherlands will continue acquiring the F-35A.
The F-35 will meet the requirements set by the Netherlands and will form an important weapons system of the armed forces in the coming decades.
De F-35 zal voldoen aan de door Nederland gestelde eisen en zal in de komende decennia een belangrijk wapensysteem van de krijgsmacht vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en De Graaf over het bericht dat België radicalen op zee gaat opsporen

MPs Popken and De Graaf asked whether the Netherlands applies maritime border and port controls comparable to Belgium's new hunt for radicalised crew on suspicious ships, and whether Dutch controls should be stepped up. The ministers answered that Dutch sea and port controls are comparable, describing the roles of the Kustwacht, ILT, Douane and Marechaussee, and pointed to extra funding for the Marechaussee.
The organisation of sea and port control in the Netherlands and Belgium is comparable.
De inrichting van de controle van de zee en havens in Nederland en België is vergelijkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de civielrechtelijke regeling naar aanleiding van standrechtelijke executies in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

MP Karabulut asked whether the government would extend the deadline for claims by widows of people summarily executed in former Dutch East Indies and extend the scheme to children. The minister confirmed a further two-year extension of the claim window and declined to extend the scheme to children, citing pending court cases on limitation.
Given the special nature of the matter, however, the cabinet sees reason to extend the filing period by another two years.
Gezien de bijzondere aard van de zaak ziet het kabinet echter aanleiding de termijn voor indiening nog eens met twee jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanschaf van een Russisch luchtafweersysteem door NAVO-lid Turkije

MPs Ten Broeke asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about reports that NATO member Turkey agreed to buy the Russian S-400 air defence system, and the consequences for NATO. The government said it could not confirm a definitive deal, declined to speculate on consequences, and noted that arms purchases are sovereign and NATO has no rules barring them.
However, the cabinet cannot currently confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement and also has no further information about this possible agreement.
Echter, het kabinet kan thans niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten en beschikt ook niet over nadere informatie over deze mogelijke overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over een schip dat in de nabijheid van marineschepen is geëxplodeerd voor de kust van Somalië

MPs De Roon and Popken asked the ministers whether a ship exploding near naval vessels off Somalia was a navy ship, whether EU navies were involved, and which navies were present, and whether the cause would be investigated before a Dutch ship deployed there. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that the ship was very likely not a naval vessel, that an Italian frigate found nothing on investigation, and that the incident gave no reason for further inquiry.
Neither the initial incident report nor the subsequent actions of EUNAVFOR Atalanta give reason to carry out further investigation.
Zowel de initiële incidentmelding als de daaropvolgende acties van EUNAVFOR Atalanta geven geen aanleiding om verder onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht "Niets ging goed bij fatale schietoefening commando’s"

An MP asks the Defence Minister about a fatal live-fire exercise involving commandos and the recurring safety lapses the Safety Board (OVV) described, and whether safety is now guaranteed. The Minister says safety must always be ensured, that shooting exercises were suspended and the KCT is reviewing procedures, and that OVV recommendations are being implemented, though she gives no definitive guarantee and a dedicated shooting facility will only be ready in 2019.
The findings of the OVV are leading in this matter.
De bevindingen van de OVV zijn hierbij leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en Maeijer over het bericht dat Europese legers structureel gaan samenwerken

MPs Popken and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Defence Minister about reports that European armies will cooperate structurally, including Poland's concerns about duplication with NATO, EU defence fund spending, and EU Battlegroup costs and deployments. The minister answered that Netherlands supports stronger EU defence within a complementary NATO framework, outlined its EU Battlegroup contributions for 2018, and rejected any transfer of sovereignty.
Your House will receive a BNC fiche on the European Defence Fund setting out the Dutch position.
Uw Kamer ontvangt een BNC-fiche over het Europees Defensiefonds met daarin het Nederlandse standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Tellegen over het aanhouden van een veroordeelde terrorist op de vliegbasis Volkel

MPs Van den Bosch and Tellegen (VVD) asked the Defence and Justice ministers how a convicted terrorist gained access to Volkel air base, whether screening was done, why he was released, and whether access rules will be tightened. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 34 550-X, nr. 91) answering a related request, without giving substantive answers in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht dat officieren waarschuwen dat onze Luchtmacht er slecht voor staat

An MP asked the Defence Minister about officers warning that the air force is in poor shape after 20 years of missions, and whether the four-year recovery period is too long and whether defence should focus on homeland defence. The minister acknowledged the F-16 fleet's readiness limits, said recovery takes eighteen months with possible redeployment from 2018, defended the F-35 transition and the postponement of the MALE UAV, and argued the armed forces must be able to operate beyond the EU's borders.
Recovering the readiness of the F-16s takes eighteen months.
Het herstel van de gereedheid van de F-16's neemt achttien maanden in beslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een schietincident in Irak in 2004

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute a Dutch soldier before all evidence on a 2004 Iraq shooting was gathered, whether it withheld statements, and how the minister views the claim that the OM misled the court. The minister declined substantive answers, citing a pending Article 12 Sv complaint procedure, judicial independence, privacy and investigative interests.
A procedure under Article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is currently ongoing on this matter.
Over deze aangelegenheid loopt momenteel een procedure ex artikel 12 Wetboek van strafvordering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over het bericht 'Man koopt auto van Defensie en vindt nepbom'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether a fake explosive left in a former Defence vehicle sold at auction was a serious lapse, whether other sold vehicles might contain explosives, and how future sales could be prevented from leaving such items behind. The Minister confirmed the object resembles a fake explosive, said the Royal Marechaussee is investigating how it got there, and explained that surplus vehicles are transferred to Domeinen Roerende Zaken for public sale after Defence removes non-standard defence items, without addressing whether other vehicles are affected.
The Royal Marechaussee is investigating how and when the object was placed in the car.
De Koninklijke Marechaussee onderzoekt hoe en wanneer het voorwerp in de auto is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Knops over de aangekondigde evaluatie van de helikopterlaagvlieggebieden

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister why the promised 2014 evaluation of helicopter low-flying areas was delayed, what the plan and timeline are, and how complaints are handled. The minister attributes the delay to waiting for a Council of State ruling and staff reductions, commits to presenting a draft report to the advisory group by end of May 2017 with a decision by year-end, and describes the complaint handling and communication practices.
The evaluation must result by the end of this year in a proposal on how a wider spread of low-flying exercises can be achieved.
De evaluatie moet voor het einde van dit jaar uitmonden in een voorstel op welke wijze meer spreiding van laagvliegoefeningen mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over tientallen meldingen bij Defensie van bedreiging van militairen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about dozens of reported threats against military personnel and how many involved Islamic or terrorist motives, plus whether dual nationals should be barred from the armed forces. The minister reported 79 incidents in 2013 to date (20 with police reports), with only five linked to an Islamic background, all involving civilians and no sign of terrorism, and referred back to earlier answers on dual nationality.
In the period in question, a total of 79 incidents were registered with Defence, in twenty of which a report was also filed with the Royal Military Police.
In de betreffende periode zijn er in totaal 79 incidenten geregistreerd bij Defensie, waarbij in twintig gevallen ook aangifte is gedaan bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Popken over de marinierstraining in het Himalayagebergte

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that a Marine Corps Himalayan climbing training cost nearly 1 million euros, asking about its added value, when Defence was informed, and how to address anger among marines. The minister confirmed costs of about 923,000 euros (about 600,000 in extra costs), justified the training as valuable experience for extreme-environment operations, and said that 2016 cuts had been considered but the training was kept because of prior commitments.
Where necessary, choices made in the readiness plan will be explained in more detail to the personnel.
Waar nodig zullen gemaakte keuzes in het gereedstellingsplan uitvoeriger worden uitgelegd aan het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de klokkenluider van vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a whistleblower at Eindhoven air base, including an entry in his medical file wrongly recorded as a psychological consult, the squadron commander's public statements, the handling of the OIO and IMG investigations, and whether the whistleblower still has legal protection. The Minister denied any falsification of the file, explained the IMG's reconstruction and its admitted dating assumptions, described the apology and data deletion, and confirmed the whistleblower remains protected by the whistleblower regulation.
There is no question of falsifying the medical file.
Van het vervalsen van het medisch dossier is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Eijsink, Van Bommel en Belhaj over het gebruik van een door Nederland gefinancierd mortuarium in Afghanistan als jongensbordeel

MPs asked whether the government knew that a mortuary it helped fund near Kamp Holland in Tarin Kowt, Afghanistan, was used as a brothel for boys (bacha bazi), when it was discovered, and what measures followed. The government answered that it had no information during ISAF that the building was misused, learned of it from the Brandpunt broadcast, raised child abuse with local leaders regularly, and confirmed it financed the mortuary (about EUR 15,000) in 2008.
During the ISAF mission the cabinet had no information showing that the mortuary was being used for other purposes.
Het kabinet beschikte gedurende de ISAF-missie niet over informatie waaruit bleek dat het mortuarium voor andere doeleinden werd gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een Chinees radarsysteem waarvoor de JSF niet langer onzichtbaar zou zijn

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Chinese state media reports of a quantum radar test threaten the stealth of the F-35 and whether the Netherlands will verify its stealth itself. The minister answered that quantum radar is still experimental, that stealth reduces but does not eliminate detection, and that the Dutch air force has its own means to assess stealth on delivered aircraft.
The production process ensures that the aircraft meets the stealth specifications upon delivery.
Het productieproces waarborgt dat het toestel bij aflevering aan de stealth specificaties voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de enorme tekorten aan marechaussees op Schiphol

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the reported shortage of Royal Marechaussee staff at Schiphol and the government's response to warnings that security was at risk. The ministers replied that temporary extra capacity (135 fte) and e-gates will allow minimum performance in 2017, with structural needs to be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options to be proposed.
Together with the airports, the aim is a safe yet swift flow of passengers, and a proper balance between mobility and security is continually sought.
Gezamenlijk met de luchthavens, wordt gestreefd naar een veilige doch snelle doorstroom van passagiers en wordt voortdurend naar een juiste balans tussen «mobiliteit» en veiligheid gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht 'Veiligheid is in het geding, waarschuwt Schiphol'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops (CDA) asked ministers whether KMar border-guard capacity at Schiphol would be expanded given rising passenger numbers and terror threat, and about funding and timing of extra staff. The government answered that 135 temporary FTE are funded from incidental resources and available by summer 2017, that structural capacity will be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options, and that it declines to bear the 190 million euro automation cost at Schiphol.
In the current situation, with Schiphol's healthy financial position and a competitive cost level for airlines, the cabinet sees no reason to also contribute financially to the investment programme.

Het kabinet ziet in de huidige situatie, met een gezonde financiële positie van Schiphol en een concurrerend kostenniveau voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen, geen aanleiding om ook financieel bij te dragen aan het investeringsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht inzake de illegale opstelling van raketten door Rusland

MP Ten Broeke asks the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether Russia deployed new intermediate-range missiles in breach of the INF treaty and how NATO has responded. The government says it cannot yet confirm the deployment, notes that such deployment would breach the treaty, and describes ongoing NATO-Russia dialogue and a pattern of Russian provocations.
the government cannot yet confirm that the Russian armed forces have deployed a ground-launched cruise missile with a range of 500 to 5,500 kilometres
kan de regering het opstellen van een grondgelanceerd kruisvluchtwapen met een bereik van 500 kilometer tot 5.500 kilometer door de Russische krijgsmacht vooralsnog niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de omgang van Nederland met het seksueel misbruik van minderjarige jongens (‘bacha bazi’) in Afghanistan

MP Belhaj asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers how the Netherlands handled bacha bazi (sexual abuse of boys) in Afghanistan, including pre-deployment briefing, protocols, reports by soldiers and Afghan criminal law. The ministers answered that no specific protocols existed, one 2007 incident was reported to Afghan police without known prosecution, and they would raise children's rights in existing dialogues.
There are no specific guidelines or protocols for Dutch soldiers on how to act regarding bacha bazi.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen of protocollen voor Nederlandse militairen hoe zij moeten handelen ten aanzien van «bacha bazi».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een Brits bedrijf het IT-beveiligingsbedrijf dat Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt, heeft overgenomen

MPs Van Raak and Jasper van Dijk asked why the state relies on a private firm to secure state secrets, whether the UK takeover of Fox-IT endangers them, and why the NCTV and MIVD were not informed or able to block the deal. The ministers answered that the state needs specialised private expertise, that contractual and legal security requirements guard against unwanted access, that no notification duty existed and Dutch law offers no grounds to restrict such takeovers, and that the MIVD lacks power to block them.
Under the existing contractual arrangements with the company concerned, there was no obligation to inform the NCTV of a proposed takeover.
Op grond van de bestaande contractuele afspraken met het betreffende bedrijf bestond niet de verplichting om de NCTV op de hoogte te stellen van een voorgenomen overname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de slag om Chora

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers whether they would revise the official civilian death toll from the 2007 Chora operation after a documentary with eyewitness claims, whether Australia objected to artillery use, and whether a COMISAF report and NATO's response can be shared. The government declined to revise its position, pointed to several prior investigations, said Australia raised no objection and was not involved in the fire decisions, and withheld the COMISAF report and NATO response as operationally sensitive.
The COMISAF report and the reaction of SACEUR and the NATO Secretary General contain operationally sensitive information.
Het rapport van COMISAF en de reactie van SACEUR en de Secretaris-generaal van de Navo hierop bevatten operationeel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Marinier is homo op Aruba’

An MP asked the Defence Minister how many marines on Aruba had registered same-sex partnerships to obtain a higher foreign allowance, what it cost, whether it was checked elsewhere and whether money would be recovered. The minister said such partnerships made purely for the allowance are no longer tolerated and requests will be refused, but Defence does not record how many occurred for privacy reasons, and no recovery was needed as there was no formal misuse.
For reasons of privacy, Defence does not register the nature of a relationship when such an application is made.
Om redenen van privacy registreert Defensie bij een dergelijke aanvraag namelijk niet de aard van een relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het tekort aan materieel voor de missie in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether shortages of night-vision devices, jammers and new body armour were preventing Dutch troops in Mali from patrolling, and why troop numbers were not matched to equipment. The minister acknowledged the unit handover caused delays, said all needed equipment is now in theatre, confirmed five reconnaissance groups are operational, and said night-vision devices were shared with other units and new ones will be delivered from February 2017.
Defence has since purchased new night-vision devices. These will become available in phases from February 2017.
Defensie heeft inmiddels nieuwe nachtzichtmiddelen gekocht. Deze komen vanaf februari 2017 gefaseerd beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het uitblijven van luchtsteun in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether France, the UK and the US agreed in May 1995 to halt air strikes on Serbian targets without informing the Netherlands, and whether they had access to documents on this. The government answered that a NIOD exploration found no evidence of secret international decision-making, that it had asked allies for information but does not expect release soon, and that it will not renew the request.
The NIOD concludes in its report that the exploration found no evidence or indications of secret international political decision-making, unknown to the Netherlands, on providing such air support.

Het NIOD concludeert in zijn rapport dat de verkenning geen bewijzen of aanwijzingen heeft opgeleverd voor het bestaan van voor Nederland geheime internationale politieke besluitvorming over het verlenen van dergelijke luchtsteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de uitzending van 'Waarom Srebrenica moest vallen'

MP Kuzu asked the Defence Minister whether a 2015 documentary revealed new information about the Dutch role in the fall of Srebrenica, alleged betrayal by allied states, and related accountability and victim-support measures. The government answered that a NIOD exploratory study found no evidence of secret allied deals or betrayal, declined to request further US documents, and rejected new external investigations and claims reconsideration.
NIOD states that it has not been shown that the allies France, the United Kingdom and the United States made secret agreements not to use air power anymore.
Het NIOD stelt dat niet is gebleken dat de bondgenoten Frankrijk, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de Verenigde Staten geheime afspraken hebben gemaakt om het luchtwapen niet meer in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de klokkenluider van Vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that whistleblowers at Defence were pressured, whether the department erred in the Eindhoven air base case, whether the whistleblower met the Minister and consented to sharing the IMG report with parliament, and whether he risks consequences. The Minister said the whistleblower consented, the report was shared confidentially, and no consequences are expected, while maintaining that the case involved careless recording but no fraud.
The report contains not only confidential personal data of the whistleblower, which was the reason for confidential disclosure.
Daarnaast bevat dit IMG-rapport niet alleen vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens van de klokkenluider, hetgeen reden is geweest voor de vertrouwelijke verstrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het tekort aan materieel voor de missie in Mali

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why parliament learned of an equipment shortage for the Mali (MINUSMA) mission from the press, when this was known, whether the shortage is shameful, and whether the mission should be ended. The minister acknowledged delayed equipment delivery and said the required gear is now in the operating area, while declining to end the mission, which was extended to the end of 2017.
There is a delayed delivery of equipment.
Er is sprake van een vertraagde levering van materieel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over megaclaims naar aanleiding van brandstofleveranties in Afghanistan

MPs Van Dijk and Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister about reported NATO-Supreme Group fuel-supply claims in Afghanistan, including whether NATO faces a court case and how much Dutch money is involved, and about oversight and outsourcing. The minister declined to give details on the claims while the court case is pending, confirmed the Netherlands received fuel from Supreme, said control services are adequately equipped, and said Defence still has contracts with Supreme and outsources procurement for cost reasons.
As long as the case is still before the court, the government cannot go into detail on this.
Zolang de zaak nog voor de rechtbank dient, kan de regering hierover niet in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het Apache ongeluk in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government knew of contamination of hydraulic fluid in the AH-64D Apache control system before the fatal Mali crash, and whether that caused the crash. The minister confirmed awareness of the US findings, said both incidents involved the same component but the Dutch failure had a different technical cause, and stated that Dutch ground equipment and fluid testing showed no shortcomings.
At the time, Defence examined whether the Dutch ground equipment met the requirements and whether the hydraulic fluid was periodically tested and analysed.
Destijds heeft Defensie onderzocht of de Nederlandse gronduitrusting voldeed aan de eisen en of de hydraulische vloeistof periodiek werd getest en geanalyseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over claims met betrekking tot het reinigingsmiddel PX-10

An MP asked the Defence Minister why PX-10 victims were told their compensation claims might be time-barred, whether the government would clearly rule out limitation, and why Defence needs former staff to prove their employment. The minister answered that relative limitation (five years from October 2008) is applied case by case without automatic invocation, that absolute limitation (30 years) will not be invoked, and that validating old employment records is reasonable.
However, Defence will not automatically invoke the relative limitation period.
Echter, Defensie zal de relatieve verjaringstermijn niet automatisch inroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over de verdwenen oorlogsgraven van Nederlanders in de Javazee

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked whether the government will pursue an international treaty to protect war graves at sea, what contacts with other states produced, whether wrecks of Dutch warships were towed to Surabaya and sold as scrap, and when the investigation will conclude. The minister replied that existing law already protects warship wrecks, that contacts with several states have taken place, that it is too early to confirm the scrapping report, and that no concrete timeline exists yet, though results will be shared.
Of course we will inform you about the outcome of the investigation.
Uiteraard zullen wij u informeren over de uitkomst van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het mandaat van de VN-missie dubbelzinnig is

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the UN MINUSMA mandate in Mali is ambiguous, since troops must be impartial while supporting state-building, and whether impartiality problems explain attacks on peacekeepers. The minister replied that the mandate is clear, centred on supporting the peace agreement, that the attacks are terrorist acts by non-signatory groups, and that the Rules of Engagement are clear, so no changes were planned.
The cabinet is of the view that the mandate of MINUSMA is clear.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het mandaat van MINUSMA duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland een Nederlandse onderzeeër op de Middellandse Zee verjaagt

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Russia drove a Dutch submarine out of the Mediterranean, whether it was in international waters, what Russia's legal basis was, whether there was diplomatic contact, and what the submarine was doing there. The ministers only acknowledged the Russian statements, declined to comment on submarine movements, and said there had been no contact with Russia.
No statements are made about the movements of Dutch submarines.
Over de bewegingen van Nederlandse onderzeeboten worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de vorstelijke vertrekregelingen bij de Belastingdienst en het gapend AOW-gat bij Defensie

Two CDA MPs asked the Defence and Finance ministers about the suspended defence pay talks, the AOW (state pension) gap for former defence staff, and the generous early-retirement scheme at the Tax Administration. The minister answered that talks have resumed, that a new AOW arrangement is being pursued in response to court rulings and that Finance is not her responsibility, while distinguishing the two schemes' purposes.
As employer, I have the responsibility to make a provision for the AOW gap of civilians and military personnel in (former) service at Defence.
Als werkgever heb ik de verantwoordelijkheid om een voorziening te treffen voor het AOW-gat van burgers en militairen in (voormalige) dienst bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de bescherming van Nederlandse militairen tegen jihaddrones in Irak

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch soldiers in Iraq face risks from jihadist explosive-laden drones, how they are protected and why drone-detection procurement was postponed. The Minister confirmed a nearby drone attack, described limited detection capacity with an expansion planned for 2023, and said the project was delayed by one year due to competing needs.
For security reasons, no further information will be provided on this.
In verband met de veiligheid worden hierover verder geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het CAO-overleg bij Defensie

Teeven (VVD) asked the Defence Minister whether CAO wage negotiations at Defence had stalled over long-term pension-related pay issues, what the sticking points are, and how talks will proceed. The minister confirmed the talks are stalled, explained that Rijksbrede pension developments are being assessed and will take time, and said the unions have suspended negotiations pending that assessment.
Defence considers reaching a working conditions agreement important and hopes negotiations can resume in the short term.
Defensie vindt het bereiken van een arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord belangrijk en hoopt dat de onderhandelingen op korte termijn kunnen worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de onrust binnen het Korps Commandotroepen

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister about reported unrest and shortcomings in the Commando Troops (KCT), including unsafe training sites, equipment shortages and the need for drones. The minister denied that the KCT is not being heard, said safety measures were taken after a fatal training accident under investigation, referred the detailed equipment shortfall to a confidential letter, and said drone needs are being reviewed with an expansion expected in mid-2017.
Defence regards this as operationally sensitive information.
Defensie beschouwt dit als operationeel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de inzet van militairen op Schiphol

An MP asked the government about deploying Royal Netherlands Marechaussee support and army infantry at Schiphol, whether the promised 85 new marechaussees were truly additional, and why a structural solution was still pending. The minister answered that army support was a temporary, ended measure, that the 85 recruits were redirected from regular intake and phased in, and that a capacity needs assessment would be sent to parliament in autumn.
This autumn I will inform you further.
Dit najaar zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over een uitnodiging aan Saoedi-Arabië voor een Nederlandse wapenbeurs

MPs asked whether the Royal Netherlands Navy invited a Saudi delegation to the MAST 2016 defence fair, why the first question was not fully answered, and how an invitation squares with a strict arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia given the situation in Yemen and human rights. The government confirmed invitations went to 23 countries including Saudi Arabia, that no Saudi delegation attended (reason unknown), maintained its strict export licensing, and said it could not provide a central overview of past defence-fair invitations.
The Ministry of Defence does not keep a central registration of defence fairs.
Het Ministerie van Defensie voert geen centrale registratie van defensiebeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen inzake de misstanden op vliegbasis Eindhoven

MPs Belhaj and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about new revelations of misconduct at Eindhoven air base, the scope and powers of the internal investigation, its timeline, and the status of the flares transport case. The minister declined to share the investigation's assignment details or findings before completion, promised to inform parliament of the outcome, and reported that prosecutors dropped the flares case without finding criminal offences.
Pending the investigation results, I will make no further statements on this.
In afwachting van de onderzoeksresultaten doe ik hier geen nadere uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that F-35 software problems remain unresolved, the risks flagged by the US chief tester, schedule delays, cost overruns and the readiness of the aircraft. The minister acknowledged technical challenges and a roughly six-month software delay but said the Dutch budget ceiling is unchanged, the Dutch SDD contribution is capped with overruns borne by the US, and rejected the claim that acquisition is in doubt.
The US government has not yet released the memo in question.
De Amerikaanse overheid heeft het desbetreffende memo tot op heden niet vrijgegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er een wachtlijst bestaat voor assistentiehonden voor mensen met een psychische stoornis en over het bericht dat assistentiehonden nog steeds niet overal toega

MPs asked the Defence and Health ministers about waiting lists for assistance dogs for veterans with PTSD and about hotels refusing access to assistance dogs despite legal duties. The ministers said waiting lists are undesirable but left them to the sector, pointed to pending independent research funded by Defence, and promised to consult Koninklijke Horeca Nederland and to raise awareness.
It is undesirable that hotels wrongly refuse assistance dogs.
Het is onwenselijk dat hotels assistentiehonden ten onrechte weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Turkse steun voor jihadi’s en een Turks verzoek om de inzet van  inlichtingendiensten voor de jacht op opponenten van Erdogan

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether a Turkish request for German intelligence help in hunting Erdogan opponents had reached Dutch services, whether Turkish support for jihadists was known to the AIVD and MIVD, and whether cooperation should end. The government said it cannot discuss concrete contacts with foreign services publicly, outlined its cooperation criteria, and declined to give details on the services' knowledge.
The government cannot publicly discuss concrete contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over "leenhelmen" voor militairen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister about reports that soldiers on missions must share helmets, and about shortages of equipment and ammunition, asking whether every soldier will get a helmet and whether the 2% NATO spending target will be met. The minister answered that 22,500 new helmets are being bought, 18,000 for operational personnel and 4,500 for a central pool, that equipment is issued on a need-to-have basis, that ammunition stocks are being raised, and that the government is taking steps toward the NATO spending commitment.
Defence is therefore purchasing 22,500 new helmets, of which 18,000 will be issued to military personnel with an operational function.
Defensie schaft daarom 22.500 nieuwe helmen aan, waarvan 18.000 worden verstrekt aan militairen met een operationele functie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de aanschaf van nieuwe tanker/transportvliegtuigen

An MP asks the Defence Minister why Parliament was only informed on the day of contract signing about the costs of buying two MRTT tanker aircraft, why the partner countries withdrew, and why cost estimates vary widely. The Minister answers that the offer deadline forced quick signing, that Luxembourg (about 10 percent) is the remaining partner with options for others, that the cost range is given confidentially within the DMP framework, and declines to give exact prices for commercial confidentiality reasons.
On the day of contract signing, 28 July, I informed the House immediately by letter (Kamerstuk 27 830, no. 183).
Op de dag van de ondertekening van het contract, op 28 juli jl., heb ik de Kamer direct per brief (Kamerstuk 27 830, nr. 183 ) geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de noodzaak om NAVO-kernwapens weg te halen uit Turkije

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government shares concern about NATO nuclear weapons stored at Incirlik in Turkey, whether they should be removed, and whether Turkey should be expelled from NATO after the post-coup crackdown. The ministers declined to confirm locations or numbers of nuclear weapons, stated that Turkey's NATO membership is not under discussion, and said the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to respect the rule of law.
Based on alliance and legally binding agreements, no statements are made about the locations and numbers per location of these nuclear weapons in Europe.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken worden geen mededelingen gedaan over locaties en aantallen per locatie van deze kernwapens in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over geldverspilling bij de Luchtmacht

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister about spending by the Air Force on its Innovation AIR programme, including paid speakers such as Stanley McChrystal, budgets, staffing and certificates. The minister defends the innovation cells and the speaker costs as serving military innovation and technical staff retention, and answers most questions with figures, though the claim that a toilet was placed in a lift is denied.
On the goals and results of AIR and the various other innovation initiatives, Defence is open and transparent.
Over de doelen en resultaten van AIR en de diverse andere innovatie-initiatieven is Defensie open en transparant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ronnes en Fokke over de verhuizing van het Financieel Service Centrum Defensie van Limburg naar Utrecht

MPs Knops, Ronnes and Fokke asked the Defence Minister why the Financieel Service Centrum (FSC) in Eygelshoven is being moved to Utrecht despite earlier promises to keep work in Limburg, and how this fits with union and works-council opposition, job losses in Limburg, and the motion on fair treatment of peripheral provinces. The Minister answered that a 2015 evaluation showed the split was not natural, that US forces returning to Eygelshoven make the site unsuitable for offices, and that the decision is based primarily on operational grounds with the works council involved in implementation.
These developments were decisive in revising the earlier decision.
Deze ontwikkelingen zijn doorslaggevend geweest om het eerder genomen besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de situatie in Zuid-Soedan en de evacuatie van Nederlandse militairen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence about the security situation in Juba, South Sudan, the whereabouts and protection of six Dutch staff officers, UN peacekeeper casualties, and whether Dutch soldiers should be evacuated immediately. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter, 'Recente ontwikkelingen Zuid-Sudan', rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe misstanden op Vliegbasis Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether a new internal investigation into misconduct at Eindhoven Air Base (ten incidents, including alcohol abuse and fraud) was being carried out, who would conduct it, why it was not external, and whether earlier measures had been adequate, including whether disciplinary action had been taken and staff suspended. The Minister confirmed the base commander ordered an internal investigation by a commission of staff from outside the base with an outside retired colonel as chair, said it follows the internal investigation protocol, and declined to comment further on earlier measures or suspensions pending the results.
On the advice of the Royal Marechaussee, the commander of Eindhoven Air Base ordered an investigation into (financial) integrity violations at the air base.
Op advies van de Koninklijke Marechaussee heeft de commandant van de Vliegbasis Eindhoven een onderzoek gelast naar (financiële) integriteitschendingen op de vliegbasis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk en Servaes over een Saoedische delegatie die op uitnodiging van de Koninklijke Marine een Nederlandse wapenbeurs bezoekt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk and Servaes asked whether a Saudi delegation was invited by the Royal Netherlands Navy to the MAST arms fair, and how such an invitation fits with the motion on Saudi arms exports, the EU Parliament resolution and alleged humanitarian law violations in Yemen. The ministers replied that no Saudi delegation attended MAST 2016, and that the government maintains a very strict case-by-case arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia, with no export licences granted in 2016 so far.
No, no Saudi delegation was present at the Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Neen, er is geen Saoedische delegatie aanwezig geweest op de Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Merkies over defensiebedrijven die via Nederland belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked whether large defence companies use Dutch holdings to avoid tax, how much corruption and holding data is tracked, and whether research into the sector's use of the Dutch tax climate is needed. The State Secretary answered that such data is not kept, corruption is addressed through EU and national anti-money-laundering and criminal rules, and that no specific sector-focused research is planned.
This data is not kept as such.
Deze gegevens worden niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de stijging van het aantal ernstige ongevallen bij Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a reported rise in serious accidents at the Ministry of Defence, whether budget cuts caused it, and how the number will be reduced. The Minister answered that the rise in reported incidents reflects an improved reporting culture rather than worse safety, denied an increase in serious accidents, supplied the data as attachments, and described ongoing risk assessments and investigations of serious incidents.
The rise in the number of reports is partly related to the improved reporting culture at Defence.
De stijging van het aantal meldingen hangt onder meer samen met de verbeterde meldingscultuur bij Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht “Nederlands-Duits defensiebedrijf gehackt door Chinezen”

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Rheinmetall Defence secret data was stolen by Chinese hackers since 2012, and how responsibility for protecting defence-sector ICT is divided between Defence and private firms. The minister declined to confirm or refute the media report, said neither Rheinmetall nor Fox-IT confirmed theft, and stated that protecting the private sector is not Defence's task, pointing to contractual security rules (ABDO) and MIVD audits.
It is not for the Ministry of Defence to refute or confirm such reporting.
Het is niet aan het Ministerie van Defensie om dergelijke berichtgeving te ontkrachten of te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bedrijf Supreme Group dat Nederlandse troepen in Afghanistan heeft bevoorraad

SP MPs asked whether Defence knew of overcharging by Supreme Group, whether a whistleblower's report was acted on, and whether audits, repayment and legal action occurred. The minister confirmed the overcharging, said the whistleblower report was handled through audits and the matter was corrected, withheld amounts and audit reports as commercially confidential but offered confidential briefing, and said no civil or criminal action was taken since the company cooperated and repaid.
I am willing to inform you about the reports confidentially.
Ik ben bereid u op vertrouwelijke wijze over de rapporten te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over aan Jordanië verkochte F-16’s

The MP De Roon asked how many F-16s the Netherlands sold to Jordan, whether they are operational, whether external inspections are possible, and whether they were resold to Pakistan. The government answered that 21 were sold (6 delivered), the six delivered are still in use, post-shipment controls are complex but the Dutch ambassador confirmed with Jordan that no resale to Pakistan will occur.
Post-shipment controls are a complex matter, because the Netherlands has no jurisdiction in the country of end use.
Controles na levering ( post shipment controls ) zijn een complexe zaak, omdat Nederland geen jurisdictie in het land van eindgebruik heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht ‘Laat veteranen op 25 juni vrij reizen’

An MP asked whether post-active veterans may travel free by rail on Veterans Day, and whether this excludes actively serving veterans and their families. The government answered that post-active veterans get two free day-train cards per year via the Veterans Institute, with an extra card for a partner or companion when registered for the parade, while active-duty veterans claim travel costs through Defence.
Post-active veterans receive travel tickets via the Veterans Institute, because they cannot claim through the regular Defence channels.
Post-actieve veteranen krijgen vervoerbewijzen via het Veteraneninstituut, omdat zij niet via de reguliere Defensiekanalen kunnen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Vrij reizen voor veteranen op Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether free travel for veterans on Veteranendag could be extended to active veterans, and whether the government shares the view that veterans deserve more open recognition. The Minister of Defence answered that the 76 percent public support for veteran recognition is noted, that recognition policy is already in place, and that active veterans can already claim travel costs to veteran events.
Veterans in active service already have that option. They can claim travel to veterans' events.
Veteranen in werkelijke dienst hebben die mogelijkheid al. Zij kunnen reizen naar veteranenevenementen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over slachtoffers van chroomverf

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Defence about chromium-6 paint victims at the former POMS site, including their long wait for the RIVM study, a survey showing 68 percent health complaints, medical data held by the CAOP reporting point, other hazardous substances such as depleted uranium, and whether individual work experiences are considered. The Minister answered that the RIVM study is ongoing and must be thorough, that most questions should be answered this year, that the health data can only be shared within privacy rules for the RIVM study, and that no separate investigation into other substances is planned.
Within the framework of privacy legislation, Defence can only make the data provided by (former) employees available for the RIVM study.
Defensie kan binnen de kaders van de privacywetgeving de gegevens die (oud-)medewerkers hebben gegeven alleen beschikbaar stellen voor het RIVM-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over onderzoek naar de export van goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including whether licences were required and whether defence projects are affected. The minister replied that customs found no breach of Dutch or European law, that the violations concerned US sanctions and were settled with a warning, and that there are no consequences for defence projects.
The customs investigation shows that RH Marine Group (formerly Imtech Marine) did not violate Dutch or European legislation.
Het onderzoek van de Douane wijst uit dat RH Marine Group (voormalig Imtech Marine) geen Nederlandse of Europese wetgeving heeft overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over Nut en noodzaak van de aanschaf van MALE UAV (medium-altitude long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle)

An MP asks the Defence Minister about the necessity, cost, procurement choice, training and ethics of acquiring MQ-9 Reaper MALE drones, which have been postponed. The minister answers that the need is for surveillance rather than armed drones, that the delay was a budget-driven prioritisation, that a lease option is being studied, and that the government supports an open international debate on armed drones.
As explained in the 2016 budget, Defence is examining whether this need can be met in an alternative way, for example through a leasing arrangement.
Zoals in de begroting voor 2016 is toegelicht onderzoekt Defensie of op alternatieve wijze, bijvoorbeeld via een leaseconstructie, in deze behoefte kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven inzake het bericht over gestolen data van Zwitserse speciale eenheden door Russische hackers

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked the Defence Minister about reports that Russian hackers stole data on Swiss special forces, the risks of such cyberattacks to the Dutch armed forces, and whether Dutch units' identities are adequately protected. The Minister replied that Switzerland is investigating the incident, that Defence faces a considerable and growing cyber espionage threat but has not lost sensitive information so far, and that the Swiss case does not require additional measures.
Defence repels attacks daily and there are so far no known cyberattacks in which sensitive information has been seized.
Defensie slaat dagelijks aanvallen af en er zijn vooralsnog geen cyberaanvallen bekend waarbij gevoelige informatie is buitgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over ‘islamitische koekoeks-jongen bij de krijgsmacht’

De Roon (PVV) asks the Defence Minister how she views reports that 29 ex-German soldiers joined jihadist groups, whether Defence risks being misused as training for jihadists, how many (ex-)soldiers have gone to Syria/Iraq and are monitored, how many Islamic personnel have been removed, and whether dual nationals should be excluded from the armed forces. The Minister says intelligence services investigate such cases, declines to publish numbers of (ex-)soldiers who travelled to conflict zones, states that conduct rather than faith is central at Defence, and refers back to earlier answers on dual nationals without adding anything.
In the letter I sent to your House on 29 May 2015 on this matter, I concluded that this is not possible.
In de brief die ik op 29 mei 2015 hierover aan uw Kamer heb gezonden (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 311 ), kom ik tot de conclusie dat dit niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het de Günal-Gezer en Eijsink over het artikel ‘Onrust op fregat’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Dutch contribution to NATO surveillance in the Aegean, aimed at people-smuggling networks, should be labelled a 'mission' rather than an 'activity', and whether that labelling carries financial consequences for crews. The minister answered that the deployment falls within the existing task package of standing NATO maritime groups, so it is classed as an activity, that crew receive the normal overtime compensation, and that financial considerations played no role; she declined to re-label it.
The deployment in the Aegean Sea falls within the existing task package of the standing NATO maritime groups.
De inzet in de Egeïsche Zee past binnen het bestaande takenpakket van de staande Navo-vlootverbanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over de fitheidstest bij de krijgsmacht

MP Teeven asked the Defence Minister about the large number of military personnel, especially senior officers in office jobs, who do not complete the mandatory annual fitness test, and whether the test should be abolished or enforced. The minister answered that the test is a useful instrument, will not be abolished, that obstacles such as facility access will be addressed with alternatives, and that commanders already have disciplinary tools to enforce it.
The individual reasons are not recorded.
De individuele redenen worden niet vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het uit de vaart nemen van de Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman

A VVD MP asked the Defence Minister about the damage to the Karel Doorman's electric propulsion motor, the lengthy eight-month repair, the lack of replacement supply capacity, and whether budget cuts contributed. The minister acknowledged an unexpected, rare defect, explained the repair must be done in a factory, and said the delay is unrelated to past budget cuts or spare-parts shortages, with a repair estimate expected after research concludes in mid-June 2016.
The investigation is expected to be completed by mid-June 2016.
Naar verwachting zal dit onderzoek medio juni 2016 voltooid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de ernstige schade aan het voortstuwingssysteem van Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman

The MP De Roon asks the Defence Minister about the choice of a diesel-electric propulsion configuration, whether 2006-2009 design cost cuts caused a motor defect, whether a deck or hull must be cut to replace the motor, who pays, whether such motors are designed to be replaceable, what warranty clauses apply and whether the Ebola deployment affects recovery of costs. The Minister answers that the cuts did not affect the motors, that the damaged motor was removed through a shaft in intermediate decks, that costs fall under the builder's warranty, that the contract cannot be published as it is commercially confidential, and that the Ebola mission does not affect the warranty claim.
The specific warranty provisions cannot be made public because they concern commercially confidential information.
De specifieke garantiebepalingen kunnen niet openbaar worden gemaakt omdat het om commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van De Roon de trage afhandeling van klachtbrieven door het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked why the Defence Ministry has not sped up handling of complaint letters, which is costing large sums in penalty payments, and how many late decisions occurred over five years. The minister explained that late decisions stem from complex court rulings on staff allowances, that penalty payments totalled about 318,000 euros in 2015, and that accuracy takes priority over speed without committing to a concrete new measure.
The Ministry of Defence does what it can to make decisions within the statutory deadline.
Defensie doet wat zij kan om binnen de wettelijke termijn besluiten te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het uitbesteden van militairen taken

An MP asked the Defence Minister for an overview of military tasks outsourced to private parties in the missions in Mali, Iraq/eastern Syria, Afghanistan and Somalia. The minister answered that outsourced tasks are mainly support services and declined to name the companies, citing security reasons.
For security reasons, the names of the companies and organisations cooperating in this context are not made public.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen worden de namen van de bedrijven en organisaties waarmee in dit verband wordt samengewerkt, niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse luchtmacht naar een alternatief voor de F-35 zoekt

MP Belhaj asked whether the US Air Force search for an alternative to the F-35 (reported as a replacement for the A-10) should lead the Netherlands to reconsider its F-35 purchase and whether it would affect Dutch unit prices. The minister answered that the US is studying options for succeeding the A-10, not replacing the F-35, that the F-35 is a multirole aircraft with the required capabilities, and that US contract negotiations have historically lowered unit prices.
The US Air Force is not looking for an alternative to the F-35, but is examining alternatives for succeeding the A-10.
De Amerikaanse luchtmacht zoekt geen alternatief voor de F-35, maar onderzoekt alternatieven voor de opvolging van de A-10.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Van Veldhoven over de militaire beveiliging van Belgische kerncentrales en het oordeel van de Hoge Gezondheidsraad dat België onvoldoende is voorbereid op een kernramp

Two D66 MPs asked whether Belgian nuclear plants guarded by the army reflect a terrorist threat, whether the Netherlands faces similar risks, and how the Belgian Health Council's finding of inadequate nuclear emergency preparedness affects Dutch policy. The minister answered that no concrete threat information underlies the Belgian measures, that Dutch nuclear security is standard and in line with law, and that the Council's findings do not change the risk picture; the OVV is still considering an investigation.
No substantive information is given on specific security measures, including whether or when military personnel are deployed.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan, dat geldt ook voor het moment waarop al dan niet militairen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over Salafisme onverenigbaar met waarden Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of radicalisation in the French army and police, Salafism within Dutch Defence, whether Salafism should be treated as a totalitarian anti-Western ideology, and how Defence handles security clearances and Salafist conduct. The minister answered largely by referring to earlier letters and reports, saying the MIVD findings go through the usual channels, that clearance decisions rest on actual conduct, and that the motion will be addressed in a broader cabinet letter.
I inform the House of the outcomes of MIVD investigations through the appropriate channels.
Over uitkomsten van onderzoeken van de MIVD informeer ik de Tweede Kamer via de daartoe geëigende kanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over een voorzorgslanding door een Apache gevechtshelikopter

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a precautionary landing by an Apache helicopter after an uncommanded flight manoeuvre, why it was transported by truck, what caused the fault warning, and whether it relates to a 2015 Mali crash. The Minister explained the standard procedures, said the investigation with Boeing is not finished and cause and follow-up measures are undetermined, and said the effects on the fleet's deployment are limited.
Defence is investigating the cause with manufacturer Boeing and collecting flight and system data from the helicopter. The investigation is not yet complete.
Defensie onderzoekt met fabrikant Boeing de oorzaak en verzamelt daartoe vlucht- en systeemdata van de helikopter. Het onderzoek is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over het bericht dat getraumatiseerde veteranen op straat dreigen te belanden

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary for health and the defence minister about reports that traumatised veterans may end up on the street after funding problems at the Compound in Assen, and whether national government should take a role given its supra-regional function. The state secretary said funding is secured for 2016, that the municipality and the Compound are seeking a multi-year solution, that no national role is foreseen under current responsibilities, and that no further central involvement is planned.

Under the current allocation of responsibilities agreed between central government and municipalities, the national government has no role regarding an additional national arrangement for care and support for the facilities the Compound in Assen provides to veterans.

In de huidige structuur van verantwoordelijkheden die zijn afgesproken tussen het Rijk en gemeenten is geen rol weggelegd voor het Rijk ten aanzien van een aanvullend landelijk arrangement voor zorg en ondersteuning voor de voorzieningen die de Compound in Assen aan veteranen biedt.
