Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over weer een voorzorgslanding door een Apache gevechtshelikopter

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a second precautionary landing of an Apache helicopter on 25 March 2016, whether it was linked to an earlier incident and to a 2015 Mali crash, and whether budget cuts were to blame. The minister said an investigation with Boeing is ongoing, the two incidents appear to have different causes, and the landings are not a consequence of budget cuts.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, Defence will determine whether this complaint leads to measures and, if so, which ones.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bepaalt Defensie of deze klacht tot maatregelen leidt en, zo ja, welke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Eijsink over Bescherming scholen en universiteiten tegen militair gebruik tijdens gewapend conflict

MPs Servaes and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about implementing guidelines protecting schools and universities from military use in armed conflict, and about the #WatchOurSchools campaign. The government answered that Dutch forces already follow the spirit of the guidelines through humanitarian law training, though they are not part of Rules of Engagement, and that Nederland has urged other states to endorse the Safe Schools initiative and recorded 52 supporting countries.
The guidelines are not part of the Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for operations, as ROEs are not a suitable instrument for including provisions of the law of armed conflict.
De richtlijnen maken geen deel uit van de Rules of Engagement (ROE's) voor operaties, aangezien ROE's geen geschikt instrument zijn voor het opnemen van oorlogsrechtelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat er mogelijk honderden ontslagen vallen bij defensie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether hundreds of dismissals were coming at the Defence Materiel Organisation, whether staff elsewhere should fear redundancy, how IT problems would be prevented from worsening, and what would be done about calls for voluntary-departure compensation. The Minister confirmed awareness, said ongoing reorganisations may create redundancy, stated IT renewal is underway, and said talks with public-sector unions on the 'knelpuntcategorie' instrument are ongoing.
Talks are being held with the public-sector union federations about possibly using the 'knelpuntcategorie' instrument for staff categories where redundancy will likely occur.
Met de centrales van overheidspersoneel wordt gesproken over de mogelijke inzet van het instrument «knelpuntcategorie» voor personeelscategorieën waarbij waarschijnlijk overtolligheid zal optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht "Defensiepersoneel vreest honderden ontslagen"

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether hundreds of jobs will disappear at DMO and JIVC due to an IT reorganisation, and about the effects on the investment quota and project timelines. The minister confirmed that JIVC and Operations are merging into one IT company, that the precise staffing effects are not yet clear, and that personnel will be consulted and redeployed where possible.
The precise consequences of these developments for the required size and composition of the future workforce are not yet clear.
De precieze gevolgen van deze ontwikkelingen voor de benodigde omvang en de samenstelling van het toekomstige personeelsbestand zijn nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het bericht "Openbaarmaking personeelsblad MIVD brengt werknemers in gevaar"

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked why the MIVD staff magazine Ingelicht was published online with unredacted staff names and photos, and what is being done about security risks. The Minister says the names should have been anonymised, that the MIVD advised honouring the access request, that no threats have been recorded, and that efforts to have the personal data removed have not yet succeeded.
In hindsight, however, it can be concluded that when the access request was granted, the names in the magazines should have been anonymised.
Achteraf kan echter geconcludeerd worden dat bij het honoreren van het inzageverzoek de namen in de bladen geanonimiseerd hadden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over voortdurende problemen bij de MIVD

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the MIVD's internal problems, the publication of its staff magazine Ingelicht exposing personnel to danger, past dysfunction, cooperation with the AIVD, and reputational issues. The Minister rejected claims of amateurism, said the risks of publication are being handled without disclosing measures, and described cooperation with the AIVD as good, with a 2009 report finding no serious work-climate problems.
In order not to undermine the effectiveness of these measures, I do not provide information about their content.
Om de effectiviteit van deze maatregelen niet te ondermijnen, doe ik over de inhoud ervan geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat het Pentagon hackers uitnodigt de digitale beveiliging te doorbreken

An MP asked the Defence Minister how she assesses the Pentagon's 'Hack the Pentagon' bug-bounty pilot, whether the Netherlands should try it and pay per vulnerability, and how Defence currently cooperates with hackers. The minister answered that the pilot is limited to public websites, that Defence will inform parliament if a similar approach is chosen, that responsible disclosure is preferred over full disclosure and paying per leak is not applied, and that Defence works with experts and partners.
Should Defence wish to pursue a similar approach, the House of Representatives will be informed about it.
Mocht Defensie tot een soortgelijke aanpak willen overgaan, dan zal de Tweede Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de relatie tussen openbaarmaking van interne tijdschriften van de MIVD en het geheimhouden van de AIVD-tapstatistieken

An MP asked whether publishing MIVD internal magazine content reveals its working methods, and why AIVD wiretap statistics cannot be published. The government answered that the MIVD publications gave no insight into working methods and that the Minister of Interior will take a new decision on AIVD wiretap statistics after a Council of State ruling, so nothing more can be said until then.
Until this assessment has been completed, nothing can be added to the earlier answers to the written questions from MP Koşer Kaya.
Tot het moment waarop deze beoordeling is afgerond, kan er niets worden toegevoegd aan de eerdere beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over eventuele schadevergoeding voor Libanonveteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Lebanon veterans' psychological complaints, delayed care, and the 163 pending claims following a court ruling on aftercare. The minister answered that care was provided, that Defence does not accept it has failed, and that claims are handled individually while the financial consequences of the court ruling will be reported before summer.
Defence has the duty to protect veterans as well as possible against the consequences of shocking experiences during missions.
Defensie heeft de plicht veteranen zo goed mogelijk te beschermen tegen de gevolgen van schokkende ervaringen tijdens missies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over luchtaanvallen in Irak en Syrië

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Dutch government about civilian casualties from anti-IS coalition airstrikes in Iraq and Syria, Dutch involvement in specific strikes, and transparency. The government said exact civilian casualty numbers cannot be determined, that Dutch involvement cannot be fully ruled out in the cited strikes, that two possible civilian-casualty cases from Dutch strikes are under investigation, and that it will press for greater coalition transparency.
For operational reasons, no details of the individual investigations are released. The House will be informed of the outcomes.
Om operationele redenen worden geen details vrijgegeven van de afzonderlijke onderzoeken. De Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Teeven over de bewapening van politie en marechaussee

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence about heavier arming of police and Royal Marechaussee in light of the terror threat, and about staffing and training. The government replied that equipment and armament are set per situation based on threat assessment, that the Marechaussee can carry out its core tasks though capacity is tight, and that extra staff is being recruited.
Should it become apparent that the performance of the Marechaussee's core tasks is at risk, the desirability and possibility of new additional measures will of course be reassessed.

Mocht blijken dat de uitvoering van de kerntaken van de Kmar in het geding komt, dan zullen de wenselijkheid en de mogelijkheid van nieuwe aanvullende maatregelen vanzelfsprekend opnieuw worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid De Roon over personeelstekorten bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee

An MP asked the Defence Minister about staff shortages at the Royal Marechaussee, including reallocation of personnel, deployment abroad and whether the force can still fulfil its core tasks amid migration and terrorism pressures. The minister replied that capacity has been reprioritised, extra staff are being recruited, about 50 marechaussees were deployed abroad in 2015, and the force can still perform its core tasks though capacity is tight.
Frequent consultation on this is held with the Ministry of Security and Justice.
Hierover wordt frequent overleg gevoerd met Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat er nog steeds onveilig wordt gewerkt met het gif chroom 6

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister whether chromium-6 contamination found at the Den Helder naval yard means workers are still exposed, and what is being done to prevent unsafe work with the substance. The minister replied that wipe samples found chromium-6 but air measurements and urine analyses showed no exposure above limits, and pointed to a 2015 defence-wide directive restricting its use.
However, on the basis of wipe samples alone it cannot be concluded that personnel were exposed to chromium-6.
Op basis van veegmonsters alleen kan echter niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat personeel is blootgesteld aan chroom-6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een opgepakte anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest and possible prosecution of a Dutch veteran who fought against IS in Syria, and why returning jihadists receive assistance while he is detained. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, described the general approach to returning jihadists, and explained that fighting IS can in principle be prosecuted under ordinary criminal law.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels over het in vreemde krijgsdienst treden

D66 MPs Pechtold and Swinkels asked whether a Dutch man arrested for fighting ISIS alongside the Kurdish YPG breaches the ban on joining foreign military service, whether the YPG is terrorist-listed, and whether the concept of 'vreemde krijgsdienst' should be revised. The Minister declined to discuss the ongoing case, said the YPG is not on Dutch, EU or UN terrorism lists, and saw no need to revise the concept, while noting a bill to allow nationality revocation for terrorist participation.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de berichten over het gebrek aan voortgang van de technologische en software ontwikkeling van de F-35

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports of delays in the technological and software development of the F-35 (Block 3F), including test cuts, withheld weapons, costs, ALIS integration, and whether the Dutch aircraft will be operational by 2019 and within budget. The Minister acknowledged a likely delay to Block 3F software (expected end-2017), stated the Dutch IOC target of end-2021 is not under serious threat, promised further reporting in the progress reports, but gave no firm cost estimates and did not commit to a new parliamentary step beyond existing reports.
Defence informs the House about the progress of the programme with the progress reports in March and September.
Defensie informeert de Kamer over de voortgang van het programma met de voortgangsrapportages in maart en september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het kritische rapport van het Pentagon over de JSF

MP Belhaj asked the Defence Minister to respond to a critical Pentagon DOT&E report on the F-35 JSF, including concerns about an early block buy, mission data file shortcomings, low readiness and operational timelines. The Minister answered that a separate letter addresses the report, that a block buy is not yet decidable and will be discussed at the JESB, that the JPO is taking measures on mission data and readiness, and that Dutch initial operational capability is expected by end 2021 with full capability in 2024.
At the upcoming JSF Executive Steering Board (JESB) at the end of March, the Block Buy will be discussed in detail.
Tijdens de komende JSF Executive Steering Board (JESB) eind maart zal de Block Buy uitvoerig aan de orde komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer, Albert de Vries en Monasch over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

Three PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers whether tender specifications for the marine barracks construction could favour regional firms in Zeeland, and why such room is possible in other public tenders but not here. The minister answered that favouring local firms through specification requirements is not permitted under procurement law, and that regional businesses can instead take part via consortia or as subcontractors.
Making room for local businesses in the programme of requirements leads to favouring those businesses and is not permitted.
Ruimte maken voor lokale bedrijven in het programma van eisen leidt tot bevoordeling van deze bedrijven en is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Thales Nederland

Two MPs asked the defence and economic affairs ministers whether Thales Nederland's 200 job cuts relate to postponed naval investments, what this means for the domestic defence industry and armed forces' access to radar technology, and how investment planning accounts for industry knowledge. The minister replied that the cuts are a company reorganisation, that investment decisions are weighed against the budget, that access to SMART-L radar technology is secured through signed contracts, and that knowledge is maintained via the Gouden Driehoek cooperation and maintenance contracts.
The measure announced by Thales Nederland is of a business-economic nature and concerns an internal reorganisation.
De maatregel die Thales Nederland heeft bekendgemaakt is van bedrijfseconomische aard en betreft een interne reorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens dat Defensie discrimineert op grond van chronische ziekte

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister how she views a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that Defence discriminated against an applicant on grounds of chronic illness, and what she will do about it. The minister replied that medical basic requirements apply to all applicants, that Defence is talking with the person about options, and that the policy remains unchanged.
However, the policy remains unchanged. The medical basic requirements for military personnel apply to all applicants.
Het beleid blijft echter ongewijzigd. De medische basiseisen voor militairen gelden voor alle sollicitanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de informatiebijeenkomst PX-10

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about the PX-10 information meeting, the RIVM study, unpublished documents, the exposure scenarios, and whether PX-10 would be reintroduced and the study reopened. The minister defended the meeting and the RIVM study, promised to publish some documents under FOI, and declined to reopen the research.
The RIVM stands by the research and sees no reason to carry out the study again.
Het RIVM blijft achter het onderzoek staan en ziet geen aanleiding om het onderzoek opnieuw uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ‘Toenemende twijfels over neerhalen Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije’

MP Knops (CDA) asked the government whether it still believes Turkey's account of shooting down a Russian Su-24, given analyses of radar data suggesting the jet did not clearly enter Turkish airspace, and whether the Netherlands has independent intelligence. The government replied that the exact circumstances cannot be verified from the released radar images alone, that it relies on the consistent assessments of several allies and NATO's Secretary General, does not comment publicly on intelligence sources, and sees no reason for an international investigation.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the information position or sources of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de informatiepositie of bronnen van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over export van militair materieel aan Saoedi-Arabië

SP MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms export licences to Saudi Arabia breach EU and international law given the Yemen war and blockade, and whether Nederland will restrict such exports. The ministers acknowledge likely violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition, report four licences since March 2015 worth 2.8 million euro, and say they reject most military-related requests and will grant further licences only where no use in Yemen or rights abuses is conceivable.
Only when it is indisputably established that goods cannot be used in the fighting in Yemen or for human rights violations will a licence still be issued.
Alleen wanneer onomstotelijk vaststaat dat goederen niet kunnen worden ingezet in de strijd in Jemen of bij mensenrechtenschendingen zal nog een vergunning worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Günal-Gezer en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Amper profijt Zeeuwse bedrijven bij bouw marinierskazerne'

MPs Günal-Gezer and Albert de Vries asked the Defence Minister why the Vlissingen marine barracks tender was structured as an all-in DBFMO contract, which they said sidelined Zeeland firms, and whether regional firms could be guaranteed work. The minister answered that a PPC chose DBFMO for fair competition, that delays stem from added defence requirements and site surveys, that law prevents favouring regional firms, and that the project will create over 1,700 direct jobs.
This method of procurement guarantees fair and free competition, so favouring or disadvantaging companies in a particular region is ruled out.
Deze wijze van aanbesteden garandeert eerlijke en vrije concurrentie, waardoor het bevoordelen of benadelen van bedrijven in een bepaalde regio is uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het onderzoek naar de export van omstreden goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of dual-use goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including licensing, the countries involved, and consequences for defence projects. The minister confirmed that customs is investigating after the ministry was alerted and that the remaining questions will be answered once the investigation, expected in about two months, is complete.
Questions 3 through 7 will be answered after the customs investigation has been completed.
De vragen 3 tot en met 7 worden beantwoord na afronding van het onderzoek van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het optreden van Nederlandse special forces in Afrika

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked about Dutch special forces training African militaries in counter-terrorism, the participation in Flintlock exercises since 2007, and a secret marine taskforce against piracy off Somalia that was not reported to parliament. The government answered that training takes place in secured military areas with negligible risk, lists Flintlock deployments year by year, and states that anti-piracy operations were reported via the article 100 procedure without naming this taskforce.
The name of the taskforce in question was not mentioned at the time.
De naam van onderhavige taskforce is destijds niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'We zijn een schietschijf voor terroristen', marechaussee bij Tweede Kamer klaagt over klein pistool’

Tellegen (VVD) asked whether the Koninklijke Marechaussee is adequately armed to resist terrorist attacks at sites it guards, including the Tweede Kamer, and how it scales up in emergencies. The minister answered that armament is set per threat-based security concept, regularly reviewed and adjusted with the NCTV and local authorities, but declined to give details of equipment or escalation as this would reveal working methods.
I cannot provide details on the precise equipment, including armament, because this would give insight into the working methods of the Royal Marechaussee.
Over de precieze uitrusting, inclusief de bewapening, kan ik geen mededelingen doen, omdat dit inzicht geeft in de werkwijze van de Koninklijke Marechaussee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Fokker

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked whether Fokker's job cuts of 270 positions affect Dutch defence industry, the armed forces, F-35 technology access, and whether Thales cuts signal a wider trend. Minister Kamp answered that the cuts stem from the civil aircraft market, do not weaken Fokker's strategic partnership with Defence, are unrelated to Thales, and that future trends cannot be predicted.
Through the measures now announced, the strategic partnership in the form of industry cooperation with Defence is not affected.
Door de nu aangekondigde maatregelen wordt het strategische partnerschap in de vorm van samenwerking van de industrie met Defensie niet aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse inlichtingen bij een drone-aanval met onschuldige burgerslachtoffers

MPs Hachchi and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch intelligence was used in a US drone strike causing civilian deaths, whether it was an illegal targeted killing, and whether sharing with partners should be reconsidered. The Minister of Defence said the government cannot confirm the strike was illegal, that the MIVD gathered the intelligence in NATO Operation Ocean Shield, that the government will reassess sharing if a partner is shown to carry out illegal targeted killings, and that CTIVD's review timing is for the CTIVD to announce.
As also stated in my reply to the questions of MPs Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak and Sjoerdsma of 10 April 2014, it is not known on the basis of what information such activities are carried out.

Zoals ook gemeld in mijn reactie op de vragen van leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak en Sjoerdsma van 10 april 2014 is niet bekend op basis van welke informatie dergelijke activiteiten worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het neerhalen van een Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asks the government about Turkey's shootdown of a Russian Su-24, questioning Turkey's account (the 17-second claim, speed calculations, Rules of Engagement, warnings) and whether NATO should investigate. The ministers answer that the government has no independent information, sees no reason for its own investigation, considers Turkey's right to protect its airspace subject to necessity and proportionality, and backs NATO's call for de-escalation without taking a position on the legal merits.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make well-founded statements about the application of those requirements in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om gefundeerde uitspraken te kunnen doen over de toepassing van die vereisten in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over voorzorgsmaatregelen tegen een chemische en/of biologische terreuraanval

MPs asked whether the Netherlands is prepared for a chemical or biological terrorist attack, including specific civilian protocols, public information, cross-border planning and a Frenchstyle antidote stockpile. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the Netherlands has multidisciplinary CBRN protocols, specialist units, citizen information via Crisis.nl and NL-Alert, existing atropine stocks and EU and BTWC cooperation.
The Netherlands has in recent years taken a package of measures to prepare for incidents involving chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear (CBRN) material.
Nederland heeft de afgelopen jaren een pakket maatregelen genomen ter voorbereiding op incidenten met chemisch, biologisch, radiologisch of nucleair (CBRN) materiaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het personeelstekort bij Defensie

An MP asks the Defence Minister about the personnel shortage, including the fill rate of vacancies, hard-to-fill technical posts, the Techbase event, reinstating older staff, workload and innovative recruitment. The minister reports 94% filled military posts, an 86% recruitment target, a partly frozen right to extend service, and points to the personnel report for details.
The military organisation is 94 percent filled (reference date 1 July).
Antwoord 2 De militaire organisatie is voor 94 procent gevuld (peildatum 1 juli).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hachchi over bijeenkomsten in het kader van het RIVM-onderzoek naar werken met chroom-VI

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Hachchi (D66) asked the Defence Minister about information meetings for former staff on the RIVM study into chromium-VI exposure, including frustration over criteria and attendance and the timeline. The minister defended the meetings and the study's independence and oversight, gave attendance figures, and promised fuller information in a late-January 2016 progress letter.
In the next progress letter, expected at the end of January 2016, I expect to be able to give you more substantive information about the study.
In de volgende standvanzakenbrief, die eind januari 2016 is voorzien, verwacht ik u meer inhoudelijke informatie over het onderzoek te kunnen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops inzake nieuwe onthulling over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP from CDA asked the ministers whether they recognised a leaked German intelligence finding that Turkey supplied weapons to rebel groups in Syria, whether those groups are jihadist, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with Turkey and Germany or confirm it through AIVD/MIVD. The government answered that it is aware of reports of Turkish support to jihadist groups but that the situation is complex, that it has regular contacts with Turkey and Germany, and that AIVD and MIVD do not publicly comment on their findings.
No public statements are made about the subjects or the results of investigations by the AIVD and MIVD.
Over de onderwerpen of de resultaten van onderzoek door AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over salafisme

An MP asks the Defence Minister how a stated rejection of radical salafism within the armed forces squares with her opposition to a motion to ban salafism in Defence, and about the difference between peaceful and jihadist salafist currents, dismissal of a salafist soldier in Germany, and whether Dutch practice differs. The minister answers that salafism has diverse currents, that the government acts against behaviour incompatible with the democratic legal order, that dismissal in Dutch law depends on proven conduct, and that Defence screening weeds out persons posing a security risk.
Regardless of personal convictions, every citizen in the Netherlands is expected to respect the democratic legal order.
Ongeacht persoonlijke overtuigingen wordt van iedere burger in Nederland verwacht dat hij of zij de democratische rechtsorde eerbiedigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het zweren op Allah bij de militaire beëdiging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Islamic oath taken by soldiers at a public swearing-in is a wrong development and whether military oaths should be aligned with those of police and civil servants. The Minister replied that no new development exists, that the 1916 royal decree already regulates oaths for Muslim soldiers, and that military oaths differ from civil-service oaths, so no measures are planned.
There is no question of a development.
Er is geen sprake van een ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over de plaatsing van nieuwe kernwapens in Duitsland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about German nuclear-capable upgrades at Büchel, whether Dutch costs for Volkel were estimated, whether modernising B61 weapons conflicts with Global Zero and risks an arms race, and whether the Netherlands should drop modernisation now the JSF will not carry nuclear tasks. The government declined to speculate on Russian reactions, said NATO funds the WS-3 upgrades and gave no cost figures, rejected the view that modernisation conflicts with disarmament, and said it will keep the nuclear task debate open within NATO and not press for abandoning the B61 life-extension.
Under alliance agreements, no statements are made about the Netherlands' nuclear task.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken worden er geen mededelingen gedaan over de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi over de berichtgeving dat de MIVD nog steeds advocaten afluistert

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked whether the MIVD wiretaps lawyer-client conversations, how often this happens, and whether a court-ordered change to independent review of lawyer taps will be implemented before taps occur. The Minister said the MIVD taps only when necessary under the law with ministerial approval, declined to say how often or whether a specific person is tapped, and said the court ruling's implications, including independent review, are being studied with information to the House to follow as soon as possible.
As you know, I cannot publicly address whether someone is being wiretapped by the MIVD.
Zoals u weet kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de vraag of iemand door de MIVD wordt afgeluisterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over berichtgeving dat de Landmacht snijdt in het budget voor reservisten

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether the Army's cuts to the reservist budget limit reservist deployment and endanger national security. The minister said deployment is growing fast, a temporary measure curbs overruns at the Army command, national security is not harmed, and the 2% NATO spending commitment is addressed in the 2016 budget and later steps.
The measure has no adverse effects on national security.
De maatregel heeft geen nadelige effecten voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over berichtgeving dat de Landmacht snijdt in het budget voor reservisten

An MP asked whether the Army would sharply cut the reservist budget, what operational effects this has, and about drone, tank and EOD problems. The Minister said reservist use grew faster than expected, so the Army took a temporary measure to limit extra activities to the end of 2015, mainly ceremonial and public-facing ones, while protecting readiness and missions.
To prevent this, the CLAS has taken a temporary management measure to moderate the growing deployment of reservists.
Om dat te voorkomen heeft het CLAS een tijdelijke beheersmaatregel genomen om de groeiende inzet van reservisten te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi over de uitspraken dat een Nederlandse militair die is overgelopen naar ISIS beter ‘daar kan sneuvelen’

Two MPs asked the government whether the Minister-President's and Defence Minister's remarks that a Dutch soldier who defected to ISIS could better die there were government policy, and about related questions on citizenship loss, prosecution and punishment. The government answered that the remark was a reaction to a multiple-choice question, not cabinet policy, that the soldier will be arrested and questioned on return, that ongoing criminal investigation prevents further disclosure, and that a bill to expand citizenship revocation for terrorism is pending.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) has started an investigation into criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) is een onderzoek gestart naar strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘dure reizen’ door de defensietop in de Telegraaf

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister how she views reports of high travel spending by the defence leadership, whether it is acceptable, and for overviews of flights and other declarations, and whether she will tighten travel policy. The minister answers that business-class travel is limited to specified ranks or operational necessity, provides aggregate flight and declaration figures, and says that business-class travel within Europe for senior staff has been restricted since 2010 with a proposal to unions this autumn, without detailed per-flight overviews.
Question 3: Can you provide an overview of all flights (and associated costs) made by the defence leadership in the past two years?
Vraag 3 Kunt u een overzicht geven van alle vliegreizen (en bijbehorende kosten) die in de afgelopen twee jaar gemaakt zijn door de defensietop?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat hoge militairen en beleidsambtenaren businessclass vliegen

MP De Roon asked the Defence Minister about reports that senior military and policy officials fly business class, including ticket numbers since 2010, the Marechaussee share, intra-European business class, policy versus other ministries, and possible savings. The minister confirmed roughly 1,000 to 1,300 business class tickets a year, explained that much of this relates to close protection by the BSB, said intra-European business class is restricted since 2010 but still formally in the legal position, and noted that formal restriction requires agreement with public-sector unions.
Since 2010, business class flying within Europe has been restricted for budgetary reasons. However, this has not yet been recorded in the legal position.
Sinds 2010 is het businessclass vliegen binnen Europa om budgettaire redenen ingeperkt. Dit is echter nog niet in de rechtspositie vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de tekorten bij Frontex

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence about reported shortages of border guards and equipment at Frontex, why many member states have not responded to its calls, and whether the Netherlands has made an extra contribution. The government confirmed the shortages, said member states decide their own contributions, and listed Dutch additional personnel and equipment for 2015 while noting it has no overview of other states' pledges.
I have no overview of the total deployment or the additional pledges made by individual member states to Frontex in 2015.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de totale inzet of de extra toezeggingen die afzonderlijke lidstaten in 2015 aan Frontex hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Eijsink over kindermisbruik in Afghanistan

MPs Hachchi and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about reports that US soldiers were told to ignore child sexual abuse (bacha bazi) in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch troops were trained and guided on it. The minister acknowledged the practice conflicts with human rights, said Defence was unaware of it at the 2002 start and has no specific guidelines, relying on general ethics training, a pragmatic ban on minors at Dutch bases, and post-mission care.
Defence lacks the information needed to fully assess the American case.
Het ontbreekt Defensie aan informatie om de Amerikaanse casuïstiek volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over een tekort aan bommen boven Irak voor Nederlandse F-16’s

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the Defence Minister about a reported shortage of bombs for Dutch F-16s fighting ISIS over Iraq, including consequences, causes, reorders and allied supply. The minister replied there is no current shortage, but certain precision munitions may run out over time due to higher consumption and long delivery times, and that the government is pursuing deliveries, loans and prioritisation with allies and producers.
There is currently no shortage of bombs for the Dutch F-16s deployed in the fight against ISIS.
Er is op dit moment geen tekort aan bommen voor de Nederlandse F-16’s die worden ingezet in de strijd tegen ISIS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de mogelijkheid in een handomdraai aan een vals Syrisch paspoort te komen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the government about a press report that a forged official Syrian passport could be obtained easily, and whether Dutch services detect such documents and cooperate with intelligence services. The government answered that Syrian documents are checked extra thoroughly, that the damaged document cannot be examined for detection purposes, and that the IND cooperates with the AIVD and MIVD and with European partners.
The document described in the article was rendered unusable by the journalist.
Het document waar in het artikel over wordt geschreven is door de journalist onbruikbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen PKK en ISIS

Members Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Turkey's airstrikes on Kurdish groups (PKK, YPG) and ISIS, including alleged civilian casualties, coordination with the US-led coalition, and a proposed buffer zone in northern Syria. The government said it lacks independent information on Turkish operations, that Turkey and the US have agreed deconfliction and joint operations against ISIS, that it will look into the Zergele allegations via Turkey's announced inquiry, and that it sees no need for an independent investigation into alleged Turkish support for ISIS.
The cabinet does not have independent information on the circumstances of the Turkish air operations and the associated risks to American military personnel.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de omstandigheden van de Turkse luchtoperaties en de daaraan verbonden risico's voor Amerikaanse militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Teeven over de financiering van het verjaardagsfeestje van de VARA door het vfonds

MPs Bruins Slot and Teeven asked whether the vfonds, an independent foundation for veterans, funded the VARA's 90th anniversary party and a half-million-euro TV series on labour history, and whether this fits its mandate and was coordinated with Defence. The Minister replied that the vfonds is independent with its own spending authority, confirmed the subsidy, declined to judge the foundation's guidelines, and said she held no consultation because the subsidy does not affect veteran care funding.
The National Fund for Peace, Freedom and Veterans Care (vfonds) is an independent foundation with autonomous control over its expenditure.
Het Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg (vfonds) is een onafhankelijke stichting, met autonome zeggenschap over haar uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse militair die overgelopen is naar IS

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister whether a Dutch soldier who defected to IS would lead to tighter screening, whether the investigation extends beyond the Air Force, the soldier's nationality, the intelligence services' current monitoring, and how many other ex-soldiers have joined Islamist terror groups. The minister referred the MPs to a separate letter answering a related request from another MP about possible radicalisation of an active soldier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Eijsink over de samenwerking met milities die kindsoldaten inzetten

MPs Van Laar and Eijsink asked the ministers about Dutch cooperation with militias that deploy child soldiers in the fight against IS, including whether Dutch forces work with Iraqi militias and what can be done to end child deployment. The government answered that it does not cooperate with parties using child soldiers, that its Iraq training targets Iraqi Special Operations Forces and Peshmerga rather than militias, and that it will keep raising human rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and support education for children.
The Netherlands does not cooperate with parties that deploy child soldiers.
Nederland werkt niet samen met partijen die kindsoldaten inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het patiëntenvervoer vanaf de Waddeneilanden

An MP asked the Defence Minister why the tender for air ambulance helicopter transport from the Wadden islands failed, and about the cost, training and landing consequences of Defence continuing to fly patient transport with the NH90. The minister answered that the RAV Fryslân tender was abandoned after a court ruling, that Defence's patient transport was handed to Coast Guard helicopters from 24 August, and that the NH90 cannot land on the UMCG roof when fully loaded.
Taking into account the court's ruling, the RAV concluded that no remaining bids met the requirements and conditions of this tender, and it therefore abandoned the tender.
Met inachtneming van de uitspraak van de rechter heeft de RAV geconcludeerd dat er geen inschrijvingen meer over zijn die aan de opdracht, eisen en randvoorwaarden van deze aanbesteding voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over tekortkomingen van de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) ten opzichte van potentiële tegenstanders

An MP asks the Defence Minister whether the F-35 fighter is inferior to potential adversaries in manoeuvrability, payload, range, stealth and whether it can be detected, and whether the Netherlands bought a pig in a poke. The minister rejects the critical conclusions, saying the aircraft's capabilities are sufficient, stealth reduces detection risk, and the F-35 is continuously upgraded.
No. The Netherlands chose the F-35 because this aircraft has the best capabilities from a military-operational perspective and is future-proof.
Nee. Nederland heeft voor de F-35 gekozen omdat dit toestel in militair-operationeel perspectief over de beste capaciteiten beschikt en toekomstbestendig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het tekort aan munitie bij het Nederlandse leger

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about a shortage of ammunition in the Dutch army, which they called shameful, and what measures would end it and whether defence spending would rise to 2% of GDP. The minister acknowledged the shortage as undesirable, attributed it to limited shelf life, long lead times and production delays, said deliveries were expected in 2015 and 2016 and that stocks were redistributed, and deferred the spending question to the 2016 budget.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over satellietcommunicatie bij de krijgsmacht en de beveiliging daarvan

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the armed forces use the Globalstar satellite system, which was reported as easy to hack, and how dependent Defence is on commercial satellite communications and whether there is a capacity shortage. The minister answered that Defence does not use Globalstar, plans to move to a 60% military and 40% commercial split from 2016 with the WGS system, and states there is no capacity shortage.
No, Defence does not use the Globalstar satellite system.
Nee, Defensie maakt geen gebruik van het Globalstar-satellietsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de arrestatie van Carvajal en dreigende inval van Venezuela op Aruba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about the arrest of Venezuelan official Carvajal on Aruba, reports of Venezuelan warships approaching Aruba, and whether there was a military threat. The government answered that Carvajal enjoyed consular immunity under the Vienna Convention and was released, that the Venezuelan naval vessels were in Venezuelan territorial waters, that no military threats were made, and it answered most questions in substance while declining to comment on the exact words attributed to the Prime Minister.
The cabinet has taken note of the reports.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Bijna oorlog met Venezuela'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Venezuelan naval incursions into Aruban waters were concealed and what military steps were taken, and why the government changed its position on the immunity of Carvajal. The minister answered that no Venezuelan navy vessel entered Aruban waters, no military action was needed, and the immunity conclusion was based on the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, with the government accepting that Aruba's release was an autonomous decision.
The Venezuelan navy did not sail through Aruban waters.
De Venezolaanse marine is niet door Arubaanse wateren gevaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over burgerslachtoffers in de strijd tegen IS

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about an Airwars report on hundreds of civilian deaths from coalition airstrikes against IS, including whether the coalition's figure of two civilian deaths was accurate, and whether Netherlands would disclose where and when it struck. The ministers said the coalition takes civilian casualty reports seriously, that five investigations are completed and seven ongoing, and that they will not say which specific attacks Netherlands carried out for operational and domestic security reasons.
For operational reasons and in the interest of domestic security, we make no statements about specific cases.
Om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid doen wij geen uitspraken over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eijsink over het artikel ‘Forse kritiek op direct ontslag drugsmilitair’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a military court ruling that criticised the immediate dismissal of a soldier for drug use linked to deployment-related psychological problems, and whether the zero-tolerance policy would be revised. The minister said Defence has appealed the ruling and will not discuss the individual case, that drugs and soldiers do not mix, and set out the exceptions to dismissal (first softdrug use without service link, or medical unfitness).
Defence has indeed lodged an appeal against the ruling. I will therefore not go into this individual case, which is part of a legal procedure.
Defensie heeft inderdaad hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak. Ik ga daarom niet in op deze individuele casus die onderdeel is van een juridische procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over misstanden bij de verbetering van de veiligheid bij de luchtmacht

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked whether the director of the Military Aviation Authority, who previously commanded Eindhoven air base where safety problems occurred, has a conflict of interest in overseeing air force safety, and whether disciplinary action or an independent specialist is warranted. The minister answered that the 2014 OVV report found no structural shortcomings, that the conflict concern was addressed by assigning certification of Eindhoven flight activities to the deputy director, and that no external specialist or disciplinary measures are planned.

Precisely to prevent the appearance of a conflict of interest, it was decided earlier this year to assign the certification assessment of flight activities at Eindhoven air base to the deputy director of the Military Aviation Authority (MLA).

Juist ter voorkoming van de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is eerder dit jaar besloten de beoordeling van de certificering van de vliegactiviteiten op vliegbasis Eindhoven op te dragen aan de plaatsvervangend directeur Militaire Luchtvaartautoriteit (MLA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de EU maritieme missie EU NAVFOR MED

An MP asks whether the EU is seeking a Chapter VII UN Security Council resolution for the EU naval mission EU NAVFOR MED against migrant smuggling from Libya, how migration could count as a threat to peace, and Libyan authorities' attitude to an EU mission in their waters. The government answers that negotiations in New York are stalled pending talks with Libya, that a draft cannot be shared confidentially, that Security Council resolutions under Chapter VII have precedent for migration-linked crises, and that the Libyan government lacks effective control in western Libya.
Due to the confidential nature of the discussions in New York, a draft version cannot be shared.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de besprekingen in New York kan een conceptversie niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het conflict tussen Defensie en een veiligheidsofficier

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a dispute between Defence and a former security officer, including the handling of a compensation offer, a 2001 rejection, and a request for an advance payment. The minister answered that the case is before the disciplinary court and that she cannot comment on this individual case because it is part of legal proceedings.
I cannot go into this individual case, which moreover is part of a legal procedure.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele casus, die bovendien onderdeel is van een juridische procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het blokkeren van Russische grondaankopen in de buurt van militaire terreinen

MP De Roon asked the Defence Minister whether Russian land purchases near military sites, which Finland is moving to block, occur in the Netherlands and whether the government can block them. The minister answered that no comparable cases are known, that the MIVD monitors espionage and undue influence without detailing activities, and that the government has no legal power to block private property transactions.
The government has no legal possibilities to block such transactions.
De overheid heeft geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om dergelijke transacties te blokkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het advies van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken om zeker 3,3 miljard euro extra te investeren in de krijgsmacht

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister about an advisory council recommendation for several billion euros in extra defence spending, the adequacy of the armed forces, tanks, the NATO 2% norm and a naive Russia policy. The minister denied the armed forces are in a dire state, referred the advice to a government response due around Prinsjesdag, and otherwise restated existing policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Hachchi over het bericht dat kwetsbaarheden in encryptiesoftware door Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten zijn gebruikt

Two D66 MPs asked whether a research article on Diffie-Hellman weaknesses, which suggests the NSA may have used them to read VPN, SSH and TLS traffic, is credible, whether other states or non-state actors have used such weaknesses, and whether the government wants access to encrypted data or a uniform policy on zero-day vulnerabilities. The government declined to say whether the researchers' hypothesis is correct because intelligence services do not disclose their collection methods, advised longer key lengths and stronger configuration, and said it supports encryption and responsible disclosure, referring to a forthcoming letter on encryption.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect their intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Teeven over problemen bij de inschrijving voor de Marechaussee opleiding

MPs Straus and Teeven asked the State Secretary of Education and the Minister of Defence about raised entry requirements for a one-year mbo level 2 security course that feeds into the Royal Marechaussee training, which excluded vmbo basic-track pupils without prior communication. The minister acknowledged the requirement was not in line with law, said the ROCs failed to inform the KMar, promised the pupils would be admitted via the usual selection, and committed to requiring ROCs to restore the legal entry requirement and rename the course.
The ROCs concerned will have to bring the entry requirement back to the statutory entry requirement for vmbo-bb.
De betrokken ROC's zullen de instroomeis terug moeten brengen naar de wettelijke instroomeis vmbo-bb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het dreigende zwarte gat in de informatievoorziening die de Nederlandse militairen moet behoeden voor aanslagen van ISIS

The MP De Roon asked whether US intelligence refusal to share technology, linked to the German NSA dispute, leaves Dutch troops in Iraq exposed to ISIS attacks, and about threat levels, dependence on US intelligence, the fall of Ramadi and force protection. The Minister declined to comment on the reported US-German intelligence cooperation and on operational intelligence ties, said the threat level for Dutch and German troops is the same, and gave only general statements on force protection, citing security.
The Dutch government never makes public statements about operational cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
De Nederlandse regering doet in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over operationele samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de deplorabele toestand van de landmacht

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about reports that the army is in a deplorable state, including old equipment, ammunition shortages and insufficient trained staff, and whether she will present a long-term vision and raise defence spending by at least 5 billion euro. The minister confirmed the report, said the commander's remarks match her May letter on material readiness, and said a letter on the long-term vision will follow in June as requested in a motion.
The cabinet has previously informed you that parliament will receive a letter by June in response to the Van der Staaij et al. motion.
Het kabinet heeft u eerder geïnformeerd dat het parlement uiterlijk in juni een brief ontvangt naar aanleiding van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over veiligheid van scheepvaart op de Middellandse Zee

MP De Roon asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the attack on a Turkish-flagged merchant ship off Libya and what measures will protect Dutch merchant vessels, including the threat picture and armed guards policy. Minister Koenders answered that the government lacks its own information on the attack, that shipowners bear responsibility for security with government sharing relevant information, that no separate threat assessment exists, and that the armed guards policy will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, though answers could not be given by 1 June.
The cabinet does not have its own information about the circumstances of this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigen informatie over de toedracht van deze aanval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gevolgen van het noodlottige ongeval met een Apache gevechtshelikopter in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch Apache helicopters were grounded for nearly two months after a fatal crash in Mali, what that meant for troop safety and pilot training, how Boeing was involved in the investigation, whether Boeing would bear repair, replacement and compensation costs, and how the families were compensated. The minister confirmed the grounding, said alternative protection measures were used and the helicopters were operational again from 14 May, admitted a training backlog, and explained that Defence does not contractually hold manufacturers liable for technical causes during use under the Foreign Military Sales framework, with no direct replacement planned.
In general, Defence does not cover the risks of accidents during the use phase with contractual clauses that hold the manufacturer liable in case of technical causes.
In het algemeen dekt Defensie de risico's van ongevallen gedurende de gebruiksfase niet af met contractuele clausules die de fabrikant aansprakelijk stellen in geval van technische oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over Cyberdreiging vanuit Iran

Two MPs asked the ministers about a rise in Iranian cyberattacks on the West that exploit Western IT systems, and whether sanctions are failing to prevent Iranian access to such systems. The government answered that Dutch sanctions target Iran's nuclear programme rather than internet services in general, that providers bear responsibility for their customers, and that new cyber-specific sanctions are not currently under consideration.
The cabinet is of the view that the existing sanctions instruments are flexible enough to address cyber threats where desired.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het bestaande sanctie-instrumentarium flexibel genoeg is om desgewenst ook cyberdreigingen te kunnen ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked whether the government agrees that Iran's seizure of a merchant ship in the Strait of Hormuz is an act of aggression, and about the safety of Dutch-flagged ships there. The government shares US concern that the seizure was unlawful, sees no current threat from Iran to Dutch-flagged or Dutch-crewed shipping, and reports no relevant incidents or shipowner requests.
The Netherlands shares the concerns of the US about this.
Nederland deelt de zorgen hierover van de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

MP De Roon asked whether the government would request, as the UK had, US naval escorts for Dutch merchant ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The ministers confirmed the British escorts and answered that no Dutch shipping firm had requested protection, so there was currently no reason to make such a request.
No requests from Dutch shipping companies regarding protection in the Strait of Hormuz have been received.
Er zijn geen verzoeken van Nederlandse reders ontvangen omtrent bescherming in de Straat van Hormuz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over problemen met de motor van de F-35

An MP (Hachchi, D66) asked the Minister of Defence about a US Inspector General report finding quality-management failures and 61 deviations at Pratt & Whitney, the F-35 engine maker, and what this means for Dutch contracts and costs. The minister answered that the findings concern process control rather than product quality, that the JPO is acting on them, and that the deviations have no direct consequences for product quality or costs.

There are no consequences. The Netherlands has legal arrangements with the US government, which concludes contracts with the manufacturers Lockheed Martin and Pratt & Whitney on behalf of the partners.
Er zijn geen gevolgen. Nederland heeft juridische afspraken met de Amerikaanse overheid die namens de partners contracten sluit met de fabrikanten Lockheed Martin en Pratt & Whitney.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Turkije lonkt naar een Russisch systeem voor luchtafweerraketten

The MP De Roon asked whether Turkey is reconsidering Russian S-300 air defence systems, whether Turkey still considers a Chinese system incompatible with NATO missile defence, and whether Turkey is distancing itself from NATO. The government replied that no concrete Turkish interest in the S-300 can be confirmed, that no decision timeline is known, that NATO allies have raised interoperability concerns, and that Article 5 is not in question.
It is not known when Turkey will decide on the purchase.
Het is niet bekend wanneer Turkije een besluit over de aanschaf zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk, Teeven en De Roon over het project Data Communicatie Mobiel Optreden Long Range Communications (DCMO-LRC)

MPs Vuijk, Teeven and De Roon asked the Defence Minister about the DCMO-LRC communications project, its status, purpose, reliability in worst-case scenarios and lessons learned. The minister answered that the project is in its realisation phase due for completion in 2015, that LRC extends communication beyond VHF radio range, and that Defence uses a mix of transmission means, with the business partner FoxIT developing the basic module.
LRC is in the realisation phase.
LRC bevindt zich in de realisatiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over de aanwijzing Extern optreden in relatie tot de vrijheid van meningsuiting

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the requirement that staff submit external publications in advance to the Communications directorate for advice infringes freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution. The minister answered that the advice is non-binding, serves to prevent operational and security harm and consequences afterwards, and that she does not consider the requirement a restriction on freedom of expression.
The advice of the Communications directorate is non-binding.
Het advies van de directie Communicatie is vrijblijvend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat Defensie laks zou zijn met geheimen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a report that Defence is lax with secrets, and about a Lloyd's audit and whether it should be sent to parliament. The minister rejects the press framing, says the audit is an internal tool that will not be sent to parliament, and states that existing security rules and supervision are adequate, pointing to awareness-raising measures.
It is not obvious to send this report to the House of Representatives.
Het ligt niet voor de hand om dit rapport naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over familie van Nederlandse militairen die zouden kunnen worden bedreigd door IS-aanhangers

MP Teeven asked the Defence Minister whether relatives of Dutch soldiers are being threatened by IS sympathisers and whether soldiers' home numbers are being traced, and what precautions exist. The minister said the MIVD investigates reported incidents, has seen more reported approaches on social media, cannot disclose details on their origin, and that security information is shared with soldiers' families during briefings and contact is available 24 hours a day.
I cannot say what the MIVD precisely knows about the origin of these kinds of requests, to protect the level of knowledge and the working methods of the service.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over wat de MIVD precies weet over de herkomst van dit soort verzoeken, omwille van de bescherming van het kennisniveau en de werkwijze van de dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de oorzaak en consequenties van het neerstorten van een ScanEagle

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about the cause of a 2013 ScanEagle drone crash, the adequacy of operator training, the Military Aviation Authority's review, why the investigation was not sent to parliament, and the use of the drone over populated areas and by police. The minister said a faulty sensor coating caused the crash, training has been adjusted, the report was withheld for confidentiality reasons, and the drone has not yet been deployed over the Netherlands for civil support.
Investigation reports on such incidents are as a rule not sent to the House of Representatives.
Onderzoeksrapporten van dergelijke incidenten worden in de regel niet naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over Nieuwe tegenslagen met de JSF

An MP asked the Defence Minister about new software delays in the F-35 programme, including effects on cost, operational capability, close air support and projected Dutch industry revenue based on 4,500 aircraft. The minister answered that the delays have no financial consequences, that the block 3F software will give full capabilities around 2017, and that the figures and cost-accounting concerns were already addressed earlier.
No, that is not correct. The first aircraft with the full operational capabilities of the block 3F software are expected in 2017.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De eerste toestellen met de volledige operationele capaciteiten van de block 3F software worden in 2017 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de F-35 faalt bij luchtsteun

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that the F-35 underperforms in close air support compared with the A-10, and about related capability, weapons, night-flying and cost concerns. The minister answered that the F-35 follows a phased development (block 2B now, block 3F expected 2017), that the aircraft is multirole and not directly comparable to the A-10, and that the Dutch acquisition timeline is unaffected.
There are no consequences for the F-35 acquisition timeline.
Er zijn geen gevolgen voor het aanschaftraject van de F-35.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Defensie een zwarte lijst voor journalisten aanhoudt

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether Defence keeps a blacklist of journalists, as reported by EenVandaag, and what measures would prevent one. The Minister answered that no such list exists, that the report rested on a single internal email expressing a staff member's personal frustration, and that press freedom is an important good to be protected.
As I reported to your House in my letter of 17 April (Kamerstuk 29 692, no. 20) following EenVandaag's coverage, there is no blacklist or similar list for journalists at Defence.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 17 april jl. (Kamerstuk 29 692, nr. 20 ) naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving van EenVandaag aan uw Kamer heb gemeld, is er bij Defensie geen sprake van een zwarte of soortgelijke lijst voor journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Nederland knooppunt wapensmokkel’

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether large shipments of machine pistols were regularly entering the Netherlands for onward distribution, how the smuggling is tackled, and how a Defence employee's involvement was possible. The minister said Europol could not confirm regular large shipments, that police had intervened in one acute case with ongoing prosecution, and that Defence runs security checks and opens investigations when information arises.
Beyond that, I cannot comment on this ongoing criminal case.
Voor het overige kan ik over deze lopende strafzaak geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over minder criminaliteit door militairen op straat

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would deploy soldiers in the Netherlands to tackle crime at hotspots, after a Belgian report of reduced crime where soldiers patrol. The minister replied that the National Police is adequately equipped, but civilian authorities can request military assistance in specific situations.
The National Police is generally adequately equipped to tackle and combat crime, including at places referred to as hotspots.
De Nationale Politie is in het algemeen voldoende toegerust om criminaliteit aan te pakken en te bestrijden, ook op plaatsen waar aan wordt gerefereerd met de term «hot spots».
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de Minister van Defensie over rechtszaken tegen Defensie over chroom-6 (ingezonden 27 maart 2015).

An MP asked the Defence Minister about court hearings involving sick former Defence employees exposed to chromium-6 and why they must wait for the RIVM study. The Minister said no lawsuit yet exists, only a preliminary witness hearing, and pointed to the RIVM study, a compensation scheme and a commission to speed up the research.
Because I wish to exercise care as an employer, I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into the health effects causally linked to exposure to chromium-6.
Omdat ik als werkgever zorgvuldigheid wens te betrachten, heb ik het RIVM verzocht onderzoek te doen naar de gezondheidseffecten die in causaal verband staan met de blootstelling aan chroom-6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat de Navo België adviseert om fregatten van de hand te doen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO advised Belgium to divest its frigates and what the consequences would be for Dutch-Belgian defence cooperation, including naval cooperation (Benesam) and the NH-90 helicopter. The minister said intensive contacts exist, that no Belgian decision had been taken, that NATO contacts are confidential, and pointed to existing cooperation in helicopters and special forces.
I have not understood from my Belgian colleague that such a measure is under consideration.
Ik heb van mijn Belgische collega niet begrepen dat een dergelijke maatregel aan de orde zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over islamitische militairen die door loyaliteitsproblemen niet geschikt zijn voor de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister about Islamic military personnel with alleged loyalty problems, questioning the choice of a commissioned study on religious chaplaincy, the number of Muslim soldiers and dual-nationality recruitment, and asking for ex-soldiers who joined jihadist groups and a recruitment campaign. The Minister rejected the premise that Muslim soldiers cannot be distinguished, stated that Defence does not register religious belief, cited a study finding about 1,600 soldiers with other non-Christian beliefs, refused to restrict dual nationals or launch the proposed campaign, and referred back to earlier answers on ex-soldiers.
Defence does not register the religious beliefs of its employees.
Defensie registreert de geloofsovertuiging van haar medewerkers niet.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Jasper van Dijk over de resultaten van de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi en wapenhandel met Saoedi-Arabië

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Damen Shipyards naval contract with the UAE, whether it fell under Dutch arms-export criteria, the role of the Defence Minister at the Abu Dhabi fair, and why the Netherlands does not follow Sweden in halting arms trade with Saudi Arabia. The government answered that the contract dated from 2013, that export licences are assessed case by case against the EU Common Position criteria, that no credit guarantees or government-brokered contracts were involved at the fair, and that Sweden's decision concerned a memorandum rather than a trade halt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over containers met stenen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Bommel asked why ten containers returning Defence materiel from Afghanistan arrived at Volkel air base filled with stones. The minister answered that eleven containers were involved, that the seals were intact on arrival, that the military police (KMAR) could not establish how the goods were removed and has closed its investigation, so the materiel must be considered lost.
The KMAR has now closed the investigation. The materiel must therefore be considered lost.
Inmiddels heeft de KMAR het onderzoek gesloten. Het materieel moet daarom als verloren worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de diefstal van tenten, F-16 onderdelen en heftrucks

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the theft of tents, heavy trucks and compressors from containers returned from Afghanistan, which arrived at Volkel air base filled with stones, and whether F-16 parts were involved. The minister confirmed the containers were tampered with although seals were intact, the KMAR investigation was closed without finding how the goods disappeared, and no F-16 parts were involved.
The KMAR has meanwhile closed the investigation.
Inmiddels heeft de KMAR het onderzoek gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over containers met stenen uit Afghanistan

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how stolen Dutch defence equipment from Afghanistan was replaced by containers of stones, the value of the loss, whether it can be recovered, and how the theft happened. The minister said the containers were transferred to a civilian carrier, the equipment cannot be traced or recovered, the carrier has been held liable, and the military police closed their investigation without finding how the theft occurred.
The military police investigated the circumstances of this incident and could not determine how the removal took place.
De KMAR heeft de toedracht van dit voorval onderzocht en daarbij niet kunnen achterhalen op welke wijze de ontvreemding is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de dreigende situatie in Venezuela

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the unrest in Venezuela threatens the Kingdom and whether the military presence on the Caribbean islands should be expanded. The minister answered that the threat to sovereignty is currently unlikely, that no expansion is warranted now but the situation is monitored, and that no specific military assistance agreements with the US exist.
Specific agreements on military assistance have not been made.
Specifieke afspraken over militaire bijstand zijn niet gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat twee voormalig medewerkers van de MIVD worden doorbetaald tot hun pensioen en zijn bevorderd

An MP asked the Minister of Defence whether two former MIVD intelligence officers, placed on non-active duty in 2007, were promoted and paid until retirement without working, and about the costs and leak of the settlement. The minister answered by referring to earlier CTIVD and ministerial letters and said the settlement's contents remain confidential under the agreement with the parties.
In reaching the solution to the labour dispute through a settlement agreement, the parties agreed to keep its contents confidential.
Bij de totstandkoming van de oplossing voor het gerezen arbeidsconflict door middel van een vaststellingsovereenkomst zijn partijen over de inhoud daarvan geheimhouding overeengekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de aanwezigheid van voormalig secretaris-generaal en van een zedenmisdrijf verdachte Joris Demmink bij de nieuwjaarsborrel van de Commandant Koninklijke Marechaussee

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Defence about the presence of former secretary-general Joris Demmink, a suspect in a sex offence case, at the Marechaussee commander's New Year reception, including whether the minister had contact with him and whether the commander would be called to account. The minister answered that all guests were received the same way and that Demmink is presumed innocent until proven otherwise in court.
All guests at the New Year reception of the Governor of the Residence were received in the same way.
Alle genodigden voor de nieuwjaarsreceptie van de gouverneur der Residentie zijn op dezelfde manier ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over beschimmelde marine kazerne

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether reports of mould in the Erfprins barracks in Den Helder were accurate, why the problem was not fixed earlier, and what would be done to improve sailors' housing. The minister answered that mould was found but posed no health risk, that a full renovation is planned for 2018 due to budget and logistical constraints, and that interim measures and quarterly checks are in place.
After implementation of the above measures, inspection takes place every three months and the measures are repeated where necessary.
Na uitvoering van bovenstaande maatregelen vindt elke drie maanden controle plaats en indien nodig worden de maatregelen opnieuw uitgevoerd.
