Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er recentelijk nog onveilig is gewerkt met chroom-6

MPs Hachchi and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about reports that personnel at Volkel and Eindhoven air bases worked with chromium-6 unsafely in 2012 and 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed proactively. The Minister replied that exposure was below the limit value, that about a few dozen specialised staff work with chromium paint, that measures were taken, and that the Armed Forces occupational health service will report on an ongoing review, expected in April.

As I previously reported to you (see among others Chamber letter 34 000 X, no. 72 of 2 February), the Defence occupational health service is conducting research at the ten defence locations where chromium-containing paint is still used.

Zoals ik u eerder heb gemeld (zie onder meer Kamerbrief 34 000 X, nr. 72 van 2 februari jl.), voert de arbodienst van Defensie onderzoek uit op de tien defensielocaties waar nu nog met chroomhoudende verf wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de aanschaf van Chinese 'Patriots' door Turkije

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether pressure from the West had been applied to Turkey to drop a Chinese air defence system, whether Turkey was linking its procurement to the Armenian genocide commemoration, and whether NATO interoperability concerns would be raised. The government answered that allies including the Netherlands had conveyed interoperability concerns, that negotiations were ongoing with no decision date known, and that it was up to Turkey to decide.
NATO allies, including the Netherlands, clearly conveyed concerns to Turkey about the interoperability of a Chinese air and missile defence system.
NAVO-bondgenoten, inclusief Nederland, hebben aan Turkije duidelijk de zorgen overgebracht over de interoperabiliteit van een Chinees lucht- en raketverdedigingssysteem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het aan de grond houden van Duitse NH90 helikopters vanwege technische gebreken

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether German NH90 helicopter restrictions over sea and built-up areas apply to the Dutch NH90 and affect delivery and capacity. The minister answered that the German limits stem from a national airworthiness rule rather than a technical defect, that the Dutch NH90 is certified under US FAR standards and not affected, and that the Dutch military aviation authority confirmed this.
The Netherlands is itself responsible for the certification of military aircraft.
Nederland is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de certificering van militaire luchtvaartuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi

An MP asked the Defence and Trade ministers whether the February 2015 economic mission to Abu Dhabi and the IDEX defence fair aimed at arms exports, and how the government would manage the risk of arms exports fuelling instability and rights abuses in the MENA region. The government answered that the mission supports the defence and security industry under the Defence Industry Strategy, that export licences are assessed against the EU Common Position criteria, and that it will not reconsider attendance.
If this assessment against the EUGS criteria is negative, the export licence is refused.
Indien deze toets aan de EUGS-criteria negatief uitvalt, wordt de exportvergunning afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de krijgsmacht niet klaar is voor een situatie van oorlogsdreiging

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about reports that the armed forces are not ready for a threat of war, including shortages of equipment, fuel, personnel and pay issues. The minister answered that operational readiness has limitations but denied a fuel shortage, said outflow of staff is in line with planning, and declined to commit to a 10% pay rise or a specific defence budget increase pending ongoing negotiations and cabinet deliberations.
However, I do not recognise the shortage of fuel.
Het tekort aan brandstof herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de mogelijke bewapening van Nederlandse onbemande vliegtuigen (drones)

MP Jasper van Dijk asks whether the Netherlands is requesting a targeting component that would allow its planned US Reaper drones to be armed, whether Dutch personnel will train on drones and be kept out of US targeted killings, and why costs may rise by 50 million euro. The minister replies that the Reaper's standard configuration includes the MTS-B sensor, that the Dutch need is not for an armed platform, that training is only on sensor and piloting with no weapons involvement, and that cost information is still awaited with a later update promised.
Defence is still awaiting American information about the product and the price.
Defensie is nog in afwachting van Amerikaanse informatie over het product en de prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het dreigende ontslag van een militair wegens haar relatie met een Turk

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Defence and Social Affairs ministers about a female soldier facing dismissal because of her relationship with a Turkish partner, whom the MIVD cannot screen. The Defence minister answered that a tailored solution can prevent dismissal, that the MIVD has done what is required, that the commander's view is weighed, and that personnel will receive more information on partner policy.

As I explained in my letter of 21 May, no list can be released of the countries with which the intelligence and security services have a cooperation relationship on the basis of which personal data are exchanged.

Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van 21 mei jl., kan geen lijst worden vrijgegeven van landen met wie de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten een samenwerkingsrelatie hebben op basis waarvan persoonsgegevens worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over gebruik van chroomverf bij Defensie

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister why chromium paint was still used unsafely in 2008, whether safe working can be guaranteed, and how staff are informed. The minister said Defence aims to work chromium-free, that new incidents cannot be fully excluded, that protective measures were tightened since 2001 and staff are trained, and that work is halted when precautions are missing.
Despite the tightening of regulations and adjustments to working methods, new incidents remain possible.
Ondanks de aanscherpingen van de regelgeving en aanpassingen van de werkwijze blijven nieuwe voorvallen mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Keijzer over de hulp aan gewonde oud-militair die met Koerden vocht tegen ISIS

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Health about the plight of a seriously wounded former conscript who fought alongside Kurds against ISIS, and whether the government would help repatriate and treat him. The government answered that he was not a veteran, that consular assistance was provided, that he left Northern Iraq, and that without adequate insurance the state does not finance treatment or repatriation.
With due regard to the security aspect, the usual consular assistance was provided to the person concerned.
Met in achtneming van het veiligheidsaspect is aan betrokkene de gebruikelijke consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over een op non-actief gestelde topambtenaar die toch bij de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) aan de slag ging

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked how a senior civil servant placed off duty at Defence could later work at the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa, whether this was a favour, and what the usual practice is. The minister replied that the official was never suspended or placed on non-active status but offered his post himself after IT restructuring, that the Defence Minister's investigation is awaited, and denied any favour or cover-up, while declining to give a full overview of reassignments.
I want to emphasise that in this case there is no question of an official who is or has been placed on non-active status.
Ik wil benadrukken dat er in dit geval geen sprake is van een ambtenaar die op non-actief is of wordt gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het dreigingsniveau in Mali

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Defence about the raised threat level around Dutch soldiers in Mali, including the MNLA demand for apology over an Apache strike, deaths during protests in Gao, a possible buffer zone and whether intelligence gathering and political reconciliation remain possible. The government answered that the threat level is significant, extra protective measures were taken, no investigation is needed into the Apache strike since MINUSMA acted in self-defence, and the Algiers talks have resumed.
In response to the raised threat level, additional measures have been taken.
Naar aanleiding van het verhoogde dreigingsniveau zijn aanvullende maatregelen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Patriot-eenheid is teruggekeerd uit Turkije

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about reports that the Dutch Patriot unit returning from Turkey was worn out, including overdue maintenance, spare-parts shortages, and overextended specialists. The minister acknowledged overdue maintenance and that the systems will be non-operational for about a year, while defending the personnel measures taken and declining to commit to a fourth Patriot battery pending the broader defence review.
It is true that the major maintenance and modification of the systems will still take at least a year.
Het is juist dat het groot onderhoud en de modificatie van de systemen nog zeker een jaar zullen duren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de beschikbaarheid van de krijgsmacht in het kader van terreurdreiging

Knops (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether the Dutch armed forces are sufficiently available for terrorism-related domestic deployment, given NRF and overseas commitments, and whether defence cuts should be reversed. The minister answered that the forces can largely meet their readiness targets, with some limits (medical posts, CBRN decontamination), and that the government will decide on the defence ambition level and the motion Van der Staaij in spring 2015, reporting before the summer recess.

The cabinet will inform parliament by May or June at the latest, or as early as possible, of the outcome of its deliberations, so that it can be discussed with the House of Representatives before the summer recess.

61 ), zal het kabinet het parlement uiterlijk in mei of juni – of zoveel eerder als mogelijk – op de hoogte stellen van de uitkomsten van zijn beraadslagingen, opdat hierover vóór het zomerreces met de Tweede Kamer kan worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over asbest in onderzeeboten

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about asbestos exposure among naval personnel and submarines, including missing registration of staff who worked with asbestos and a case of a sick former crew member. The minister answered that no operational exposure is indicated, that registration of exposed staff is kept in personnel files with a central overview promised for autumn 2015, and that the submarines are asbestos-safe though not asbestos-free.
My predecessors have informed you about this in the past.
Hierover hebben mijn ambtsvoorgangers u in het verleden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink naar aanleiding van het bericht dat militairen met een buitenlandse partner naar de rechter stappen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that military personnel with foreign partners are taking legal action over partner screening, and about a planned arrangement for suspended personnel. The minister said defence-wide information on partner screening has been given and will be repeated, and referred to a letter of 13 February 2015 for the details of the arrangement.
With my letter of 13 February (Parliamentary paper 34000-X, no. 66) I informed the House of Representatives about the arrangement.
Met mijn brief van 13 februari jl. (Kamerstuk 34000-X, nr. 66 ) heb ik de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de regeling.
Vragen van het lid Jasper vanDijk (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de Nederlandse luchtaanval in Mali (ingezonden 23 januari 2015).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a Dutch Apache air strike in Mali near Tabankort, the protests in Kidal, casualties, the UN mandate, and the peace process. The ministers answered that the strike was defensive under the UN mandate, that casualties are not yet officially confirmed and are under investigation, and that the peace process continues.
How many dead and injured are to be regretted exactly has not yet been officially established. Research into this is still being conducted.
Hoeveel doden en gewonden er precies te betreuren zijn is nog niet officieel vastgesteld. Hiernaar wordt nog onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over bewerkte testresultaten van de F-35

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether improvements in F-35 test results stem mainly from a changed counting method, whether the minister was informed, and whether stealth problems exist. The minister answered that the DOT&E report shows reliability gains, that the report does not clarify how much is due to counting changes, that the partner countries were informed without content details, and that there are no stealth problems.
He points out that part of the improvement in this parameter can be attributed to the way the F-35 programme counts and processes failures.
Hij wijst erop dat een deel van de verbetering van deze parameter kan worden toegeschreven aan de manier waarop het F-35 programma storingen telt en verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over verstekelingen aan boord van de Karel Doorman

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about stowaways found aboard the Karel Doorman Ebola relief ship, the security consequences, what happens to them on arrival, and whether they were infected. The minister confirmed awareness, said an internal investigation found remaining intrusion points being addressed, that the stowaways were refused entry and handed to the IND for asylum processing, and that they were not infected.
The internal investigation into the stowaways found aboard the Joint Support Ship (JSS) Karel Doorman has now been completed.
Het interne onderzoek over de verstekelingen die werden aangetroffen aan boord van het Joint Support Ship (JSS) Karel Doorman is inmiddels voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse informatiepositie in aanloop naar de MH-17 ramp

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Foreign Affairs and Defence about the Dutch government's information position before the MH-17 downing, including what was known about downed aircraft, Ukrainian airspace warnings, the July 2014 Ukraine briefing and the role of the OVV and CTIVD. The government answered most questions by pointing to the ongoing OVV and prosecution investigations, stating it had no validated list of downed aircraft and that Ukraine gave no warnings beyond NOTAMs, while committing to share the briefing report and correspondence with the OVV.
We consider it of the utmost importance that the Public Prosecution Service can continue its investigation unhindered.
Wij achten het van het grootste belang dat het OM het onderzoek ongehinderd kan blijven verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de zaak Spijkers

An MP asks ministers about the Spijkers settlement, including whether medical records were ordered destroyed without the claimant's explicit consent, who may access the archived file, and whether it was improperly kept secret. The government denies any destruction decision was taken, states the digital record was deleted by the former occupational health provider with a destruction statement, says the file was transferred to the National Archives under access rules, and refuses to open the full file to the Chamber or researchers on the grounds set out in earlier letters.
Otherwise a check of what was transferred would not have been possible.
Een controle van hetgeen werd overgedragen was anders niet mogelijk geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘geheime informatie over JSF in handen van China’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether reports that secret F-35 information was in Chinese hands were true and what the consequences would be, and whether this squared with hosting Chinese naval ships. The minister replied that the reporting concerns old leaked US documents and a years-old incident without classified data being taken, that operational security is not at stake, and that the Chinese ship visit follows from a bilateral partnership.
Furthermore, the JPO states that for security reasons no further details are provided.
Verder stelt het JPO dat om veiligheidsredenen geen nadere details worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat veel geheimen van de JSF in Chinese handen zijn

De Roon (PVV) asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands and the Five Eyes were informed of serious damage to the JSF programme after reports that many JSF secrets had fallen into Chinese hands, and asked for details of the leak, what was stolen, and countermeasures. The minister replied that the JPO says no classified information was stolen, that serious damage is not the case, and that further details and specific countermeasures cannot be shared for security reasons.
For security reasons, the JPO does not provide further details.
Het JPO verstrekt om veiligheidsredenen geen nadere details.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het College van de Rechten van de Mens dat er sprake is van leeftijdsdiscriminatie als een uitkering van functioneel leeftijdsontslag stopt op

MPs Ulenbelt asked how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that ending the UGM military disability benefit at 65 while the AOW age has risen amounts to age discrimination, and what it will do about the resulting income gap. The minister says the ruling concerns UGM benefits, that Defence is negotiating a fix with unions and a temporary ABP bridging scheme runs to 2016, and that the AOW gap is a deliberate sustainability measure with a temporary OBR bridging benefit; no structural change is promised.
Until then, the Minister of Defence is obliged to apply the existing terms of employment and no individual deviating arrangements will be made.
Tot die tijd is de Minister van Defensie gehouden de bestaande rechtspositieregeling toe te passen en worden geen individuele afwijkende regelingen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de integratie van een Nederlandse gemechaniseerde brigade in het Duitse leger

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the 43rd Mechanised Brigade's integration into the German army was finalised and why, and whether Dutch tank capability and sovereignty were being eroded after the sale of Leopard tanks. The minister replied that integration is still under study, that a small non-operational tank training unit was created, that Dutch and German governments always retain final say over deployment, and that defence cooperation does not conflict with sovereignty.
Both Germany and the Netherlands always retain the final word over the deployment of their own military personnel.
Zowel Duitsland als Nederland behoudt altijd het laatste woord over de inzet van eigen militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een jihadistische dreiging voor de NAVO-basis in Brunssum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reported jihadist threats to the NATO base in Brunssum, the link to a nearby mosque, possible closure of that mosque, and security measures. The minister declined to discuss specific threats or measures publicly, said responsibility is shared between defence, local authorities and NATO, and referred to the general threat assessment.
For security reasons I do not make public statements about threats and risks concerning specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreigingen en risico’s ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over “noodkreet van een Nederlandse militair”

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about a soldier's public complaint that the government is too afraid to let the armed forces defend themselves, including the ban on wearing uniforms during commuting, unarmed civilians at military gates, threat statistics, a pay rise, and budget increases. The minister explained the uniform ban as a precautionary measure given higher jihadist threat, declined to detail security measures or individual cases, confirmed CAO negotiations had started, and deferred budget questions to a spring 2015 reply.
Defence generally makes no statements about security measures, so also not about how access to military sites is organised.
Over beveiligingsmaatregelen doet Defensie doorgaans geen uitspraken, dus ook niet over de wijze waarop de toegang tot militaire objecten is georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat een medewerkster van de Nederlandse ambassade in Bagdad gevoelige informatie zou hebben gelekt

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether a local employee at the Dutch embassy in Baghdad had leaked sensitive information to Iraqi intelligence, whether screening of embassy staff is adequate, and whether military personnel could be endangered. The government answered that an investigation found no evidence of leaking or selling information, that screening of local staff is done as well as possible, and that no defence information appears compromised.

The investigation, in which the Ministry of Defence was also involved, has now been completed and no indications were found that the employee in question leaked or sold information to the Iraqi intelligence service.

Het onderzoek, waarbij ook het Ministerie van Defensie betrokken was, is inmiddels voltooid en er zijn geen aanwijzingen gevonden dat betrokken medewerkster informatie heeft gelekt dan wel heeft verkocht aan de Iraakse inlichtingendienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het aantal neergeschoten helikopters en vliegtuigen boven Oost-Oekraïne voorafgaand aan de ramp van 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the government how many aircraft and helicopters were shot down over eastern Ukraine before the MH17 disaster, what the cabinet knew on 17 July 2014, and related questions about Dutch monitoring, a 14 July briefing, and prosecution timing. The government answered that the numbers were unverified and no validated list could be provided, that no specific airspace consultations took place, and that prosecution options cannot yet be disclosed because the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Both the number and the causes are unclear and not validated.
Zowel het aantal als ook de oorzaken zijn onduidelijk en niet gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat er enkele doden zijn gevallen bij een aanslag op een VN-konvooi nabij de luchthaven van Somalië

MP De Roon asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly attack on a UN convoy near Mogadishu airport, the safety of Dutch EUTM Somalia personnel, the security threat in Mogadishu, Al-Shabaab's strength, Kenya's role, and whether the Dutch training contribution should be withdrawn. The ministers answered that no Dutch personnel were present at the convoy, the mission remains in Mogadishu with security measures, and they will not end the Dutch contribution, while declining to engage on religious questions.
There were no Dutch nationals present with the UN convoy when the attack was carried out.
Er waren geen Nederlanders aanwezig bij het VN-konvooi toen de aanslag werd gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de transactie met militairen, verdacht van verduistering

PVV MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers why a settlement offer over alleged embezzlement by soldiers in Kunduz was made on embezzlement in a group rather than in a service relationship, and whether the suspects were Marechaussee members subject to dismissal. The Defence minister answered that the settlement was based on the suspicion of embezzlement committed in association, that the suspects were not Marechaussee members, and gave no further explanation of the omitted aggravating element.
Answer 2 See the answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Zie het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het hoofdkwartier van Hamas in Turkije

CDA MP Knops asked the ministers whether Turkey hosts a Hamas headquarters from which attacks on Israel are organised and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey, the EU or NATO on this. The government could not confirm the reports, saw no need for an independent investigation, declined to put the matter on the NATO ministerial agenda, and said it is critical of Turkey where necessary.
The cabinet cannot confirm this reporting.
Het kabinet kan deze berichtgeving niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens in twee zaken die Somalische piraten hadden aangespannen tegen Frankrijk

MP Knops asked about two ECHR rulings against France involving Somali pirates, including compensation, whether France acted under UN mandate, and whether the Netherlands could intervene in a Grand Chamber referral. The minister answered that the rulings concern detention without prompt judicial appearance, that the Netherlands handles such cases differently, that Dutch navy operations are unaffected, and that Dutch intervention would depend on a referral and offer legal added value.
The Netherlands has so far organised this procedure differently.
Nederland heeft deze procedure tot dusver op andere wijze vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Russische agressie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about growing Russian military assertiveness, NATO's response, defence spending toward the 2% target, and whether the Russian ambassador would be summoned over unannounced bomber flights. The government answered that assertive Russian behaviour has increased, described NATO's reassurance and Readiness Action Plan measures, pointed to a letter on defence spending, and said the ministry had already raised concerns with Russia's chargé d'affaires.
On 30 October the Ministry of Foreign Affairs conveyed the Dutch concerns about the unannounced flights to the chargé d'affaires of the Russian embassy at senior official level.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft op 30 oktober jl. op hoogambtelijk niveau in een onderhoud met de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Russische ambassade de Nederlandse zorgen over de onaangekondigde vluchten overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het wapenembargo tegen Rusland, de Franse Mistraldeal en samenwerking tussen Europese wapenleveranciers en Russische strijdkrachten

Two MPs asked whether the Mistral helicopter carrier deal would be delivered to Russia despite the arms embargo, how Europe's arms makers could cooperate with Russian forces, and about the embargo's status and enforcement. The minister replied that France decides on delivery, that the government shares France's view that conditions are not right for delivery, that the embargo does not cover pre-August 2014 contracts, that it runs until 31 July 2015, and that the Netherlands will raise enforcement issues in Brussels.
The government has no insight into deliveries above 1 million euros from EU member states based on contracts concluded before 1 August 2014.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in leveringen van boven de 1 miljoen euro vanuit EU-lidstaten op basis van voor 1 augustus 2014 gesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over postume rehabilitatie van drie KNIL-vliegers

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether three KNIL pilots convicted in Colombo in 1943 were given long sentences to set an example, and whether the government would reopen historical research and reconsider posthumous rehabilitation. The minister answered that the sentencing cannot now be traced to a deterrence motive, that the 1950 pardon already addressed their interests, that the earlier rehabilitation refusal stands, and that further historical research is unlikely given lost archival sources.
Obtaining further insight into this case is therefore unlikely.
Het verkrijgen van nadere inzichten in deze zaak is daardoor onwaarschijnlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ronselpraktijken op een luchtmachtbasis

An MP asks the Defence and Justice ministers about alleged jihadist recruitment at the Volkel air base, including whether the radicalised ex-soldier has been located, what measures exist against radicalised ex-military personnel, and how many ex-staff are involved in jihadist activity. The government answers that recruitment is criminal under the Penal Code, that the integrated jihadism approach also covers Defence staff, that the MIVD investigates radicalisation when warranted, and declines to give numbers or operational details.
I cannot make any statements about the numbers of radicalised former Defence employees involved in jihadist activities.
Over aantallen geradicaliseerde ex-medewerkers van Defensie die betrokken zijn bij jihadistische activiteiten kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat Defensie jarenlang op de hoogte was van de gifverf, maar geen maatregelen nam

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether Defence knew for years about carcinogenic chromium-6 paint and failed to protect staff, including past inspections, a prosecution report and a 1990 medical inquiry. The minister answered that the RIVM investigation must first establish what happened and when, and gave timelines for ongoing GGD and RIVM studies without concluding on past knowledge.
With the ongoing RIVM investigation into the use of chromium-containing paint at Defence, more insight must be gained into what happened when.
Met het lopende onderzoek door het RIVM naar het gebruik van chroomhoudende verf bij Defensie, moet meer inzicht worden verkregen in wat wanneer is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Fraude onder defensiemedewerkers

An MP asked the Defence Minister about alleged large-scale fraud by defence employees, whether they were military or civilian, whether the probe covered the whole armed forces, why offenders were not dismissed, and whether the results would be shared. The minister said three civilian staff at the US Army Garrison Schinnen had irregular travel claims totalling 200 to 1,250 euro each, received a pay-related disciplinary measure and repayment, and that a full answer by the requested date was not possible.

Given the nature and extent of the dereliction of duty, a disciplinary measure affecting pay was chosen that is proportionate to the dereliction committed, together with repayment of the fraudulent amounts.

Gelet op de aard en omvang van het plichtsverzuim is gekozen voor een disciplinaire maatregel in de sfeer van bezoldiging die proportioneel is in verhouding tot het gepleegde plichtsverzuim en het terugbetalen van de fraudebedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Kerstens over het gebruik van PX-10 door Defensie

Two MPs (Eijsink and Kerstens, PvdA) asked the Minister of Defence why the Ministry kept using PX-10 despite known health risks since 1976, why Parliament was not informed earlier, and what measures would follow an EenVandaag broadcast. The Minister answered that documentation dates from 1980, phasing out occurred 1981–1996, Parliament was informed 2008–2011, internal documents were already public, and the RIVM independently handles any counter-expertise, while personnel can contact helplines.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de gevolgen van het gebruik van het schoonmaakmiddel PX-10

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about the PX-10 cleaning agent, benzene exposure, RIVM findings, and whether Defence took health precautions and followed up a 2009 motion for former staff. The Minister answered that no historical measurements were found, that RIVM's methods are sound, and that the health risk was judged practically excluded, with former staff able to contact occupational health services.
No measurements from that period have been found.
Er zijn uit die periode geen metingen teruggevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over omstandigheden voor militairen in Mali

An SP MP asks the Defence Minister about poor conditions for Dutch troops in Mali, including tents, broken toilets, extreme heat, equipment shortcomings and whether soldiers can safely complain. The minister answers that conditions are difficult but acceptable, that shelters and containers are being provided, that complaint channels and surveys exist, and declines an IMG inspection for now.
The IMG can, however, also carry out an investigation at the request of the unions.
De IMG kan echter ook op aanvraag van de bonden onderzoek verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanval op een student in defensie-uniform

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether an alleged knife threat and car incident against students in defence uniform were linked to jihadist danger, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that police found the threat report was false and the car incident was not deliberate, that no other such incidents are known, and that Defence takes staff safety seriously but will not disclose its measures.
So as not to undermine the intended effect, no statements are made about measures taken or still to be taken.
Om het beoogde effect hiervan niet te ondergraven, worden over genomen of nog te nemen maatregelen geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote zorgen van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the Commander of the Armed Forces' concerns over underfunding, NATO's 2% target, limits on possible ISIS operations, a stepwise budget plan and a 15-year vision. The minister acknowledged the remarks, pointed to a forthcoming letter on the motion-Van der Staaij and NATO summit commitments, noted some operational constraints, and referred to earlier reports without committing to a budget schedule.

As the Prime Minister committed during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House by letter before the Defence budget debate on how it intends to implement the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering wil geven aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdiensten voor bijbanen in publieke dienst

An MP asked the government about reports that former minister Uri Rosenthal received raised fees for his advisory council chairmanship and how much he earns from public-sector side jobs, and whether officials should earn no more than a minister. The government replied that the report was wrong, that the fee was actually lowered, that a calculation error in the published decision was corrected, and that the Remuneration Decree already caps combined fees at a minister's salary.
The internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat 60 procent van het Defensiepersoneel geen vertrouwen in de minister heeft

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether she is aware that 60% of defence personnel reportedly lack confidence in her, whether she still considers herself credible, and when a new collective labour agreement and compensation for the WUL and AOW gap will follow. The minister acknowledges eroded staff confidence due to cuts and reorganisations, says a new cao cannot be guaranteed before the November budget debate, and declines to detail negotiation content while pointing to a structural 50 million euro allocation and a planned AOW-gap solution.
I cannot give guarantees on the timing of completion, but my aim is to reach good cao agreements as quickly as possible.
Ik kan geen garanties geven voor het tijdstip van voltooiing, maar mijn streven is zo snel mogelijk tot goede cao-afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland inlichtingen over Toearegs verstrekt aan het Malinese leger

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch intelligence supplied to Mali's army could help it attack Tuareg groups, and whether this undermines the UN mission and mediation. The government denied sharing intelligence with the Malian army, said Dutch-gathered intelligence goes to the UN mission (MINUSMA) and that sharing with Bamako is up to the UN, and described ongoing peace negotiations.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army, as the article claims.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger, zoals in het artikel wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inlichtingenverstrekking door Nederlands leger aan leger van Mali

MP De Roon asked whether Dutch military intelligence sharing with Mali's army in its internal conflict with Tuareg insurgents, and whether the government would prevent it. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares no intelligence with the Malian army; the Dutch contribution to the UN ASIFU unit serves only MINUSMA and sharing with Mali is for the UN to decide.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke fraude bij de productie van de motor van de F-35

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked the Defence Minister about possible fraud involving titanium of uncertain origin, possibly from Russia, in the F-35 engine, and how Defence would prevent unsafe or illegally sourced materials. The minister replied that US authorities are investigating, affected parts are being replaced, Defence has raised the matter with the Joint Program Office, and she cannot rule out problems until the inquiry ends, but will inform the House of the outcome of the case against A&P Alloys.
I cannot make any statements on this at the moment because the American authorities are conducting an investigation.
Ik kan daarover op dit moment geen uitspraken doen omdat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over opheldering over uniformverbod militairen

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister to clarify whether soldiers are obliged to follow the ban on wearing uniforms during commuting, whether it is an order, and why the government communicated inconsistently about it. The minister replied that the precautionary measure was ordered on security advice, that soldiers can be addressed on compliance, that communication could have been clearer, and that the measure stays in force until further notice.
It is not customary for every internal precautionary measure, order, directive or instruction to be shared with the House.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat elke interne voorzorgsmaatregel, order, richtlijn of bevel met de Kamer wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onze ontmantelde krijgsmacht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the state of the Dutch armed forces, including whether they can contribute to fighting ISIS, the NATO 2% spending norm, and a long-term vision. The minister answered that the armed forces remain capable, that the 2% commitment will be addressed in a letter before the budget debate, and that the existing course in the 2013 policy note still applies.

As the Prime Minister promised during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives by letter before the Defence budget debate, planned for 12 and 13 November, on how it implements the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd in de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie, gepland op 12 en 13 november, per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over escortering van een VN-schip naar Somalië

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why a Dutch frigate was used to escort a UN food-aid ship to Somalia rather than embarked armed guards, whether this means fewer frigates are needed for anti-piracy, and whether the Netherlands will hand the escort task to other countries. The Minister answered that the WFP has no longer a contract and charters ships individually, so the armed-guard teams cannot be used; escorts are a core Atalanta task, other countries also escort, and the next WFP ship may again use a guard team.
On these transports the deployment of an AVPD team is not possible and therefore the EU operation Atalanta carries out escorts.
Op deze transporten is de inzet van een AVPD-team niet mogelijk en daarom voert de EU-operatie Atalanta escortes uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Van Hijum en Hachchi over het bericht ‘Ziek personeelslid vliegbasis Twenthe kreeg 100.000 euro schadevergoeding’

MPs asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a media report that a sick former employee at Twenthe air base received 100,000 euro in damages after 14 years, allegedly on condition of dropping further legal steps, and whether such payouts had occurred before. The Minister confirmed the settlement after a long process delayed by medical uncertainty, denied any gag clause, reported fourteen related claims with five liability acknowledgements, and agreed to an independent broad investigation of all Defence staff exposed to chromium-6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over diefstal van geheime legerstukken

MPs asked why Parliament was not informed in time about the November 2013 theft of secret military documents from a car, and what follow-up was taken on the related procurement. The Defence Minister answered that the theft was reported internally and to police, suppliers were informed, staff were re-instructed, and the procurement is ongoing and unaffected by the theft.
The theft took place on 27 November 2013.
De diefstal heeft plaatsgehad op 27 november 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Veel meer giftige verf bij Defensie”

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister how she views reports that toxic chromium-6 paint exposure occurred at many more Defence workplaces than the known POMS sites, why the Chamber was not informed, and whether all sites will be investigated. The minister replied that these findings were largely known since 1998 and 2001, that the results of the ongoing broad investigation must be awaited, and that the investigation is being extended to all Defence locations using CARC and chromium-containing paint.
Defence is collecting data and reports on CARC and chromium-containing paints found in the archive and elsewhere.
Defensie is bezig met het verzamelen van gegevens en rapporten over CARC en chroomhoudende verven die in het archief en elders zijn aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de staking Kustwacht

MP Bosman asked the Defence Minister about a strike by Curaçao Coast Guard patrol staff, its effects on regional security, threats to local staff, drug seizure trends and decentralisation of coast guard command. The minister replied that the strike lasted about 36 hours, did not compromise border security, that threat reports were unfounded or unrecorded, that seizures fluctuate, and that a pilot decentralisation is under evaluation with the director remaining responsible.
The strike has had no consequences for security in the region.
De staking heeft geen gevolgen gehad voor de veiligheid in de regio.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Hijum over een onderzoek op het voormalige NAVO-depot in Vriezenveen naar een mogelijk verband tussen gezondheidsklachten van oud-medewerkers en het werken met de giftige verf

MPs Knops and Van Hijum asked the Defence Minister why an investigation into health complaints of former workers with the paint CARC was launched for a depot in Limburg but not in Vriezenveen, and how former workers can have their complaints independently examined. The Minister answered that the research is being expanded to all defence sites using CARC and chromium VI, including Vriezenveen, that both studies run simultaneously, and that former workers can register with a reporting point, with individual follow-up after the RIVM results.
The investigations in Limburg and Vriezenveen are taking place simultaneously.
De onderzoeken in Limburg en Vriezenveen vinden gelijktijdig plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht «Nederland weigert eigen tolk asiel»

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about press reports that the Netherlands refused asylum to a former Dutch interpreter from Uruzgan, whose claim was rejected by Norway, and about the wider treatment of Afghan interpreters. The government answered that Norway is responsible under Dublin, that no individual circumstances justified taking over the claim, that individual talks and compensation payments to a group of 25 Afghan interpreters are under way, and that a referral route via the IND exists.
As the Chamber is aware, I am reticent about providing information on an individual case.
Als uw Kamer bekend, ben ik terughoudend met het verstrekken van informatie over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding in de Golf van Guinee

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a US counter-piracy plan for the Gulf of Guinea, including armed private guards and convoys, and whether Dutch navy should act more in international waters. The government answered that it supports a regional, EU-coordinated approach focused on maritime capacity building, notes most attacks occur within coastal states' territorial waters, and sees no need for a more active navy role beyond existing exercises and training.
The cabinet favours a regional solution to maritime crime in the Gulf of Guinea, through regional prevention, prosecution and maritime capacity building.

Het kabinet is voorstander van een regionale oplossing voor het probleem van maritieme criminaliteit in de Golf van Guinee, door middel van regionale preventie, vervolging en maritieme capaciteitsopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding bij Somalië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether pressuring Somali piracy protectors toward legal economic activity or destroying their landing facilities is a viable, cheaper policy. The government answered that naval missions have sharply reduced attacks, that state-building and the New Deal are the long-term answer, and that the 2012 raid on a pirate depot was a one-off with no exclusive pirate facilities remaining.
Since 2012 no ships have been hijacked.
Sinds 2012 zijn er geen schepen meer gekaapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de NAVO-vrees voor een Russische inval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about NATO fears of a Russian invasion of Ukraine, the value of Russia's humanitarian convoy proposal, next NATO steps, a defence vision, and reaching 2% of GDP on defence. The minister answered that Russian forces are massed at the border, that NATO is preparing reassurance measures to be decided at the Wales summit, and that further defence cuts are not advisable, with the spending question left to Prinsjesdag.
The cabinet is of the view that further cuts to Defence do not seem advisable, given the developing security situation in the Euro-Atlantic region.
Het kabinet is van mening dat verdere bezuinigingen op Defensie, gegeven de zich ontwikkelende veiligheidssituatie in de Euro-Atlantische regio, niet voor de hand liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Eijsink over Russische oorlogsschepen en bommenwerpers in de buurt van Nederland

MPs Knops and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about Russian warships and bombers near Dutch waters in 2014, including escorts by the Royal Netherlands Navy and the frequency of Russian bomber flights. The minister answered that the escorts and passages were routine or within international waters, that Russian bomber flights do not violate Dutch airspace, and listed past bomber patrol dates since 2007 while acknowledging a rise in assertive Russian behaviour.
Exact details of the actions taken by NATO are classified and cannot be included in this answer.
Exacte gegevens over de acties die door de Navo zijn genomen, zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen niet in dit antwoord worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over het mogelijk op straat zetten van 250 militairen

Two CDA MPs asked whether reinstating cleaning staff into government employment would force Defence to dismiss 250 military and civilian personnel, and whether this would cut the defence budget. The government denied a forced choice, said Defence is only connected from 2018 for office premises with a near budget-neutral business case, and gave a partial answer on compensation.
As stated in Minister Blok's letter of 23 June, the cabinet's choices for the departments lead to an almost budget-neutral business case for performing the cleaning work in-house.

Zoals in de brief van Minister Blok van 23 juni jl. is vermeld, leiden de keuzes van het kabinet voor de departementen tot een vrijwel budgettair neutrale business case voor het in eigen beheer uitvoeren van de schoonmaakwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat F-35 toestellen aan de grond staan

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how long the F-35 fleet would be grounded after a fire incident, and whether this affected delivery schedules, costs and confidence in the 37-aircraft budget. The Minister replied that flights resumed after a US investigation found a specific cause, that no direct delivery impact is seen (first Dutch aircraft in 2019), that financial consequences are not yet clear, and that incidents will be reported in progress reports.
I have promised to do so.
Ik heb toegezegd dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat tientallen oud-medewerkers van Defensie ernstig ziek zijn geworden omdat zij zijn blootgesteld aan giftige stoffen

MPs Van Dijk and Ulenbelt asked whether Defence commissioned studies in 1999 and 2002 showing toxic chromium exposure at POMS depots that were kept secret, and what was known, when, about former staff falling ill. The minister replied that the studies were not concealed and staff were informed, and announced an internal historical inventory, an independent assessment and a GGD study, with liability to be decided after the findings.
Defence did not conceal the outcomes of the research at the POMS sites Vriezenveen and Brunssum.
Defensie heeft de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bij de POMS-sites Vriezenveen en Brunssum niet verzwegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een aanhouding bij de Nederlandse Veteranendag

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether a spectator carrying the Morgenstervlag was arrested at the Veteranendag parade, whether the flag played a role, and whether the arrest was proportionate. The government answered that the person was arrested for climbing a fence into a closed security zone, not for the flag, that the Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag banned non-regimental flags at the parade by agreement with veterans' associations, and that the case is a standalone matter for local authorities and the Openbaar Ministerie.
In the first instance it is up to the local authorities to judge what happened.
Het is in eerste instantie aan het lokale gezag om een oordeel te geven over hetgeen er is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de marineleiding helikopters wil kopen als alternatief voor de NH-90

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether, after the NH-90 problems, a replacement combat helicopter should be bought quickly and whether the Seahawk should be considered. The Minister replied that compensating measures are being worked out, that the NH-90 problems are being addressed with NAHEMA and the manufacturer, that there is no reason yet to consider another helicopter type, and that the defence budget is part of the overall budget deliberations.
Defence is currently working on compensating measures to reduce the capacity shortfall, including the deployment of additional own Cougar helicopters.
Defensie werkt momenteel compenserende maatregelen uit om het capaciteitstekort te verminderen, waaronder de inzet van extra eigen Cougar-helikopters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Knops en Eijsink over het voornemen van de marineleiding om tweedehands helikopters aan te schaffen

Three MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the naval leadership plans to buy second-hand helicopters amid a helicopter shortage linked to NH90 problems, and what the financing, risks and training implications would be. The minister answered that the headline was incorrect, that the statements came from the naval officers' association chair rather than naval leadership, that no purchase is planned, and that compensating measures focus on extending existing Cougar helicopters and using other countries' helicopters.
The headline above the report is not correct.
De kop boven het bericht is niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het persbericht ‘Veiligheidstekorten opgelost, wel aandachtspunten bij 336 Squadron Koninklijke luchtmacht’ van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Safety Board's press release finding that safety shortcomings at 336 Squadron were resolved but the safety culture needs more attention, and about the Air Force's non-compliance with MAR OPS-1. The minister acknowledged the MAR OPS-1 implementation was ongoing with completion expected by year end and audit by the MLA, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating existing safety measures.
The implementation is expected to be completed by the end of this year. An evaluation and an audit by the Military Aviation Authority (MLA) will then follow.
Naar verwachting is de invoering eind van dit jaar voltooid. Vervolgens vindt een evaluatie plaats en een audit door de Militaire Luchtvaart Autoriteit (MLA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over meer dan 500 dagen geen Defensie-CAO

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister why more than 500 days have passed without a new collective labour agreement for defence personnel, citing financial pressure and asking for a 10% pay rise for 2015. The minister answered that the previous agreement's terms remain in force, that delays are normal under a wage freeze, promised an study of financial problems among soldiers, and said pay talks with unions are ongoing without committing to a specific figure.
I promised your House during the oral question hour on 15 April that research would be carried out into financial problems among military personnel.
Ik heb uw Kamer in het mondelinge vragenuur op 15 april jl. toegezegd onderzoek te laten doen naar financiële problemen onder militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verbod op de Morgenstervlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether the government bears responsibility for the Veterans' Day committee, which includes military staff, banning the Morgenstern flag, and whether it would ask the committee to allow it. The minister answered that the committee is independent, understands the ban as reinforcing the formal character of the parade, and refused to request that the flag be allowed.
The Netherlands Veterans' Day Committee has an independent status, in line with the advice of the Van Eekelen Committee in 2003.
Het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag heeft een onafhankelijke status, overeenkomstig het advies van de Commissie-Van Eekelen in 2003.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de militaire dreiging door Venezuela om Aruba binnen te vallen

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports of a Venezuelan military threat to invade Aruba, the release of Venezuelan intelligence chief Carvajal, and Maduro's remarks about escalation, and whether defence spending should rise. The minister answered that Carvajal was released because he enjoys consular immunity under international law, that justice is autonomous for Aruba, that Maduro's remarks were noted from the media, and that further defence cuts are not advisable though any increase will be considered in budget talks.
Diplomatic and consular relations, including immunity, are powers of the Kingdom.
Diplomatieke en consulaire relaties, inclusief immuniteit, zijn bevoegdheden van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘Man gaat joyriden met pantservoertuig’

An MP asked the Minister of Defence how a man could take an armoured YPR vehicle from a barracks unseen, what measures will prevent such theft, and whether recovery costs will be recovered from the perpetrator. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, gave a general account of how the vehicle was accessed and driven out, noted that guard staff did not follow procedures, announced stricter security enforcement, and declined to say whether costs will be recovered pending the investigation.
The criminal investigation carried out under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service by the Royal Military Police has not yet been completed.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie door de Koninklijke Marechaussee wordt uitgevoerd, is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de integratie van de Luchtmobiele Brigade in het Duitse leger

Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether integrating the Luchtmobiele Brigade into the German army is a step toward a European army, whether it limits Dutch sovereignty, and whether the government should instead invest heavily in national defence. The minister replied that no European army is planned, that each country keeps the final say over its own troops, that sovereignty is strengthened through shared capabilities, and that cooperation is not a budget-cutting measure.
Even with the integration of units, Germany and the Netherlands each have the final say over the deployment of their own military personnel.
Ook bij de integratie van eenheden geldt echter dat Duitsland en Nederland elk het laatste woord hebben over de inzet van de eigen militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de F-35 die naar Nederland komt voor geluidsmeting en Luchtmachtdagen

An MP asked whether the Defence Minister would bring an F-35 test aircraft to Volkel or Leeuwarden to clarify noise levels and give clarity to residents of Uden. The Minister answered that no concrete prospect exists yet since the Dutch test aircraft are in the US until 2018, that additional Dutch noise measurements are not expected to be necessary, and that US noise analysis results are expected after summer.
As soon as this is the case, I will inform you of that.
Zodra dit wél het geval is, zal ik u daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren inzake het artikel in de Telegraaf van 23 mei jl. over de leegloop van de krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a Telegraaf report that one in five military posts is unfilled and whether this endangers operations, and what causes the staffing problem. The minister denies the one-in-five figure, says vacancies are shrinking and operations are not at risk, attributes the shortage to cautious recruitment during reorganisations, and says Defence must invest in personnel and pay regardless of budget level.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een vertrouwenspersoon voor onderzoek naar de veiligheid van kernwapens in Nederland

MP Van Bommel asked the Defence Minister whether she would respond to Noord-Brabant's concerns about nuclear weapon safety at Volkel and appoint an independent trusted person to investigate, including transport safety. The minister replied the cabinet sees no reason to doubt the safety of US nuclear weapons in Europe, but under alliance agreements no information on numbers or locations can be given, not even to a trusted person.
However, based on alliance agreements, as is well known, no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of these weapons, not even to a trusted person.
Op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken kunnen echter, zoals bekend, geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van deze wapens, ook niet aan een vertrouwenspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de uitbesteding van de SAR-taken

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Defence Minister whether maritime search and rescue helicopter tasks were being outsourced because of delays in the NH-90, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the decision was driven by budget cuts. The minister confirmed the outsourcing is a temporary measure due to NH-90 introduction delays, stated SAR policy is set by Infrastructure and Environment and operationally by the Coast Guard, denied budget motives, and promised to inform the Chamber about the NH-90 problems before the summer recess.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment is policy-responsible for SAR.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu is beleidsverantwoordelijk voor SAR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Amerikaanse militaire activiteiten in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reported US training of Malian commandos, US support to French forces, US drone use and funding for counterterrorism in the Sahel, and whether MINUSMA and EUTM are affected. The government said it had no information on the reported secret US training, that MINUSMA and EUTM do not train special counterterrorism units, declined to comment on other countries' operations, and promised only the usual biannual parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet does not make statements about such activities of other countries.
Over dergelijke activiteiten van andere landen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verboden vlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Indonesian embassy pressured organisers to ban the Morgenster flag at the Veterans Day parade and why it was banned for the first time. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regiment flags at the formal parade, that veterans may carry the flag on the Malieveld, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The organisation of Veterans Day falls under the responsibility of the Dutch Veterans Day Committee.
De organisatie van de Veteranendag valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Eijsink over berichten met betrekking tot de beëindiging van de treinkaping bij De Punt

MPs Recourt and Eijsink asked whether reports that the FBI assumed the Moluccans would be liquidated during the 1977 De Punt train hijacking, and that the FBI persuaded the marines, are known and whether the review underway includes these archival materials. The minister confirmed knowledge of the reports, said they are part of the ongoing review, and stated the working group found the information known to it insofar as relevant, with three external experts assessing completeness.
As I informed your House by letter of 1 April 2014, I asked three external experts to assess the working group's work for care and completeness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb laten weten bij brief van 1 april 2014 2 heb ik drie externe deskundigen verzocht het werk van de werkgroep te beoordelen op zorgvuldigheid en volledigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht «Shabaab claimt aanslag Nederlanders Somalië»

MP Vuijk asked the Defence Minister about al-Shabaab's claim of an attack targeting Dutch soldiers in Somalia/Djibouti, the threat to deployed personnel, and effects on anti-piracy operations and port calls. The minister replied that the attack was likely not aimed specifically at Dutch troops, the threat assessment is unchanged in substance, and precautionary measures were adopted by EU Atalanta without affecting Dutch operations.
The MIVD has no indications that there are intentions to specifically target Dutch military personnel in the region with terrorist attacks.
De MIVD beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat er intenties zijn om terroristische aanslagen specifiek te richten op Nederlandse militairen in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over aparte berechting voor Veteranen

MP Eijsink (PvdA) asked the Ministers of Defence and of Security and Justice whether veterans with service-related trauma should be tried in a separate court, and about statistics, sentencing options, detention care, and reclassering supervision for veterans. The government answered that no statistics are held, that a 2011 study found veterans less often involved in criminal incidents, that ordinary courts already consider psychological conditions and can impose treatment conditions, that detention offers screening and forensic care, and that no special court or special reclassering regime is needed.
I consider the alignment of reclassering supervision with the perpetrator's personal circumstances sufficient and see no reason for improvement or adjustment of reclassering supervision.
Ik acht de afstemming van het reclasseringstoezicht op de persoon van de dader voldoende en zie geen aanleiding tot verbetering of aanpassing van het reclasseringstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de integratie van de Nederlandse Luchtmobiele Brigade in de Duitse Division Schnelle Kräfte en Duits-Nederlandse defensiesamenwerking

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the sovereignty implications, legal basis, equipment cooperation and parliamentary oversight of integrating the Dutch Air Mobile Brigade into the German Division Schnelle Kräfte under the 2013 Dutch-German Declaration of Intent. The minister answered that the Netherlands keeps the final say over deployment of its units, that the DoI is non-binding but enables binding agreements later, and that the Dutch parliament will be informed under the standard procurement process.
Yes, for all equipment procurement the House is informed under the agreements of the Defence Materiel Process (DMP).
Ja, voor alle materieelverwerving geldt dat de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd volgens de afspraken van het Defensie Materieel Proces (DMP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether the Ministry of Defence should stop using live animals in military medical training, given available simulators and EU rules, and why it allegedly told PETA US otherwise. The minister acknowledged live-animal training remains mandatory for trauma surgeons and anaesthetists (DSTC/DATC courses) with no alternative, denied a breach of Dutch law, and admitted the 2011 statement to PETA was inaccurate.
This information is not known to me. There are no international agreements or obligations regarding such reporting, and in practice this information is also not exchanged.
Deze informatie is mij niet bekend. Er zijn geen internationale afspraken of verplichtingen inzake dergelijke rapportages en ook in de praktijk wordt deze informatie niet uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat de Joint Strike Fighter niet onzichtbaar is voor moderne Russische en Chinese radarsystemen

The MP De Roon asks whether the F-35's stealth features are compromised by modern Russian and Chinese radar and what consequences this would have for the purchase. The Minister says the F-35 must meet its stealth requirements under US Joint Program Office oversight, that Defence monitors radar developments, and that the aircraft is considered a fifth-generation fighter.
The F-35 will have to meet the stated operational and technical requirements, including those relating to stealth properties.
De F-35 zal moeten voldoen aan de gestelde operationele en technische eisen, waaronder die betreffende stealth eigenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over tentendoeken als bescherming tegen raketaanvallen

An MP asked the Defence Minister why Dutch soldiers in MINUSMA were housed in tents rather than armoured containers from day one, why the housing policy was not smoother after the Chinook helicopter problems, and whether defence spending should rise to 2% of GDP. The minister answered that the threat level justified tents initially due to container delivery times, that armoured containers are now being procured, and that the current defence budget is adequate.
Defence will not hesitate to take additional measures if necessary.
Defensie zal niet aarzelen om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen indien dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over dalende defensiebudgetten

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether she shared US President Obama's concern about falling European defence budgets, including the Netherlands' spending at around 1% of GDP, and how she viewed statements by the Foreign and Finance Ministers on defence funding. The minister answered that international cooperation is necessary and that Dutch defence spending was welcomed, but declined to say whether she wanted more or less money for defence, only expressing support for the extra budget agreed in 2013.
Do you want more or less money for Defence?
Wilt u meer of minder geld voor Defensie?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de bezuinigingen door de NAVO op radarvliegtuigen (AWACS; Geilenkirchen)

An SGP MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO cuts to AWACS radar aircraft at Geilenkirchen weaken Western intelligence capacity, what consequences this has for Dutch airspace, Limburg employment and training noise, and what further NATO cuts are planned. The minister answered that the cuts follow from the AGS programme and Canada's withdrawal from AWACS funding, that SACEUR judged fourteen aircraft a prudent capability, that Dutch airspace management is unaffected, and that employment effects are not yet known.
The employment effects for the province of Limburg are not yet known at this time, because it is not yet definitively determined which posts will be eliminated and which staff will become surplus.
De werkgelegenheidseffecten voor de provincie Limburg zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend, omdat nog niet definitief vaststaat welke functies vervallen en welke medewerkers hierdoor overtollig worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over hedendaagse veiligheidsrisico’s bij een amfibische operatie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about rising safety risks for amphibious landings from advanced anti-ship missiles, the detectability of marines by commercial radar, and whether landing craft need upgrades for longer distances. The minister acknowledged growing risks, said threat analyses guide operational choices, and noted a planned upgrade of the Landing Craft Utility to be reported to parliament later.
Defence is preparing an adaptation of the large landing craft (Landing Craft Utility), on which the House will be informed in due course under the Defence Materiel Process (DMP).

Momenteel is Defensie een aanpassing van de grote landingsvaartuigen ( Landing Craft Utility) aan het voorbereiden waarover de Kamer te zijner tijd volgens het Defensie Materieel Proces (DMP) zal worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over de intrekking van de ondersteuning van de jaarlijkse reünie van Indië-veteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether support for the annual reunion of the 7th Grenadiers battalion (1949–1951) veterans was being withdrawn, and what means were available to keep it. The minister replied that support is maintained but coordination moves to another army unit, and that there is no budget cut on veterans' reunions.
No, support for the annual reunion of the 7th Grenadiers battalion remains in place.
Nee, de steun aan de jaarlijkse reünie van het 7e Bataljon Grenadiers blijft gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon aan de minister van Defensie over binnendringers op Vliegbasis Volkel

An MP asked the Defence Minister why intruders at Volkel air base were only apprehended after about an hour and what would be done to speed up apprehension. The minister answered that the base is protected in a tiered manner, that intruders were spotted around 06:50 and arrested at 07:00, and that security is a continuous concern, but that no details of additional measures will be given for security reasons.
For security reasons, no statements are made about measures taken and any additional security measures.
Vanuit beveiligingsoverwegingen worden geen mededelingen gedaan over getroffen en eventueel aanvullende veiligheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over het bericht dat de Interpol database van gestolen en/of vermiste paspoorten nauwelijks wordt gecheckt

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether Interpol's database of stolen and lost passports, which they said is rarely checked by governments, is adequately used at Dutch airports. The state secretary answered that the Koninklijke Marechaussee and national police have access to the database and consult it when needed, that the Schengen border check is secure, and that the Netherlands works with EU partners on passenger data.
I am currently examining the possibilities to better use this database to flag illegal immigration, serious crime and terrorism in passenger flows.
Ik onderzoek momenteel de mogelijkheden om deze databank beter te benutten bij het in passagiersstromen signaleren van illegale immigratie, zware criminaliteit en terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Turkije betrokken is bij onder andere steun aan Syrische rebellen

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Turkey supplies Syrian rebels, supports Al Nusra and was linked to the Ghouta sarin attack, and asked whether Turkey would be questioned and whether Dutch intelligence had information. The Minister answered that the government cannot independently assess the allegations, denied none of the claims could be verified, said talks with Turkey continue, and declined to share intelligence exchanges.
No public statement can be made about the sharing of information between intelligence services.
Over het delen van informatie tussen de inlichtingendiensten kan in het openbaar geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de aangekondigde evaluatie van de helikopterlaagvlieggebieden

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the timeline for a 2014 evaluation of helicopter low-flying areas, involvement of the local liaison group, noise complaints, simulator use and damage claims. The minister said a new evaluation will be carried out this year taking account of a pending court case, that communication with residents is being improved, and that complaint and damage-claim figures and handling are presented.
As announced when the previous evaluation was presented, a follow-up evaluation will be carried out this year.
Zoals aangekondigd bij de aanbieding van de vorige evaluatie zal dit jaar een volgende evaluatie worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.
