Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het artikel ‘Militair te snel dupe valse aangifte’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about suspending and dismissing soldiers before criminal investigations conclude, withdrawing security clearances (VGB) without completed prosecutions, and compensation for wrongful suspension or dismissal, as well as domestic violence in military families. The Minister answered that dismissal follows an internal investigation that is suspended while criminal proceedings run, that suspension is an order measure fully reversed if no dismissal follows, that VGB is withdrawn only after a relevant conviction with appeal rights, and that no policy change is needed.

Only after the investigation is completed and has led to a conviction for a criminal offence as referred to in the policy rule on judicial antecedents in security screenings, can the decision be taken to withdraw the VGB.

Pas nadat het onderzoek is voltooid en heeft geleid tot een veroordeling vanwege een strafbaar feit zoals bedoeld in de beleidsregeling justitiële antecedenten bij veiligheidsonderzoeken, kan het besluit worden genomen de VGB in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over gezichtsherkenning door de Scan Eagle

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Scan Eagle drone, used to track seals, is designed for facial recognition and whether its use for justice purposes could include such recognition. The government answered that the Scan Eagle's Defence cameras cannot identify people at operational altitude, but it does not rule out future low-altitude flights or facial-recognition cameras, pointing to a WODC privacy study.

Because I cannot foresee all future purposes for which a Raven or Scan Eagle will be deployed, I do not wish to rule out in advance that they will ever fly at low altitude or ever be fitted with cameras enabling facial recognition.

Omdat ik niet alle toekomstige doeleinden waarvoor een Raven of Scan Eagle zal worden ingezet kan voorzien, wil ik niet bij voorbaat uitsluiten dat deze ooit op lage hoogte zullen vliegen of dat zij ooit zullen worden voorzien van camera's waarmee gezichtsherkenning mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

Two MPs asked the government whether it condones live-animal military training such as shooting pigs and goat trauma drills, and whether Dutch soldiers take part in such training. The minister answered that the armed forces limit animal use as far as possible, that survival and trauma-surgery training uses pigs and rabbits or chickens under supervision, and that she cannot commit to ending such training for Dutch soldiers.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over hulp aan veteranen met PTSS

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about a game-based and virtual reality treatment for veterans with PTSD, including whether a Dutch game should be developed. The minister answered that VR is used in chronic PTSD treatment with 28 sessions so far, and that an effectiveness study started in 2010 will guide any decision on developing a game.
That is why I am having research carried out into the effectiveness of this innovative treatment for patients with PTSD.
Daarom laat ik onderzoek uitvoeren naar de effectiviteit van deze innovatieve behandeling voor patiënten met PTSS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de snelle slijtage van de nieuwe helikopters (NH-90)

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether the NH-90 helicopter is made by a sister company of the Fyra train manufacturer, whether this prompted a review of production and maintenance, what the financial consequences of rapid wear are, and what the operational consequences are for anti-piracy, Caribbean and future operations. The minister answered that the parent company Finmeccanica owns both Agusta Westland and AnsaldoBreda, that production and maintenance were not changed because of the Fyra, that a working group will report on financial and operational effects by end of April, and that 2014 operations proceed as planned.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform you further.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over nucleaire ontwapening en non-proliferatie

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the B61 nuclear bomb modernisation adds new military capabilities, citing claims of greater precision, yield reduction and F-35 compatibility. The government answered that the US-run life-extension programme adds no new military capabilities, that the Netherlands has no say in it, and that it will not speculate on Russian reactions.
The cabinet is not responsible for the content and implementation of the US life-extension programme and therefore makes no statements about the US Government Accountability Office's claims on this.

Het kabinet is niet verantwoordelijk voor inhoud en uitvoering van het Amerikaanse levensduurverlengingsprogramma en doet dan ook geen uitspraken over beweringen van de Amerikaanse Rekenkamer hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een schietincident in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked why witness statements from Iraqi ICDC soldiers in the 2004 Ar Rumaythah shooting case were not treated as relevant by the prosecutor and only sent to the European Court now, and whether the prosecution withheld them. The minister answers that the statements' brief content was in the KMAR file and seen by counsel in 2007, that the full statements were only sent to the court in 2012 at the state's initiative, and rejects claims of deliberate concealment and perjury.
The suggestion that these statements were deliberately withheld by the prosecution for years is firmly rejected.
Met kracht wordt de suggestie verworpen dat deze verklaringen jarenlang «opzettelijk door het OM zijn achtergehouden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about a Pentagon test report describing serious problems with the F-35 software, reliability and possible delays, and whether this would change Dutch planning. The minister replied that the report contained no major new problems, that the delay of up to 13 months could be absorbed by Dutch timelines, and that no replanning was needed.
Defence closely follows developments. In the upcoming annual report I will inform you again about the status of the F-35 programme.
Defensie volgt de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend. In de komende jaarrapportage zal ik u opnieuw informeren over de stand van zaken van het F-35 programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een door de vredesmacht United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) gerapporteerd incident in 1980

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a 1980 UNIFIL incident in which Dutch peacekeepers reported Israeli forces blowing up bodies of Palestinian fighters, and whether this was a war crime. The government answered that it took the report seriously, that the UN inquiry found the Dutch acted in good faith but could not verify their observations, and that it sees no reason to revisit its position or to call it a war crime.
The cabinet is aware of the observations voiced in Andere Tijden, but sees no reason to reconsider the position stated above.
Het kabinet is bekend met de observaties, zoals geuit in Andere Tijden, maar ziet geen aanleiding het hiervoor genoemde standpunt te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Vuijk over het zelden vooraf bekend maken van dronevluchten

Two VVD MPs asked why only 9 percent of drone flights were announced in advance in 2013 compared with 87 percent in 2011, and why flights were announced afterwards rather than beforehand, including how this relates to privacy rules. The minister explained the drop by a 2012 decision removing the separate airspace application for training flights, said civil authorities decide on pre- or post-flight publication, and stated the camera footage does not show identifiable persons.
With a view to the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights in advance.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk om vluchten van te voren aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat slechts negen procent van de door Defensie goedgekeurde dronevluchten van te voren bekend gemaakt is

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked why only nine percent of approved Defence drone flights were announced in advance and whether this is proportionate and privacy-respecting. The minister denied the figure as framed, explained that the 2012 change in procedure means fewer flights are published in the Staatscourant, described retention rules for drone footage, and declined to commit to publishing all flights in advance, citing investigation confidentiality.
In view of the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights before their deployment.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk vluchten voor de inzet aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de inlichtingenvergaring in Burum naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Nieuwsuur op 13 januari 2014

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence and Interior ministers about signals intelligence activities at Burum after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, including US equipment, oversight, and payments. The minister replied that Inmarsat provides commercial telecom services under Dutch law supervised by the Agentschap Telecom, that AIVD and MIVD have no indications of intelligence activity at Burum, and gave general answers on cooperation with partner services and US Government Network questions.
No public statements can be made about the partner services.
Over de partnerdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Landmacht betwijfelt inzetbaarheid Patriots in Turkije’

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister whether the Patriot missile systems in Turkey were struggling with heat, dust, parts delays and overdue maintenance, and why Parliament had not been informed earlier. The minister acknowledged strain and logistic efforts, said the systems remain reliable, and promised to inform Parliament if structural deployability were at risk and to address the issue in a later evaluation.
If circumstances arise that would put the structural deployability of Patriot in jeopardy, your House will be informed about this.
Indien er zich omstandigheden voordoen waardoor de structurele inzetbaarheid van Patriot alsnog in het geding zou komen, wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat zeemansgraven worden geschonden

D66 MPs asked whether the wreck of Dutch submarine O-16 in the South China Sea, possibly disturbed by a Cambodian salvage vessel, constitutes grave desecration, what happened to the crew's remains, whether international criminal prohibition should be pursued, and for an overview of sunk WWII Dutch ships. The government said the disturbance would be unlawful, that criminalisation exists via international legal assistance, that Cambodian authorities have not yet replied, and that it would not publish a wreck overview for fear of provoking further incidents.
Moreover, making such an overview public is not expedient, as it could precisely provoke more incidents.
Daarbij is het openbaar maken van een dergelijk overzicht niet opportuun, omdat daarmee juist meer incidenten zouden kunnen worden uitgelokt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over munitiestortplaats Engelsmanplaat (Waddenzee)

Two MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a WWII munitions dump near the Engelsmanplaat in the Wadden Sea, including whether it is monitored and who is responsible. The government answered that the dump lies under about 10 metres of sand, is covered by regular Rijkswaterstaat bed and water-quality surveys, and that the Ministry of Defence's EOD handles explosives clearance.
Rijkswaterstaat includes this area in the regular six-yearly depth measurements of the Wadden Sea region.
Rijkswaterstaat neemt dit gebied in het kader van de reguliere 6-jaarlijkse dieptemetingen van het Waddenzeegebied mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘Mali-missie in matig pak’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether union claims that combat uniforms for the Mali mission are of inferior quality are true, whether NATO allies use TenCate's Defender M fabric, and whether Defence leaked TenCate fabric samples to China and Indonesia. The minister answered that the uniforms meet procurement requirements, that only the United States currently uses Defender M-based uniforms, and that the allegation about leaked samples is incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Mali-missie in matig pak’

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked the Defence Minister whether combat uniforms for the Mali mission were chosen for financial reasons, were of inferior quality, and offered less fire protection than Dutch-made Defender M fabric. The Minister denied buying inferior clothing, said the current desert-pattern uniform meets the set requirements, and promised to inform parliament on the new combat clothing requirement later this year.
Once the requirement for the new combat clothing has been established, I will inform the House about it, in line with the Defence Materiel Process.
Zodra de behoefte aan de nieuwe gevechtskleding is vastgesteld, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren, in overeenstemming met het Defensie Materieel Proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de methode datamining

An MP asks two ministers whether the ARGO II intelligence processing system amounts to data mining, given that the Interior Minister in 2010 rejected data mining while Defence was preparing ARGO II. The Defence Minister answers that ARGO II only processes SIGINT already collected within the 2002 intelligence law and does not exploit databases indiscriminately, so the two positions are reconcilable.
ARGO II replaces ARGO I, the MIVD's current processing system for SIGINT (Signals Intelligence).
ARGO II vervangt ARGO I, het huidige verwerkingssysteem van SIGINT (Signals Intelligence – verbindingsinlichtingen) van de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over vertrouwelijke bijlages bij CTIVD-rapporten

An MP asked whether Snowden's revelations warrant publishing the secret annexes to several CTIVD oversight reports on the AIVD and MIVD, and why those annexes should stay secret. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wiv 2002 requires methods, sources and knowledge levels to be kept out of public reports, so the annexes cannot be published or shared beyond the CIVD, which already received them.
I therefore see no possibility to make the secret annexes public, nor to make them available for confidential inspection to any other part of your House than the CIVD
Ik zie dan ook geen mogelijkheden om geheime bijlagen openbaar te maken, noch om deze vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen aan enig ander onderdeel van uw Kamer dan de CIVD
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde

SP MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about risks, oversight, and remediation options for the Oosterschelde munitions dump, following an EenVandaag report. The minister replied that TNO studies found spontaneous explosion practically nil and no proven environmental harm, that monitoring continues with added measures in 2014, and that remediation (estimated at €7 million in 2004) was not pursued because risks are low.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dump will be measured monthly.
In 2014 zal de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks worden gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Eijsink en Albert de Vries over de rapportage ‘Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde is “tikkende tijdbom”

MPs Jacobi, Eijsink and Albert de Vries asked the ministers whether the WWII munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde pose a danger to people and nature, and whether new research is needed after a media report called it a ticking time bomb. The Minister of Defence answered that TNO research shows spontaneous detonation is practically impossible and that environmental effects are not demonstrated, while monthly water and mussel monitoring will be carried out in 2014 and Parliament will be informed of results if needed.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dumping site will be measured monthly.
In 2014 wordt de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Klaveren over een jihadistische ex-militair

Two MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether a former Dutch soldier who served in 2009-2010 is now fighting as a jihadist in Syria, whether others have done so, and whether participating in jihad should mean loss of Dutch nationality. The minister confirmed the report is likely accurate, said two other ex-soldiers are possibly fighting, and explained that nationality can be revoked only after a final conviction for a terrorist offence, only if the person holds another nationality, and only for offences committed after 1 October 2010.
For every person returning from Syria, it is examined whether criminal action is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over drugsmokkel op Schiphol

MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked whether employees arrested for drug smuggling at Schiphol held security-screened positions, whether screening is backlogged, and what measures are needed to prevent insiders from exploiting their positions. The minister answered that eight of fifteen arrested workers held screened positions, that there is no screening backlog, and that screening is one link in a broader security chain, with the overall safety of Schiphol judged good.
There is no backlog in carrying out security investigations.
Er is geen achterstand met betrekking tot het uitvoeren van veiligheidsonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht ‘Geheime dienst wijst legerliefjes af’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Defence personnel may only have relationships with partners from countries with which the MIVD or AIVD cooperates, how security clearance criteria work, and whether the policy breaches the right to family life under article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that partners are checked in security investigations, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens found an objective justification for the policy, and that in September 2010 to December 2012 five clearances were withdrawn and 25 refused due to insufficient data from time abroad.
If the security investigation yields insufficient data on the (partner of the) (prospective) position-of-trust holder, an assessment is not possible.
Indien het veiligheidsonderzoek onvoldoende gegevens oplevert over de (partner van) de (aspirant)vertrouwensfunctionaris, is een beoordeling niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de minister “persoonlijk sorry” heeft gezegd tegen haar Indonesische collega

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the defence minister apologised personally to her Indonesian counterpart over the handling of the Leopard tank deal, what that means versus formal apologies, whether the cabinet agreed to it, and whether it changes arms export policy. The minister said she personally regretted how the matter went, that formal apologies are not at issue, and that the statement does not change export policy, but declined to answer each question separately.
When asked, I said during the press meeting that I personally regret the course of events surrounding the planned delivery of tanks to Indonesia.
Ik heb desgevraagd tijdens de ontmoeting met de pers gezegd de gang van zaken rondom de voorgenomen levering van tanks aan Indonesië persoonlijk te betreuren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de schorsing van Sabra over een hernieuwd MIVD- onderzoek

An MP asked the Defence Minister how a convert to Islam with a partner linked to a convicted Hofstad group member could work for the Royal Marechaussee in sensitive posts without a timely MIVD security check, and whether such vacancies persist. The minister replied that a valid clearance existed, a renewed check was started in 2011 and closed in 2013 leading to an intended withdrawal, and that backlogs have been cleared, without disclosing the substantive reasons.
No public statements are made about the substantive reasons and considerations that led to the intention to withdraw the VGB.
Over de inhoudelijke redenen en afwegingen die geleid hebben tot het voornemen tot intrekking van de VGB worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over problemen met de JSF

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about reported quality problems with the F-35 (JSF), including 363 findings by the US Inspector General, cost and delay effects, inefficient management, and a quality-escape clause in contracts. The minister answered that the findings concern quality management rather than design, that no delays or cost increases arise yet, that the JPO adopts most recommendations, and that Dutch contracts will include guarantees against payment for substandard quality.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat onbestuurbare drones uit de lucht kunnen vallen bij regen of wind

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether Raven drones can fall from the sky in rain or wind and how many crashed, and who bears liability for damage. The Defence minister denied that nine Ravens crashed, described the Rijkerswoerdse Plassen emergency landing and other flights, and said the aircraft is not certified for icing or heavy rain, with operations stopped before limits are exceeded.
There is no question of nine Ravens having crashed.
Er is geen sprake van het neerstorten van negen Ravens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Justitie “superdrones” mag lenen van Defensie

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Justice Ministry may borrow Defence's new ScanEagle drones, and about privacy, airspace safety, incident history and transparency. The ministers answered that the ScanEagle may in principle be deployed in support of civil authorities once personnel are qualified, that existing legal frameworks suffice, and that they will not ban flights or publish evaluations, citing ongoing investigations.
It is not standard procedure for the police to conclude every deployment of a Defence Raven with an evaluation.
Het is niet een standaardprocedure voor de politie om iedere inzet van een Raven van Defensie met een evaluatie af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Günal-Gezer over de toename van piraterij aan de Westkust van Afrika

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about rising piracy off West Africa, including requests from Dutch shipping companies, possible use of Vessel Protection Detachments, and international coordination. The ministers answered that coastal states bear primary responsibility within territorial waters, that five VPD requests were rejected, and that the government will study additional measures and raise the issue in EU discussions.
The cabinet wants, in consultation with the shipping sector, to investigate whether additional measures should be taken outside the territorial waters of West African states, such as deploying VPDs.
Het kabinet wil, in overleg met de koopvaardijsector, onderzoeken of er aanvullende maatregelen moeten worden genomen buiten de TTW van West-Afrikaanse staten, zoals de inzet van VPD's.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether FRAGO 242, a British order under MND-SE, was known to Dutch contingent command beyond the detachment commanders. The minister answered that archives and personnel were searched and no reference to FRAGO 242 was found.
FRAGO 242 or references to it were not found in this regard.
FRAGO 242 of verwijzingen hiernaar zijn hierbij niet aangetroffen.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government would act after the Supreme Court rejected the review request of two conscientious objectors convicted in the 1950s for refusing service in the Dutch East Indies, including whether it would legislate rehabilitation. The Defence minister answered no: judges applied the norms of the time, reassessing conduct by today's standards would not be careful, and no rehabilitation law is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

An MP asked whether Dutch courts' 2013 rulings on Indonesia-era conscientious objectors imply that political bodies should consider rehabilitating them, and whether their convictions and rehabilitation can be reconsidered. The minister answered that such assessments belong to politics, that the military deployment had democratic legitimacy and the law then provided for conscientious objection, and that reassessing individual conduct by today's standards would not be careful, so no further rehabilitation mechanism is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het bericht ‘Militairen bij het grof vuil gezet’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about a report that soldiers were dismissed by standard letter during reorganisation, and whether personal contact and aftercare were ensured. The minister answered that dismissal follows a long, personal guidance process, that standard letters are used because their text is nearly identical, and that aftercare is guaranteed for 18 months and beyond.
Since the text of such a letter, arising from the legal position, is almost always identical, Defence uses standard dismissal letters automatically generated by the Dienstencentrum Human Resources.

Aangezien de uit de rechtspositie voortvloeiende tekst van een dergelijke brief in vrijwel alle gevallen identiek is hanteert Defensie standaard ontslagbrieven die automatisch worden opgesteld door het Dienstencentrum Human Resources ( DC HR ).
Antwoord vragen Knops over het bericht ‘Militairen bij het grof vuil gezet’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether hundreds of military and civilian staff received automatically generated, unsigned dismissal letters, why this happened, and what will be done about dignified farewells. The minister acknowledged the letters were standard template letters generated automatically, said signing was delayed by technical issues, and promised attention to personal farewells without committing to a concrete new measure.
For technical reasons, signing of appointment and dismissal letters for military personnel was only possible since last May.
Om technische redenen was ondertekening van aanstellings- en ontslagbrieven aan militairen pas mogelijk sinds mei jongstleden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht “Reservisten NATRES laten zich de vrijwilligersmedaille niet afpakken”

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Openbare Orde en Veiligheid volunteer medal is being abolished for NATRES reservists, whether this removes their eligibility, and what the reasons are. The minister replied that the medal is not abolished but will no longer be awarded to NATRES reservists from 1 January 2014, because it overlaps with existing service decorations and Defence does not decorate twice for the same act, and that the ministry is examining extending krijgsmachtdeelmedailles to reservists.
For these reasons I have decided that from 1 January 2014 the Volunteer Medal will no longer be awarded to NATRES reservists.
Ik heb om die redenen besloten de Vrijwilligersmedaille vanaf 1 januari 2014 niet meer toe te kennen aan reservisten van de NATRES.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Wilders en De Roon over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Defence minister about a military exercise in Amsterdam neighbourhoods, questioning its purpose, whether soldiers should be taught about Islam, and whether mosque construction is facilitated abroad. The minister replied that contact with local populations is standard training, that cultural customs are respected where needed, and that soldiers do not interfere in local opinions, though infrastructure reconstruction may occur on missions.
Soldiers train daily for all possible deployments and missions of the armed forces within their legal tasks at home and abroad.
Militairen oefenen dagelijks voor alle mogelijke inzet en missies van de krijgsmacht in het kader van de wettelijke taken in binnen- en buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt betreffende de zorg aan militairen die niet onder de Zorgverzekeringswet valt

Two CDA MPs asked why active-duty soldiers, who are outside the Zorgverzekeringswet, end up with a higher taxable income and lower benefits than comparable employees, and whether this was deliberate. The State Secretary confirmed the difference, explained that soldiers' health costs run through the military insurer SZVK with a taxable employer share, called it a consequence of soldiers' special position and the Wet ULB, and described a one-off 2013 fix with a structural solution to follow for 2014.
For 2014 and onward, work is under way on a structural solution.
Voor 2014 en verder wordt gewerkt aan een structurele oplossing
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de (mogelijke) inhuur van private bedrijven of particulieren door de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence Minister about outsourcing of military work to private firms and individuals, including a full overview of contractors, staffing figures, legal frameworks applicable to civilian contractors, and whether they may do more than government personnel. The minister said a complete overview is not readily available, provided a 2011 list of the top 100 contractors and an external-hire expenditure table (about 2.3 percent of wage bill), and stated that civilian contractors are not hired to perform work that law forbids the military to outsource.
A complete overview is not directly available and would be very extensive.
Een compleet overzicht is niet direct beschikbaar en zou zeer omvangrijk zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over een eventuele bijdrage van Nederland aan de EU trainingsmissie in Mali

Christian Democrat MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the Netherlands offered troops to the EU training mission in Mali without informing parliament, why the offer was not coordinated with Belgium, and whether defence cuts motivated participation. The government answered that the offer was made under political reservation during the force generation process, that the mission had no current need for it, and that participation decisions rest on substantive grounds, not budget considerations.
If the cabinet again considers a Dutch contribution in the future, the House will be informed about it.
Als het kabinet in de toekomst opnieuw een Nederlandse bijdrage overweegt, wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht “Afghaanse tolk vreest bijltjesdag”

D66 MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether Afghan interpreters working for the Dutch mission in Kunduz face danger after the withdrawal, how many are employed, whether asylum claims are expected, and whether a lighter regime or contact with Germany is planned. The ministers replied that the situation is unforeseeable, some safety measures and an inventory have been made, four monitors and sixteen interpreters are under German contracts, asylum claims are assessed individually without a special collective scheme, and contact with Germany exists.
We see no reason for a special (collective) arrangement.
We zien geen aanleiding voor een bijzondere (collectieve) regeling.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over FRAGO 242

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister whether the Guardian's claim that directive FRAGO 242 was circulated among coalition troops in Iraq is true, and about Dutch reporting rules, SFIR reports on violations of the laws of war, and US/UK command orders. The minister answered that Dutch detachment commanders were unaware of FRAGO 242, that Dutch rules on reporting suspected offences existed in internal regulations, and that the matter was otherwise handled through national procedures and earlier parliamentary reports.
The successive Dutch detachment commanders operating under the command of the British headquarters MND-SE were not aware of FRAGO 242.
De achtereenvolgende Nederlandse detachementscommandanten die opereerden onder het commando van het Britse hoofdkwartier MND-SE waren niet bekend met FRAGO 242.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over de inzet van onbemande vliegtuigjes (‘drones’) zonder toestemming van de gemeente door de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de politie in Soesterberg

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Royal Marechaussee and police used Raven drones for traffic checks in Soesterberg without informing the local authority, and how that fits with the military assistance procedure. The government admits the assistance procedure was not followed, that the local authority was not asked, that it has instructed all involved to follow the procedure in future, and that a police-wide drone policy is being developed.
Because the assistance procedure was not followed, the authority never got to the question of subsidiarity and proportionality.
Doordat de bijstandprocedure niet is gevolgd, is het gezag niet toegekomen aan de subsidiariteit- en proportionaliteitsvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over het bericht ‘Chinese hackers stelen ontwerp JSF en Patriot-raket’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Chinese hackers stole designs of the JSF fighter and Patriot missile, and about the consequences and measures taken. The minister declined to comment on US measures, said the F-35's operational data is highly classified and not internet-accessible, and that the MIVD works with partners to counter digital espionage, without committing to a specific new step.
For security reasons, the US Department of Defense does not comment on reports of possible infiltration of its computer systems.
Het Amerikaanse ministerie van Defensie gaat om veiligheidsredenen niet in op berichten over mogelijke infiltraties van hun computersystemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over betalingen aan krijgsheren, drugsbaronnen en de Taliban in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether CIA cash payments in Afghanistan reached warlords and the Taliban and whether Dutch funds did too. The government said it had no information on the CIA payments, that Dutch aid might not be fully protected from reaching informal power holders, and described its risk analysis and controls.
The government has no information that such payments were made and therefore cannot confirm that there was no critical oversight of the use of such payments.

De regering heeft geen informatie dat dergelijke betalingen zijn gedaan en kan daarom evenmin bevestigen dat er geen kritisch toezicht op de besteding van dergelijke betalingen zou hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Segers over de rol van de geestelijk verzorgers bij reorganisaties

MPs Eijsink and Segers asked the Defence Minister about the role of military chaplains during reorganisation, including support for soldiers dismissed as a result. The minister acknowledged the chaplains' importance, said chaplain posts stay unchanged until 1 January 2016 with a review ongoing, and explained that dismissed personnel are followed and supported through an external placement organisation.
For the period after 1 January 2016, a study is underway.
Voor de periode na 1 januari 2016 is een onderzoek gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het opinieartikel «Lesje in staatsrecht helpt tegen afbraak van essentiële taken» van defensiedeskundige De Wijk

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about a newspaper op-ed claiming new budget cuts of about 400 million euros on Defence, staff uncertainty, and the timing of a future-of-the-armed-forces vision. The minister denied extra cuts beyond already-known measures, listed the existing budget reductions, and promised the vision document before the 2014 Defence budget debate.
The note will be sent to you as soon as possible, but no later than the Defence budget debate later this year.
De nota zal u zo spoedig mogelijk worden toegestuurd, doch uiterlijk voor de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie later dit jaar.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en De Graaf over radarproblemen door windturbines

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether wind turbines can disrupt military radar and create false alarms in the Netherlands, and whether Defence is informed or consulted about turbine plans. The minister confirmed turbines can disturb radar, described the Rarro 75 km radar disturbance zones and model-based testing with possible refusal or modification of projects, and reported nine false radar alarms since 2010 without fighter scrambles.
Around every military radar there is a so-called radar disturbance zone with a radius of 75 kilometres.
Rond elke militaire radar ligt een zogeheten radarverstoringsgebied met een straal van 75 kilometer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes over afgebroken 100 procentcontrole op harddrugs op Schiphol

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked whether a 100 percent drug control on a Paramaribo flight was stopped because passengers threatened to run amok, why it was not completed, what the usual seized weights are, and what guidelines apply to resistance. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, gives 2012 seizure figures of 339 kilograms of net cocaine from couriers plus 128 kilograms in cargo, and states that the Customs service calls in the Royal Marechaussee in case of violence or threats.
In case of resistance with violence or threat of violence, Customs calls in the Royal Marechaussee.
In geval van verzet met geweld of dreiging met geweld schakelt de Douane de Koninklijke Marechaussee in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een 100 procentcontrole door de Koninklijke Marechaussee is gestaakt vanwege het protest van passagiers

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence whether the Royal Marechaussee's full 100 percent check of a Suriname flight was halted due to passenger protest, and how such influence will be prevented in future. The minister confirmed the report, said the full check of all passengers and baggage found no weapons or narcotics and was not cut short, and stated that passengers cannot influence how checks are carried out, though a check may be stopped for passenger safety and welfare after a risk analysis.
Passengers cannot exert influence through protest over the manner in which the checks are carried out.
Passagiers kunnen door middel van protest geen invloed uitoefenen op de wijze van de uitvoering van de controles.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de Marine wederom ingeroepen moest worden om de watervoorziening op Saba te redden

MPs Hachchi and van Veldhoven asked about the Navy being called in again to supply water on Saba, the adequacy of the island's water supply, and the government's promised structural solution. The minister answered that a drinking water study was launched to produce a durable solution by summer 2013, that imported water is an emergency measure, and that the Caribbean Netherlands water law differs from the Drinkwaterwet.
The study will be ready around summer, after which it will be jointly determined with Saba which measures will be implemented.
Het onderzoek zal rond de zomer gereed zijn, waarna gezamenlijk met Saba zal worden bepaald welke maatregelen zullen worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Eijsink over het bericht “van de heer I.A. betreffende activiteiten die hij in Afghanistan voor Defensie zou hebben verricht”

MPs Van Bommel and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister whether a civilian, I.A., was involved in supplying weapons to Dutch soldiers in Afghanistan, and whether he was offered a 500,000 euro settlement with a limited validity period. The minister confirmed awareness of the claims but declined to discuss operational MIVD matters or individual cases in public, referring to an earlier letter.
I cannot make any public statements about operational matters concerning the MIVD.
Over operationele zaken betreffende de MIVD kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het delen van inlichtingen ten behoeve van drone aanvallen

SP MPs asked whether Dutch intelligence gathered in the region is shared with the United States and could be used for targeted drone killings, and whether Dutch officials risk prosecution. The minister confirmed awareness of a UK lawsuit, declined to say anything publicly about cooperation with foreign intelligence services, and stated that the UK case is not criminal prosecution.
No public statements can be made about cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
Over de samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over Turkije‘s oorlogstaal en de Nederlandse Patriotmissie

Two PVV MPs asked whether Turkey's accusation that Israel commits state terrorism, and Turkish minister Davutoglu's remarks urging Syria toward war, warrant summoning the Turkish ambassador and withdrawing Dutch Patriot missiles from Turkey. The government replied that Turkey said its remarks were criticism of Assad rather than an incitement to attack Israel, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for steps toward rapprochement, and that it has no information linking a Netherlands-based figure to the Ankara bombing; it rejected withdrawing the Patriots.
The Netherlands will continue to urge Turkey and Israel to take steps that make rapprochement possible.
Nederland zal verder bij Turkije en Israël blijven aandringen op stappen die toenadering mogelijk maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Eijsink over het bericht dat de Hydrografische Dienst de verschijning van de 1800-serie kaarten opschort

Two MPs asked whether suspending the spring publication of the 1800-series nautical charts endangers navigation safety and whether digital publication is possible. The government answered that safety is not compromised because free online notices to mariners keep charts current, that budget cuts and Northsea traffic-scheme changes justify ending the annual spring edition, and that a new system may enable digital editions.
The budget cuts at Defence also affect the processing and production capacity of the Hydrographic Service.
De bezuinigingen bij Defensie treffen ook de verwerking- en productiecapaciteit van de Dienst der Hydrografie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over steekpenningen bij een fregattendeal met Chili

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the government was involved in bribes paid in a 2004 frigate sale to Chile and about related Chilean prosecutions. The minister replied that Defence used no intermediaries, was not involved in the Chilean bribery, and that the Rijksrecherche handled a Chilean mutual legal assistance request but information could not be shared because it concerns an individual case, and the Public Prosecution Service would not say whether it would investigate De Schelde.
It is not possible to provide this information to the House of Representatives since it concerns an individual case.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze informatie aan de Tweede Kamer te verstrekken aangezien het een individuele zaak betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink over het militair strafproces

MP Eijsink asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence whether officer-counsels (officier-raadsman) in military criminal proceedings can be justified given their limited legal training, and whether this compromises fair trial rights under Salduz and the ECHR. The government answered that officers receive about one week of military criminal law training, that the modality functions satisfactorily, and that suspects may waive the right to a lawyer, so no unfair trial arises.
I have no indication that the training in practice fails to lead to adequate qualification.
Mij is niet gebleken dat het onderricht in de praktijk niet leidt tot een afdoende kwalificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over moslimextremisten in de krijgsmacht

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch military personnel with Islamist extremist views are infiltrating the armed forces, how many are monitored, and whether they can be dismissed as Belgium reportedly cannot. The minister answered that the MIVD contributes to security, that operational details cannot be disclosed publicly, that security clearances can be withdrawn leading usually to dismissal, and that there are currently no indications requiring measures against Belgian cooperation.
No public statements can be made about the operational affairs of the MIVD.
Over operationele aangelegenheden van de MIVD kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de Duitse weigering om wapens te vervoeren in verband met de Franse interventie in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Germany would not transport weapons or ammunition supporting the French intervention in Mali, and about Dutch aircraft via the EATC. The minister answered that Germany does not transport such cargo, that the Netherlands places no restrictions on cargo, that the KDC-10 has not yet been deployed, and that Dutch aircraft are currently not used for flights to Mali pending a safety review, with the Chamber to be informed of any positive decision.
If a positive decision is taken, the Chamber will be informed further.
Bij positief besluit wordt de Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht ‘Omwonenden blij met extra geluidsmetingen JSF’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether planned US noise measurements of the F-35 in spring 2013 were needed given existing RIVM and NLR studies, and whether those institutes would be involved. The minister answered that existing studies remain valid, the new US tests cover other F-35 variants and specific aspects, and NLR's expertise will be offered for the measurements while Netherlands will keep monitoring developments.
Defence will abide by the statutory noise contours.
Defensie zal zich houden aan de wettelijke geluidscontouren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Hennis-Plasschaert en Verheijen over het veiligheidsrisico van Chinese telecomproducenten

Three VVD MPs asked the government whether Chinese telecom producers pose a security risk to Dutch critical infrastructure, what steps will be taken to map such risks, and whether KPN and others will be questioned. The minister answers that vulnerabilities are a conceivable risk but there is no direct evidence of espionage use, that intelligence services remain alert and will warn relevant parties if concrete indications emerge, and that the matter will be raised actively with companies.
For the time being there is a conceivable risk, but there are no direct indications that these vulnerabilities are actually being used for espionage purposes.
Vooralsnog is hier sprake van een voorstelbaar risico, maar zijn er geen directe aanwijzingen dat deze kwetsbaarheden daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt voor spionagedoeleinden.
Antwoord vragen Knops over de bezuinigingen op Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether her earlier claim that there would be no further cuts to troops squared with the coalition agreement's budget reductions for Defence, including a €48m structural cut, a €250m reallocation to an international security fund, and an extra €84m target. The minister confirmed the statements, said the €48m cut will be filled with efficiency measures while operational units are protected, and committed to informing the Chamber on the financial effects before the budget debate.
Antwoord vragen Knops over het bericht problemen financiering AWACS basis Geilenkirchen

An MP from the CDA asked the Defence Minister about reports of a funding dispute over maintenance of the AWACS runway at Geilenkirchen, including France's refusal to pay its share and the consequences for timing and noise. The minister answered that NATO has not yet agreed on common funding, the runway works will be carried out in 2014 subject to agreement, the delay does not add noise, and the Chamber will be informed once NATO decides.
Once NATO has taken a decision on this, the Chamber will be informed.
Zodra de Navo daarover een besluit heeft genomen zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen–Wijbenga en Hennis–Plasschaert over de automatische registratie van de Turkse nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (GBA)

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether children of Turkish parents are wrongly registered with dual nationality in the GBA, whether that is undesirable, and what the status is of the Basisregistratie personen amendment limiting registration of foreign nationality. The minister answered that GBA registration is declaratory, that the Turkish authorities have not yet responded to a request for clarification, and that the planned amendment concerns registration of foreign nationality rather than its determination.
As soon as I have received the Turkish response, I will inform you about it.
Zodra ik de Turkse reactie heb ontvangen, zal ik u hierover informeren.

m: Motie van de leden Bonis en Ten Broeke over een toekomstvisie op het postennet
Asks the government to develop and share with the Chamber a future vision for the diplomatic post network before taking irreversible decisions on it.
requests the government, before taking irreversible decisions concerning the post network, to develop a future vision on the post network and share it with the Chamber
verzoekt de regering, alvorens onomkeerbare besluiten te nemen die het postennet aangaan, een toekomstvisie op het postennet te ontwikkelen en deze met de Kamer te delen
Motie van de leden Ten Broeke en Bonis over het handhaven van het Matra-programma
Asks the government not to implement part of the proposed cut to the Matra programme and to keep it available for Eastern Partnership countries.
requests the government to partly not implement the proposed cut to the Matra programme
verzoekt de regering, de voorgestelde bezuiniging op het Matra-programma deels niet door te voeren
Motie van de leden Van Ojik en Bonis over richtlijnen voor het Uitzendtoetsingskader
Asks the government to anchor civilian-protection obligations in guidelines and the Uitzendtoetsingskader for military deployments.
requests the government to anchor this in the Uitzendtoetsingskader
verzoekt de regering, dit te verankeren in het «Uitzendtoetsingskader»
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Bonis ter vervanging van nr. 49 over het toekennen van een bedrag aan het MATRA-programma
Reallocates 3 million euro within the foreign aid budget to the MATRA programme for civil society and democracy support in Eastern Partnership countries.
This amendment aims to allocate 3 million euro to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt om een bedrag van € 3 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma.
Motie van de leden Bonis en Ten Broeke over bescherming en bevordering van de mensenrechten van LHBTI's
Motion asks the government to consistently promote LGBTI human rights in foreign policy and support global NGO cooperation, with the Netherlands taking a leading role.
requests the government to consistently work in foreign policy for the protection and promotion of LGBTI human rights wherever in the world
verzoekt de regering, zich in het buitenlandbeleid stelselmatig in te zetten voor de bescherming en bevordering van de mensenrechten van LHBTI's waar ook ter wereld
Amendement van de leden Ten Broeke en Bonis over toekennen van een bedrag aan het MATRA-programma
Moves 3 million euros from the operational objective on peace and development to the MATRA programme for civil society and democracy in Eastern partner countries.
This amendment aims to allocate an amount of 3 million euros to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt om een bedrag van € 3 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma.
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Bonis over Israëlische luchtaanval op Damascus

An MP from the Labour Party asked the foreign minister about an Israeli airstrike on a Syrian military complex near Damascus, its escalation risks, and whether the government would seek clarification from Israel and push for an emergency UN Security Council session. The minister said the government is aware of the media reports, shares concern about spillover, has no information giving reason to ask Israel for clarification, and has repeatedly urged UN Security Council action.
I do not have information that gives me cause to ask the Israeli government for clarification.
Ik beschik niet over informatie die mij aanleiding geeft de Israëlische regering om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bonis over een wetsvoorstel van de Israëlische regering strekkende tot de gedwongen verplaatsing van tienduizenden bedoeïenen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the Israeli government's bill to forcibly relocate 20,000 to 40,000 Bedouin from the Negev into townships, whether he shares Amnesty's view that it violates international law, and whether he will press Israel on it during his visit. The minister confirms awareness, declines to judge a bill still before the Israeli legislature, and states that the Netherlands engages Israel structurally on human rights including the Arab minority.
It is not for the Dutch cabinet to pass judgment on a bill that still has to be definitively assessed by the Israeli legislature.
Het is niet aan het Nederlandse kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over een wetsvoorstel dat nog definitief door de Israëlische wetgevende macht moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord vragen Maij, Servaes en Bonis over voorgestelde wetgeving in Litouwen en Macedonië die de toegang tot abortus zal beperken

Three PvdA MPs asked the Dutch government whether it is aware of proposed abortion restrictions in Lithuania and North Macedonia, whether it considers this worrying for women's health and rights, and whether it will raise concerns with those governments. The minister replied that reproductive rights are fundamental human rights and that Dutch concern is noted, that a Lithuanian bill is pending in committee and a Macedonian law is said by its government not to be more restrictive, and that the Netherlands will raise reproductive health policy in human rights reporting forums.

The Netherlands will raise the policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, including abortion legislation and its implementation, in the appropriate forums during the review of human rights reports.

Nederland zal bij de behandeling van mensenrechtenrapportages het beleid omrent Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten, inclusief abortuswetgeving en de uitvoering daarvan aan de orde stellen in de daarvoor geëigende gremia.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind Bonis en Thieme over financiering van bouwprojecten in India waar schending van arbeids- en kinderrechten plaatsvindt

MPs Voordewind, Bonis and Thieme asked whether Dutch-funded Asian Development Bank projects in India involve child labour and labour rights abuses, and what the Netherlands will do about oversight and sanctions. Minister Ploumen answered that the ADB has labour standards in its contracts and monitoring mechanisms, that the Netherlands has pressed the bank to strengthen complaint and sanction mechanisms, and that she will ask Dutch-represented constituencies at other development banks to scrutinise labour standards.
In talks with the ADB, the Netherlands has pointed out that complaint handling, a sanctions mechanism and monitoring are important.
Nederland heeft in gesprek met de ADB erop gewezen klachtenbehandeling, een sanctiemechanisme en monitoring belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bonis over mensenrechtensitutatie in Colombia

MPs Maij and Bonis asked the government about the deteriorating situation of human rights defenders in Colombia, land restitution in Curvaradó, threats and killings, impunity, and implementation of court rulings. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these concerns in dialogue with Colombian authorities, will press for investigation and prosecution at the Universal Periodic Review and in political dialogue, and will urge implementation of court rulings.
I will press the Colombian authorities for investigation, prosecution and punishment to prevent repetition.
Ik zal bij de Colombiaanse autoriteiten aandringen op onderzoek, berechting en bestraffing om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Bonis over de arrestatie en vervolgens vrijlating van de Nederlandse journaliste Rena Netjes in Cairo

MPs from VVD, D66, SP and PvdA asked the foreign minister about the arrest and release of Dutch journalist Rena Netjes in Cairo, including whether a citizen's arrest could fuel a witch-hunt against Western journalists. The minister confirmed no formal charge was filed, described ambassador contact with the Egyptian prosecutor leading to her release, and said the Egyptian authorities found the citizen's arrest unlawful.
As far as the embassy in Cairo could verify, there was no official charge against Ms Netjes.
Er is voor zover door de ambassade in Cairo kon worden nagegaan geen officiële aanklacht tegen mevrouw Netjes geweest.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked the foreign minister about Palestinian detainees Samer Issawi and Ayman Sharawneh in Israeli custody, including administrative detention, alleged mistreatment and the death of Arafat Jaradat. The minister replied that there is no administrative detention in these cases, that the Netherlands and the EU monitor the situation and raised it with Israel, and that an independent inquiry into Jaradat's death should follow with findings made public.
There is no question of administrative detention.
Er is geen sprake van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the imprisonment of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, the outcome of an Iranian parliamentary inquiry, the conviction of lawyer Mohammad Ali Dadkhah, and EU action. The minister described her sentence, said the Iranian delegation's findings may not be published, confirmed Dadkhah's sentence and Dutch concern, and reported new EU sanctions and repeated EU calls for release.
If the results of their inquiry are made public, which is not certain, I will share them with your House.
Als de resultaten van hun onderzoek publiek worden gemaakt, wat niet zeker is, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer mededelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bonis over het bericht ‘Ironies of (In)justice in Ukraine and Strasbourg’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Strasbourg court ruling (Volkov v. Ukraine) on judicial independence in Ukraine and the alleged role of a PACE rapporteur, asking whether the government would raise the matter and press for Volkov's reinstatement. The minister said the PACE appoints its own rapporteurs and governments should not interfere, that Ukraine is bound to remedy the structural problems under Article 46 ECHR with supervision by the Committee of Ministers, and that the Netherlands will raise rule-of-law concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
The Netherlands will certainly hold Ukraine to account on this in the Committee of Ministers in case of non-compliance.
Nederland zal in het Comité van Ministers Oekraïne bij niet-nakoming zeker daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Bonis over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

MPs Van Bommel and Bonis asked the Foreign Minister about Iranian prisoner Nasrin Sotoudeh, her hunger strike, restrictions on family and lawyer access, her medical care, the number of conscience prisoners in Iran, and whether the government will press for her release. The minister confirmed the situation, said the Netherlands and the EU call for her immediate release and have raised it repeatedly with Iran, but could not give reliable figures on prisoners or details of her health.
The EU, partly on Dutch initiative, has repeatedly urged the Iranian authorities to immediately release Ms Sotoudeh.
De EU heeft bij de Iraanse autoriteiten – mede op Nederlands initiatief – herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op onmiddellijke vrijlating van mevrouw Sotoudeh.
Antwoord vragen Bonis over de Israëlische aankondiging van de bouw van woningen in Oost-Jeruzalem en op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he condemns Israel's announced construction of about 1,300 homes in East Jerusalem and the West Bank as contrary to international law, and whether he will raise it with EU partners. The minister answered that the settlements violate international law, that he condemned the announcement, and that the EU has repeatedly urged Israel to halt settlement expansion and the Netherlands consults with EU partners on it.
I have therefore condemned the announcement.
Ik heb de aankondiging dan ook veroordeeld.

qn: Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het slopen van twee monumentale boer

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the planned demolition of two historic farm buildings on the De Horsten estate in Wassenaar, to make way for luxury villas, is acceptable given royal involvement and state funding. The government replied that the estate is privately owned, the buildings are dilapidated and non-viable, and that the municipality of Wassenaar must decide on the demolition permit.
It is up to the municipality to decide on the permit applications for Eikenhorst 3 and Raaphorst 5 that have come up in the media.
Het is aan de gemeente om een beslissing te nemen over de in de publiciteit aan de orde gekomen vergunningaanvragen met betrekking tot Eikenhorst 3 en Raaphorst 5.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister president, de minister van Algemene zaken en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de exploitatie van het landgoed De Horsten te Wassenaar

An MP asked the Prime Minister and ministers about the planned demolition of two farm buildings on the De Horsten estate in Wassenaar, a private estate linked to the royal family, and whether the government was involved in refusing monument status and granting a demolition permit. The government answered that the estate is privately owned, that the buildings are dilapidated and unprofitable, that the municipality decides on the permit under normal procedures, and that the planned residence of Princess Máxima's parents is unrelated to the demolition.
It is up to the municipality to decide on the permit applications for Eikenhorst 3 and Raaphorst 5 that have been in the public eye.
Het is aan de gemeente om een beslissing te nemen over de in de publiciteit aan de orde gekomen vergunningaanvragen met betrekking tot Eikenhorst 3 en Raaphorst 5.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks) en Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de vakantie van Z.K.H. kroonprins Willem Alexander en H.K.H. prinses Maxima te Mozambique (ingezonden

MPs Van Gent and Van Raak asked the Prime Minister whether the Crown Prince's family's holiday in Mozambique, at a villa tied to a controversial development, is consistent with his pledge to sell the villa once finished, and whether the minister knew of the trip in advance. The Prime Minister confirmed the visit, said the couple will sell the villa after completion, said the trip was a private matter, and referred the wider constitutional question to a pending Council of State advisory opinion.
For the rest I refer to the advice I recently requested from the Council of State on the tension between articles 10, 41, 42 and 68 of the Constitution.
Voor het overige verwijs ik naar de voorlichting die ik onlangs heb gevraagd aan de Raad van State over de spanning tussen de artikelen 10, 41, 42 en 68 van de Grondwet.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GL) aan de minister-president en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de herdenking van het drama in Srebrenica (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would attend the 15th anniversary commemoration of Srebrenica and whether the request was desirable given Dutch historical involvement. The government answered that Defence Minister Van Middelkoop will represent the government at the commemoration, which it considers a clear gesture of continued Dutch commitment.
On behalf of the Dutch government, Defence Minister Eimert van Middelkoop will attend the commemoration in Srebrenica marking the events there 15 years ago.
Namens de Nederlandse regering zal op de bijeenkomst in Srebrenica ter herdenking van de gebeurtenissen aldaar 15 jaar geleden, de Minister van Defensie, de heer Eimert van Middelkoop, aanwezig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Wilders (PVV) aan de minister-president over de oud-informateur Tjeenk Willink (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

Wilders asks the prime minister whether the informateur Tjeenk Willink showed partiality by proposing that the government refuse countersignature of majority-backed initiative bills and by making political remarks outside his mandate, and whether the Crown could stop appointing him or he could be dismissed as vice-president of the Raad van State. Balkenende rejects the characterisation, says an informateur acts for the negotiating parties and is judged by the parliamentary party leaders, that the Raad van State question is not relevant, and that he opposes a constitutional change removing the head of state from government.

An informateur himself takes responsibility for accepting an information mandate and for the manner in which it is carried out, during the information process subject to assessment by the party leaders concerned.

Een informateur neemt zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor de aanvaarding van een informatieopdracht en voor de wijze waarop deze wordt ingevuld, zulks gedurende het informatieproces ter beoordeling van de betrokken fractievoorzitters

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66) en Halsema (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, en de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Justitie, van Defensie en van Buite

MPs Van der Ham and Halsema asked the government whether archives contain documents on the affair described in the book ZKH about Prince Bernhard, why the 'Unity of the Crown' exception still applies after abdication, and whether access restrictions and classification should be reformed. The government said the relevant archives hold no such documents apart from a search still under way, that the exception is not limited to a person, that the Archives Act need not change, and declined to commission a NIOD study.

The provision in the Public Access to Government Information Act (article 10, first paragraph, under a) concerning the unity of the Crown is intended to protect the function of the Crown in the constitutional order and contains no restriction in personal terms.

De bepaling in de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (artikel 10, eerste lid, onder a) met betrekking tot de eenheid van de Kroon strekt ter bescherming van de functie hiervan in het staatkundig bestel en bevat geen beperking in personele zin.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over nadere informatie over de betrokkenheid van het fregat Van Nes en van het Korps Commandotroepen bij de illegale inval in
